title: Raakh
summary:
Raakh is a 2026 Hindi-language crime thriller television series created by Anusha Nandakumar, Sandeep Saket, and Prosit Roy. It stars Ali Fazal, Sonali Bendre, Akash Makhija, Rakesh Bedi, Ramandeep Yadav, and Aamir Bashir.
Inspired by the Ranga–Billa case, the series depicts the abduction of two siblings and the police investigation into their disappearance.
plot: In 1978, the disappearance of two teenage siblings shakes New Delhi and devastates a close-knit family. As public fear grows, a determined police officer leads an intensive nationwide manhunt that uncovers a chilling world of violence and cruelty.
reception:
Hollywood Reporter India reviewer Rahul Desai called the series "does well to stay rooted in the anatomy of crime in a pre-technology and early-forensics era." The Indian Express reviewer Shubhra Gupta stated "What’s nice is the way the writers show us that a child can be inherently depraved and violent." NDTV reviewer Tanisha Bhattacharya stated the series boils blood.
Rediff.com reviewer Deepa Gahlot felt "excessive violence is disturbing", but praised Ali Fazal's performance as "one of his best performances so far." Renuka Vyavahare of The Times of India gave 3.5 stars and said that "Raakh is unsettling, disturbing, and difficult to watch at times, but undeniably important viewing." India Today reviewer Vineeta Kumar called the series as "gritty, atmospheric and impeccably performed."
Bollywood Hungama critics rated it 3.5/5 stars and writes that "RAAKH is a hard-hitting and disturbing series that works due to its gripping narrative, atmospheric treatment and strong performances." Anuj Kumar of The Hindu observed that "Raakh’ is an immersive investigative crime drama that sifts through Delhi’s lost innocence."
Vinamra Mathur of Firstpost gave 3 stars out of 5 and said that "Raakh has more meaning than one. Given how we continue to struggle as a country, we are literally burning to the ashes." Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in writes in her review that "Raakh doesn’t give a proper sense of the time taken to catch the killers, nor of the way in which time itself might have moved more slowly all those decades ago." Rachit Gupta writing for Filmfare gave 4 stars out of 5 and stated that "What makes Raakh truly rare is its genre obscurity. It arrives as a procedural, operates as a thriller and lands as horror."
Cinema Express reviewer BH Harsh rated the series 4/5 stars and writes "the makers also show resistance at many moments." The New Indian Express reviewer rated the series 4 out off 5 stars.
The Quint reviewer felt the series "doesn’t give enough to the viewers to chew on." Kabir Singh Bhandari of The Free Press Journal stated that the series "is not an easy watch."

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The series was released on 12 June 2026 on Amazon Prime Video.

articleSections.title: Controversy
articleSections.text: Raakh generated controversy after viewers and commentators noted that several characters inspired by real people in the 1978 Ranga–Billa case had their religious and caste identities changed in the adaptation. Among the reported changes were the replacement of the Sikh perpetrators with fictional Hindu characters, the portrayal of a fictional Muslim police officer in place of a real Hindu officer, and the replacement of journalist Prabha Dutt and civilian Babulal with fictional Muslim characters. Critics argued that these changes altered the historical record, while others defended them as creative liberties typical of fictional adaptations.

episodesList.title: Gumshuda
episodesList.summary: Sixteen-year-old Suman Arora goes missing on the night of her radio performance, along with her younger brother Sahil. As panic grips their family, Sub-Inspector Jayprakash Jatav takes charge of the case. With rain washing out evidence and leads collapsing, the search intensifies-until a discovery in the Ridge forest changes everything.

episodesList.title: Jaanwar
episodesList.summary: As Suman and Sahil's murder shakes Delhi, JP uncovers critical clues about the car in which the kids were kidnapped. With mounting pressure to hand over the case, he races against time to act on the leads. In Bombay, a botched ransom ends in a child's death, sending Babu and Rajjo fleeing toward Delhi.

episodesList.title: Dhoomketu
episodesList.summary: An engraved murder weapon and two unidentified fingerprints give JP his first concrete lead. With only 48 hours to prove progress, he races to identify the sword's owner-and the men who carried out the crime.

episodesList.title: Rahu-Ketu
episodesList.summary: The discovery of another body confirms the murders are part of a larger pattern. When a key witness comes forward and identifies the two men responsible, JP finally has names. The investigation shifts from identification to a manhunt.

episodesList.title: Tilchatta
episodesList.summary: As the killers split up and attempt to disappear, JP tracks one trail to Sonipat while new links point toward Mumbai. Political pressure threatens to sideline him, but a fresh lead forces a difficult choice-follow orders, or follow the case beyond Delhi.

episodesList.title: Daitya
episodesList.summary: JP follows Babu's trail to Bombay and uncovers disturbing truths about his past. When Babu kills again and prepares to flee the city, JP pushes forward despite direct orders to stand down. The chase escalates into a high-stakes pursuit across states.

episodesList.title: Muttonwale Bauji ka Beta
episodesList.summary: Agra becomes the final battleground as JP tracks Babu and Rajjo to the same city. With the pressure mounting and exits closing fast, it becomes a race against time. Will the killers outrun the law once more?

episodesList.title: Hum Yahin Hain
episodesList.summary: The truth of what happened the day of the crime finally comes to light. In the present, the case reaches its final stage, leaving a grieving family-and a shaken city-to reckon with the aftermath.

title: Resort
summary:
Resort is an Indian Tamil-language culinary workplace comedy sitcom television series starring Vijay Kumar Rajendran, Abeneya Nethrun and Thalaivasal Vijay. The series is written by Vijay Kumar Rajendran and directed by Praveen Bennett for JioHotstar. The plot revolves follows Vetri, a 12th-fail room service boy with exceptional culinary talent and dreams of becoming a chef.
The principal characters of the series include Elango Kumanan , Dharshna Sripal Golecha, Ebi Rajhn, Kavipriya Jayavel, Keerthivel, Amar Keerthi, Vishnu Bala, Sai Dhanyaa, Badava Gopi,  Giri Dwarakish and Lallu.It premiered on JioHotstar on 13 March 2026.
plot: Set in the fictional RR Resort, the story centers on Vetri, a 12th-fail room service worker who dreams of becoming a professional chef. Despite possessing natural culinary talent, he faces constant humiliation and pressure from a ruthless kitchen hierarchy. Determined to prove himself, Vetri begins challenging the toxic system, navigating friendships, rivalry, and ambition in a high-stakes hospitality environment.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
The series was announced by JioHotstar on 9 December 2025 as part of its South UnBound content slate. The platform planned to launch nine new Tamil-language original shows under the initiative. Resort was developed as one of the projects in this lineup and was created as one of the Hotstar Specials series scheduled for release in 2026.
The series is directed by Praveen Bennett and written by Vijay Kumar Rajendran. It is produced by Global Villagers, a production company known for producing Tamil television serials such as Mahanadhi, Ayyanar Thunai and Kana Kaanum Kaalangal.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
The official glimpse of the series was released on 9 December 2025 by JioHotstar ahead of the series’ premiere, introducing the setting of a luxury resort and the central characters while highlighting the show’s blend of workplace drama and comedy.The first trailer was released on 2 March 2026, featuring Vetri joining the RR Resort as a housekeeping employee while aspiring to become a professional chef, as he faces the strict supervision of executive chef Nedumaaran, highlighting the series’ blend of workplace comedy, ambition, and drama.
It was announced that the series would be released in Tamil and other Indian languages and made its streaming debut on 13 March 2026.

articleSections.title: Critical response
articleSections.text: Siddartha Toleti of M9 News wrote that, "The four episodes of Resort precisely set the ground ready for the drama to marinate over the coming weeks. There is nothing overwhelmingly new about the story, clash and the drama, yet it is perfectly suited for timepass, inoffensive viewing, a bare minimum that we do not get to experience lately".

articleSections.title: Controversy
articleSections.text: At the middle of April 2026, Malayalam actress Anugraha S Nambiar, who plays the role of Srinidhi, released a video alleging that the makers of his web series Resort Producer and actor Vijay Kumar Rajendran and his wife have not paid her fee and have engaged in contractual traps.

episodesList.title: Hell's Kitchen
episodesList.summary: Vetri is a village boy burdened by his family responsibilities. His journey begins at RR Resort, where he comes face-to-face with Nedumaran, the resort kitchen's dictator.

episodesList.title: Unwitting Actions
episodesList.summary: Pandi guides Vetri through the resort to familiarise him with how things work there. Later, Aishu is harshly punished by Nedumaran because of Vetri's careless mistake.

episodesList.title: The Lid is Lifted
episodesList.summary: Vetri gets an opportunity to earn a living with his cooking. He comes across Nedumaran's signature soup. Meanwhile, an influencer couple raises a ruckus in the resort.

episodesList.title: Doomed
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran is enraged when Rajan speaks about cost-cutting. Vetri further aggravates his mood by selling his soup recipe from a street cart. Will Vetri survive Nedumaran's wrath?

episodesList.title: Be Irreplaceable
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran fumes as an inexperienced Vetri cracks his signature dish recipe. His plea to join the kitchen team is denied. Joji enjoys Vetri's Rasam rice. A prank on Aishu backfires.

episodesList.title: Behind the Mask
episodesList.summary: Joji tells Vetri that his Rasam rice reminded him of his college love. Aishu tries to sabotage Vetri's service by changing the dishes. Vetri finds out about Aishu's secret life.

episodesList.title: Wave of Nostalgia
episodesList.summary: Vetri plays cupid for Joji. Vetri's effort to make peace with Aishu fails. Aishu panics when she learns that Vetri is aware of her masked secret. Riya tries to patch up with Aishu.

episodesList.title: Ghost from the Past
episodesList.summary: Vetri helps Aishu and Veni with his cooking skills. Furious at first, Nedumaran is surprised when he tastes Vetri's dish. Later, he is shocked to learn who Vetri's father is.

episodesList.title: Frozen in Fear
episodesList.summary: Foreign guests like Vetri's dish, and he gets considered for the kitchen team. However, this opportunity rattles others in the kitchen.

episodesList.title: Opportunity or Adversity?
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran's decision about Vetri's entry into the kitchen shocks everyone. Will Vetri be up for the challenge?

episodesList.title: Gearing Up
episodesList.summary: Riya checks into the resort to comfort herself. Meanwhile, among gifts and sleeplessness, Vetri eagerly anticipates his big day in the kitchen.

episodesList.title: Lifeblood of the Kitchen
episodesList.summary: All prepared, Vetri delegates the day's menu to the kitchen staff. However, the new chef faces many struggles, the worst being the interruption of gas supply.

episodesList.title: Sense of Schadenfreude
episodesList.summary: Vetri rises to the challenge by using firewood stove and wins praises for the lunch menu. Seeing the kitchen's condition, Nedumaran throws Vetri out and is happy about his failure.

episodesList.title: Fresh Ally
episodesList.summary: Vetri's special Biryani request from the guests is rejected. Aishu stands up for Vetri when Vicky mocks him. She makes an appeal when Vetri and Pandi visit the bar where she sings.

episodesList.title: Comeuppance
episodesList.summary: The room service team gets targeted by the kitchen team after Vetri's failure. While Nedumaran announces Aishu as the new Sous Chef, he punishes Vicky for his reckless behaviour.

episodesList.title: Covetous Desire
episodesList.summary: Veni confronts Aishu for going against Vicky. Nedumaran feigns joy when Ragupathi informs him about handing over the resort to Riya. Deepak's announcement at the party shocks Riya.

episodesList.title: The Good Girl Syndrome
episodesList.summary: Ragupathi watches Riya being tortured by Deepak. Vetri and Aishu cook a special dish for Joji's date with his lady love. Aishu tries to tell her dad about her passion for singing.

episodesList.title: Emotional Armour
episodesList.summary: Ragupathi assures Riya of his support. Veni feels bad for Vicky who is frustrated with his room service job. Joji and Padma's date is ruined by Padma's daughter.

episodesList.title: Seething Anger
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran is angry as Ragupathi's request was actually Vetri's recipe. Joji bids adieu to Padma with a heavy heart. Vetri attends Nedumaran's call for Aishu by mistake.

episodesList.title: Face from the Past
episodesList.summary: Riya decides to continue staying at the resort. Rajan sorts an issue when John tries to blow it up. Nedumaran pretends not to recall Chidambaram when an old friend asks about him.

episodesList.title: Close Confidante
episodesList.summary: Aishu spots Veni and Vicky having an argument and feels betrayed. Though Rajan warns Riya, she tries to talk to Nedumaran about the food expenditure.

episodesList.title: Secret Kitchen
episodesList.summary: Vetri and Pandi hunt for a place and an investor to start their new business. Aishu tries talking to Vicky about Veni, which ends in disaster.

episodesList.title: Drifting Apart
episodesList.summary: Uthaman intervenes when Vetri and Vicky get into an intense argument. At Siva's birthday party, Veni sees Srinidhi and Vicky together, and she gets upset and drunk.

episodesList.title: Where is Chika?
episodesList.summary: Riya talks to Rajan about the resort's major problem: food. Vetri's dish from his secret kitchen gets mistakenly delivered to the wrong guest. Will Vetri get caught?

episodesList.title: Lovelorn Veni
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran ruins Riya's attempt to change things in the resort. Back in the kitchen team, Vicky breaks up with Veni. Vetri and Aishu save Veni when she tries to end her life.

episodesList.title: Delving into the Past
episodesList.summary: Leo's words remind Ragupathi of Chika and he decides to locate him. Nedumaran humiliates Aishu after seeing her with Vetri. Aishu learns about Vetri’s father and his family's past.

episodesList.title: The Supercilious Chef
episodesList.summary: When Vicky questions Nedumaran for making Aishu the Sous Chef, a cooking challenge is held between them. Ragupathi’s decision to find the truth about Chidambaram upsets Nedumaran.

episodesList.title: Resurfacing of Memories
episodesList.summary: Aishu takes Vetri's mom and sister to her house for a day and is shocked to see Nedumaran back early from his travel. What happens when he learns the truth about their background?

episodesList.title: New Ideas
episodesList.summary: Vetri gives his mom a tour of the resort. Riya shares her business plan with Ragupathi. While Vetri helps Aishu with the sous chef test, Nedumaran warns her to stay away from him.

episodesList.title: Dinner or Date?
episodesList.summary: Aishu tells Vetri that her father knows about the guests. She invites Vetri out for dinner. Nedumaran is not happy when Ragupathi tells him about Riya's new business plan.

episodesList.title: Chefs' Cook-Off
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran announces three rounds of the sous chef cook-off. While he demands that Aishu win the challenge, Vicky tries to distract her. Later, Nedumaran accepts the business idea.

episodesList.title: The Clock Is Ticking
episodesList.summary: Vetri boosts Aishu when Vicky mocks her for losing. Aishu wins the next round. She recalls Vetri’s words as she panics in the third round. Ragupathi gets a call about Chidambaram.

episodesList.title: The Shindig
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran resents Aishu's friendship with Vetri. Ragupathy leaves to find Chidambaram. Joji is miffed when no one remembers his birthday, but Vetri has a solution.

episodesList.title: The Apologetic Attacker
episodesList.summary: John tries to target Vetri to appease Nedumaran by messing up a guest's order. Vicky attends his friend's bachelor party and finds Vetri taking their 'special' food order.

episodesList.title: Native Charm
episodesList.summary: Vetri is tasked with handling an inspection officer, who comes over to thoroughly check the resort. Vicky and Srinidhi decide to investigate what Vetri and Pandi are up to.

episodesList.title: Busted
episodesList.summary: After Nedumaran warns him, Vetri avoids Aishu, leaving her upset and confused. When Aishu discovers Vetri in his secret kitchen, she leaves without listening to his explanation.

episodesList.title: Smoking Gun
episodesList.summary: Vetri is caught red-handed and faces Nedumaran’s wrath after Vicky shares video evidence of his secret kitchen. Vicky lies that Aishu took the video. Ragupathi visits Vetri's mom.

episodesList.title: Disillusioned
episodesList.summary: Aishu confronts Vicky for his heinous move. Defying a furious Nedumaran, Ragupathi handles the situation and Vetri is released from the station. Aishu tries to speak to Vetri.

episodesList.title: Penitent Vetri
episodesList.summary: Vetri's suspension surprises everyone. While Ragupathi accepts Vetri's heartfelt apology, his decision upsets Nedumaran. Vetri is glad to see Bhavani’s food cart back in business.

episodesList.title: Stonewalling
episodesList.summary: Riya launches RR Resort Masala Products. Nedumaran is shocked that Ragupathi knows Vetri's father and is looking for him. Aishu is hurt as Vetri decides to stay away from her.

episodesList.title: Dissolved in Tears
episodesList.summary: Aishu feels guilty about Vetri. Joji advices Vetri to save his friendship. Rajan shares vital news with Ragupathi about Chidambaram. Aishu has a heartfelt talk with Nedumaran.

episodesList.title: Mea Culpa
episodesList.summary: Ragupathi learns that Chidambaram is innocent. Meanwhile, Vicky's mother makes an unexpected visit to the resort and advises him to value his friendships.

episodesList.title: Food Fest'26
episodesList.summary: Vetri helps Ramya at her college food festival and is shocked by the chief guest. Vicky apologises to Aishu and tries to fix things with Veni, but things do not go as planned.

episodesList.title: Languishing in Prison!
episodesList.summary: Vetri rejoins his duty at the resort and promises Ragupathi to be loyal always. While Ragupathi is desperately looking for Chidambaram, what big secret is Nedumaran hiding?

episodesList.title: Flopped Business
episodesList.summary: Riya is upset as her business plan fails. Nedumaran rebukes Riya and Rajan when they inform him about the food’s quality at the resort. Vetri decides to talk to Shibu for Aishu.

episodesList.title: Nudging Friends
episodesList.summary: Ragupathi asks Riya to take up the pantry project with Vetri to help her. Nedumaran praises Aishu for running the kitchen smoothly. Vetri makes Shibu listen to Aishu’s rendition.

episodesList.title: Renewed Opportunity
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran gets angry that Vetri is to manage the pantry and questions Ragupathi. Shibu promises an opportunity for Aishu to Vetri. After Vicky apologises, Veni reconciles with him.

episodesList.title: Renaissance
episodesList.summary: Vetri sets up the pantry and is happy to know of a salary hike. While Aishu is ready to sacrifice her dreams for her father's happiness, Nedumaran learns about her secret identity.

episodesList.title: Filial Betrayal
episodesList.summary: Things take a turn when Nedumaran discovers Aishu's hidden identity. Tensions escalate within the Pantry team as they face new challenges and conflicts.

episodesList.title: Immolating Dreams
episodesList.summary: Aishu rejects Shibu's offer and assures Nedumaran she won't betray him like her sister. Priya hints at a plan to her brother, who warns her to be cautious.

episodesList.title: Culinary Stage
episodesList.summary: Ramya joins Nedumaran's kitchen as a trainee. Vetri's pantry sale picks up, but Riya rebukes him for not following the assigned menu. Vetri scolds Ramya for confronting Aishu.

episodesList.title: Entrapped
episodesList.summary: After Rajan advices Riya, she asks Vetri to make some dishes for the pantry. While Bhavani waits for Ramya to return, Priya traps her in a dangerous situation. Will Ramya survive?

episodesList.title: Frantic Search
episodesList.summary: Vetri and Pandi scour the resort in search of Ramya. Priya worriedly calls her brother and tells him about her mistake. Once the rescue is dealt with, Vetri goes on a field trip.

episodesList.title: A Daughter's Atonement
episodesList.summary: Aishu upsets everyone with her tyrannical behaviour. Veni spots Priya snooping around and gets suspicious. Vetri has a new menu. Will he successfully implement it?

episodesList.title: Contrasting Sisters
episodesList.summary: Divya asks for Riya's support at her wedding. Aishu tells Divya that she will not let their father down. Aishu warns Vicky for mocking Ramya. Vetri is sad as the pantry sales drop.

episodesList.title: Bitter Encounters
episodesList.summary: Vetri's new menu struggles to attract customers. Ramya tells Vetri about how Vicky bullies her, which angers him. Divya finally comes face to face with Nedumaran at the resort.

episodesList.title: Aishu's Complaint
episodesList.summary: After a complaint from Aishu reaches Rajan, Vetri faces an uncomfortable meeting. Feeling dejected, he finds support from Ramya and Pandi, who motivate him to focus on the pantry.

episodesList.title: Suspicions Sparked
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran brushes aside Aishu's wedding-related concerns, while Vetri finds inspiration for new pantry dishes. Veni grows suspicious of Priya's actions and shares it with Vicky.

episodesList.title: Yearning Daughters
episodesList.summary: Vetri works tirelessly to manage both the pantry and room service while launching fresh ideas. Meanwhile, Nedumaran's anger flares when he learns of Divya's wedding menu plans.

episodesList.title: Booming Pantry Sales
episodesList.summary: Ragupathi shares his concern about Chidambaram with Nedumaran. Vetri makes a sweet for Divya. Vetri's strategy with kids works well for the pantry business, making Nedumaran angry.

episodesList.title: Showered by Appreciation
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran fumes as the pantry food is liked by the guests. While Riya congratulates Vetri, Ragupathi praises her for the pantry's success. Nedumaran recalls his talk with Chika.

episodesList.title: Spurned Invitation
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran lashes at Divya for inviting him to her wedding. John announces the Star Chef competition. Priya plans her revenge by tarnishing Nedumaran's name at Divya's wedding.

episodesList.title: Wrecking the Wedding
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran's new signature dish becomes an instant hit. He ignores Karthik who tries to convince him to attend the wedding. Priya executes her plan amidst the wedding preparations.

episodesList.title: Blood is Thicker than Water
episodesList.summary: Priya's plan fails as Nedumaran handles the situation. Divya is elated to see her father at her wedding as Aishu gives him an earful. Nedumaran rages when Aishu shows him a photo.

episodesList.title: A Bride's Farewell
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran has a private word with Karthik before bidding the newlyweds goodbye. Uthaman introduces the new members to the room service team. Meanwhile, Vetri falls sick.

episodesList.title: The Hidden Truth
episodesList.summary: When Vicky and Veni share a private moment, Nedumaran conducts an inspection, alarming Vetri. Aishu asks about the untoward kitchen incidents and the picture from Nedumaran's desk.

episodesList.title: Ravaged Kitchen
episodesList.summary: Riya finds out the reason behind Deepak's return and confronts him. Ragupathi asks everyone to prepare for a minister's visit, but Priya has another plan up her sleeve.

episodesList.title: Against All Odds
episodesList.summary: The kitchen's destruction upsets the chefs. Nedumaran proposes that his team move into the pantry temporarily, but Riya opposes it vehemently. What will Ragupathi decide?

episodesList.title: Rajan's Avowal
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran is angry by the minister’s mother’s words. While Riya assures her dad she is happy, Rajan admits to Aishu that he loves Riya. Vetri helps Aishu with a last-minute order.

episodesList.title: Nedumaran's Notoriety

episodesList.title: Minister's Misattribution
episodesList.summary: Ragupathi is moved by Aishu’s suggestion to get Riya and Rajan married. Priya celebrates with her brother. The minister applauds Nedumaran for the amazing dishes in the pantry.

episodesList.title: Nedumaran's Unpleasant Encounter
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran is upset by a call and the profit margin between the kitchen and pantry. Veni learns that Priya is constantly following Nedumaran. Martin visits Nedumaran at RR resort.

episodesList.title: All about Chika
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran meets Chidambaram aka Chika, who wins hearts with his cooking. Ragupathi nominates him for a Star Chef competition. Upset, Nedumaran decides to cook for a hunting party.

episodesList.title: Web of Deceptions
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran reports illegal hunting and leaves Chika alone in the forest. Chika gets arrested. At the resort, Nedumaran spins a tale about Chika’s missing, all for a Star Chef award.

episodesList.title: Hidden Feelings
episodesList.summary: Vetri is heartbroken to see Aishu’s ex-boyfriend. A complaint about a pantry dish has Nedumaran fuming. Rajan admits his feelings to Riya. Vetri is thrilled as Aishu lifts the ban.

episodesList.title: Old Flame
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran complains to Ragupathi about the pantry. Aishu and Selvin catch up after ages. Veni spies on Priya. Ramya confides in Aishu about Vetri while Ragupathi collapses in pain.

episodesList.title: Stricken Ragupathi
episodesList.summary: Priya becomes cautious when Veni and Vetri visit her house. Ragupathi is hospitalised and Nedumaran assumes that he will be taking over the resort in his absence.

episodesList.title: Who is the Alpha?
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran stops Rajan's staff meeting and lets everyone know who the boss is. Aishu is selected for the Star Chef event. Vetri is shocked as Nedumaran replaces the pantry staff.

episodesList.title: Rebuffed
episodesList.summary: Veni scolds Vicky for being rude to Vetri. Nedumaran insults Vetri for questioning about the pantry. Ragupathi tells Rajan to take charge of the resort. Ramya proposes to Vetri.

episodesList.title: The Next CEO!
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran takes complete control of the resort, and everyone worries as word spreads that he'll be the next CEO. Ragupathi recovers and immediately calls for an investor's meeting.

episodesList.title: Bittersweet Departure
episodesList.summary: RR Resort is in chaos after Nedumaran walks out with his team. Rajan handles the situation calmly. Aishu bids farewell to Vetri. Nedumaran leaves the Kitchen with bitter emotion.

episodesList.title: Seizing the Day
episodesList.summary: Vicky exploits the situation at the resort. Vetri asks Riya to help him join the Kitchen team. While admitted in the hospital, Vetri’s mother reveals the truth about his father.

episodesList.title: Strengthening Ties
episodesList.summary: Rajan confidently meets the resort's investors and explains his future plans. Since Vicky struggles to run the Kitchen with reduced staff, Riya and Rajan offer him a solution.

episodesList.title: Nedumaran's Minion
episodesList.summary: Vetri asks for help from Veni and others for the Star Chef competition and goes in search of a former winner. As Nedumaran trains Aishu, he brews a sinister plan for the resort.

episodesList.title: Durai, the Savior ?
episodesList.summary: Rajan entrusts Vicky with arranging dinner for the investors. Nedumaran plots to take over RR Resort with Luther's help. Vetri waits desperately for Durai, but will he help him?

episodesList.title: Persistant Chef
episodesList.summary: Nedumaran trains Aishu for the competition at home. A stressed Aishu meets Selvin, but she cannot get Vetri out of her mind. Hearing his struggles, Durai agrees to help Vetri.

episodesList.title: The Trial
episodesList.summary: Durai sets to train Vetri if he passes three tests. Vicky informs Nedumaran about Vetri’s move. He tells Vetri he will run the kitchen during the training. Vetri clears two tests.

episodesList.title: The Dead Kitchen
episodesList.summary: Vetri clears Durai's tough task with ease, and he promises to train him. Ragupathi, Riya and Rajan feel betrayed as Vicky executes his plan and shows his colours to the investors.

episodesList.title: Ragupathi's Reassurance
episodesList.summary: The situation at the resort worsens when board members pull back. When the employees begin to fear for their jobs, Ragupathi calls for a staff meeting.

episodesList.title: Dark Grief
episodesList.summary: Durai sees Chidambaram in Vetri and tells him about how he knew his father and his tragic past. When Veni calls Aishu to vent her frustration, the latter learns a startling truth.

episodesList.title: Good Luck
episodesList.summary: Just when Vetri completes his training, he gets a call from his sister that his mother is hospitalised. On the day of the competition, Nedumaran warns the organiser about Vetri.

episodesList.title: The Champion Returns
episodesList.summary: When Vetri goes to register for the competition, they question the legitimacy of Durai's signature. However, all hope is not lost.

episodesList.title: Chef's Culinary Clash Begins
episodesList.summary: Durai wishes Vetri and leaves. Aishu confronts Selvin for hiding about partaking in the competition. Nedumaran briefs Aishu. Meanwhile, will Vetri be able to handle the rounds?

episodesList.title: Memory of a Father
episodesList.summary: Vetri freezes before the first round. Later, he recalls his childhood memories with his father and that inspires him to make his first dish of the competition.

episodesList.title: The Sous Chefs
episodesList.summary: In the new round, Veni becomes Vetri's sous chef and Vicky becomes Aishu's. Veni's presence distracts Vicky, who misses her a lot.

episodesList.title: A Friend in Need
episodesList.summary: Selvin wins an advantage and chooses a toughest ingredient to break his opponents. Durai's training helps Vetri, but he uses his time to help Aishu. Selvin’s query confuses Vetri.

episodesList.title: A Helpless Son
episodesList.summary: Aishu asks Nedumaran why he's so hell-bent on her winning the competition. Just before the finals, Vetri receives a devastating call from his sister about his mother's condition.

episodesList.title: The Final Dish
episodesList.summary: While Vetri stands still, feeling helpless, a timely help from a benefactor saves the day. However, when Vetri presents his final dish, the judges get upset with his presentation.

episodesList.title: The Star Chef Rises
episodesList.summary: The judges and viewers are moved after Vetri shares the concept behind his dish. Once the competition ends, Aishu tells her father her wish.

episodesList.title: Unfinished Business
episodesList.summary: Everyone awaits the arrival of their new CEO at RR Resort, but their identity shocks them. Vetri settles his debts and returns to the resort, but his choice surprises Ragupathi.

title: Raakshasa
summary: Raakshasa is a 2026 Indian Kannada-language psychological crime thriller web series written and directed by Suhan Prasad and produced by Tharun Sudhir. The series features Vijay Raghavendra in his digital streaming debut as a police officer investigating a series of mysterious deaths in North Karnataka. The series premiered on ZEE5 on February 20, 2026.
plot: Set against the backdrop of North Karnataka, the narrative follows an intense investigation into a series of gruesome deaths initially attributed to crocodile attacks. As the investigation unfolds, the protagonist, a dedicated police officer, uncovers evidence suggesting that the killings may be linked to dark cult rituals and human intervention rather than animal attacks. The series explores the psychological tension between local superstition and forensic reality.
reception:
Raakshasa received mixed reviews from critics, who largely compared it to its source material, the Tamil series Vilangu. While the North Karnataka setting and Vijay Raghavendra's performance were praised, the show was criticized for its technical execution and lack of originality.
The Times of India called it a "gripping watch" that benefited from a "restrained, internalised performance" by Raghavendra and an atmospheric setting. The Hollywood Reporter India noted that while the pacing was "sturdy," the early reveal in the third episode stripped the later half of its "riveting" potential. Moneycontrol praised the series for adapting the story into the "distinct social fabric" of rural Karnataka, highlighting the "natural" supporting cast.
In a critical review, Deccan Herald rated it 1.5 out of 5 stars, stating it "fell prey to the OTT template" with forced cliffhangers and "amateurish" dubbing. Firstpost gave it 2 out of 5 stars, arguing the show "loses its bite in translation" and suffered from a "generic" visual palette. OTTplay also rated the series 1.5 out of 5, concluding that it "pales in comparison to the original" due to repetitive beats.
The Hans India dismissed the series as a "hollow remake," criticizing the "shallow writing" and uninspired direction. Writing for India Today, the critic noted that while the "central mystery is engaging enough to keep viewers invested," the series suffered from an "amateurish, underproduced quality" and technical issues such as "glaring errors with the dubbing" and grammatical mistakes in the credits.

articleSections.text: In early 2026, it was confirmed that actor Vijay Raghavendra would lead the series, marking his debut in the OTT space.

title: Ronkini Bhavan
summary: Ronkini Bhavan is an Indian Bengali-language psychological thriller directed by Abhrajit Sen. It stars Shyamoupti Mudly and Gourab Roy Chowdhury, with Bidipta Chakraborty in a supporting role. It is an adaptation of Kannada web series Ayyana Mane.
plot: The story follows Juthika, a newly married woman who arrives at her husband's ancestral mansion and encounters references to a family curse and a history of wives who have met unexplained fates. As she begins to question the household's rituals and secrets, a police visit to the property points to an investigation linked to the family's past.
reception: Arpita Sarkar of OTTplay rated the series 3.5 out of 5, describing it as a "psychological thriller that combines suspense with themes of trauma and fear, and recommending it as a notable entry in the genre."

title: Rangeen
summary: Rangeen is a 2025 Indian Hindi-language drama television series by Kabir Khan and Rajan Kapoor. Directed by Amardeep Galsin and Amir Rizvi, it stars Vineet Kumar Singh, Rajshri Deshpande and Taaruk Raina. The series was released as an Amazon Prime original on 25 July 2025.
plot: In the midst of a stagnant marriage, an upright middle-aged man's world is turned upside down when he discovers his wife's secret trysts with a paid lover. Desperate to reclaim his manhood, he plunges into the world of paid intimacy, hidden in plain-sight. Yet his unconventional path to revenge forces him to confront his fragile ego, biases, and desires. Along the way, a mix of eccentric characters and absurd situations sparks unexpected epiphanies. Rangeen is a humorous and poignant exploration of identity, manhood, morality and the true cost of getting what you want.
reception:
The Free Press Journal wrote: “In an era where streaming often favours titillation over storytelling, Rangeen arrives with a scandalous premise — gigolos, infidelity, revenge — but swerves into unexpected territory… a soulful, slow-burn character study that flirts with scandal yet lands on emotional depth, restraint, and quiet, deeply human truths.”
OTTplay called Rangeen “a bold, bizarre, and brilliant midlife crisis,” praising the show for its originality and risk-taking, especially highlighting Vineet Kumar Singh’s performance: “Vineet Kumar Singh excels as Adarsh, and this is something that you have never seen him do ever.”
Rajshri Deshpande’s portrayal of Naina drew particular acclaim, with The Indian Express calling her arc “the most special part” of the series: “Naina refuses to apologise for her actions… A woman’s loneliness, in bed and out of it, is reason enough for her to seek succour outside of her marriage, and no one needs to judge her for it.” While Gupta and others noted that the series at times struggled with tonal cohesion and narrative sharpness, there was broad recognition of its willingness to provoke, challenge, and invite reflection.
Sheeba Chaddha was similarly praised for her role as Sitara, delivering “a quietly commanding performance… balancing warmth and shrewdness with ease.”
Rahul Desai for The Hollywood Reporter India remarked that while Rangeen “isn’t badly made,” its “reluctance to commit” at times undermined its impact, suggesting the series was “shy about the very repression it platforms.”
Reviewing for Scroll.in Nandini Ramnath wrote , "In its attitude towards sex work, the show is an improvement on Tribhuvan Mishra (about a debt-ridden chartered accountant) as well as B.A. Pass, Ajay Bahl's erotic thriller film from 2012.".
Vinamra Mathur of Firstpost wrote in her/his review, "Rangeen should have been a story about these two and how they reignite the extinguished flame of their decaying marriage. But it digresses more often than it should have." Shweta Keshri from India Today wrote "While the idea seemed quite intriguing and unique, 'Rangeen' soon loses its uniqueness and becomes just another bland show."

episodesList.title: Dimaag ke Keedey
episodesList.summary: A seemingly upright newspaper editor's life goes awry when he discovers that his wife is sleeping with a paid lover. Feeling emasculated, he makes a radical decision.

episodesList.title: Sanki
episodesList.summary: A raw confrontation with Naina drives Adarsh into a vengeful spiral, but he is out of his depth in an unfamiliar world. Naina doesn't know who to turn to, and Sunny finds himself stuck between the two.

episodesList.title: Cheenti
episodesList.summary: Adarsh pressures Sunny's agent Sitara to hire him. Sitara arranges a trial, during which he leaves a lasting impression. Naina feels unwelcome in her parents' house.

episodesList.title: Sooja Hua Mooh
episodesList.summary: Adarsh is pursued by a young girl online. At a family function, Naina and Adarsh cross paths for the first time since their explosive argument. Meanwhile, Sunny spends time with Sitara's kids, and things get complicated.

episodesList.title: Magarmachh
episodesList.summary: Adarsh replaces Sitara's blue-eyed boy Sunny and is paired with the volatile and capricious Jugnu. With Sitara out of his life, Sunny loses his sparkle.

episodesList.title: Daldal
episodesList.summary: Adarsh moves up the ladder as he gets paired with the aristocratic Roshni, and Sunny sinks into a low as he accepts an uncomfortable arrangement. The boundaries of both gigolos are tested in different ways.

episodesList.title: Junglee Suar
episodesList.summary: Through Jugnu, Adarsh experiences the thrill of his new world, while through Roshni, he witnesses its desolation. Naina confronts her mother and resorts to desperation, while Sunny faces every gigolo's worst nightmare.

episodesList.title: I'm the Man
episodesList.summary: Adarsh is hired by Renu as a stand-in fiancé, forcing a confrontation with his past. Sunny makes desperate attempts to reclaim his manhood while Naina must release herself from guilt before turning the page.

episodesList.title: Do Gadhey
episodesList.summary: Adarsh and Naina realise the futility of their pursuits. Sunny makes an unexpected revelation, but Adarsh's actions land him in trouble.

plotHtml: In the midst of a stagnant marriage, an upright middle-aged man's world is turned upside down when he discovers his wife's secret trysts with a paid lover. Desperate to reclaim his manhood, he plunges into the world of paid intimacy, hidden in plain-sight. Yet his unconventional path to revenge forces him to confront his fragile ego, biases, and desires. Along the way, a mix of eccentric characters and absurd situations sparks unexpected epiphanies. Rangeen is a humorous and poignant exploration of identity, manhood, morality and the true cost of getting what you want.

title: Ram Bhavan
summary: Ram Bhavan is an Indian Hindi-language television family drama series which aired from 29 January 2025 to 11 July 2025 on Colors TV and streams digitally on JioHotstar. It is produced by Rahul Kumar Tewary under Rolling Tales Productions and stars Khushbu Tiwari and Mishkat Varma. It is an official remake of the Tamil TV series Deivamagal.
plot: Set in the heart of Prayagraj, Ram Bhavan tells the story of a crumbling mansion that has witnessed decades of family feuds and shifting power dynamics. The show spotlights the clash between Om Vajpayee, a resourceful and ambitious young man, and his cunning sister-in-law, Gayatri, who holds the reins of the family's fortune, as well as Isha, a tenacious woman, navigating her way through life's challenges while battling Gayatri's oppressive rule. Together, Om and Isha take on Gayatri in a battle that threatens to shake the foundations of Ram Bhavan.

title: Reeta Sanyal
summary: Reeta Sanyal is an Indian Hindi-language pulp legal thriller TV series directed by Abhirup Ghosh. The show is based on Amit Khan's series of crime thriller novels named Reeta Sanyal Ke Mukkadmein (translation: Reeta Sanyal's lawsuits). It was written and adapted for screen by Deeptak Das. Produced by Rajeshwar Nair and Krishnan Iyer under the banner Keylight Productions, it stars Adah Sharma, Rahul Dev, Manik Papneja and Ankur Rathee. The series premiered on 14 October 2024 on Disney+ Hotstar.
reception:
According to Ormax Media, which estimates audience views, Reeta Sanyal secured the second spot on the list of the most-watched streaming originals in India, with approx. 2.5 million views each week. Reeta Sanyal became the most-watched fictional series on OTT during its run.
Sarthak of Gurucool writes "What sets Reeta Sanyal apart from other thrillers is its ability to evoke genuine emotion while maintaining the suspenseful thrill". The Production and the lead performances were praised. Entertainment Portal Binged Bureau wrote "Adah Sharma is a perfect choice to play the titular character Reeta. Her portrayal makes the role more vulnerable and witty. She’s relatable and you end up rooting for her". Lipika Verma of Deccan Chronicle writes "Adah Sharma Shines in Reeta Sanyal, embraces diverse roles".

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series was announced on Disney+ Hotstar by Keylight Productions. Hina Khan was considered for the role before it went to Adah Sharma. Principal photography of the series commenced in Mumbai. The trailer of the series was released on 4 October 2024.

episodesList.title: Main Kaatil Hoon!
episodesList.summary: Advocate Reeta Sanyal is eyeing a career-defining case. An opportunity arises in the form of a high-profile murder case, but her client demands execution instead of freedom!

episodesList.title: Chhoti Bachhi
episodesList.summary: A deadly attack on Keshav leaves Reeta scrambling to find the truth behind the murder of Parav Rane. At the hospital, a sinister killer lurks to make her next move.

episodesList.title: The Perfect Murder
episodesList.summary: Chasing down a new lead, Reeta and her assistant-cum-friend Ishaan crack the code behind Keshav's so-called 'perfect murder'. But will the truth be as flawless as the crime?

episodesList.title: Ek Filmy Twist
episodesList.summary: With Inspector Jai by their side, Reeta and Ishaan search for the murder weapon that will crack this case wide open. On the first day of trial, a major setback ruins it all!

episodesList.title: Lady Undercover
episodesList.summary: Reeta goes undercover at Club Platina to dig up dirt on Parav Rane but ends up with more questions than answers. Chaos ensues when her cover gets blown!

episodesList.title: The Lost File
episodesList.summary: To solidify her defence, Reeta revisits the crime scene and uncovers explosive leads. A new intel on her father's death may open the Pandora's box!

episodesList.title: Ms. Killer
episodesList.summary: Footages from Parav’s cellar bring disturbing scenes and an unexpected eyewitness to light. A viral meme helps Reeta close in on the prime suspect.

episodesList.title: Yamraj Thakral
episodesList.summary: After Jai files crucial evidence against Rane, Reeta reevaluates her trial strategy. But with Thakral being one step ahead, her plan may hit another hiccup.

episodesList.title: A Bait
episodesList.summary: A witness’ testimony on the stand shifts the direction of the court proceedings. Jai and his team lay a trap for the elusive lady assassin. Will she get caught?

episodesList.title: The Defence Rests
episodesList.summary: The truth about Ishaan’s real identity comes to light. Ahead of the final verdict, Reeta struggles with her defence. But a new testimony shakes up the courtroom!

episodesList.title: Blood Is the Only True Ink
episodesList.summary: Reeta tries to piece together the truth behind her father’s death. An attack on the mysterious girl brings a bigger conspiracy to light but the only clue is a British-era coin.

episodesList.title: The Girl with a Superpower
episodesList.summary: With her razor-sharp ideas, Reeta signs the mysterious girl as her client. Eyeing for new leads on Joseph Jahazi, a trap is laid for Khushboo. But the plan backfires!

episodesList.title: High Alert
episodesList.summary: After a close call at the restaurant, Reeta uncovers the truth of a smuggling racket involving her father. New findings at a murder scene hint at a possible terror threat.

episodesList.title: Guilty Mind
episodesList.summary: Facing off Thakral in court, Reeta follows an unorthodox approach to prove her point. Taking the mystery girl to a hypnotist opens doors to a new maze.

episodesList.title: Who Killed My Father?
episodesList.summary: Reeta and Jai spring back to action, nabbing the infamous Acid Anna. As missing pieces of Subhash’s murder come together, Reeta braces for a fightback!

episodesList.title: Blood Sisters
episodesList.summary: Reeta unravels the past and present of the secret society ‘Blood Sisters’. As she tries to connect the dots, a nationwide threat comes to the picture.

episodesList.title: Honey Trap
episodesList.summary: A new avatar helps Reeta uncover the modus operandi of the Blood Sisters. Racing against time, Reeta takes a dangerous chance but the plan hits a snag!

episodesList.title: The Real Bookkeeper
episodesList.summary: Decoding a 200-year-old riddle, Reeta and Ishaan try to defuse a volatile situation. The real bookkeeper steps out of the shadows. And this is just the beginning!

episodesList.title: Who’s a Friend, Who’s a Foe?
episodesList.summary: In the game of power grab, the Blood Sisters plan to uproot the government. Reeta joins forces with Thakral to salvage the situation while a new enemy comes into the picture.

episodesList.title: The Score Is Settled!
episodesList.summary: Revelations, regrets, and secrets surface! In a bid to neutralise the national threat, Reeta pulls out all the stops in one final showdown. But she’s yet to face one hard truth.

title: Raat Jawaan Hai
summary: Raat Jawaan Hai (transl. The Night Is Young) is an Indian Hindi-language television series directed by Sumeet Vyas and written by Khyati Anand Puthran. Produced under Yamini Pictures Private Limited, starring Barun Sobti, Anjali Anand and Priya Bapat. It is premiered on SonyLIV on 11 October 2024.
plot: Three friends, Avinash, Suman and Radhika navigate the challenges of parenting and work-life balance in this slice-of-life wholesome comedy.
reception: The series opened to positive reviews, with Arpita Sarkar of OTTPlay rating the series 3/5 stars. Sonal Pandya of Times Now gave the series 4/5 stars. Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in said in her review that "Fortunately, Raat Jawaan Hai doesn’t bite off more than it can chew, focusing on delivering a carefully prepared feast of laughs, frowns and tears." Troy Ribeiro of The Free Press Journal gave 3.5 stars and said that "If you’re looking for a heartfelt series that embraces the messiness of parenting with open arms, this one’s for you".

articleSections.text: The series was announced on SonyLIV. The principal photography of the series commenced in March 2024. A special screening of the series was held at Mumbai on 9 October 2024.

episodesList.title: Meet The Ranis
episodesList.summary: 12 fierce and fabulous queens from across the Indian reality TV universe come together for a wild and exhilarating adventure in the jungle. While there, they face nature's elements, challenging games, and more.

episodesList.title: Luxury or Lost
episodesList.summary: The adventure heats up as teams are formed and the queens set out on a challenging trek through the jungle towards their new camps. Whoever reaches the luxury camp first not only wins the luxury but money and immunity.

episodesList.title: Face-Off in The Jungle
episodesList.summary: Two friends face off in the season's first survival challenge, testing their individual skills and resolve. Meanwhile, the remaining queens tackle a demanding money challenge that puts their teamwork and unity to the ultimate test.

episodesList.title: Laws Of The Jungle
episodesList.summary: This week, the Ranis need to retrieve crucial supplies from a raft that has overturned. The first queen to retrieve all the supplies wins the survival challenge and secures her place. Meanwhile, the camp status between luxury and basic camps is reset.

episodesList.title: Survival Of The Fittest
episodesList.summary: The Ranis face a grueling race through the jungle that pushes their physical limits. As new teams emerge and old alliances fracture, they navigate through the wilderness to their new camps and the treacherous No-Man's Land.

episodesList.title: Mud Fight
episodesList.summary: Two queens face a critical survival challenge in the jungle, where only one will emerge victorious. Tensions rise as a money challenge in a mud pit reveals deep rifts within the luxury camp and forces one queen into isolation.

episodesList.title: Win Some, Lose Some
episodesList.summary: The money challenge yields an unexpected twist, dramatically altering the game. Two strong queens are nominated for the survival challenge, where they must endure harsh weather conditions and relentless rain.

episodesList.title: Race To Camp
episodesList.summary: As the series nears its climax, the queens gear up for the final race to camp. One queen secures a direct ticket to the Grand Finale with a standout performance. Meanwhile, two others face a grueling survival challenge that will determine their fate.

episodesList.title: Final Push For Survival
episodesList.summary: A brutal survival challenge pushes two Ranis to their limits as they protect their supplies from fierce predators and harsh elements. Only one will make it to the top five. In the final money challenge, alliances dissolve, and more.

episodesList.title: Survival Rani Of The Jungle
episodesList.summary: The ultimate showdown begins as the final three Ranis face the final survival challenge. Each will apply the survival skills they have learned so far to overcome nature's elements. Discover who will claim the title of Ultimate Reality Rani of the Jungle.

episodesList.title: Sink, Swim, Survive
episodesList.summary: 12 fearless ranis are dropped into the ocean off India's western coast—clueless about to face their first brutal test. Varun Sood reveals the twisted theme: Sankat by the Sea. After a dramatic swim, tensions rise when the first two ranis reach the shore.

episodesList.title: Luxury Or Loyalty
episodesList.summary: Captains Irina and Samyuktha face their first moral test: Dharam Sankat, and must choose luxury or loyalty.  Later, Varun reveals "Varun's Chakravyuh", a brutal challenge where immunity is on offer in exchange for a personal sacrifice.

episodesList.title: Luxury Or Loyalty
episodesList.summary: Captains Irina and Samyuktha face their first moral test: Dharam Sankat, and must choose luxury or loyalty.  Later, Varun reveals "Varun's Chakravyuh", a brutal challenge where immunity is on offer in exchange for a personal sacrifice.

episodesList.title: Jungle Judgements
episodesList.summary: While the Ranis in the luxury tent enjoy a hearty meal and air-conditioned rest, the basic camp team battles insects, hunger, and a sleepless night under the open sky. Later, the Ranis vote for one player from each team to face the survival challenge.

episodesList.title: Drown The Doubt
episodesList.summary: Bhavya and Scarlette brace for the first survival challenge this season. With their captains, they test their strength and willpower by racing across the beach, swimming in open waters, retrieving a smoke flare and returning before being eliminated.

episodesList.title: The Money Trap
episodesList.summary: Bhavya returns triumphant from the survival challenge and shakes up the camps, selecting one Rani from each team who will not receive their long-awaited belongings. Then, the Ranis race to find hidden money bags and return to deliver a means of survival.

episodesList.title: Catch Or Crash
episodesList.summary: The Ranis journey deep into the jungle to search for money bags as the cutthroat competition continues. Later, the jungle Ranis are offered a temptation: a personal cash reward, but with a twist that it deducts from their team's total.

episodesList.title: Race To Riches (Or Ruin)
episodesList.summary: A new day brings a game-changing shifts. Varun announces that the teams will move camps, but only one gets the luxury upgrade.

episodesList.title: Urine Or You're Out
episodesList.summary: Varun returns with his most shocking Chakravyuh yet. A gut-wrenching challenge for immunity. Two Ranis go head-to-head in a challenge that's less physical, more stomach-churning to drink the most amount of cow urine

episodesList.title: Burn To Stay
episodesList.summary: Morning in the camp is far from calm. Tensions rise, cliques deepen, and friendships teeter as the two nominated Ranis prepare for the Survival Challenge.

episodesList.title: The Karmic Dilemma
episodesList.summary: The jungle buzzes after the brutal Survival Challenge. Nishu returns with a twist: the Karmic Dilemma. Samyuktha's punishment: being chained to a fence in No Man's Land. Emotions run high, and as chaos peaks, a wild force of nature arrives: Rakhi Sawant.

episodesList.title: Lucky Breaks And Coconuts
episodesList.summary: Rakhi returns as Double Trouble- not to win, but to stir chaos. The Money challenge begins: smash doors, launch coconuts, and chase real cash using makeshift catapults. As tensions rise, Rakhi watches closely, ready to cause trouble.

episodesList.title: Coconut Clash
episodesList.summary: The clash for coconuts continues. The Golden Coconut will make or break a team’s earnings. Back at camp, a fragile peace is broken by nominations. Tensions mount, and the jungle makes it clear: there’s no room for comfort in this game.

episodesList.title: The Double Nomination
episodesList.summary: Accusations fly, friendships falter, and loyalty becomes a rare commodity during the nominations. But Double Trouble isn’t done. It’s time for a Double Nomination. Emotions run high as four Ranis prepare for the toughest challenge yet.

episodesList.title: The Coffin Challenge
episodesList.summary: The Survival Challenge turns dark as one Rani is buried alive, relying on her partner's voice to escape. Panic and confusion cost one pair their place. Prachi and Irina return victorious, bringing back yet another Karmic Dilemma to the shaken camp.

episodesList.title: A Twist Of Fate
episodesList.summary: The power of the Karmic Dilemma weighs heavy. One Rani will be excluded from the upcoming Ticket to Finale challenge. No more captains and no more immunity. The next challenge? A savage cage match in the crashing surf.

episodesList.title: Final Showdown
episodesList.summary: Waves slam the Ranis in a brutal cage match. Only Irina and Ishu remain, earning a face-off for the Ticket to Finale. One gets a guaranteed spot in the grand finale, while the other must battle again to survive.

episodesList.title: Hunters And Gatherers
episodesList.summary: Irina has the Ticket to Finale. The other Ranis face a brutal Race to Camp challenge: hauling luggage, cracking coconuts, and dragging goat carcasses. As exhaustion hits, Season 1 finalist Pavitra Punia returns, not to compete, but to guide them.

episodesList.title: Final Feast
episodesList.summary: The Race to Camp ends in heartbreak as the last pair is cut, leaving five finalists. At a celebratory feast, Varun reveals a twist: each Rani can take a cash offer and quit or risk it all for the crown. One Rani stuns everyone with her unexpected choice.

episodesList.title: The Ultimate Reality Rani
episodesList.summary: Four Ranis, one crown. In the grueling final challenge, they hang upside down, haul sandbags, dig for keys and swim into the ocean. All fight hard, but only one crosses the finish line victorious and becomes the ultimate Reality Rani of the Jungle.

title: Ranneeti: Balakot & Beyond
summary: Ranneeti: Balakot & Beyond is a Hindi-language war drama streaming television series directed by Santosh Singh for JioCinema. The series stars Ashutosh Rana, Ashish Vidyarthi, Jimmy Shergill, Lara Dutta, Aakanksha Singh, Mir Sarwar, Prasanna, Sikandar Kharbanda and others. The series was premeiered on 25 April 2024 on JioCinema.
plot: The show centers on an R&AW agent and his group as they retaliate against Pakistan following the devastating Pulwama assault. In the midst of hybrid warfare and Pakistan's deceptions in the media, the spies attempt to rescue a captured pilot while exposing the cunning neighbor.
reception:
Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express gave the series 1.5 stars and stated that "Another cross-border sub-plot featuring a couple of undercover agents has car chases, and shoot-outs, and fireworks. This ratchets the temperature a little, which overall remains tepid, and predictable."
Deepa Gahlot of Rediff.com rated 2.5 stars to the series and opined that "Balakot And Beyond veers between intriguing and boring."
Dhaval Roy of The Times of India rated 3.5/5 and stated that "The series does have a few predictable and far-fetched moments, especially regarding one of its pivotal characters."
Vinamra Mathur of Firstpost rated 2.5/5 and wrote in his review "The aerial action, most recently seen in Operation Valentine and Fighter, fail to ignite any sense of panic or patriotism."
Rishil Jogani for Pinkvilla rated 3/5 and wrote that "A show like Ranneeti has very little margin for error because it is inspired by true events and something that is added only for dramatic effect, makes it less believable, overall."

episodesList.title: Drishtikon - War of Perspective
episodesList.summary: Suspended RAW agent Kashyap uncovers vital intel on a cross-border terrorist organisation's latest developments posing a grave threat to India. Unfortunately, a massive explosion hits Pulwama before he can get through NSB head Dutta.

episodesList.title: Yuktikon - War of Strategy
episodesList.summary: Kashyap assembles an elite counter terrorism unit which also has Manisha, a spin doctor with a past connection to Kashyap. Their plan is to carry out a radical operation against the terrorists who caused the Pulwama attacks.

episodesList.title: Anubhootikon - War of Perception
episodesList.summary: With aid from the IAF, Kashyap's team begins strategizing the execution of a deadly air strike, aided by a deep-cover Indian spy within the terrorist camp who is risking his life to supply critical intelligence.

episodesList.title: Pratishodhikon - War of Retaliation
episodesList.summary: A humiliated Pakistan launches a counter-airstrike in Kashmir. While Indian jets chase away the intruder, Wing Commander Abhimanyu is taken P.O.W in the skirmish escalating tensions between India-Pakistan.

episodesList.title: Shaktikon - War of Power
episodesList.summary: Post the airstrikes, India and Pakistan engage in a media war of narrative control. While Kashyap and Manisha are on opposite ends regarding their approach; Chief Dutta ponders on how to avoid an all-out war.

episodesList.title: Kathakon - War of Narrative
episodesList.summary: Dutta and Kashyap's plan creates international pressure on Pakistan compelling them to release the captured Indian Pilot. Once back, Abhimanyu reveals critical intel that prompts India to challenge Pakistan.

episodesList.title: Jhoothkon - War of Lies
episodesList.summary: Abhimanyu helps Kashyap figure a counter strategy to firmly challenge Pakistan at FATC. Meanwhile, Netra and Kabir are back at the enemy camp gathering concrete proof of Pakistan's support to terrorism to support Kashyap's case.

episodesList.title: Rahasyakon - War of Secrets
episodesList.summary: Netra and Kabir are caught in a deadly chase from the terrorist camp with sensitive intel which could incriminate Pakistan at FATC. Kashyap is racing against time to get them both to safety but will he be successful?

episodesList.title: Vaastavikatakon - War of Reality
episodesList.summary: At the FATC amongst global leaders, Kashyap tries to pin down Pakistan's every move. Will he be able to expose their ties to terrorism and be a step ahead in this grey war.
