title: Raisinghani vs Raisinghani
summary: Raisinghani vs Raisinghani is a legal drama series streaming on Sony LIV, directed by Aniruddha Rajderkar. Produced by Sobo Films Holding P.Ltd, it stars Jennifer Winget, Karan Wahi, and Reem Shaikh. It first streamed on Sony LIV OTT platform and then was telecast on Sony Entertainment Television.
plot:
Anushka is a clear-sighted, honest and intelligent young lawyer, striving to make her mark in her father’s prestigious law firm. Virat, an ambitious and driven young lawyer, is viewed as the natural successor of the firm. As her ethics and righteousness clash with his views and objectives, moral differences play out.
Anushka and Virat, who were once in love, are now at loggerheads. Bound by destiny and brought together by their differences, the stakes are high in this professional rivalry with starkly diverse ideologies.
The law firm’s young intern, Ankita Pandey, is navigating her way with her own dark secrets. Her position at the firm is much more than what meets the eye. Watch her journey unfold as she lays claim to what she believes is rightfully hers.

episodesList.title: Justice Is Blind
episodesList.summary: Anushka is a sharp lawyer who works at her father's reputed law firm and has an ethical outlook. However, her father, Rajdeep Raisinghani, wants her to be ruthless in court. Unbeknownst to them, their lives are about to go through an unexpected change as someone seeks to destroy the Raisinghani family from within.

episodesList.title: Landmark Decision
episodesList.summary: Anushka gets the news about her father's accident. In Rajdeep's absence, the chairman position of Raisinghani law becomes a point of contention between Anushka and Virat. Will Anushka be able to prove her worth as a lawyer?

episodesList.title: Family Legacy
episodesList.summary: Virat and a few other lawyers resign from the firm when Anushka becomes the head of Raisinghani Legal. How will Anushka deal with this crisis?

episodesList.title: The Deciding Factor
episodesList.summary: Anushka learns that Rajdeep has slipped into a coma, and her grandmother blames her for it. Later, the police contact Anushka with some critical information about the accident.

episodesList.title: Star Client
episodesList.summary: Anushka decides to meet cricket superstar Aryaman Singh at a party and offers to become his legal representative. However, Virat also arrives at the party to steal a potential client from Anushka.

episodesList.title: The Best Bet
episodesList.summary: Virat and Anushka are at odds as both of them want to make Aryaman a part of their clientele. Who will be the one to win his trust?

episodesList.title: Finding The Middle Ground
episodesList.summary: Aryaman asks Virat and Anuska to team up and fight the case as his lawyers. Can they work together to prove Aryaman's innocence?

episodesList.title: Connecting The Dots
episodesList.summary: Anushka and Virat scramble to find a breakthrough in Aryaman's case as the court denies their bail plea. Meanwhile, Anushka takes it upon herself to investigate her father's accident.

episodesList.title: Joint Strategy
episodesList.summary: Anushka and Virat find out that their college batchmate, Raghav, is representing the opposition in Aryaman's case. After receiving this new information, both of them decide to come up with a better strategy.

episodesList.title: A New Beginning
episodesList.summary: Virat and Anushka manage to get bail for Aryaman with their new strategy. While celebrating their achievement, Anushka finds out that Virat is getting engaged soon.

episodesList.title: The Outsider
episodesList.summary: Anushka goes to the police station to collect Aryaman's call records. Meanwhile, Virat starts having second thoughts about his engagement to Ayesha.

episodesList.title: Personal Problems
episodesList.summary: Anushka decides to withdraw from Aryaman's case as a part of her strategy, wanting to focus all of her attention on her father's accident. What will she find?

episodesList.title: The Case Of Love
episodesList.summary: Anushka decides to find some new clients to boost her firm's reputation. Meanwhile, Ankita gives Virat some advice to win back Anushka's trust. Will he be able to do it?

episodesList.title: Office Politics
episodesList.summary: Anushka decides to give some of Virat's clients to the other senior members of the firm. Meanwhile, Anushka's new friend, Akshat, arrives at her house for dinner.

episodesList.title: Sacred Bonds
episodesList.summary: Virat agrees to give up some of his clients for the firm's sake, while Anushka decides to check on Ankita when she doesn't show up for work.

episodesList.title: The Special Prosecutor
episodesList.summary: Anushka gets the opportunity to become a special prosecutor for an important case. However, accepting this case would put her at odds with Akshat. What will she do?

episodesList.title: A New Perspective
episodesList.summary: Anushka feels conflicted about her new case. Meanwhile, Virat gets into a fight with Raghav outside the court.

episodesList.title: Love And Destiny
episodesList.summary: Ankita lands herself in trouble while researching a case. Meanwhile, Anushka confesses her feelings for Akshat.

episodesList.title: One For All
episodesList.summary: After taking up the job of a special prosecutor, Anushka decides to make some changes to the firm. She decides to make Virat the head while she is working on the case. Is she making the right choice?

episodesList.title: Relationship Trouble
episodesList.summary: Anushka faces problems while dealing with the investigating officer of a case. Meanwhile, Virat asks for Ankita's advice on breaking up with Ayesha.

episodesList.title: Soul Searching
episodesList.summary: Anushka continues her investigation into the Tara Kaul case. Meanwhile, Akshat asks for Anushka's help to get Virat and Ayesha closer.

episodesList.title: Safe Place
episodesList.summary: Akshat agrees to assist Anushka with the case. Later, Virat confesses his love to Anushka. What will be Anushka's answer?

episodesList.title: Star Maker
episodesList.summary: Anushka meets with Prashant's ex-wife to get more information about the case. Meanwhile, Virat makes some changes to the firm and keeps it a secret from Anushka.

episodesList.title: The Relationship Game
episodesList.summary: Anushka meets with the doctors and learns valuable information from Tara's autopsy reports. Later, Anushka and Virat get into an argument about their relationship.

episodesList.title: Karmic Justice
episodesList.summary: Ankita asks to live with Anushka at her house when she gets thrown out of her apartment. Meanwhile, Anushka confronts Virat about his recent behaviour at the office.

episodesList.title: Emotional Centre
episodesList.summary: Ankita tries to win over Anushka's family members while living in her house. Meanwhile, Virat asks Anushka for a second chance. What will Anushka do?

episodesList.title: Master Key
episodesList.summary: Virat reaches a landmark judgement in an important case. Meanwhile, Ankita makes her next move to solidify her place in the Raisinghani house.

episodesList.title: Challenges And Commitments
episodesList.summary: Anushka faces a challenging situation in court as Rajdeep's old rival, Rachel Simon, takes over as the defence lawyer. Meanwhile, Virat causes problems in the firm due to his treatment of the junior employees. What will Anushka do?

episodesList.title: Trust Issues
episodesList.summary: Ankita wants to extend her stay at Anushka's house and thinks of ways to impress her family members. Meanwhile, a junior employee takes drastic measures upon being pressurized by Virat.

episodesList.title: A Twist Of Fate
episodesList.summary: Anushka and Akshat's relationship goes through a rough patch when Akshat agrees to become the witness for the opposing side in the Tara Kaul case. Meanwhile, Virat apologizes to Rumina for his past behaviour in front of everyone at the firm.

episodesList.title: Falling-out
episodesList.summary: Virat feels cheated by Anushka, and both of them have a falling-out. Later, he resigns from the position of the managing leading lawyer. What will Anushka do now?

episodesList.title: North Star
episodesList.summary: Anushka meets with Virat and tries to change his mind about resigning. Meanwhile, Anushka finds out that Tara's sister hid the truth from her regarding the case. What will she do now?

episodesList.title: Commitment Issues
episodesList.summary: Raghav calls Anushka to tell her about his engagement. Meanwhile, Ankita searches for a case file in Anushka's house behind her back.

episodesList.title: Heart Of Gold
episodesList.summary: Anushka and her team consult with Tara's parents to prepare for the case. However, an unpredictable testimony from Tara's mother complicates the case even more. What will Anushka do now?

episodesList.title: Old Mistakes
episodesList.summary: Anushka reprimands Ankita and Rumina for messing up during the court hearing. Meanwhile, Virat gets a panic attack when he finds out that his mother is trying to call him.

episodesList.title: Reasonable Doubt
episodesList.summary: Anushka goes to meet Akshat at his office when he starts ignoring her calls. Meanwhile, Anushka's grandmother gets suspicious of Ankita and wants to kick her out of the house.

episodesList.title: Moral Compass
episodesList.summary: Anushka's family members think that Ankita is responsible for Rajdeep's recovery, and they let her stay in the house. Meanwhile, Akshat tries to reach out to Anushka and arrives at the court hearing to meet her.

episodesList.title: The Bigger Picture
episodesList.summary: Anushka is unable to keep up with Rachel Simon in court. Things take a turn for the worse when an important witness doesn't show up for the hearing. What will Anushka do now?

episodesList.title: Key Witness
episodesList.summary: Anushka meets mafia boss Dada Kamble to help find the missing witness for her case. Later, Ankita hands her resignation to Anushka for messing up during the court hearing.

episodesList.title: The Firm's Legacy
episodesList.summary: The firm comes under immense pressure after Anushka's defeat in the Tara Kaul case. Virat and the others are worried about the firm's viability and call for a partnership bid. Meanwhile, Anushka decides to break things off with Akshat.

episodesList.title: Buried Secrets
episodesList.summary: Anushka reaches out to Dada Kamble again for more information about her father's accident. Meanwhile, Harsh and Virat begin to dig deep into the Mehta Group case.

episodesList.title: Uncovering The Mystery
episodesList.summary: Anushka is worried as the firm is undergoing a financial crunch. Virat continues his investigation into the Mehta case. Later, Anushka finds the truck that caused her father's accident.

episodesList.title: Calculated Risk
episodesList.summary: Virat asks Anushka to accompany him for his therapy sessions. Meanwhile, Anushka's uncle gets a business offer from a rival firm.

episodesList.title: The Big Catch
episodesList.summary: Virat finds out that Dev is speaking to a rival firm for a merger. Meanwhile, Anushka confronts a journalist about the articles being published against her.

episodesList.title: One Step At A Time
episodesList.summary: Raghav and Dev ask Virat to convince Anushka for the merger. Meanwhile, Anushka asks Imran to help her investigate Rajdeep's accident.

episodesList.title: Blank Slate
episodesList.summary: Virat and Dev think of ways to convince Anushka for the merger. Meanwhile, Anushka meets Dada Kamble to step down from the case.

episodesList.title: Golden Opportunity
episodesList.summary: Virat surprises Anushka at the guest house and asks for a second chance. Meanwhile, Anushka gets a new tip from the journalist Imran Basheer.

episodesList.title: Guiding Light
episodesList.summary: Anushka feels betrayed when Virat and the others propose a merger in front of her. Will Virat be able to convince her?

episodesList.title: Securing The Future
episodesList.summary: Anushka's cousin, Siddharth, joins the firm as an assistant lawyer. Meanwhile, Ankita approaches a family to help reopen their old case.

episodesList.title: The Bitter Truth
episodesList.summary: Anushka asks for Virat's help with the Dada Kamble case. Later, Anushka finds out some shocking information about her father and his past.

episodesList.title: Unfortunate Coincidence
episodesList.summary: Anushka begins to question Rajdeep's legacy when she finds out about his involvement in illegal affairs. What will she do now?

episodesList.title: Making The Connection
episodesList.summary: Rajdeep's health worsens, and he is rushed to the hospital. Meanwhile, Virat formulates a strategy with Aryaman for his case.

episodesList.title: Valuable Player
episodesList.summary: Anushka finds out that Imran is hiding something from her. Meanwhile, Ankita and Harsh begin work on their new case.

episodesList.title: The Great Writ
episodesList.summary: Virat finds out that Imran is the stalker who has been following Anushka for the past seven years. Later, Ayesha asks Anushka to help her win Virat's heart.

episodesList.title: Last Minute Tips For Virat
episodesList.summary: Virat tries to apologise to Anushka in the office while Ankita emphasises the importance of her case to Harsh. Later, Anushka gives Virat a few last-minute tips to make his proposal to Ayesha on Valentine's Day romantic.

episodesList.title: Secrets and Revelations
episodesList.summary: Harsh reveals to Virat and Ankita the nature of the connection between Vayu Energy, Mehta Group and Shruti Yadav. Meanwhile, Anushka meets with Dada Kamble to try and get important information from him regarding his case.

episodesList.title: Strong Evidence
episodesList.summary: Harsh and Ankita are able to acquire evidence, that is strong enough to reopen the Mehtas' case. Anushka is informed about her father's unpredictable recovery. Later, while Anushka and Virat are at the hospital, the emergency alarm goes off in Rajdeep's room.

episodesList.title: Gayatri's Trust
episodesList.summary: The doctors manage to stabilise Rajdeep while Virat questions the security lapse in the hospital. Meanwhile, Dheeraj and Dev clash over Gayatri's decision to trust Anushka, as Ankita asks her mother if she's ready to go to Raisinghani Mansion.

episodesList.title: Anushka's Fear
episodesList.summary: A rattled Anushka tells Virat that Ishan Talwar has returned and was the public prosecutor against her in the Dada Kamble case. Meanwhile, Ankita and Harsh fight over the status of their relationship.

episodesList.title: The Darkness
episodesList.summary: Ishan confides in Anushka about his struggle with darkness and the steps he took to pull himself out of it. Meanwhile, Mr. Mehta decides to focus on his international business and instructs Virat to not take any hearing dates for pending cases until he returns.

episodesList.title: No Time For Love
episodesList.summary: Virat suspects that someone else is pulling the strings when Anushka expresses her frustration at Basheer's increasing demands for money. Meanwhile, Harsh tells Ankita that one can't plan when to fall in love after she tells him that she has no time for it. Will Ankita confront her feelings for Harsh?

episodesList.title: Just Friends
episodesList.summary: Anushka tells her family that Virat and she have decided to be friends, much to their disappointment. Meanwhile, Dev speaks to Dhiraj of ongoing talks to create a new firm and expresses his skepticism of his brother's complete recovery.

episodesList.title: Upholding The Law
episodesList.summary: When questioned about how Dada Kamble came to possess a .38 calibre gun from Kanpur, Anushka reminds the inspector that Dada Kamble is illegally detained. She and Virat then assert that it is a lawyer's job to ensure the police follow the law.

episodesList.title: Mr Raisinghani Is Delicate
episodesList.summary: The doctor informs Anushka that her father is in critical condition and that they will do their best to help him. Virat assures them that the culprit will be caught. Later, crucial information about the case is discussed in court.

episodesList.title: Search Warrant For Anushka's Office
episodesList.summary: A team from the Financial Crime Directorate arrives at Anushka's office looking for her, intending to search and seize documents related to the ongoing Mehta Case in court. They ask her to hand over all documents for their investigation into the money laundering case. How will Anushka handle this situation?

episodesList.title: Emergency Meeting At The Raisinghani Firm
episodesList.summary: Anushka asks Virat if it's a good idea to handle the Dada Kamble surrender case, and he assures her that they will manage it. Later, Anushka contacts Ankita and summons all the senior members for the Dada Kamble case.

episodesList.title: Raghav's Peace Treaty
episodesList.summary: Raghav proposes a peace treaty between himself, Anushka, and Virat. Considering the current state of Raisinghani Law Firm, he suggests a merger between the two firms. Will Virat and Anushka agree to this proposition, given the circumstances?

episodesList.title: Anushka's Protocols
episodesList.summary: Anushka attempts to discuss the case with Dada Kamble. Later, she and Virat have an argument regarding the same case. Will this disagreement create a rift between them?

episodesList.title: Dada Kamble Surrenders
episodesList.summary: Anushka brings the good news that Dada Kamble has agreed to surrender and shares it with Virat. Later, Virat visits Anushka's house and suggests they should give their juniors a chance to handle high-profile cases.

episodesList.title: Anushka Gets Mobbed
episodesList.summary: Anushka is mobbed by the media over the Dada Kamble case, creating a chaotic scene. Later, Rumina faces humiliation at the office. How will they handle these challenging situations?

episodesList.title: Break The Pattern
episodesList.summary: Virat has an intimate conversation with Anushka about the consequences of breaking protocols. Later, he instructs Rumina to prepare a guest list for her birthday party before they dive into the Aryaman trial preparations.

episodesList.title: Yes Or No
episodesList.summary: During the office party, Virat dances with Anushka. Later, Anushka learns that Mr. Raisinghani's condition has worsened and the next 24 hours are critical for his survival.

episodesList.title: Miracle
episodesList.summary: The doctors inform Anushka that Rajdeep Raisinghani has miraculously come out of his coma. Later, Ankita arrives to visit Rajdeep Raisinghani, adding an emotional layer to the already intense situation.

episodesList.title: Bored And Done
episodesList.summary: Anushka and Virat visit the police station to meet ACP Yogi about Mr. Raisinghani's car accident. Later, Ankita confides in Harsh about her mother being tortured and urges him to end their relationship.

episodesList.title: Aryaman's Passport
episodesList.summary: Anushka and her grandmother care for Rajdeep Raisinghani. Later, Ankita and her parents visit Anushka's house to see Rajdeep, while Aryaman arrives to discuss his case with Virat.

episodesList.title: Raisinghani Family Values
episodesList.summary: Anushka tries to persuade everyone to bring Raamya home since Rajdeep has requested her, but the family is adamant about not allowing her back. Later, Rajdeep attempts to stand on his feet.

episodesList.title: Get Raamya Back
episodesList.summary: Kersay visits Rajdeep to check on his health and tries to persuade Gayatri to let Raamya see Rajdeep. Meanwhile, Virat and Rumina make significant progress in the Aryaman case.

episodesList.title: Company By-Laws
episodesList.summary: Raamya arrives at the Raisinghani house to visit Rajdeep. Later, Ankita seeks information from James about the company by-laws. The family members oppose Raamya's stay in the house.

episodesList.title: Golden Opportunity
episodesList.summary: Raamya feels a sense of familiarity upon meeting Ankita, who denies knowing her. Meanwhile, Dev interrogates Harsh about his father, offering him a golden opportunity. Later, Raghav discusses an out-of-court settlement for Aryaman's case with Anushka and Virat.

episodesList.title: A Way To Be Good
episodesList.summary: Raamya and Anushka spend a calming time together before beginning their day. After Anushka reaches her office, Virat comforts her and invites her for dinner. Later, the family members confront Raamya and tell her they all want the same thing.

episodesList.title: Learning To Love Yourself
episodesList.summary: Raamya helps Anushka to understand the importance of self-love. Everyone rejoices as Rajdeep begins to remember his loved ones' faces. Later, Virat discovers he will be going against one of Rajdeep's rivals in court.

episodesList.title: Confrontation Of Egos
episodesList.summary: Raamya encourages Anushka and Virat to sit face to face and speak their hearts out. Later, Anushka and Virat continue to fight for their client in court.

episodesList.title: Earning A Dream
episodesList.summary: Raamya urges Anushka to be more forthcoming and grab onto any opportunities that knock on her doors. Later, Anushka and Virat discuss strategies that can help them defend their client.

episodesList.title: A Breakthrough
episodesList.summary: Raamya gets invited to the dinner table at the Raisinghani house. Virat questions Aryaman to figure out a way to win the case. Later, Raamya gets curious about Ankita and asks Anushka about her.

episodesList.title: Light After The Dark Tunnel
episodesList.summary: Anushka's friend visits her and brings her baby along. Rajdeep decides to name the baby "Anushka" in a touching gesture. Later, Ankita arrives to see Rajdeep Raisinghani.

episodesList.title: Raamya Leaves The Raisinghani House
episodesList.summary: The entire Raisinghani family expresses their gratitude to Raamya for her assistance in taking care of Rajdeep. Later, Ankita consults Harsh about filing a case, but Harsh advises against it. What will Ankita decide to do next?

episodesList.title: The Aryaman Case Verdict
episodesList.summary: Virat and Anushka are in court, diligently fighting the Aryaman case as they interrogate the witnesses. Will their efforts be enough to prove Aryaman not guilty?

episodesList.title: Victory Begins
episodesList.summary: Virat proposes to Anushka, but she remains speechless. The R Legal team celebrates their victory with their new team members. Later, Aryaman meets Virat and gifts him a car as a token of appreciation.

episodesList.title: Giving Love A Chance
episodesList.summary: Anushka consults a therapist to determine if Virat is doing well and whether she should accept his proposal. Later, Virat invites Anushka to his home to discuss the Nina Walia case, and Harsh manages to uncover some crucial information about it.

episodesList.title: Khoob Singh's Confession
episodesList.summary: Anushka and Ankita visit Khoob Singh to gather information, and Ankita discreetly records his confession. Meanwhile, Rumina talks to Virat, voicing her disappointment about not being involved in the Tara Kaul case.

episodesList.title: Rajdeep Raisinghani Is Back
episodesList.summary: Virat invites Anushka to his home to discuss Rajdeep's statement to the media regarding the leadership of R Legal. Later, Harsh confronts Ankita, accusing her of acting out of hatred. Rajdeep Raisinghani recovers and speaks to the entire family.

episodesList.title: Familyship
episodesList.summary: The Raisinghani house is filled with joy as Rajdeep has recovered. Later, Virat asks Rajdeep for Anushka's hand in marriage

episodesList.title: Power Dynamic
episodesList.summary: Anushka and Virat discuss the lead lawyer position at R Legal. Later, Rumina presents the CCT party guest list to Harsh. Meanwhile, Anushka goes to see Akshat.

episodesList.title: Stuck In A Bubble
episodesList.summary: Anushka and Virat get time to unwind when they get stuck in a bubble. They discuss strategy for their new client and uncover a lead. Later, Anushka meets Uday to tell him about the new lead she has uncovered.

episodesList.title: The Havelberg Report
episodesList.summary: Anushka and her team discover that one of their clients has been named in the Havelberg Report. The R Legal team work together to figure out the truth behind the scam that the Mehtas have been accused of.

episodesList.title: The Energy Scam
episodesList.summary: Anushka uncovers a dirty secret from Virat's past. Later, the FD shows up at R Legal, asking them to cooperate with them in the Energy Scam that the Mehtas have been accused of. Will Anushka and Virat set their differences aside to protect their client and the firm's reputation?

episodesList.title: Rajdeep's Past
episodesList.summary: Ankita reveals the truth about her mother's past and blames Rajdeep for her current state of mind. How will this change the dynamics at the Raisinghani house?

episodesList.title: Madhu And Rajdeep Come Face To Face
episodesList.summary: Ankita's mother, Madhu, comes face to face with Rajdeep, who apologizes to her. Ankita responds harshly, accusing him of being responsible for Rahul Pandey's death. Later, Anushka asks Ankita to reconsider and give them a chance.

episodesList.title: Shining Example Of Goodness
episodesList.summary: Anushka is heartbroken and feels betrayed by Ankita and Harsh, while Virat attempts to console her. Later, Virat and Anushka confront Harsh about his actions. Will they be able to resolve the situation and save R Legal?

episodesList.title: Anushka Feels Responsible
episodesList.summary: Anushka feels responsible for all the issues plaguing R Legal, while Virat attempts to comfort her. Later, Anushka confronts Rajdeep and assures him that everything will be resolved.

episodesList.title: Power Of Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Anushka is deeply heartbroken by the deaths of Harsh and Ankita and blames herself for what happened. Later, a video of Ankita brings tears to everyone’s eyes. Anushka then visits Vayu to gather information from him.

episodesList.title: R Legal Is Sealed
episodesList.summary: Anushka and Vayu have a confrontation, but just as things escalate, Virat arrives with the police, though Vayu manages to escape. Two weeks later, R Legal is sealed, and everyone is evacuated from the office. Anushka then goes to visit Nina Walia.

plotHtml:
Anushka is a clear-sighted, honest and intelligent young lawyer, striving to make her mark in her father’s prestigious law firm. Virat, an ambitious and driven young lawyer, is viewed as the natural successor of the firm. As her ethics and righteousness clash with his views and objectives, moral differences play out.
Anushka and Virat, who were once in love, are now at loggerheads. Bound by destiny and brought together by their differences, the stakes are high in this professional rivalry with starkly diverse ideologies.
The law firm’s young intern, Ankita Pandey, is navigating her way with her own dark secrets. Her position at the firm is much more than what meets the eye. Watch her journey unfold as she lays claim to what she believes is rightfully hers.
tagline: Anushka is a clear-sighted, honest and intelligent young lawyer, striving to make her mark in her father’s prestigious law firm.

title: Razia
summary: Razia is a 2023 Pakistani television miniseries that premiered on Express Entertainment. It stars Mahira Khan, Shaheera Jalil Albasit (as Razia), Moomal Sheikh and Mohib Mirza. The series is directed and written by Mohsin Ali and produced by Kamran Afridi and Hina Aman. The series premiered on 15  September 2023 and concluded on 19 October 2023.
plot: The miniseries is based on social issues regarding women's status and the problems they face because of biased opinions regarding gender roles in society. The story revolves around Razia (played by Shaheera Jalil Albasit), the first-born daughter in her family where everyone had desired for a boy. The series chronicles her journey towards independence and realization of self-worth beginning when her brother was born and becomes the limelight of the house.

title: Rafuchakkar
summary: Rafuchakkar is a 2023  Hindi-language heist comedy TV series on JioCinema. It is written by Arjun Singgh Baran and Kartik Nishandar and directed by Ritam Srivastav. It stars Maniesh Paul, Priya Bapat, Aksha Pardasany, Sushant Singh, Lekha Prajapati and Chahat Vig.
plot: A weird tale of Pawan Kumar, often known as Prince, who is accused of committing odd frauds involving anything from diet cookies to low-cost aeroplanes. A guy of many guises, is he a con artist or simply an upright man caught up in the web built up around him?

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Rafuchakkar is scheduled to be released on JioCinema on 15 June 2023.

episodesList.title: The game begins
episodesList.summary: Pawan Kumar Bawaria aka Prince, a con artist from Nainital, is caught by the Crime Branch officer, Shaurya Chautala, for duping eminent citizen Sarvesh Pathania. He is taken to court, where his friend Jaidev defends him against the public prosecutor.

episodesList.title: Cat and mouse
episodesList.summary: In a back-and-forth between the courtroom in the present and Shaurya's investigation in the past. Just when it seems that the case is swinging in Prince's favour, a new twist arises in the form of three new witnesses from Ahmedabad.

episodesList.title: Magic biscuits
episodesList.summary: A new con comes to light when the 3 witnesses allege that they have been conned by Kirtan Gada, an alibi of Pawan, posing as a fitness trainer. The noose tightens further around Prince as Ritu demands something that will nail him: a polygraph test.

episodesList.title: True or false
episodesList.summary: The Polygraph test begins. At first, Prince is able to dodge the questions but stumbles when he sees Harpreet Singh who alleges that he was conned by Manjeet Walia. The polygraph test turns the tables in favour of Ritu and Shaurya.

episodesList.title: Con the conman
episodesList.summary: The trial continues with Pawan yet to be proven guilty. This leads to a desperate situation and Pathania, Ritu, and Shaurya plan to trap Pawan. But their plans are laid bare when the Judge sides with Pawan and gives him bail.

episodesList.title: Double agent
episodesList.summary: Prince plans new cons and one of his victims includes who works as a property dealer in Gurgaon. He tries to persuade Ritu to join his side. But things don't go as smoothly as Shaurya begins to see through Prince's machinations.

episodesList.title: Blast from the past
episodesList.summary: Shaurya and Ritu plan to track Prince's past. Soon Prince is back in court. But Jaidev is absent, having dropped the case. With Shaurya, Pathania and Ritu, Prince finds himself surrounded. Ritu reveals a secret about Pawan's past.

episodesList.title: Motivation
episodesList.summary: Ritu reveals the real motive for every con that Prince has done and seeks punishment for him. Just then when hope seems lost, Prince has a saviour who helps turn the tables in his favour leaving Shaurya and Ritu frustrated.

episodesList.title: Birds of a feather
episodesList.summary: Prince presents proof of illegality against Pathania. He reveals the reason for Pathania's interest to see him apprehended. He accepts the charges, in return for Pathania's arrest. Is his new attitude towards Ritu and Shaurya another trick?

title: Rana Naidu
summary:
Rana Naidu is an Indian action crime drama television series on Netflix directed by Karan Anshuman and Suparn Verma.  It is the Netflix’s first Telugu original series. Adapted from the popular American Showtime series Ray Donovan.
On 19 April 2023, the show was renewed for a second season, starring Arjun Rampal as the antagonist.
reception:
Sangeetha Devi Dundoo for The Hindu wrote "Beneath all that dressing up of sex, alcohol and expletives, Rana Naidu has an undercurrent of pathos. Cinematographer Jayakrishna Gummadi uses warm and dark tones to accentuate the grim atmosphere, aided by John Stewart Eduri's background score."
Raghu Bandi for The Indian Express wrote "The overall story-broken family working hard to come together-actually suits Indian sensibilities. But the way it is treated is not to everyone's taste."
Saibal Chatterjee for NDTV rated 2.5 stars out of 5 and wrote "As a series of ten episodes of an average of 50 minutes each, it had the potential for significant tonal variations. A lot of it remains unrealised because the show never quite breaks into a canter. Parts of Rana Naidu are monotonous."
Deepa Gahlot saw a mix of violence and sex in the series and wrote for Rediff.com in her review "Profane language is now par for the course for series about gangsters and a liberal sprinkling of cuss words do not even register anymore. But even so, the overuse of the 'G' word is simply annoying."
Vijayalakshmi Narayanan for The Free Press Journal rated the series 1 star out of 5 and wrote "With cusswords and sexually explicit scenes hitting you like a ton of bricks, you'd have to wonder how 'Rana Naidu' was approved for viewing despite 'College Romance', a relatively harmless show about youngsters, facing a legal notice from the Delhi High Court for 'obscene and vulgar' language."
Deep Haider of India Today rated the series 2.5 stars out of 5 and wrote "Rana Naidu could have been a welcome relief from the worldwide wokeness that has afflicted our creative spaces. It does not."
Udita Jhunjhunwala of Scroll.in wrote "It appears as though the creators directed Rana Daggubati to be one-note. If so, he's aced it. He rarely smiles and barely gives his rage a break. In the moments when Rana Naidu quietly, but visibly, masks his judgement or extends a compassionate gesture, you feel a connection with him, but briefly."
Haricharan Pudipeddi for Hindustan Times wrote "Rana Naidu takes the whole family dynamics and gives it a sinister twist. Here's a family that's more flawed than one can even imagine."
Sanchita Jhunjhunwala of Zoom TV rated the series 4 stars out of 5 and wrote "A well written and directed series is one which has a balance of what it tells us it has to offer. As a crime drama, there's just enough crime going on and at the same time, there's also a lot of drama - be it the family, the kids, or the politics, among other things."

episodesList.title: One Last Job
episodesList.summary: Rana Naidu attempts to retire from his life as a fixer and focus on his family, but his son Ani is kidnapped by the gangster Rauf. Forced back into the criminal underworld, Rana seeks help from his estranged father, Naga. Together, they plan Ani's rescue with the assistance of powerful ally Viraj Oberoi.

episodesList.title: Bada Kutta
episodesList.summary: While Rana confronts Rauf in prison, his wife Naina grows emotionally distant and confides in a new acquaintance, Naveen. Meanwhile, Rana tries to balance Ani's safety with keeping his criminal dealings away from his children.

episodesList.title: Well Played Mr. Naidu
episodesList.summary: Rauf begins blackmailing Rana to bend him to his will. Ani's birthday celebration turns tense as Rana and Naina's marital strain deepens, and family tensions threaten to boil over.

episodesList.title: Kacchaa Limbu
episodesList.summary: Naga and Tej execute a dangerous heist at Oberoi Studios, seeking leverage against Viraj. Elsewhere, Naina's closeness with Naveen unsettles Rana. Rana struggles to protect both his family and his brother Jaffa, who is preparing for his marriage to Tasneem.

episodesList.title: It Will Never Be Okay
episodesList.summary: After Tej is brutally attacked in prison, Rana makes desperate attempts to free him. At the same time, Nitya becomes trapped in a violent shootout, escalating Rana's fear that his family will never be safe from the consequences of his life.

episodesList.title: Double Dholki
episodesList.summary: Owing Viraj Oberoi a debt, Rana is coerced into covering up the murder of Paritosh. Anjali manipulates Naga into carrying out a dangerous mission, while Naina's relationship with Naveen continues to test her loyalty to Rana.

episodesList.title: Sumdi Mein Lomdi
episodesList.summary: Naveen seizes an opportunity to frame Rana for a crime, hoping to drive a wedge between him and Naina. During the wedding festivities of Jaffa and Tasneem, Rauf launches a deadly ambush, leaving Tej critically injured and Tasneem wounded.

episodesList.title: One Last Job Again
episodesList.summary: The Naidu family reels from the wedding attack as Tej fights for his life. Rana finally confronts Rauf and kills him. Before dying, Rauf reveals that OB Mahajan betrayed Rana by leaking Nitya's whereabouts. Rana confronts OB with a gun, forcing him to face his guilt. Later, at Tej's funeral, police arrest Rana for Rauf's murder. As Rana is taken away, Naga vows to break him out, setting up the continuation of the story.

title: Roktokorobi
summary:
Roktokorobi is a Bengali thriller drama web-series starring Raima Sen, Vikram Chatterjee, Rooqma Ray, Tulika Basu, Laboni Sarkar, Shantilal Mukherjee, Bhaswar Chatterjee, Abhijit Guha and Haridas Chatterjee. It is produced by Sahana Dutta and Rohit Samanta and directed by Sayantan Ghoshal.
The series premiered on ZEE5 on 3 February 2023.
plot: The story revolves around psychologist Satyaki (Vikram Chatterjee) visiting his aunt's place in a Uraldanga and comes across several mysteries in the house.
reception: Sangbad Pratidin rated it 3 out of 5 stars. Rating the show 4 out of 5 stars, OTTplay in its review commented, "Despite the lacunas, Roktokorobi is a fantastic production. A crime and its multidimensional perspectives are beautifully addressed in the show."

title: Ranga Bou
summary: Ranga Bou is an Indian Bengali language Drama television series that premiered on 19 December 2022 on Zee Bangla. The series is produced under the banner of Crazy Ideas Media. It stars Shruti Das and Gourab Roychowdhury in lead roles. The show ran for nearly a year and concluded on 16 December 2023 after airing approximately 314 episodes.

title: Rabb Se Hai Dua
summary: Rabb Se Hai Dua (transl. My Prayer to God) is an Indian Hindi-language drama television series that premiered on 28 November 2022 on Zee TV and is digitally available on ZEE5. Produced by Prateek Sharma under LSD Films Private Limited, it formerly starred Aditi Sharma, Karanvir Sharma and Richa Rathore. From February 2024 to December 2024, it starred Yesha Rughani, Dheeraj Dhoopar and Seerat Kapoor as the second generation leads.
plot:
Haider Akhtar is a wealthy businessman who is married to Dua, a kind woman. Their lives take a turn when they meet an outspoken woman, Ghazal, who befriends Dua but is at loggerheads with Haider. Haider and Dua offer shelter to Ghazal in their own house after her house gets destroyed by an earthquake. Haider befriends Ghazal too. Ghazal falls in love with Haider but tries to forget him for Dua's sake. Haider's stepmother, Gulnaaz, instigates Ghazal and reveals to her how Haider's mother, Hina, had caused Ghazal's mother's death years ago. Before dying of cancer, Ghazal's father had proposed Haider and Ghazal's marriage but Hina had declined as Dua was already engaged to Haider at that time. Ghazal turns vengeful and pretends to have forgiven Hina but vows revenge.
When Dua discovers Ghazal's grudge against Hina, she attempts to evict her from the house. Ghazal lies to Gulnaaz's son, Ruhaan, who was in love with her, that she loves him too and Hina fixes their alliance. Gulnaaz turns against Ghazal. Ghazal creates circumstances and manipulates Ruhaan into believing that she and Haider are having an affair. Thus, Ruhaan runs away on the wedding day with Dua's help. Ghazal gets Ruhaan abducted by her cousin, Ejaz. Dua is blamed for Ruhaan's escape. Ghazal reveals to Haider that Hina was responsible for her parents' death and pretends to commit suicide if he doesn't marry her.
Feeling guilty for Hina and Ruhaan's actions, Haider ends up marrying Ghazal. Everyone in the house refuses to accept Ghazal, except Hina who turns against Dua. Dua, motivated by her mother Hamida, turns bold and rebellious, refusing to perform her duties as a daughter-in-law and a wife. Ruhaan is rescued and brought back home, but he believes Dua and Haider to be his enemies. Later, Ruhaan learns about Ghazal's schemes and reconciles with Dua. Ghazal is finally exposed but she pushes Hina off the balcony, causing her to loose her memory. Ghazal uses Haider's sperm samples and gets pregnant via IVF. Once Hina recovers her memories, the Akhtar family lodge a police complaint against Ghazal. Still on the run from the police, Ghazal goes into hiding, thus concealing her pregnancy from everyone. Dua is also revealed to be pregnant.
Six months later, Kaynaat, Haider's sister, gives birth to her son, Subhaan. Dua's baby shower ceremony is interrupted by Ghazal who reveals her pregnancy and demands her rights. Dua allows Ghazal to stay in a warehouse under surveillance, near the Akhtar mansion. Kaynaat's hatred grows against Ghazal and her unborn child as she considers it as a threat to her family. Kaynaat is ousted from the house by Dua after she abducts Ghazal. With Dua’s help, Ghazal delivers a baby girl, Ibaadat.
Shortly, thereafter Dua too delivers a baby girl, Mannat. Realizing that she won't be able to live happily with Haider ever, Ghazal jumps down from the cliff, pulling Haider along with her, resulting in both of their deaths. Kaynaat blames Dua for Haider's death as she had previously ignored her warning to oust Ghazal from the house. Soon, Kaynaat is forced to shift to London with her family after she tried to kill Ibaadat again and vowed revenge on Dua.

articleSections.title: After 22 years
articleSections.text:
Unwitting half-sisters, Ibaadat and Mannat are now grown up and share a strong sisterly bond, believing themselves to be twins. Ibaadat values her family the most and has turned out to be simple, confident and sweet. Mannat is spoiled, self-obsessed and over-pampered by the family. Dua is indifferent towards Ibaadat, who craves for Dua’s love since childhood. The family still despises Ibaadat while the only one to support her is Hamida. Ibaadat and Mannat goes to court and fights for the right of Muslim women who are victims of marital violence and their spouses marrying more than one wife according to the laws of Islam and they are appealing to the court to correct the injustice against women. Meanwhile, Subhan under the pen name of SS(secret superstar) becomes a superstar. Kaynaat returns to India with her family. Ibaadat has been writing emails to Subhaan all these years, under the name of Mannat, so that Subhaan doesn't get upset. In the present, Subhaan confesses his love for Mannat, thinking she was the one who wrote emails to him, and proposes her.
When Ibaadat risks her life to save a drunk Mannat from getting molested by her lover Farhaan, Dua accepts Ibaadat as her daughter and apologizes to her for not giving affection to her all these years. Gulnaaz and her grandchildren instigate Mannat against Ibaadat, making her believe that Farhaan was innocent and that Ibaadat wants to separate her from Farhaan. Mannat agrees to marry Subhaan. To seek revenge, Mannat conspires and creates circumstances which make it look like Ibaadat wants to steal Subhaan from her. Thus, Ibaadat receives backlash from Hina and Kaynaat. On the wedding day, Mannat runs away with Farhaan, leaving Subhaan at the altar. Ibaadat and Subhaan get married at Dua's behest while Mannat returns after receiving mistreatment from Farhaan.
A vengeful Subhaan pretends to romance Ibaadat to make Mannat jealous. Ibaadat reveals to Subhaan that she was the one who wrote emails to but he feels betrayed because she lied to him all these years. Mannat decides to snatch Subhaan from Ibaadat, after Kaynaat reveals to her the story of Dua-Haider-Ghazal and that Ibaadat is Ghazal's daughter. Mannat and Farhaan manipulate Subhaan into believing that Ibaadat had pre-planned everything with Farhaan, thus making Ibaadat evil in Subhaan's eyes. Subhaan begins hating Ibaadat and starts an affair with Mannat. Ibaadat discovers their affair and feels betrayed. With Dua and Hamida's support, Ibaadat turns outspoken and bold and stops Mannat and Subhaan's wedding. A furious Mannat reveals to Ibaadat that her real mother is actually Ghazal, leaving Ibaadat shattered. Subhaan pretends to be remorseful for his deeds infront of Ibaadat but actually plots with Mannat to gather evidence against her to divorce her.
When Mannat defames Ibaadat's character in court, an enraged Subhaan slaps her and refuses to divorce Ibaadat. Ghazal is revealed to be alive and has returned after 22 years, to seek revenge on Dua and protect her daughter Ibaadat. Mannat tries to kill Ibaadat and Subhaan breaks up with Mannat. Subhaan and Ibaadat confess their love and reunite. Angered by Mannat's attempt to kill Ibaadat, Ghazal frames Mannat for Farhaan's murder as revenge. Ibaadat, Mannat and Subhaan make Ghazal confess to killing Farhaan and framing Mannat. Ghazal tries to shoot Dua, but Mannat takes the bullet. Ghazal is arrested by the police. Mannat recovers, turns over a new leaf and unites Subhaan and Ibaadat. Kaynaat accepts Ibaadat as her daughter-in-law. Ibaadat is revealed to be pregnant with Subhaan's child and the family rejoices. The show ends on a happy note.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: The series is produced by Prateek Sharma under the banner of LSD Films Private Limited. It is Zee TV's fourth show with an Islamic background after Qubool Hai, Ishq Subhan Allah and Qurbaan Hua.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Karanvir Sharma was cast to portray the male lead Haider, marking his return after Shaurya Aur Anokhi Ki Kahani. It was reported that Aalisha Panwar News were that Aalisha Panwar or Roopal Tyagi will be play the parallel lead Ghazal, but finally Richa Rathore was cast to portray Ghazal opposite Karanvir Sharma, marking her comeback after Aapki Nazron Ne Samjha.

title: Raazz Mahal
summary: Raazz Mahal (transl. Royal Palace - Mystery Of Demon) is an Indian Hindi-language fantasy drama television series premiered on 28 November 2022 on Shemaroo Umang. Produced by Rashmi Sharma under the banner of Rashmi Sharma Telefilms, it stars Himanshu Soni, Neha Harsora and Ridheema Tiwari. It ended on 27 May 2023.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Himanshu Soni as Adhiraj, and Neha Harsora as Sunaina were signed in the lead roles. Ridheema Tiwari was cast to portray the negative lead.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: The series was announcement by Rashmi Sharma Telefilms for Shemaroo Entertainment. The shooting of the series began in November 2022, mainly shot at the Film City, Mumbai. The promos were released in November 2022. It premiered on 28 November 2022 on Shemaroo Umang.

title: Rajjo
summary: Rajjo is an Indian Hindi-language television drama series that premiered on 22 August 2022 on StarPlus and digitally streams on Disney+ Hotstar. The show is produced by Bits N Bots Media and stars Celesti Bairagey, Rajveer Singh and Gungun Uprari in the titular roles. It is an official Hindi remake of Star Jalsha’s Aalta Phoring. It was replaced by Teri Meri Doriyaann in its timeslot.
plot: The show revolves around the trials and tests of an aspiring athlete Rajjo from Uttarakhand. Her mother, Manorama, has a dark past, and hence is against Rajjo’s dreams of turning an athlete. After getting separated by her mother in Kedarnath flood and crossing-paths with a fertilizer businessman Arjun, how will Rajjo react to the past, and manage to win her dreams in the present?

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Celesti Bairagey as Rajjo Dhaki Thakur – An aspiring athlete; Manorama and Pushkar's daughter; Kalindi, Niharika and Bunty's half-sister; Mukund, Sagar and Pankhuri's cousin; Vicky's ex-fiancé; Arjun's wife (2022—2023) * Rajveer Singh as Arjun Singh Thakur – A fertilizer businessman; Madhumalti and Pratap's younger son; Chirag's brother; Mukund, Rocky, Sagar and Pankhuri's cousin; Urvashi's ex-fiancé; Rajjo's husband. (2022—2023) * Gungun Uprari as Manorama "Manno" Dhaki – A former athlete; Pushkar's ex-lover; Rajjo's mother. (2022—2023)

articleSections.title: Broadcast
articleSections.text: The show was moved from its original time slot on 4 January 2023. It was replaced by Teri Meri Doriyaann in its original time slot. Speaking on the same, actor Rajveer Singh said, "At the end of the day, it is the channel's decision. Our show is moving to that slot and I think we will do good in that slot, too. In the 7 pm slot, we have been consistent and so I don't feel that our show was moved due to low ratings. In fact, in the last two weeks, our ratings have improved. Maybe, the channel wants to make the 6.30 slot more engaging for viewers."

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Celesti Bairagey was chosen after she released a video of herself in a Gangubai Kathiawadi clip, which went viral.
Post Bairagey, Rajveer Singh and Gungun Uprari too were signed along with other actors to join the cast.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The first promo of Rajjo was released in July 2022. It replaced Kabhi Kabhie Ittefaq Sey from 22 August 2022.

articleSections.title: Title
articleSections.text: The show was initially promoted with the title Udti Ka Naam Rajjo, before it was modified to Rajjo.

title: Recce
summary: Recce is an Indian Telugu-language crime-thriller web series directed by Poluru Krishna. It featured Sriram, Siva Balaji, Dhanya Balakrishna, Saranya Pradeep, Rajashree, Aadukalam Naren and Ester Noronha in main roles. Recce premiered on 17 June 2022 on ZEE5. As of 22 June 2022, it has 40 million streaming minutes.
plot: In 1992, in Tadipatri of Andhra Pradesh, a son consumed by greed and lust hires people to kill his own father and ends up falling to his own demise. S.I Lenin who investigates these murders uncovers the underbelly of familial relationships that when consumed by jealousy, lust and greed, even families can turn lethal.
reception: The Times of India gave a rating of 3.5 out of 5 and stated that "Poluru Krishna, who also worked on story adaptation, screenplay and dialogues, did a fabulous job narrating this bold and gripping crime thriller". 123Telugu opined that Recce is "one of the finest political crime thrillers with some decent performances, and excellent background score". Satya Pulagam of ABP Nadu appreciated cinematography, background score and screenplay by Poluru Krishna.

title: Ravivaar With Star Parivaar
summary: Ravivaar With Star Parivaar (transl. "Sunday with Star Family") is an Indian Hindi-language television game show that premiered on 12 June 2022 on StarPlus. It digitally streams on Disney+ Hotstar. The series is a remake of the Tamil reality script show Enkitta Modhaade The series is hosted by Arjun Bijlani and Amaal Mallik and features various StarPlus television series casts competing in a music competition. The show features eight shows competing against each other to win the title of Best Parivaar. Team Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai emerged as the winner of the show.

title: RaanBaazaar
summary: RaanBaazaar is an Indian Marathi-language thriller-drama web series written and directed by Abhijeet Panse. The show features Tejaswini Pandit, Prajakta Mali, Mohan Agashe, Makarand Anaspure, Sachin Khedekar. The series was launched on 20 May 2022, garnered acclaim across Maharashtra due to its compelling narrative rooted in real-life events.
plot:
In a state government, things get all shaky because two people doing an old job accidentally become super important in a mix of politics, power, and secret plans. The choices these two make mess up the political world, making the stable government start wobbling because of unexpected problems and how people relate to each other.
As the story goes on, the government machine that used to run smoothly now struggles with the results, and the state government is almost falling apart. This interesting story shows how personal decisions mix up with big government stuff, showing a lively picture where power structures and people's lives come together in a story that goes beyond what society expects.
reception:
Upon release, Chitrali Chogale-Anavkar of Lokmat rated the show 4 out of 5 and said, "In short, the storm in politics created by the two ladies is definitely a must watch and equally entertaining. For Prajakta's acting, Abhijeet Panse's direction, a boldly different story and an entertaining experience, definitely watch 'Raanbazaar..."
Shaheen Irani from OTTplay reviewed that "Raanbaazaar finale is so worth the time it took. The episode comes a full circle, in a way that you would barely expect it to. It is not your happy ending kind of a show but the real elements and how everything is dealt with, is what makes this series so special. Watch this one without fail."
Salonee Mistry of Pune Mirror rated it 4 stars and stated that the series is clutter breaking and promises edges of the seat thriller and powerful performance.

episodesList.title: Kaand
episodesList.summary: Appa Divekar, a wise retired journalist, shares the tale of Maharashtra's government downfall with two young reporters. In a quiet newsroom corner, he unfolds the story of political twists, corruption, and power struggles that shook the state. Through his experienced eyes, the young journalists glimpse the past, inheriting the torch of journalistic legacy as they absorb the turbulent narrative of Maharashtra's political history.

episodesList.title: Karma
episodesList.summary: Chaos ensues as the leader of the opposition, Sayajirao Patil, is discovered dead in a hotel room, sending shockwaves through the political landscape.

episodesList.title: Gurudakshina
episodesList.summary: Under mounting pressure, the Chief Minister of Maharashtra instructs the Joint Commissioner of Police to locate Ayesha. Faced with limited options, the Jt. CP is compelled to seek assistance from the suspended officer, Charudutt Mokashi, in a desperate bid to unravel the mystery.

episodesList.title: Moksha
episodesList.summary: As the search for Ayesha intensifies, the name of casting director Farooq surfaces. Despite relentless efforts, Mokashi finds himself unable to reach or apprehend Farooq in the pursuit of crucial information.

episodesList.title: Chakva
episodesList.summary: The suspense reaches a climax as Mokashi captures a waiter attempting to conceal a hidden camera in Ayesha's room, unraveling a colossal scandal that shakes the foundations of the unfolding mystery. The revelation adds a new layer of intrigue to the unfolding drama.

episodesList.title: Shodh
episodesList.summary: Under pressure, Sayajirao's family compels Mokashi to halt the investigation and close the case swiftly. Simultaneously, Sub-Inspector Palande uncovers intriguing evidence, adding a new twist to the unfolding narrative.

episodesList.title: Pita

episodesList.title: Nirvan

Meanwhile, in a significant turn, Mokashi uncovers buried evidence during the ongoing investigation, potentially reshaping the course of the narrative.

plotHtml:
In a state government, things get all shaky because two people doing an old job accidentally become super important in a mix of politics, power, and secret plans. The choices these two make mess up the political world, making the stable government start wobbling because of unexpected problems and how people relate to each other.
As the story goes on, the government machine that used to run smoothly now struggles with the results, and the state government is almost falling apart. This interesting story shows how personal decisions mix up with big government stuff, showing a lively picture where power structures and people's lives come together in a story that goes beyond what society expects.
tagline: In a state government, things get all shaky because two people doing an old job accidentally become super important in a mix of politics, power, and secret plans.

title: Roohaniyat
summary:
Roohaniyat (transl. Spirituality) is an Indian, Hindi-Language streaming  television series, directed by Glen Barretto and Ankush Mohla for MX Player Originals. The series stars Arjun Bijlani and Kanika Mann in key roles alongside Smita Bansal and Aman Yatan Verma with Yuvika Chaudhary in a special appearance. It is based on the Forever Series by Novoneel Chakraborty with new characters and additional storyline written by Shilpa Choubey and Sushil Choubey .
On 23 March 2022 the first chapter was released on MX Player including 13 episodes. It became the first long format series to be released on any OTT platform. The first chapter received positive reviews from critics. The second chapter was set to release on 21 April in the same year but got delayed and was postponed to 22 July 2022. The trailer for the second chapter released on 14 July 2022. The second chapter was released on 22 July 2022 by a 3 episodic release window which opened every Friday, 11 AM IST. With the release of the second chapter, Roohaniyat made it to COTT's Top 10 OTT shows of 2022 with a total of 25.95 million views, positioned at the 9th spot.
The web series was shot in various locations in Pune, Mumbai, Mahabaleshwar, Panchgani and Lonavala.
The songs in the web series were composed by Rishabh Srivastava for chapter 1, while Paresh Shah and SCAR composed songs for chapter 2. Rishabh Srivastava also provided the score for chapter 1 and chapter 2. Paresh Shah Studios contributed in score for chapter 2 only. The songs in the first chapter were released officially on 26 August 2022, including the tracks 1 to 7.

articleSections.title: Summary
articleSections.text: The series follows the story of Saveer Rathod, a man who has faced certain situations in his life that have led him to believe that love does not last forever, and Prisha Srivastava, a teen who strongly believes in love. The two are complete strangers to each other, only till they are met again and again by coincidence or destiny, as Saveer believes it. Prisha somehow ends up playing a crucial role in Saveer's life and discovers something terrible about him that changes her life in a way she never could have expected.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Arjun Bijlani as Saveer Rathod, CEO of Rooh Publications; Prisha's boyfriend; Ishanvi's ex-boyfriend * Kanika Mann as Prisha Srivastava, an aspiring author; intern at Rooh Publications; Saveer's girlfriend

episodesList.title: Forever Is a Lie
episodesList.summary: Our protagonist is Saveer Rathod who is madly in love with Ishanvi. On his birthday he asks her not to give him any kind of surprise but himself gets surprised and shocked when his fiancé gets killed just to realize that he is being blamed for the same

episodesList.title: Middle Finger
episodesList.summary: Prisha is upset about what happened with Rishi, in anger she decided to fill her bag with gifts she also tells her mother that she has decided to change her college course her mother supports her decision

episodesList.title: Blind Date
episodesList.summary: Saveer is still wondering about the footage in the pen drive. The gang of friends has returned from Mahabaleshwar, Prisha seems to be in a bad mood, and she speaks about an addition of a vamp type character in her life, Gouri & Diggy leave her to her thoughts.

episodesList.title: Thank You
episodesList.summary: Prisha wakes up in a hospital bed as she gets flashes of the previous night. She looks for her friends who are also admitted they discuss the chain of events that took place in the previous night.

episodesList.title: Suicide Attempt
episodesList.summary: Saveer is getting ready, yet again he finds his pen drive. He finds strange footage of himself; he tries to recreate it but then wonders why he would do something like that. Prisha sees her mother thinking about the previous happy moments of her marriage, but she is thinking about how things got sore between her and Ashok.

episodesList.title: Unconditional Love
episodesList.summary: Saveer is surprised to see that Prisha is his blind date. He gets upset and explains how she is behaving childish this puts a thought in Prisha’s head. Saveer gets back into his car we see someone keeping an eye on him.

episodesList.title: Destiny
episodesList.summary: Anu jokes about how a 19-year-old put Saveer in a spot. Meanwhile the rest of the office staff introduce the gang to Rooh Publications. After their work the gang decides to go for a movie Saveer in his car notices a bubbly Prisha.

episodesList.title: Dream
episodesList.summary: Saveer is discussing his grandmother health with the doctor. Anu asks Saveer to meet the interns he refuses and tells Anu to handle it. Saveer is thinking about Ishanvi in his cabin.

episodesList.title: Roohaniyat
episodesList.summary: Saveer visits his grandfather’s tomb he is worried about his life. Prisha is rushing to office she drops all her papers and Saveer reaches but he doesn’t help her this ticks off Prisha.

episodesList.title: New Beginnings
episodesList.summary: Prisha is drooling over Saveer as he enters the office, he is about to walk towards Prisha but he is interrupted by Anu.

episodesList.title: Girlfriend Killer
episodesList.summary: Prisha and Gouri are discussing about Saveer at the breakfast table, later Rishi comes to meet Prisha and they have an argument Prisha tells him to stay away Saveer sees this. At the breakfast table Prisha and Gouri see Diggy arrive with Mrinal they enquire if there is something between them and Diggy refuses.

episodesList.title: Who the Hell Is Prisha
episodesList.summary: Saveer is in his room thinking about his conversation with Prisha. Anu enters his room, mean while Prisha is looking up Saveer’s murder case. Anu makes a move on Saveer he is drunk, and he happens to see Prisha he pushes Anu away and passes out.

episodesList.title: Departure
episodesList.summary: Prisha is upset and is standing by the pool, her leg slips, and she falls into the pool. Saveer arrives at the last minute and saves her. Next morning Prisha wakes up with a hangover and Gouri and Diggy taunt her about her dinking, they revisit her story and make fun of her.

episodesList.title: Thank You
episodesList.summary: Prisha, Gouri & Diggy are discussing her attraction for Saveer, Gouri and Diggy get worried that she is falling for him. Saveer is at home he has made pasta for himself he gets a call from Anu she says that Prisha has uploaded a podcast that she has not approved, but there is no problem as the podcast is good.

episodesList.title: I Am in Love
episodesList.summary: Prisha says thank you to Saveer they have a romantic moment. Prisha has a moment with Saveer’s saxophone, and the gang has a fun moment with each other. Anu and Saveer are talking in his cabin she is telling him that Prisha is an excellent writer.

episodesList.title: She Has a Crush on You
episodesList.summary: On the club’s anniversary waiter is distributing shots to people. Prisha, Gauri and Diggi are dancing. Rehman approaches Prisha to dance with him but she refuses. Gouri hits him and everyone starts fighting.

episodesList.title: Laghbagh
episodesList.summary: Prisha dreams about Saveer who is romantically asking her to express her feelings. Prisha is kissing in the dream and all this is being watched by Gauri and Diggi who are making her video. Diggi tries to understand why Gauri and Prisha have fallen for mature guys to which Gauri says that girls get mature faster so they gel well with older men.

episodesList.title: Kaash Aur Laghbagh
episodesList.summary: The pink shoe person is on the same bus as Prisha, thinking about Saveer and filling the diary with her words. Prisha is dreaming about Saveer when she sees that Saveer is in a bathtub in the center of the garden and asks Prisha to come and sit near him by calling her Isha.

episodesList.title: First Kiss
episodesList.summary: Prisha removes the cigarette buds on her scooty through the same warning of ‘Stay away’ repeated on a poster which is on the rod of a spear. Saveer realizes that he loves Prisha while watching the footage of the photo shoot in which Prisha is there.

episodesList.title: He Is Chasing Me
episodesList.summary: Prisha has an illusion of Saveer. Saveer reaches home and wonders how Ishanvi’s photo frame is broken. He checks his house but doesn’t find anyone. He talks to Ishanvi’s photo asking if she is okay with Prisha being in his life. He receives a positive response.

episodesList.title: We Are a Couple
episodesList.summary: A parking siren breaks and Saveer wonders how come his car has come home. He doesn’t understand where he has kept the keys and so he calls Krishna who tells him that he had messaged him to repair his car and had asked him to keep the keys under the doormat.

episodesList.title: Happy Birthday Prisha Srivastava
episodesList.summary: Anu is very upset. On a video call, Gauri tells Prisha that maybe Saveer is planning a surprise for her. Someone is watching Prisha from outside her room window. When Prisha gets up the next day she sees some mud on her floor and asks Priya about the same who wishes her a very happy birthday and asks her to wear the new top.

episodesList.title: Adhuri Kiss
episodesList.summary: Prisha and Saveer are returning and we go into a flashback where Prisha remembers how the tent caught fire and Saveer got a lighter with SR encrypted on it. Saveer asks Prisha to leave from there. Priya makes Ashok taste his own medicine when he confronts Priya on meeting Madhur.

episodesList.title: Fur Wala Stole
episodesList.summary: Saveer sees the video of how his and Prisha’s photo was burnt by the lighter in his hands. He is not able to understand when he shot this from the camera. He sees Ishanvi who tells him that he should tell the truth to Prisha as his birthday is approaching.

episodesList.title: Self Isolation
episodesList.summary: Prisha wakes up at home though she remembers being at the Saveer’s place. Saveer is in a shower. His phone rings. He sees Prisha’s missed calls he feels he is doing the right thing and doesn’t call her back.

episodesList.title: Dil Pe Tattoo
episodesList.summary: Shelly asks Prisha if Saveer is her boyfriend and hands over Rishi and Prisha’s photos to her. Prisha warns Shelly that Rishi has not moved on yet a person who can ditch once can do it twice. Prisha meets Saveer at the Rooh office and forcefully sits in his car while he tries to come out.

episodesList.title: Forever Is a Lie
episodesList.summary: It's midnight when his birthday starts and the doorbell rings. Saveer opens the door and finds a bouquet with a box wrapped in a happy birthday wrapper in which he finds a knife with SR written on it. Prisha’s voice enquires from him if this gift is for her and she vanishes.

episodesList.title: Life and Death
episodesList.summary: The previous season ends when we see Saveer pushing Prisha from a cliff to find out if she will survive and if Saveer is responsible for her accident

episodesList.title: Back Off Prisha…Back Off…
episodesList.summary: While Prisha battles between life and death. Inspector Rebeiro has started investigating her case. Prisha's friends and family are worried for her health and Saveer wakes up at his old farmhouse.

episodesList.title: Not Again Saveer
episodesList.summary: We see Saveer in the hospital but to our surprise, he is here to threaten Prisha, tell her to stay away or she won't be lucky next time. Prisha's family is wondering how all of this conspires. Meanwhile, a broken Saveer visits the police station to confess.

episodesList.title: Saveer Gayab Hai
episodesList.summary: After a few days, we see Prisha walking in the hospital garden she seems to have recovered well. Prisha is back in her room the nurse tells her to rest if she wants to get better soon. She feels Saveer standing in front of her he apologizes for her condition. Anu comes to the farmhouse with cup noodles She introduces him to Brownie. We see Saveer visiting his Dadi at the rehab.

episodesList.title: Warning
episodesList.summary: Prisha tells Shelly and Priya that she is bored sitting at home and she wants to go to the office they argue about Saveer. Prisha goes to Rooh Ofiice and everybody is happy to see her. Prisha walks into Saveers cabin and she is shocked to see Anu sitting there. Saveer gets a call from Anu she tells him Prisha had come to the office and created a scene. We are introduced to a mysterious den with multiple CCTV screens.

episodesList.title: Rooh Se Rooh Tak
episodesList.summary: Prisha decided to share her message with Saveer via the Rooh podcast. Anu doesn’t like that Saveer is listening to the podcast and gets highly emotional. The next day there is an explosion in Saveers Farmhouse.

episodesList.title: 24 Ghante Ka Challenge
episodesList.summary: Saveer and Prisha have a moment in the rain (romantic). Prisha gets an idea to break into Saveer's house. She later gets arrested for this but Anu decides to not press charges against her.

episodesList.title: Yehi Sach Hai
episodesList.summary: Shelly and Prisha walk into their parent's room & see them fighting, they get to know that their father is having an affair mean while Saveer gets news that Dadi has been taken away from rehab this worries him and he also finds out that his dog Brownie has been killed. Anu pacifies Saveer.

episodesList.title: The Proof
episodesList.summary: Anu Saveer and Rebeiro are still looking for Dadi Shelly and Priya have a family discussion about love Prisha finally gets to know where Saveer is and she rushes to meet him we see someone is keeping an eye on them Rebeiro meets with a big accident and it looks like Saveer is driving the car.

episodesList.title: Khulasa
episodesList.summary: Prisha relives her night with Saveer she later gets news that Rebeiro has met with an accident in the college we see Diggy falling for one of the professors later in the episode Saveer meets Anu and things don’t go well.

episodesList.title: Tit for Tat
episodesList.summary: Saveer has been trying to get in touch with Anu he cannot get through the reach Rebeiro's house and they are shocked to see a mysterious person roaming around the house they try Anu's phone and this person picks up Saveer and Prisha rush to Anu's house.

episodesList.title: Gifty
episodesList.summary: Saveer leaves for Udaipur to look for answers here he realises that he has a twin. On the other Gouri and Prisha feel Diggy's date is Mysterious the rush to the club.

episodesList.title: Forever Is True
episodesList.summary: Prisha is kidnapped Saveer is looking for her he finally reaches the place she is held captive and Saveer is face to face with his biggest demon.

title: Rudra: The Edge of Darkness
summary: Rudra: The Edge of Darkness is a 2022 Indian psychological crime thriller television series, created for Disney+ Hotstar. It is a remake of British series Luther. Directed by Rajesh Mapuskar, it stars Ajay Devgn, Raashii Khanna and Esha Deol. It received mostly positive reviews with praise directed towards Devgn and Khanna's performance, Mapuskar’s direction, visual style and cinematography.
plot:
DCP Rudraveer Pratap Singh "Rudra" (Ajay Devgn) is pursuing a suspect who ends up in a comatose state in the hospital. After an inquiry into what happened, he is reinstated in the force.
The time apart has taken its toll on him. His investigations lead him to cross into Aliyah Choksi (Raashii Khanna), who is a psychologically affected doctor and killer. She was suspected of double murder.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: In April 2019, Applause Entertainment acquired the rights to remake the hit BBC One's drama series Luther. In April 2021, Disney+ Hotstar formally announced the show attaching Devgn to star in the lead role with Applause Entertainment and BBC Studios India producing.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: In April 2021, reports came in stating that Ajay Devgn will star in the Indian adaptation and the same was confirmed later that month with the series order from Disney+ Hotstar. In July 2021, Esha Deol was cast as the female lead. Later that month, Raashii Khanna joined for a prominent lead role, then Atul Kulkarni, Ashwini Kalsekar and Ashish Vidyarthi joined the cast. In January 2022, Satyadeep Mishra and Tarun Gahlot were confirmed to be cast in main roles.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The six episode first season premiered on 4 March 2022 on Disney+ Hotstar. In US, the show will be available on Hulu as part of distribution agreements with Star India.
