Shibhapriya Swas is the set and costume designer who was inspired from their descriptions in scriptures, as well as different paintings. Surya Raj Kamwas is the music director of the show who composed various themes. There were approximately 500 members of the crew.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: In 2017, Chahat Pandey was first cast as the lead Radha opposite Sumedh Mudgalkar while Madirakshi Mundle and Siddharth Arora as Goloka RadhaKrishna. They also starred in the show's first teaser, however, were replaced by Mallika Singh, Shivya Pathania and Himanshu Soni due to creative differences.

articleSections.title: Shooting
articleSections.text: the show’s crew of 180 people were stranded at the show’s shoot location Umargam from March till May 2020 due to COVID-19 lockdown in India.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: In the first week of December 2018, it was at fifth position with 6.6 million impressions.

articleSections.title: Prequel
articleSections.text: A prequel show was launched, highlighting the early days of Lord Krishna. It was titled as Jai Kanhaiya Lal Ki and premiered on 19 October 2021 and ended on 4 July 2022.

episodesList.title: The Classic Love Saga
episodesList.summary: Witness the eternal love story of Radha Krishna. Lord Krishna's ardent devotee, Sridhama curses Radha and separates her from Krishna. How will they unite now?

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna Take a New Birth
episodesList.summary: Radha takes birth in the Rawal village, Brijbhumi as Vrishbhan's daughter. Vrishbhan sees his daughter but is shocked to find that her eyes are still closed. Meanwhile, Devaki gives birth to Krishna within the confinements of Kansa's prison.

episodesList.title: Vasudev Swaps the Infants
episodesList.summary: Time stands still as Vasudev visits Nanda's house and exchanges the infants. On the other hand, Radha's parents celebrate her birth.

episodesList.title: Krishna Kills a Demon
episodesList.summary: Krishna kills a demon. Krishna and Radhey grow into young adults and yearn to meet each other again.

episodesList.title: Radha's Stern Decision
episodesList.summary: Kansa punishes the potter for obstructing his yagya. Krishna sets out to meet Radha, who is determined to defy Kansa and help the poor potters.

episodesList.title: It's Time for Love, Again!
episodesList.summary: Lord Krishna falls in love once again, when he comes across Radha selling earthen pots. On the other hand, Radha feels mystical when he helps her.

episodesList.title: Radha Appreciates Lord Krishna
episodesList.summary: Lord Krishna does something unexpected and wins Radha's appreciation. Later, Radha gets into trouble.

episodesList.title: Krishna Is Radha's Saviour
episodesList.summary: Krishna rescues Radha from the soldiers. He brings Kansa's soldiers to task for trying to arrest him. Kansa is determined to destroy Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Grabs Radha's Attention
episodesList.summary: Krishna wins the confidence of Radha's parents and comes up with a way to grab her attention. Kansa tells Devaki that he has tracked her son's whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Will Krishna Oblige Radha?
episodesList.summary: Radha forces Krishna to reveal the identity of his beloved when he tells that he loves a girl from her hamlet. Kansa plans his strategy against Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Smart Idea
episodesList.summary: Radhey feels frantic as she wakes up from a nightmare. Krishna comes up with a clever plan to protect Gokul and the villagers from the demon.

episodesList.title: Radha's Concern for Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna convinces Nanda Baba and the others to stay at Barsana. Krishna teases Radha, seeing her overwhelming care for him.

episodesList.title: Ayan Confronts Krishna
episodesList.summary: Kans tells Devaki and Vasudev that he had killed Krishna. Elsewhere, Ayan confronts Krishna about his intentions, but ends up receiving a stern punishment.

episodesList.title: Krishna wants Radha's Room
episodesList.summary: Ayan wants to avenge Krishna. Radha confronts Krishna, seeing him in her room and asks him to leave. But, he is reluctant to do so.

episodesList.title: Radha Feels Mystical
episodesList.summary: Radha feels nostalgic as she looks into Krishna's eyes. Ayan expresses his love for Radha and warns Krishna to stay away.

episodesList.title: Jhatila Is against Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Ayan don't tell Radha about their challenge. Jhatila persuades Kirtida against getting Krishna married to Radha and instigates Ayan against Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Makes a Demand
episodesList.summary: Balram bashes up Ayan and his friends after he insults him. Krishna tells Radha to fulfill his demand if she wants him to stop Balram.

episodesList.title: Radha Feeds Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna is delighted as Radha accepts his friendship and feeds butter to him. Later, Ayan and his men visit Balram and try to attack him. Will Krishna be able to stop the fight?

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna Come Closer
episodesList.summary: Radha convinces Ayan to be friends with Krishna. She and Krishna come closer while she gives him dance lessons. Ayan is jealous to witness the same.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Persuade Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna tries to convince Radha to unite Sudevi with her lover. Later, Kansa's aide threatens Nand Baba to handover Krishna to him.

episodesList.title: Krishna Seeks Attention
episodesList.summary: Krishna seeks Radha's attention by acting sick in front of her. Balram learns about Jatila's evil intentions and takes a shocking decision.

episodesList.title: Vrishbhan Ensures Krishna's Safety
episodesList.summary: Krishna pretends to be grateful to Ayaan for choosing to fight Kansa's soldiers. Vrishbhan and the others determine to protect Krishna from Kansa's army.

episodesList.title: Krishna Fights the Army
episodesList.summary: Krishna fights against Akrur's army and gives him an ultimatum. Akrur apologises to Krishna in the battleground. Will Radha witness Krishna's supremacy?

episodesList.title: Radha's Challenge to Krishna
episodesList.summary: Radha challenges Krishna to get Sudevi married to Bhairav. Later, Balram complains to Radha about Krishna's intentions.

episodesList.title: Radha Is Misled
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Balram mislead Radha about their true intentions. Later, Krishna plans to get Sudevi married to Bhairav.

episodesList.title: Radha Dances to Krishna's Music
episodesList.summary: Krishna plans to help Bhairav and Sudevi elope. Radha wants to foil Krishna's attempt and asks him to play the flute while she dances.

episodesList.title: Krishna Takes the Stage
episodesList.summary: Krishna goes on stage and starts dancing. He gives Radha dandiyas and invites her to join him, hoping to win her heart. Will his plan work?

episodesList.title: Radha Accuses Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna acts innocent when Radha accuses him of plotting to get Sudevi married to Bhairav. Radha corners Balram into confessing the truth.

episodesList.title: Krishna Disappoints Nand Baba
episodesList.summary: Upset with Krishna's deed, Nand Baba decides to leave Barsana. Krishna hopes that Sudevi acknowledges Bhairav's love when he gets punished.

episodesList.title: Radha's Promise to Vrishbhan
episodesList.summary: Krishna convinces Sudevi's father to let Sudevi marry Bhairav. An upset Vrishbhan asks Radha to make a promise when she does not tell him the truth.

episodesList.title: Krishna Bears the Brunt
episodesList.summary: Krishna is disheartened as Radha holds him responsible for the misunderstanding between her and Vrishbhan. She asks him to leave Barsana!

episodesList.title: Krishna's Clever Move
episodesList.summary: Krishna plans to change Radha’s perception about love. Kansa's aide attacks Barsana. Krishna tries to use this situation in his favour.

episodesList.title: Bakasur Creates Chaos
episodesList.summary: A demon named Bakasur creates chaos in Barsana. Ayan tries to fight back Bakasur, while Nand Baba waits for Krishna's arrival.

episodesList.title: Krishna Tricks Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna playfully tricks Radha and starts to run when Bakasur tries to catch them. Later, he stops time for a moment and magically creates the Vrindavan forest.

episodesList.title: Krishna Gets Rid of Bakasur
episodesList.summary: Krishna kills Bakasur after he tries to harm Radha. Kansa is agitated to learn about Krishna's deed. Will Krishna reveal it all to Radha?

episodesList.title: Ayaan Assaults Krishna
episodesList.summary: Ayaan resolves to uncover the secret behind Krishna's powers and attacks him. Later, Radha is shocked when Krishna reads his thoughts.

episodesList.title: Krishna Prepares Kheer for Radha
episodesList.summary: Vrishbhan and his men desperately search for Radha while Krishna prepares delicious kheer for her. Later, Krishna feels odd when she refuses to eat the kheer.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Strict Order
episodesList.summary: Krishna orders the demon snake, Kaliya to leave the river near Gokul. But, Kaliya pays no heed to his words and challenges him.

episodesList.title: Rishi Durvasa Visits the Palace
episodesList.summary: Ayaan spikes the grains meant for the grand feast. Yashoda panics on learning about the rotten smell in the food prepared for Rishi Durvasa.

episodesList.title: Radha Seeks Durvasa's Blessings
episodesList.summary: Nand Baba tells Yashoda, Krishna and Balram to apologise to Rishi Durvasa. Radha brings food for Rishi Durvasa and seeks his blessings.

episodesList.title: Krishna Enters the River
episodesList.summary: Kaliya riles in pain when Krishna steps on his tail. Meanwhile, a distressed Yashoda pleads with Krishna to come out of the river.

episodesList.title: Kaliya Seeks Revenge
episodesList.summary: Radha fails miserably when she tries to outsmart Krishna. Kaliya seeks revenge against Krishna by poisoning the river water.

episodesList.title: Krishna Battles Kaliya
episodesList.summary: Everyone is shocked when Ayaan reveals that a giant snake has pulled Krishna into the river. Later, Krishna battles a furious Kaliya

episodesList.title: Krishna Forgives Kaliya
episodesList.summary: Krishna forgives Kaliya. Everyone is shocked to see him dancing on Kaliya's hood. Radha is in for a huge surprise.

episodesList.title: Radha Complains to Yashodha
episodesList.summary: Radha complains to Yashodha and Nand Baba that Krishna is a sorcerer. Krishna tries to prove that her claims are baseless.

episodesList.title: Radha Conducts the Puja
episodesList.summary: With a hidden agenda, Krishna ensures that Radha conducts the puja and makes her plant a Tulsi sapling in the village. Radha names the place Vrindavan.

episodesList.title: Radha Needs an Answer
episodesList.summary: After inferring that Krishna is trying to win her love, Radha confronts him about the same. Ayaan meets Kansa to plan his strategy against Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Raises an Objection
episodesList.summary: Radha resolves to expose Krishna. Ayaan and Kansa plot to kill him. Later, Krishna objects Vrishbhan's decision.

episodesList.title: Krishna Manipulates Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna manipulates Radha to participate in a contest. He tells her that she will have to sit with him on the swing as he is determined to make her win.

episodesList.title: Yashodha Punishes Krishna
episodesList.summary: Upset with Krishna's pranks, Yashodha ties him to a pillar. Radha rejoices as he is unable to participate in the contest.

episodesList.title: Krishna Challenges Radha
episodesList.summary: Radha tries to stop Krishna from using his tricks to participate in the match. He challenges her that Yashodha will free him.

episodesList.title: Krishna Vs Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna takes part in the Rangoli competition in spite of his mother not letting him. However, Radha wins the Rangoli competition.

episodesList.title: Krishna Faces the Agitated Ox
episodesList.summary: Ayaan implements his evil plan. Krishna faces the agitated ox at the event and tries to prevent it from attacking Radha.

episodesList.title: Balram Persuades Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna pretends to faint as he wants Radha to wake him up. Balram, through his strategy, tries to ensure that Radha fulfils Krishna's wish.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Plan for Radha
episodesList.summary: Kansa instigates Aghasur against Krishna. Meanwhile, Krishna intends to make Radha realise her true identity when she sits beside him on the swing.

episodesList.title: Agasur Attacks the Village
episodesList.summary: The villagers run helter-skelter as Agasur unleashes his fury on the village. Later, Krishna enlightens Balram about Brahma's boon which Agasur possess.

episodesList.title: Radha's Risky Move
episodesList.summary: Radha takes a drastic decision to save Vrishbhan from Agasur's clutches. Meanwhile, Krishna hopes that Radha conquers her fears.

episodesList.title: Radha Assaults Agasur
episodesList.summary: A fearless Radha assaults Agasur with Krishna's flute. Krishna is overwhelmed to witness her brave deed.

episodesList.title: Radha to Save Krishna
episodesList.summary: Radha succeeds to escape from Agasur's captivity but Krishna fails to escape. Later, Radha comes up with a plan to free Krishna.

episodesList.title: Radha Wants to Meet Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna misleads Kansa. Radha sets out to meet Krishna to thank him for helping her conquer her fears. Ayaan tries to stop her from meeting Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Ignores Radha
episodesList.summary: Radha thanks Krishna and expresses her wish to be friends with him. However, Krishna turns down her friendship!

episodesList.title: Radha is Jealous
episodesList.summary: Ayaan is reluctant to tell Kansa that Krishna is alive, while Radha spots Krishna with her friends.

episodesList.title: Krishna's 'Friendship' Rules
episodesList.summary: Jhatila suggests a risky plan to Kansa. Meanwhile, Krishna presents some strange rules when Radha offers her friendship.

episodesList.title: Radha Stuns Her Family
episodesList.summary: Radha's family is stunned, noticing her peculiar behaviour. Meanwhile, Ayaan executes his evil plan against ?Vrishbhan and Nand.

episodesList.title: Will Radha Realize the Truth?
episodesList.summary: Ayaan's ploy lands Vrishbhan in trouble. Elsewhere, Radha's friend hints at her changed feelings for Krishna.

episodesList.title: Radha to Play a Game
episodesList.summary: Ayaan and his mother plan to break the friendship between Vrishbhan and Nand. Meanwhile, on Balram's suggestion, Radha plays a game with Krishna.

episodesList.title: A Special Medicine for Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna prepares a medicine for Radha when she falls ill. Jhatila convinces Radha's friend to assist her in her evil ploy.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Raas Leela
episodesList.summary: Radha faces disappointment when she sneaks out of the house to meet Krishna at night.

episodesList.title: Radha Dances with Krishna
episodesList.summary: The music from Krishna's flute mesmerises Radha and the gopis and they dance together. Later, Radha finds herself in a spot when she returns home.

episodesList.title: Radha to Test Krishna
episodesList.summary: Ayaan confronts Jhatila for plotting against Radha. As per Vishakha's plan, Radha assigns a dangerous task to Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna vs Aristasur
episodesList.summary: Krishna climbs up a big mountain to bring a special flower for Radha. However, at the top, he engages in combat with Aristasur.

episodesList.title: Krishna Is Banished
episodesList.summary: Radha tries to confess her feelings to Krishna. As a result of Jhatila's vicious plan, Krishna is banished from the kingdom.

episodesList.title: Ayaan Makes a Revelation
episodesList.summary: Radha feels guilty for getting Krishna in trouble. Nand is stunned when Ayaan makes a shocking revelation about Krishna to Vrishbhan.

episodesList.title: Lord Shiva to Visit Barsana
episodesList.summary: Radha manages to stop Krishna from leaving Barsana. When the two indulge in a blissful Maharaas, even Lord Shiva decides to be a part of this divine celebration of pure love.

episodesList.title: Lord Shiva in a Disguise
episodesList.summary: Krishna is overwhelmed as Lord Shiva, disguised as a woman, joins him and Radha as they dance.

episodesList.title: Shiva's Gift to Radha
episodesList.summary: A disguised Shiva hands over a special gift to Radha. Krishna too presents her with Shaligram bracelet while Jhatila executes her evil plan against him.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Radha
episodesList.summary: Vrishbhan shares details about the wedding proposal to Radha. Unable to defy her father's decision, a shattered Radha gives her consent to the marriage.

episodesList.title: Radha Reveals the Truth
episodesList.summary: While Ayaan relishes his victory over Krishna, Radha confides in her mother about her feelings for Krishna.

episodesList.title: A Secret Letter for Krishna
episodesList.summary: Radha requests Vishakha to hand over a secret letter to Krishna while Ayaan prepares to commit suicide.

episodesList.title: Krishna Reads Radha's Letter
episodesList.summary: Krishna reads Radha's letter stating that she loves him and asking him to stop her marriage. He visits Radha's house while she meets her prospective groom.

episodesList.title: Radha's Clever Plan
episodesList.summary: Krishna watches in awe as Radha tries to dissuade the prospective groom from accepting the marriage proposal.

episodesList.title: Radha Feels Helpless
episodesList.summary: Radha feels helpless when Krishna refuses to act while her family makes the arrangements for her wedding.

episodesList.title: Radha Seeks Krishna's Help
episodesList.summary: Radha seeks help from Krishna to call off her wedding, while Jhatila implements her plan to save Ayaan. Later, Vrishbhan confronts Radha.

episodesList.title: Vrishbhan's Uncontrolable Rage
episodesList.summary: Vrishbhan shoots sharp accusation at Nand on learning about Radha and Krishna's secret relationship.

episodesList.title: Krishna Faces Jhatila's Questions
episodesList.summary: Vrishbhan accuses Nand Baba of conspiring against him. Elsewhere, Jhatila questions Krishna if he loves Radha, while Radha hopes that Krishna will reciprocate her feelings.

episodesList.title: Radha Confronts Krishna
episodesList.summary: Vrishbhan and Nand Baba break all ties. Meanwhile, an agitated Radha confronts Krishna for hurting her feelings.

episodesList.title: Krishna Hurts Radha
episodesList.summary: Radha gets extremely furious when Krishna explains the difference between love and greed. Later, in a fit of rage, she does the unthinkable.

episodesList.title: Yashodha Suspects Krishna
episodesList.summary: Yashodha suspects that Krishna is the mastermind behind the conflict that has occurred. Krishna sneaks into Barsana while Radha’s pre-wedding rituals begin.

episodesList.title: Krishna Expresses His Love
episodesList.summary: Krishna confesses his love to Radha and tells her that he will not let her marry Vyomesh. Meanwhile, Jhatila and Ayaan have an evil plan in mind.

episodesList.title: Vyomasur Reveals It All!
episodesList.summary: Balram fights Vyomesh after he reveals his true identity. Later, Vyomasur tells Ayaan his real motive behind marrying Radha.

episodesList.title: Balram and Krishna are Accused
episodesList.summary: Vrishbhan confronts Nand Baba and accuses Balram of trying to kill Vyomesh. Later, Vrishbhan alleges that Krishna threatened Radha of foiling her marriage.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Feminine Avatar
episodesList.summary: Lord Shiva decides to help Krishna reunite with Radha. Later, on his insistence, Krishna takes up a feminine avatar.

episodesList.title: Gopadevi, Baldevi Fool Ayaan
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Balram disguise themselves as Gopadevi and Baldevi. They try to trick Ayaan and convince him to take them both to Barsana.

episodesList.title: Gopadevi Is up to Her Tricks
episodesList.summary: Gopadevi and Baldevi mislead Radha and Vrishbhan about their identity when they meet them. Later, Gopadevi asks Radha if she loves someone.

episodesList.title: Gopadevi Advises Radha
episodesList.summary: Gopadevi tries to change Radha's perception about love and advises her against getting married to someone she does not love. Meanwhile, Ayaan and Vyomasur are up to some foul play.

episodesList.title: Gopadevi Instigates Vyomesh
episodesList.summary: Krishna in the disguise of Gopadevi provokes Vyomesh to make Radha dance at the ceremony. Elsewhere, Balram dressed as Baldevi avoids Dhama, who is smitten with her.

episodesList.title: Radha, Gopadevi's Divine Synergy
episodesList.summary: Radha and Gopadevi aka Krishna, mesmerize the onlookers with their divine dance. Later, Ayaan assists a band of dacoits to enter the palace.

episodesList.title: Gopadevi, Baldevi Save the Day
episodesList.summary: Gopadevi and Baldevi rescue Radha by using witty tricks. Later, Gopadevi shocks Ayaan when she informs Vrishbhan about an ongoing conspiracy.

episodesList.title: Baldevi in an Awkward Situation
episodesList.summary: Gopadevi and Baldevi mislead Radha when she suspects them. Jhatila and Vyomasur speculate about Krishna's strategy, while Dhama proposes to Baldevi!

episodesList.title: Gopadevi, Baldevi in Trouble!
episodesList.summary: On learning about Gopadevi and Baldevi's real identity, Radha confronts Krishna for misleading her. She sets out to expose his and Balram's deceit to Vrishbhan.

episodesList.title: Radha's Shocking Demand
episodesList.summary: Radha decides to teach Krishna a lesson for hurting her feelings. Later, Krishna is shocked when Radha compels him to make a promise to her.

episodesList.title: Krishna Bids Farewell
episodesList.summary: Balram, bound by his promise to Krishna, is unable to disclose the truth about Vyomeshwar to Radha. Krishna sits alongside Radha as she performs the rituals during her sagaai ceremony.

episodesList.title: Gopadevi Provokes Vyomesh
episodesList.summary: After Vrishbhan announces the muhurat of her wedding, an emotionally stressed Radha faints. Later, Gopadevi instigates Vyomesh to call off his wedding.

episodesList.title: Gopadevi Makes Things Right
episodesList.summary: As a part of her ingenious plan, Gopadevi makes Vyomesh apologise to Vrishbhan. Later, he advises Radha when she questions her decision of marrying Vyomesh.

episodesList.title: Radha to Confront Krishna
episodesList.summary: Radha is distraught with Krishna's obscure behaviour and decides to confront him. Elsewhere, Krishna continues to puzzle Vyomesh.

episodesList.title: Radha's Haldi Rituals Begin
episodesList.summary: Ayan spots Yashoda trying to conceal herself. Ayan and Vyomesh are suspicious of Krishna's hallucination and they eagerly want to know the truth.

episodesList.title: Radha Plays the Flute!
episodesList.summary: Radha makes a flute for Krishna and plays it, grabbing his attention. Later, Kirtida becomes enraged when she finds out Gopadevi's real identity.

episodesList.title: Jatila Identifies the Truth
episodesList.summary: Jatila spots Yashodha and identifies Gopadevi and Baldevi's truth. Later, Radha decides to sacrifice her love for the sake of her father's prestige.

episodesList.title: Radha's Unexpected Move
episodesList.summary: Krishna reveals Vyomesh's real identity to Radha. Later, she takes an unexpected step when Ayaan tries to expose Krishna, Balram and Yashodha.

episodesList.title: Radha Misleads Vrishbhan
episodesList.summary: Radha foils Ayan's attempt to stir trouble by lying to Vrishbhan. Later, Krishna and Balram assist Yashodha to sneak out of Barsana.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Radha to Expose Vyomesh
episodesList.summary: Radha provokes Vyomesh against Krishna. Along with Krishna, she tactfully makes a fool out of Vyomesh and traps him in their plot.

episodesList.title: Krishna Exposes Vyomasur
episodesList.summary: Krishna successfully exposes Vyomasur. Later, Nand marches with his army towards Barsana on learning some shocking information.

episodesList.title: Krishna Rescues Radha
episodesList.summary: Kans incurs another massive defeat. Later, Krishna rescues Radha thus, putting an end to Nand and Vrishbhan's enmity.

episodesList.title: Balram Teases Krishna
episodesList.summary: Ayaan receives the honour of breaking the wall separating Barsana and Vrindavan. Later, Balram uses an ingenious tactic to tease Krishna.

episodesList.title: Ayan, Krishna Become Friends
episodesList.summary: Krishna tells Radha that their love is eternal and free from the obligations of marriage. Later, Ayan apologises to Krishna and wishes to be friends with him.

episodesList.title: What Is Ayan up to?
episodesList.summary: Balram doubts Ayan's intentions while Radha seeks a promise from Krishna. Later, Jhatila and Ayan visit the palace of Kans.

episodesList.title: Radha Relishes Krishna's Company
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Balram plan to set up a stall at the Basant Panchami fair. Later, an exhausted Balram deals with the customers while Krishna helps Radha in shopping.

episodesList.title: Radha Decides to Test Krishna
episodesList.summary: Balram’s innocence is misused at the fair as the customers begin to cheat him. Radha plans a test for Krishna after the couple confesses their feelings to each other.

episodesList.title: Radha's Behaviour Worries Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna feels worried, assuming that Radha is displeased with him. Later, he talks to Balram about Radha's jealousy.

episodesList.title: Radha is Being Possessive
episodesList.summary: Krishna tells Balram about Radha's possessiveness towards him. She is infuriated, spotting her cousin in Krishna's arms. Later, Krishna purposely makes her feel jealous

episodesList.title: Krishna Irks Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna spends time with Chandravali, leaving Radha infuriated. Later, he continues to irk her even after she burns her fingers.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Odd Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Krishna requests Chandravali to show him some of her poetry, much to Radha's dismay. Later, Chandravali questions him regarding his relationship with Radha.

episodesList.title: Ayaan Misleads Radha
episodesList.summary: Radha lies to Chandravali in order to separate her from Krishna. Later, Ayaan tries to mislead Radha about Krishna and Chandravali's relationship.

episodesList.title: Chandravali Loves Krishna
episodesList.summary: Radha provokes Chandravali against Krishna when the latter reveals her love for him. Later, Chandravali takes her to Krishna for a confrontation.

episodesList.title: Jhatila Threatens Vishakha
episodesList.summary: Despite being falsely accused by Radha, Krishna accepts his mistakes. Later, Jhatila threatens to kill Vishakha's family if she refuses to mislead Radha.

episodesList.title: Krishna Receives a Punishment
episodesList.summary: While Radha and her friends are taking a bath in the river, Krishna steals their clothes. Later, Chandravali defends him when Yashoda ties Krishna to a pillar.

episodesList.title: Chandravali Loves Krishna
episodesList.summary: Yashoda asks Radha to apologise to Krishna. Later at night, Chandravali confesses her love to Krishna while Balram and Radha secretly witness the same.

episodesList.title: Krishna Reveals His Plan
episodesList.summary: Lord Shiv and Gauri are hurt by Krishna's deeds. Later, Krishna and Chandravali make a shocking disclosure to Balram. A distressed Radha grieves over her miseries.

episodesList.title: Radha Confronts Krishna
episodesList.summary: Kans schemes to kill Krishna. Later, an annoyed Radha stops Chandravali from meeting Krishna and sets out to tackle him herself.

episodesList.title: Radha Saves Krishna
episodesList.summary: Kans's poison makes the residents of Vrindavan ill. Later, Balram brings Radha to save Krishna after he absorbs the poison.

episodesList.title: Aayan's Vicious Trap
episodesList.summary: Aayan is pleased thinking that his ploy is taking shape. Radha grieves seeing Krishna injured. She decides to do anything to get him well.

episodesList.title: Radha Saves Krishna
episodesList.summary: When Kans is gearing up to kill Krishna, a distressed Radha prays to Narayan for a miracle. Later, she receives a divine message, which helps her to save Krishna.

episodesList.title: Radha Challenges Krishna
episodesList.summary: Vrishbhan gives the credit of Krishna's recovery to Chandravali. Later, a jealous Radha challenges Krishna for a competition, choosing Ayaan as her ally.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Visits Krishna
episodesList.summary: Radha makes an unexpected confession to Balram. Later, Krishna declares that his friend from Kailash will be the judge for the upcoming competition.

episodesList.title: Radha Competes With Krishna
episodesList.summary: Ayaan makes a shocking offer after Radha suffers an emotional outburst. Later, they compete against Krishna and Chandravali in an idol-making competition.

episodesList.title: Radha Gets Jealous
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Chandravali enact a play on Lord Shiva and Parvathi as a victory celebration. Later, following Ayaan's advice, a jealous Radha disappoints Bhatooknath.

episodesList.title: Radha Makes a Mistake
episodesList.summary: Krishna decides to teach Radha a lesson for not accepting her mistake. Meanwhile, Ayan brainwashes Radha into misunderstanding Krishna.

episodesList.title: Radha Confesses the Truth
episodesList.summary: Unable to bear the sight of Krishna carrying out the punishment, Radha confesses about feeling jealous of Chandravali in front of everyone. Later, Vrishbhan takes a shocking step.

episodesList.title: Radha Is Stunned
episodesList.summary: Radha successfully creates the Shivling, following which she learns a shocking truth. Later, she gets Bhatooknath married to Gowri on the occasion of Maha Shivratri.

episodesList.title: Ayaan Battles Kans
episodesList.summary: Kans and Ayaan engage in fierce combat. Elsewhere, Krishna shares a special moment with Radha.

episodesList.title: Krishna Is Outraged
episodesList.summary: Vrishbhan falls for Ayaan's trap as Krishna rushes to save him. Later, an inconsolable Radha runs out of the palace.

episodesList.title: Kans' Unusual Demand
episodesList.summary: After a shocking announcement, Kans demands that his chieftains gather in Mathura. Later, Ayaan nominates Radha as the representative of Barsana.

episodesList.title: Radha's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: Radha is reluctant to become the leader of Barsana while Kans gives Ayaan a magical diamond. Later, Radha announces her final decision.

episodesList.title: Radha's Coronation Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Despite Krishna's objection, Radha is declared the queen of Barsana after a grand ceremony. Later, a distressed Balram shares his concerns with Krishna.

episodesList.title: Radha Invites Trouble
episodesList.summary: A distressed Krishna secretly watches Radha leave for Mathura. Later, he addresses Balram's question while Ayaan and Kans work together to trap Radha.

episodesList.title: Kans to Execute Radha
episodesList.summary: Kans threatens to kill Radha if the residents of Barsana fail to fulfil his outrageous demand. Later, he orders his men to make arrangements for her execution.

episodesList.title: Radha's Life Is in Peril
episodesList.summary: Radha calls out to Krishna as the executioner readies to kill her. Later, Krishna makes a shocking revelation to the people of Barsana.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna Celebrate Holi!
episodesList.summary: Ayaan tells everyone about Radha's bravery. Later, Krishna asks the people of Barsana to play Holi with flowers. However, Radha refuses to take part in the celebration.

episodesList.title: Krishna Khele Phoolon Ki Holi
episodesList.summary: Radha is furious at Krishna for leaving her in a lurch in Mathura, even as he praises her strength. Later, Krishna colours Radha's face while she is asleep.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Balram Have a Tough Time
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Balram struggle to evade the traps set by an infuriated Radha. Later, the people of Barsana gather for Holika Dahan.

episodesList.title: Ayaan Challenges Krishna
episodesList.summary: Radha and Krishna perform Holika Dahan. Later, Ayaan is shocked to learn that Krishna was aware of his evil plot and ends up challenging him.

episodesList.title: Radha's Big Plan
episodesList.summary: Radha and her friends are ready with their sticks for the Lathmar Holi. Meanwhile, Murari ki toli enters Barsana, to celebrate the festival with them.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna Celebrate Holi
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Radha celebrate holi while Balram rubs black paint on Ayaan's face. Later, an infuriated Ayaan decides to create a rift between Krishna and Radha.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Fight Dhumrasur
episodesList.summary: Kans creates Mahabali Dhumrasur to oppress the people of Barsana. Radha finds out Kans’s ploy, meanwhile, Krishna wonders how to defeat him.

episodesList.title: Kans' Wicked Ploy
episodesList.summary: Krishna finds a way around Kans' tax while he sends a powerful demon to destroy Barsana. Later, Radha is puzzled after Krishna refuses to be by her side.

episodesList.title: Ayaan Instigates Radha
episodesList.summary: Ayaan manipulates Radha after eavesdropping on her conversation with Krishna. Later, Kans sends an alarming message to the people of Barsana.

episodesList.title: Radha's Clever Tactic
episodesList.summary: Radha is puzzled by Krishna's expectations while Kans' army is about to attack Barsana. Later, her tactical decision to save Barsana infuriates Ayaan.

episodesList.title: Krishna Praises Radha
episodesList.summary: Ayaan apologises to Radha on Jatila's advise while she runs to meet Krishna. Later, Radha is highly praised by Krishna, making Ayaan furious.

episodesList.title: Radha Has a Solution
episodesList.summary: Radha comes up with an ingenious plan to pay the taxes imposed by Kans. Later, Jatila ensures that Ayaan stops Radha in her endeavour.

episodesList.title: Kans to Punish the Sponsorers
episodesList.summary: Ayaan secretly gets the information from Radha's room and gives it to Kans. Later, Kans decides to punish the sponsorers for helping Radha.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Action Shocks Radha
episodesList.summary: Radha is shocked to see Krishna selling her paintings and idols. Later, Balram insults one of the sponsorers while the people of Barsana learn a shocking fact.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Radha Team Up
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Radha brilliantly trick the moneylenders while they try to capture Barsana. Later, Kans tortures the moneylenders while Balram challenges Radha.

episodesList.title: Balram Lands in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Radha puts Balram in a fix when he showcases his might at the fair. Elsewhere, Jatila and Ayan think of ways to target Radha.

episodesList.title: Jatila, Ayan to Create Trouble
episodesList.summary: Radha spots Krishna stealing idols and paintings from her room. Elsewhere, Jatila and Ayan come up with a plan to create trouble at the fair.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Unthinkable Act
episodesList.summary: Ayan and Jatila are shocked as their plan backfires. Later, Radha takes credit for her work and challenges Krishna to prove his love.

episodesList.title: Makradikasur Attacks Barsana
episodesList.summary: Chaos grips the fair as Makradikasur attacks Barsana. Later, Radha expresses her desire to kill the Asur.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Fight Makradikasur
episodesList.summary: Radha and Krishna engage in a flute selling challenge. Later, he leaves quietly from the fair in order to kill Makradikasur.

episodesList.title: Ayan's Cunning Move
episodesList.summary: Radha gets embarrassed while she ends Markadikasur's life. Later, Ayan feels elated as the sponsorers insult Vrishbhan in front of the villagers.

episodesList.title: Krishna Has a Solution
episodesList.summary: The sponsorers humiliate Vrishbhan while Radha loses control over the situation. Later, Krishna offers a solution to repay the loan.

episodesList.title: Kans Kills the Sponsorers
episodesList.summary: A furious Kans kills the sponsorers while Vrishbhan intends for Radha to follow her mother. Later, her blind trust for Krishna worries him.

episodesList.title: Radha to Honor Krishna
episodesList.summary: Mahadev is worried about Krishna while Radha prepares an adoration ceremony for him. Later, her constant attention to Krishna makes Ayan furious.

episodesList.title: Krishna Tricks Radha
episodesList.summary: Kans orders Keshi to kill Nand and Vrishbhan when they will be riding Krishna's chariot.Later, Krishna tricks Radha to break her silence.

episodesList.title: Krishna Is Enraged
episodesList.summary: An impressed Radha presents Krishna with a dance while Ayan waits to initiate the plan. Later, an out of control Keshi takes Krishna to the banks of Yamuna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Kills Keshi
episodesList.summary: Krishna kills Keshi on the banks of the Yamuna river. Later, Kans is horrified to learn about Keshi.

episodesList.title: Radha, Chandravali Meet Soham
episodesList.summary: Chandravali receives a special gift from Soham while a suspicious Radha turns to Krishna for help. But, his reaction puzzles her even more.

episodesList.title: Chandravali Expresses her Love
episodesList.summary: Mahadev warns Krishna of an impending danger while Chandravali expresses her love for Soham to her parents. Later, Mahadev is pleased with Kans' devotion.

episodesList.title: Kans Gets a Boon
episodesList.summary: Mahadev grants Kans his desired boon and tells him a secret to defeat Krishna. Later, Soham meets Chandravali's parents while Radha is anxious.

episodesList.title: Kans to Destroy the Pearls
episodesList.summary: Kans finds a solution after he fails in his attempts to destroy the pearls of love. Later, Radha is puzzled by Govardhan's behavior towards Chandravali.

episodesList.title: Soham Threatens Govardhan
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Balram confront Soham for threatening Govardhan. Later, Ayan apologises to Radha for not understanding her love for Krishna

episodesList.title: Krishna to Expose Soham
episodesList.summary: Radha is confused when Chandravali requests her to perform her pre-wedding ritual. Later, Krishna puts his plan into action.

episodesList.title: Ayan Manipulates Radha
episodesList.summary: In order to escape from Kans, Ayan asks Radha to break the magical pearl. Later, Krishna is shocked as Radha leaves Barsana along with Chandravali.

episodesList.title: Kans to Kill Ayan, Jatila
episodesList.summary: A disappointed Kans decides to execute Ayan and Jatila. Elsewhere, Radha gets offended by Krishna and takes a shocking step.

episodesList.title: Radha Meets with an Accident
episodesList.summary: Krishna comes to Radha's rescue after she meets with a fatal accident. Later, Yashodha and Kirtida Devi are trapped in a severe storm.

episodesList.title: Krishna Fights with Timirasur
episodesList.summary: Krishna decides to encounter Timirasur while Radha's health deteriorates. Later, he brings his Sudarshan Chakra to destroy the demon.

episodesList.title: Kans Attacks Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna is ambushed by Kans when he rushes to meet Radha. Later, Balram is dejected while Radha's health deteriorates.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Celestial Travel
episodesList.summary: Krishna carries Radha to the centre of the universe and tries to revive her using his magical powers. Elsewhere, Kans offends Shiva with his unbridled arrogance.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Kill Kans?
episodesList.summary: Krishna discovers Kans' evil ploy and decides to kill him. Later, Govardhan asks Krishna for a favour.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna's Undying Love
episodesList.summary: Kans is scared of losing his life while Krishna suggests a fun game. Later, Krishna and Radha's love indirectly makes Govardhan and Chandravali feel happy.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Radha Help Govardhan
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Radha help Govardhan secretly meet Chandravali while Kans struggles to get some sleep. Later, Radha challenges Balram and the other men.

episodesList.title: Radha, Balram Want Krishna's Help
episodesList.summary: Radha challenges Balram to make the Maha Bhoj while Kans is unable to stop eating. Later, a tug of war for Krishna ensues between Radha and Balram.

episodesList.title: Balram Is Stunned
episodesList.summary: Balram is shocked when Vrishbhan makes a declaration after tasting his food. Later, Krishna makes a plan to stay with Radha.

episodesList.title: Kans Vows to Kill Krishna
episodesList.summary: While Kans vows to kill Krishna or commit suicide, Vrishbhan is worried about Radha's safety. Later, Krishna's love for Radha grows many folds.

episodesList.title: Krishna Decides to Marry Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna confides in Balram about his intention to marry Radha. Later, Yashoda is angry at Krishna while he tells Radha a secret message.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Propose Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna struggles to express his feelings to Radha while Balram takes a shocking step. Later, Krishna comes up with an idea to put forth the marriage proposal.

episodesList.title: Krishna Proposes Radha
episodesList.summary: Gauri gets Radha ready while a furious Kans wants to kill himself and Krishna's parents. Later, Krishna proposes Radha on the moon.

episodesList.title: Radha Agrees to Marry Krishna
episodesList.summary: Radha agrees to marry Krishna while Ayan is shocked at Kans' statement. Later, Kans meets Aghori Rakshas.

episodesList.title: Krishna Teases Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna pulls Radha's leg after she fails to talk to Vrishbhan about the wedding. As Chalasur visits Barsana in disguise, Jatila and Ayan make an evil plan.

episodesList.title: Chalasur Humiliates Vrishbhan
episodesList.summary: As Chandravali and Govardhan tie the knot, Chalasur humiliates Vrishbhan in front of everyone. Later, an unexpected guest arrives.

episodesList.title: Jatila's Odd Request
episodesList.summary: Krishna promises Radha that he will take Yashodha's approval for their marriage. Meanwhile, Jatila pretends to be ill and puts forth a strange request.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Sweet Proposal
episodesList.summary: Krishna convinces Yashodha that she needs a daughter-in-law. Later, Yashodha teases him as he struggles to place a proposal before her.

episodesList.title: Ayan Is Exposed
episodesList.summary: Krishna tells Yashoda that he wants to marry Radha while Ugrapath is furious about Ayan's evil deeds. Later, Jatila puts forth a short-sighted request.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Fulfil Radha's Wish
episodesList.summary: Radha puts forth an unexpected demand before Krishna. Later, Kans performs a yajna dedicated to Lord Indra with an evil plan in mind.

episodesList.title: Ugrapath's Stern Decision
episodesList.summary: Ugrapath decides to punish Jatila while Ayan helps Kans to stop the puja. He is stunned when things start going wrong during the ceremony.

episodesList.title: Kans Misleads Indradev
episodesList.summary: Kans misleads a furious Indradev while Krishna argues with Ugrapath. Later, Chandravali and her friends mock Balram.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Govardhan Leela
episodesList.summary: Krishna infuriates lord Indra as Radha and the villagers worship the Govardhan mountain. Witness Krishna's divine prowess as he lifts the mountain on his little finger.

episodesList.title: Indra Attacks Govardhan
episodesList.summary: On Radha's insistence, the villagers pray to Narayan while Indra attacks Govardhan. Later, Mahadev makes a shocking revelation to Indra.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna Break the Fast
episodesList.summary: Radha and Krishna share a moment when they break their fast. Later, Vrishbhan's unexpected demand stuns everyone.

episodesList.title: Vrishbhan Takes a Decision
episodesList.summary: Vrishbhan shocks everyone with his decision regarding Radha and Krishna's marriage. Later, Kans is enraged following a shocking celestial announcement.

episodesList.title: Ugrapath's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: Yashodha asks Balram to announce Radha and Krishna's proposed marriage. Later, Radha is stunned with Ugrapath's decision.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna to Get Married!
episodesList.summary: Radha is impressed when Krishna makes celestial changes to find an auspicious date for their marriage. Later, Kans conspires to stop them from tying the knot.

episodesList.title: Radha Remembers Her Identity
episodesList.summary: Krishna tells Radha about Go Lok and takes her to the land of love. Later, Radha remembers her real identity and spots a mysterious person in Krishna's absence.

episodesList.title: Krishna Has a Plan
episodesList.summary: Balram is dejected after falling prey to Jatila and Ayan's cunning ploy, but Krishna reassures him that he has a plan. Later, Radha reveals her mysterious dream to Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Takes a Gigantic Form
episodesList.summary: Krishna takes the form of a giant to save Munja Van. Later, Ugrapath makes an unexpected announcement about the Vagdaan ceremony.

episodesList.title: Krishna Saves Radha
episodesList.summary: Kans threatens Shankhchurn and orders him to kill Radha. Later, Krishna shows his celestial avatar to Shankhchurn.

episodesList.title: Krishna Competes with Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Radha take part in a contest. Later, Jatila accuses Ugrapath of siding with Krishna while the latter kills Shankhchurn.

episodesList.title: Ugrapath Makes a Promise
episodesList.summary: In order to prevent Ayan from completing the ritual, Ugrapath makes a promise to help him. Elsewhere, Balram pokes fun at Chandravali.

episodesList.title: Radha Overhears Vrishbhan
episodesList.summary: Radha overhears Vrishbhan talking about the vow he has broken. Later, Jatila plans a severe punishment for him.

episodesList.title: Radha Is Perturbed
episodesList.summary: Jatila criticises Vrishbhan in front of a perplexed Radha. Later, Krishna foresees an upcoming danger when Radha tells him about the mysterious man.

episodesList.title: Krishna Is Crestfallen
episodesList.summary: Krishna learns about Ugrapath's demand, which leaves him heartbroken. Later, Sridhama puts forth a desperate plea to Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Cancel the Wedding?
episodesList.summary: Krishna explains the duties of a daughter to Radha and urges her to cancel their wedding. Later, everyone is baffled when Krishna belittles an ancient ritual.

episodesList.title: Krishna Breaks the Rules
episodesList.summary: To everyone's shock, Krishna breaks the rules and visits Radha's house to meet her. Meanwhile, Ayan sees an opportunity that might cancel the wedding.

episodesList.title: Ayan to Defame Krishna
episodesList.summary: Despite multiple refusals, a persistent Krishna urges his sakhiya to perform Ras-Leela. Later, Ayan devises a cunning plan to defame him.

episodesList.title: Balram Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Vrishbhan is enraged at Krishna's behaviour while Yashodha confronts him. Later, Balram is taken aback by Radha's sacrifice.

episodesList.title: Decision Time for Radha
episodesList.summary: Radha and Krishna think about their decision and its results on their lives. Later, Radha is in a dilemma when Vrishban questions her.

episodesList.title: Balram's Sheshnag Avatar
episodesList.summary: Ugrapath announces Ayan's marriage with Radha. Kans is overjoyed at his success. Later, Balram takes the form of Sheshnag to fight against Ayan.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna's Final Moments
episodesList.summary: Krishna helps a shattered Radha dress up for the wedding. Later, he uses a magical illusion to pacify her as she heads for the marriage venue.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna's Painful Farewell
episodesList.summary: Krishna suffers an emotional breakdown during Radha's wedding while Ayan continues to taunt him. Later, Lord Shiva tries to console a shattered Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Final Plea
episodesList.summary: Radha's declaration shocks Ayan. Later, Kans orders a demon to bewitch Krishna while the latter puts forth a final request to Radha.

episodesList.title: Radha in a Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Radha is torn between meeting Krishna and the responsibilities placed upon her by Ugrapath. Later, Balram joins Krishna for a secret mission.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Leave Barsana
episodesList.summary: Radha panics when Krishna decides to leave Barsana in order to kill Kans. Later, he shows her the wise path following an emotional confession.

episodesList.title: Krishna Defends Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna defends Radha when they are accused of meeting in secret. Later, Ugrapath warns Krishna while a strict punishment is decided for Radha and Ayan.

episodesList.title: Krishna Enlightens Balram
episodesList.summary: Krishna enlightens Balram about Lord Brahma's choice while Radha is lost in her thoughts. Later, a furious Ayan restricts Radha from serving food to Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Has a Plan
episodesList.summary: Krishna tries to get Radha to realise her love for him with Mahadev's help. Later, Sage Durvasa's Brahmins warn Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Meets Sage Durvasa
episodesList.summary: Sage Durvasa is ecstatic to meet Krishna during his meditation. Later, Krishna secretly helps Radha when she is assigned with an unfeasible task.

episodesList.title: Kans to Kill Radha
episodesList.summary: Kans orders Ayan to dance after gifting him an anklet. Later, he plots to crush Radha under a mountain and assigns an evil task to Karakshasur.

episodesList.title: Krishna Hypnotises Karkashasur
episodesList.summary: Karkashasur tries to awaken Sage Durvasa when Sheshnag attacks him. Later, Krishna hypnotises Karkashasur to punish Kans while Radha is lost in thoughts.

episodesList.title: Radha's New Duty
episodesList.summary: While Radha is appointed to guard Durvasa's meditation, Krishna explains how destiny brings them closer.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Radha's Graceful Act
episodesList.summary: Radha and Krishna prepare a special garland for Durvasa, while Ayan faces strong criticism. Later, a demon disguises himself as Shuka to meet Radha.

episodesList.title: Kans Is Helpless
episodesList.summary: Krishna decides to trap Kans and kill him, while he watches Shuka wreak havoc at his palace. Later, Ayan and the Brahmins are agitated with Krishna's decision.

episodesList.title: Krishna Worships Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna explains his devotion to Radha while Jatila conveys her views to Ugrapath. Later, Krishna's firm decision infuriates Ayan and the Brahmins.

episodesList.title: Krishna Builds Radha's Idol
episodesList.summary: Ugrapath and Jatila discover some shocking facts while Kans plots against Krishna. Later, Krishna prepares an idol of Radha.

episodesList.title: Durvasa's Unbridled Fury
episodesList.summary: Ayan is shocked when Radha refuses to eat the magical fruit. Later, an enraged Durvasa does the unthinkable after learning about Ayan's true intentions.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Devotion to Radha
episodesList.summary: Durvasa instructs Radha to listen to her conscience while choosing her Guru. Later, Krishna bows to Radha and worships her with flowers, fruits, etc.

episodesList.title: Krishna Secretly Helps Radha
episodesList.summary: Ayan declares a punishment for Radha while Jatila assigns her with strenuous tasks. Later, a solicitous Krishna secretly helps Radha accomplish them.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Ingenious Plan
episodesList.summary: Krishna plans to use Shuka, Radha's pet parrot to express his feelings to her. Meanwhile, Kans decides to visit Pataal Lok to acquire a deadly weapon.

episodesList.title: Balram Stuns Jatila, Ayan
episodesList.summary: Shuka criticises Krishna while Kans decides to meet the demon, Ekdansh. Later, Jatila and Ayan are enraged by Balram's unexpected move.

episodesList.title: Kans' Offer to Ekdansh
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Radha meet once again while Kans puts forth an offer before Ekdansh. Later, Jatila hatches an evil plan to insult Radha.

episodesList.title: Radha Is Stunned
episodesList.summary: Radha is tensed after committing a blunder while Kans decides to worship Goddess Mahakali. Later, Krishna's solution leaves Radha speechless.

episodesList.title: Mahakali Visits Kans
episodesList.summary: Kans performs a yagna to please Mahakali while Ugrapath wants Radha to visit her parents. Later, Mahakali makes a shocking declaration to Kans.

episodesList.title: Kans' Evil Ploy
episodesList.summary: Krishna wants to worship Mahadev with Radha while Kans orders Ekdansh to kill Ayan. Later, Krishna rushes to a cave upon getting an intuition.

episodesList.title: Mahakali Stops Krishna
episodesList.summary: Ekdansh poisons Radha while Mahakali restricts Krishna from entering the cave. Later, a guilt-ridden Ekdansh finds a way to attain salvation.

episodesList.title: Krishna Visits Radha in Disguise
episodesList.summary: Kans rejoices his success while Krishna seeks Mahadev's help to cure Radha. Later, a disguised Krishna pays a visit to her.

episodesList.title: Achyuta Heals Radha
episodesList.summary: Achyuta aka Krishna heals Radha with her miraculous touch. Later, Achyuta reveals that Ayan is responsible for Radha's plight.

episodesList.title: Achyuta's Unusual Demand
episodesList.summary: Radha regains consciousness while Achyuta's odd demand infuriates Jatila and Ayan. Elsewhere, Krishna's absence drives Yashodha to make a shocking decision.

episodesList.title: Balram Tricks Radha
episodesList.summary: Balram tricks Radha into taking Achyuta aka Krishna home. Elsewhere, Kans brews his evil plan against Radha.

episodesList.title: Ayan's Cunning Ploy
episodesList.summary: Ayan makes a spiked herbal medicine to hinder Radha's recovery. Later, he suspects Achyuta while Ugrapath's health condition deteriorates.

episodesList.title: Ayan Declares Mal Yudh
episodesList.summary: Krishna visits Radha to motivate her. Later, an infuriated Ayan declares Mal Yudh against Achyuta.

episodesList.title: Radha to Meet Krishna?
episodesList.summary: Achyuta tells Radha about her lover, Harikanta while Kans is infuriated by his defeat. Later, Radha becomes restless on spotting Krishna in a fair.

episodesList.title: Achyuta Fights Ayan
episodesList.summary: In search of Achyuta, the king's men approach Radha and threaten her of dire consequences. Later, Balram makes Ayan take up Achyuta's challenge.

episodesList.title: Achyuta Tricks Radha
episodesList.summary: Achyuta tricks Radha into accepting a gift from Krishna. Later, Achyuta finds a hidden locker in Ugrapath's room while Kans assigns a task to Jatila.

episodesList.title: Krishna Tricks Jatila, Ayan
episodesList.summary: Krishna outwits Jatila and Ayan when they spy on him to solve Achyuta's mystery. Later, Ugrapath reveals the truth about the locker to Achyuta.

episodesList.title: Ayan, Jatila Accuse Achyuta
episodesList.summary: Jatila and Ayan accuse Achyuta of theft after she secretly takes Ugrapath's precious box with her. Later, Radha's health deteriorates.

episodesList.title: Achyuta Accuses Ugrapath
episodesList.summary: Achyuta accuses Ugrapath of theft to make him realise his folly. Later, she assigns Jatila and Ayan with an arduous task.

episodesList.title: Ayan to Expose Achyuta
episodesList.summary: A suspicious Ayan plans to expose Achyuta after spotting her near Krishna's house. Later, Achyuta tricks Radha to make her realise that she still loves Krishna.

episodesList.title: Achyuta Kills Jwalantak
episodesList.summary: Kans orders Jwalantak to kill Achyuta and Krishna. But after a shocking realisation, the fire demon attains salvation at the hands of the latter.

episodesList.title: Krishna Creates Prem Sarovar
episodesList.summary: Krishna creates Prem Sarovar using a mixture of his and Radha's tears. Later, Radha is puzzled by Achyuta's magical transformation.

episodesList.title: Radha's Miraculous Experience
episodesList.summary: Radha is desperate to learn about Krishna's identity after she witnesses a miracle. Meanwhile, Kans meets Shukracharya to find a way to defeat Krishna.

episodesList.title: Radha's Unusual Discovery
episodesList.summary: Mahadev stops Shukracharya from revealing Krishna's identity to Kans. Meanwhile, Yashoda puzzles Radha with an unusual fact about Krishna's childhood.

episodesList.title: Radha Witnesses a Miracle
episodesList.summary: Radha is baffled to see the endless universe enclosed in Krishna's mouth. Later, an astonished Radha learns another intriguing fact from Balram.

episodesList.title: Radha's Stern Decision
episodesList.summary: After listening to the story, Radha decides to figure out the reason behind Krishna's brave act. Later, Mahadev puts forth a condition in front of Krishna.

episodesList.title: Celebrating Krishna's Birthday
episodesList.summary: Yashoda invites the villagers to celebrate Krishna's birthday at the Ambikeshwar temple. Later, Kans plots to kill Krishna at a special location.

episodesList.title: Krishna Adds to Radha's Confusion
episodesList.summary: Krishna decorates a cart for Radha, while Shukracharya awakens Sudarshan to help Kans. A confused Radha witnesses Krishna perform yet another miracle.

episodesList.title: Krishna Restricts Radha
episodesList.summary: Taking the form of Sheshnag, Balram attacks Sudarshan while Krishna enlightens the latter. Meanwhile, Krishna stops Radha from revealing his real identity.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Visits Radha
episodesList.summary: Kans is overjoyed when Shukracharya reveals a way to battle Krishna. Elsewhere, Mahadev appears in front of Radha when she worships him along with Krishna.

episodesList.title: Kans, Shukracharya's Evil Ploy
episodesList.summary: Kans and Shukracharya order Yamuna to cause a disastrous flood in Barsana. Later, Radha reveals a shocking truth to Yashodha and Nand Baba.

episodesList.title: Nand Tells Krishna's Story
episodesList.summary: Nand tells Radha an interesting story from Krishna's childhood. Later, Krishna meets her in a forest while Kans targets Yamuna with his evil powers.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Gopal Avatar
episodesList.summary: Krishna takes the form of Gopal during the thunderstorm while Kans prepares to unleash Yamuna's wrath on Barsana. Later, Gopal's unusual claim stuns Vrishbhan.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Odd Plan
episodesList.summary: Radha extends her support to Krishna's odd plan of delaying his return to Barsana. Later, Kans decides to free Yamuna without Shukracharya's presence.

episodesList.title: Radha in Danger
episodesList.summary: Ayan is angry with Krishna for manipulating Radha while a bird attacks Kans during a puja. Later, Radha gets stuck on a tree in the disastrous flood.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Proposition
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Radha spend time on an island while Shuka brings unexpected news to Balram. Later, Krishna puts forth a proposition to Yamuna regarding Kans.

episodesList.title: Kans Is Attacked
episodesList.summary: Kans is attacked by Yamuna's fury while Radha visits Yashodha. Later, Krishna warns Balram of a major disaster that is coming their way.

episodesList.title: Shukracharya's Shocking Plan
episodesList.summary: Shukracharya summons Lord Shiva and explains his shocking plan to exact revenge on Krishna. Meanwhile, the latter reminisces about his childhood with Radha.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Birthday Celebration
episodesList.summary: Radha stuns Krishna by arranging a grand event for his birthday, while Kans assigns an evil task to Jatila. Later, Krishna accepts Matki Tod challenge.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna's Team Effort
episodesList.summary: Radha and Krishna give their best attempt at Matki Tod while Lord Shiva watches over them. Later, Kans is furious upon learning a shocking truth.

episodesList.title: Radha's Daivik Avatar
episodesList.summary: The involvement of Krishna's gopis in his 'Abhishek' ritual irks Radha. Later, her Daivik form baffles Shukracharya while Ugrapath makes a shocking declaration.

episodesList.title: Radha's Miraculous Experience
episodesList.summary: Radha makes a small idol of Krishna while Vishnu names his new form as Laddu Gopal. Later, Radha is stunned by a miracle.

episodesList.title: Krishna Tells Radha a Story
episodesList.summary: Krishna challenges Radha and tells her the story of Laxmi-Narayan. Later, Ayan overhears his conversation with Balram.

episodesList.title: Krishna Narrates an Epic Tale
episodesList.summary: Balram tricks Ayan and Jatila into allowing Radha to meet Krishna. Later, Krishna continues narrating the Lakshmi-Narayan epic.

episodesList.title: Ganesha to Meet Krishna
episodesList.summary: Jatila complains to Kans about Radha's odd behaviour. Later, Ganesha plans to visit Krishna while Balram sets up a big puja.

episodesList.title: Ganesha's Incarnation on Earth
episodesList.summary: Lord Ganesha stops Ayan from spotting Radha and Krishna while Krishna is delighted to meet him. Later, Balram teases Ayan after he fails to prove himself.

episodesList.title: What Is Krishna's New Leela?
episodesList.summary: While Krishna plans a grand surprise for Radha's birthday, Ayan and Jatila are hell-bent on spoiling it. Later, Vrishbhan and Kirtida visit Radha.

episodesList.title: Govind Arrives in Barsana
episodesList.summary: Disguised as Govind, Krishna arrives in Barsana while Radha puts forth a challenge to him. Later, Govind makes a shocking demand before Vrishbhan.

episodesList.title: Kans Builds a Kaal Chakra
episodesList.summary: Ayan brings a special gift for Chitra in order to expose her. After obtaining Kaal Devta's blessings, Kans constructs a deadly trap for his archnemesis.

episodesList.title: Ayan Spots a Strange Figure
episodesList.summary: Krishna continues to narrate the story to Radha while Ayan spots a mysterious figure. Later, Chitra berates Ayan while the latter recalls his evil plan.

episodesList.title: Radha's Special Birthday
episodesList.summary: On Radha's birthday, Ayan tricks her into entering the Kaal Chakra. Later, Kaal Devta experiences the unthinkable.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna Share a Dance
episodesList.summary: Krishna finishes his story and promises to tell Radha a secret as her birthday gift. On the other hand, Ayan hatches an evil plan.

episodesList.title: Krishna Surprises Radha
episodesList.summary: A disguised Krishna gets Ayan in trouble with the people of Barsana. Later, Radha is taken aback by Krishna's surprise.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Forgiving Nature
episodesList.summary: Ashtavakra curses Kans' head dancer during a visit to his palace. Elsewhere, Krishna believes Ayan can redeem himself while the latter plots against him.

episodesList.title: Krishna Has a Plan
episodesList.summary: Krishna claims to have a plan when Balram questions his intentions. Ayan prepares to execute Kans' ploy while Krishna continues his story session with Radha.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Ingenious Act
episodesList.summary: Krishna comes up with a smart act to save Radha when Jatila interrupts the story. Later, Ayan tricks some villagers and meets Ashtavakra with an evil scheme.

episodesList.title: Radha Is in a Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Radha is in a dilemma when Ugrapath instructs her to act opposite to her personality. Meanwhile, Ayan impresses Ashtavakra and plots against Radha with Jatila.

episodesList.title: Ayan Manipulates Ashtavakra
episodesList.summary: Sage Ashtavakra misunderstands Radha's kind gesture and gets angry. Later, Ayan manipulates him into cursing her while Krishna puts forth a demand.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Clever Trick
episodesList.summary: Krishna seeks Balram's help to trick Radha. Later, he continues to narrate the story and tells her about Hiranyaksh's troublesome act.

episodesList.title: Vishnu's Varaha Avatar
episodesList.summary: Krishna narrates an emotional climax of Varaha avatar, while Kans summons Sammohana in an attempt to destroy him. Later, she hypnotises Barsana with her beauty.

episodesList.title: Krishna Tells Hiranyakashipu's Tale
episodesList.summary: Krishna warns Radha and begins telling her the story of Prahlad and Hiranyakashipu. Later, Ayan puts Radha in a fix while the people of Barsana face a strange problem.

episodesList.title: Krishna Narrates about Holika Dahan
episodesList.summary: Krishna creates Motikund to solve Radha's problems. Later, he tells her about Holika, who tried to push Prahlad into the fire.

episodesList.title: Lord Narasimha's Rage
episodesList.summary: Sammohana tricks all the men with her charm. Later, Krishna narrates to Radha, the story of how Lord Vishnu reincarnated in his Narasimha Avatar to save Prahlad from his father.

episodesList.title: Lord Narasimha Wreaks Havoc
episodesList.summary: While Jatila plans to kill Krishna, he narrates to Radha how Lord Narasimha defeated Hiranyakashipu. Later, Radha receives a magical gift from him.

episodesList.title: Radha's Magical Encounter
episodesList.summary: Radha faces trouble when the hypnotised mob attempts to kill her. Later, she defends herself with a magical weapon while Krishna tricks Sammohana.

episodesList.title: The Story of Raja Bali
episodesList.summary: Radha makes a promise to Dama. Later, Krishna narrates the story of Raja Bali to Radha while Kans meets Dhenukasur on a learning a secret.

episodesList.title: Narayan Tricks Bali
episodesList.summary: Kans assigns a task to Dhenukasur while Ayan fools Radha to usurp her political powers. Later, Krishna narrates to her how Narayan tricked King Bali.

episodesList.title: Ayan's Eligibility Test
episodesList.summary: Krishna tricks Brahmandev with a plan to stop Ayan's coronation ceremony. Later, Ayan faces trouble after Brahmandev conducts an eligibility test.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Sri Ram Avatar
episodesList.summary: Balram gets emotional when Krishna reveals Ram-Lakshman's avatar to him. Later, Radha gets tensed when Kans summons her for a meeting.

episodesList.title: Kans' Gruelling Challenge
episodesList.summary: Kans decides to punish Radha for going against his will. While the people of Barsana panic about the situation, she accepts his shocking challenge.

episodesList.title: Ram, Sita's First Meeting
episodesList.summary: Krishna narrates how Lord Ram fell in love with Sita at first sight. Elsewhere, the Barsana women arrange their shops while Akrur announces Kans' cruel decision.

episodesList.title: Ram Wins Sita's Swayamvar
episodesList.summary: Krishna narrates the story of Sita's Swayamvar and how all the kings failed including the mighty Raavan. And thereafter, how Lord Rama strung 'Pinaka' the Shiv Dhanush and won.

episodesList.title: Ram, Sita's Auspicious Wedding
episodesList.summary: Krishna narrates the significance of Ram and Sita's wedding. Elsewhere, Kans realises the hostages are set free while Krishna creates a terrifying illusion.

episodesList.title: Ram, Sita's Vanvaas
episodesList.summary: Balram announces of an upcoming miracle in Barsana. Later, Krishna narrates the story of Ram and Sita's exile.

episodesList.title: Lakshman Attacks Surpanakha
episodesList.summary: Krishna narrates how Lakshman cut off Surpanakha's nose to give a special message. Later, the villagers gather at Barsana to witness a miracle.

episodesList.title: Raavan's Deceitful Disguise
episodesList.summary: Radha narrates the story of Lakshman's efforts to protect Sita in Ram's absence. However, Sita is tricked into crossing his Lakshmanrekha by a disguised Raavan.

episodesList.title: Ram Takes an Oath
episodesList.summary: Mahamaya gives the Visthapan Astra to Kans after Akrur offends the latter with his unexpected act. Later, Radha narrates about Ram's oath to reunite with Sita.

episodesList.title: Hanuman's Devotion Towards Ram
episodesList.summary: Radha narrates the tale of Hanuman's unconditional devotion towards Ram. Later, she gets a divine awakening and summons Mahadev for help.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Siddheshwar Avatar
episodesList.summary: The women of Barsana get caught in a magical trap. Later, Radha narrates how Hanuman found Sita in Lanka while Mahadev takes on his Siddheshwar avatar.

episodesList.title: Ram, Ravan's Intense Battle
episodesList.summary: A disguised Mahadev gets infuriated after Krishna reveals a fact about the women of Barsana. Elsewhere, Radha narrates the story of Ram and Ravan's fiery battle.

episodesList.title: Siddheshwar Worships Siddhidatri Devi
episodesList.summary: Siddheshwar worships Siddhidatri Devi inside the Premsetu created by Krishna while Radha witnesses Devi's divine avatar. Later, Akrur asks Kans to accept defeat.

episodesList.title: Radha Supports Krishna
episodesList.summary: Radha assures Krishna that she will fight for him. Elsewhere, Kans summons his eight demons in preparation for the battle.

episodesList.title: Radha's Ashtalakshmi Avtar
episodesList.summary: After coming face-to-face with the Asurs, Radha unleashes her Ashtalakshmi Avtar to combat them. Later, Jatila tries to instigate Ugrapath against Radha.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna to Unite
episodesList.summary: Jatila puts Radha under house arrest while Krishna makes a shocking decision. Enlightened by love, Radha takes a daring step to meet Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Shocking Revelation
episodesList.summary: Jatila and Ayan plan to catch Radha red-handed while Balram gets tensed upon hearing Krishna's prophecy. Later, Radha manages to trick the villagers.

episodesList.title: Balram's Playful Disguise
episodesList.summary: Radha asks Balram to enact a role under the disguise of a sage, Balbaba. Later, Krishna challenges Radha to an amusing task.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Gopika Form
episodesList.summary: Radha is mesmerised when Krishna appears as Gopika. A series of dramatic events occurs after Radha and Krishna swap their lifestyles.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Struggle as Gopika
episodesList.summary: Radha enjoys watching Gopika tackle her problems while Gurudev gives Kaaldand to Kans. Later, Ugrapath is worried as the idol cracks before the Satyanarayan puja.

episodesList.title: Jatila Provokes Ugrapath
episodesList.summary: Kans orders Brahmasur to predict Krishna's future. Elsewhere, Ugrapath gets furious when he finds Radha missing from the house while Jatila provokes him.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Solve Radha's Riddle?
episodesList.summary: Radha teases Krishna after challenging him to solve a riddle. While he faces Balram's interrogation, Kans sends Pralambasur to execute his plan.

episodesList.title: Pralambasur Is Tricked
episodesList.summary: Krishna tricks Pralambasur during their challenge. While the latter demands that Jatila and Ayan help him, she instructs Gopika to prepare the Chappan Bhog.

episodesList.title: Radha in a Tight Spot
episodesList.summary: Radha, disguised as Vallabh, sneaks into Krishna's room while the latter manages to fool Jatila. Later, Yashodha and Balram feed Vallabh too much food.

episodesList.title: Radha Offers to Help Krishna
episodesList.summary: Balram gives Vallabh a peacock feather. Later, Krishna receives help from Radha while Ayan and Jatila are stunned by an unexpected letter.

episodesList.title: Kutila Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Kutila meets her family while Krishna and Radha enjoy some quality time together. Later, a heated argument erupts between Pralambasur and Kutila.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna Make the Idol
episodesList.summary: Pralambasur and Kutila try to destroy the idol made by Radha and Krishna. Later, they hatch an evil plan to hinder the Satyanarayan puja.

episodesList.title: Lord Shiva Visits Barsana
episodesList.summary: Krishna declares himself a saint as he takes the Mahapandit's seat. Later, Lord Shiva visits Barsana during the puja proceedings.

episodesList.title: The Tale of Satyanarayan
episodesList.summary: Krishna narrates Satyanarayan's story to the villagers. Later, Kutila makes an ingenious plan to help Pralambasur touch Krishna's hands.

episodesList.title: Ballav, Gopika's Divine Love
episodesList.summary: Radha curses Pralambasur for speaking ill of Krishna. Later, Kutila and Balram are shocked to see Ballav and Gopika spend some quality time together.

episodesList.title: Kutila Helps Gopika, Vallabh
episodesList.summary: Kutila helps Gopika and Vallabh escape from the village with an evil plan against Radha and Krishna. Later, Jatila provokes Vrishbhan against Krishna.

episodesList.title: Jyotishmati, Sheshnag's Love Story
episodesList.summary: Krishna narrates the story of Sheshnag and Jyotishmati's eternal love to Radha. Elsewhere, Pralambasur informs Kans about the upcoming Malyudh.

episodesList.title: A Challenge for Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna challenges Radha to convince Balram to meet his lady love. Elsewhere, Kans tells King Kakudmi that he will contest the Malyudh in his favour.

episodesList.title: Balram Saves Princess Revati
episodesList.summary: Balram follows Radha secretly and saves Princess Revati from danger. Later, Radha and Krishna make a plan while Balram is awestruck by Revati's beauty.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna's Unique Experience
episodesList.summary: Revati is disappointed after meeting Balram while Radha urges Krishna to see the flower of love together. Later, Krishna gets an invitation from King Kakudmi.

episodesList.title: Kutila's Unthinkable Demand
episodesList.summary: Radha is disappointed when Krishna accepts Kutila's unthinkable demand. Meanwhile, Revati is delighted by the news of Balram's arrival in her kingdom.

episodesList.title: Balram, Krishna at Loggerheads
episodesList.summary: Krishna gives Radha a strange warning. At the malyudh, Balram and Krishna are at loggerheads after it is declared that the winner will get Revati's hand in marriage.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Fight Balram
episodesList.summary: Balram gets ready to fight Krishna after defeating the other fighters. While Pralambasur executes his devious plan, Krishna does the unthinkable.

episodesList.title: Krishna Proposes a Solution
episodesList.summary: While Kans is stunned to learn about Pralambasur's death, Kutila attempts to break Krishna's flute. Later, Krishna suggests a solution to King Kakudmi.

episodesList.title: Balram Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Balram is shocked to learn the truth about Vallabh and Gopika while Kutila poses an awkward question to Yashodha. Later, Krishna makes plans to visit Mathura.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Arrive in Mathura
episodesList.summary: A petrified Kans foresees his Kaal while Radha permits Krishna to go to Mathura. Later, Kans is bewildered upon seeing Devki and Vasudev.

episodesList.title: Radha Learns a Shocking Truth
episodesList.summary: Kans asks Lord Parashuram for a powerful bow. While Balram is stunned by Krishna's confession, Kutila overhears the latter telling Radha a shocking truth.

episodesList.title: Kutila Stirs Trouble
episodesList.summary: Ignoring Radha's pleas, Jatila locks her in a room. Later, Kutila meets Yashodha with a plan to reveal the truth about Krishna's real parents to her.

episodesList.title: Radha Stuns Yashodha
episodesList.summary: While Akrur seeks Radha's forgiveness, Krishna uses his magical powers on Jatila. Later, Radha stuns Yashodha with her revelation regarding Krishna's divinity.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna's Last Meeting
episodesList.summary: An emotional Krishna struggles to reveal the truth to Radha during their final meeting. Meanwhile, Radha is overcome by a sense of dread.

episodesList.title: Yashodha Bids Farewell to Krishna
episodesList.summary: While Radha prays to Narayan, Devaki warns Kans of his inevitable doom. Later, Yashodha bids farewell to Krishna as Jatila and Kutila concoct an evil plan.

episodesList.title: Radha's Emotional Declaration
episodesList.summary: A grand farewell is arranged in Krishna's honour. Later, Radha learns about his departure and makes a shocking declaration in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: Krishna Bids Farewell
episodesList.summary: Yashodha requests Radha to apply tilak on Krishna. Before departing for Mathura, he spends some quality time with Radha and plays an enchanting flute melody.

episodesList.title: Kans Creates a Chakravyuha
episodesList.summary: Kans creates Ashtha Chakravyuha and waits for Krishna while Akrur witnesses Krishna's Narayan Avatar. Ignoring Ayan's order, Radha rushes to warn Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Challenge to Kans
episodesList.summary: Krishna consoles some tensed villagers and makes an unexpected statement about Kans' magical bow. Upon reaching Mathura, he puts forth a challenge to Kans.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Balram's Ingenious Plan
episodesList.summary: Krishna seeks help from the villagers to end Kans' tyranny. Later, Krishna and Balram disguise as the villagers with a plan to kill Kans.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Balram's Ingenious Plan
episodesList.summary: Krishna seeks help from the villagers to end Kans' tyranny. Later, Krishna and Balram disguise as the villagers with a plan to kill Kans.

episodesList.title: Kans Is Horrified
episodesList.summary: As per Krishna's plan, Kans breaks the Chakravyuha. Later, Kans is terrified upon witnessing some dreadful events signifying his inevitable doom.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Ingenious Trick
episodesList.summary: Krishna breaks Kans' bow and gives the credit to a child, Abhinav. Elsewhere, Ayan and Kutila defame Krishna on learning about the same.

episodesList.title: Kans Prepares the Arena
episodesList.summary: Kutila vows to make Ayan Barsana's next chief while Kans prepares the combat arena. Later, Krishna imbues a handful of dirt with the power of Radha's love.

episodesList.title: Krishna Cures Kubja
episodesList.summary: Kubja, an old lady criticizes Narayan while Krishna magically cures her hunchback. Elsewhere, Ayan declares himself as the chief of Barsana.

episodesList.title: Krishna Declares War
episodesList.summary: As Krishna declares war on Kans, the villagers of Mathura plan to present him with a divine warrior armour. Later, Kans discusses battle strategy with his brothers.

episodesList.title: Krishna Accepts Kans' Gift
episodesList.summary: Krishna gives Radha a pleasant surprise while she is tormented by Kutila's words. Kans' plan backfires after Krishna accepts his gift.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Huge Challenge
episodesList.summary: Kans executes his diabolical ploy while Radha rushes to give Krishna grave news about Shukha. Later, Krishna faces a fierce elephant sent forth by Kans.

episodesList.title: Krishna to End Kans?
episodesList.summary: Krishna defeats the elephant and storms to Kans' palace with Mathura to kill him. However, Krishna falls into a tough spot after King Ugrasena makes a request.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Balram In a Tough Spot
episodesList.summary: Kans puts Ugrasena back in chains. Meanwhile, Balram and Krishna get ready to fight Kans' five rakshasas.

episodesList.title: Kans, Krishna's Epic Battle
episodesList.summary: Krishna gives Kans one final chance to attain Mukti. While a chained Devaki is overwhelmed, Krishna fulfils Kans' last wish before the killing blow

episodesList.title: Krishna Reveals the Truth
