episodesList.summary: Devaki implores Krishna to return her six dead children to her. Later, Krishna reveals that he is indeed Narayan, shocking Devaki and Vasudev.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: Krishna refuses to rule people and suggests King Ugrasena's name. Meanwhile, Maharishi Garg arrives to take Krishna and Balram with him.

episodesList.title: Radha's Stunning Decision
episodesList.summary: An infuriated Ayan makes a shocking statement to Jatila. While Radha's decision stuns Barsana, Krishna is asked to renounce his relationships and become a sage.

episodesList.title: Krishna Faces a Tough Challenge
episodesList.summary: Balram is surprised when Krishna renounces all his worldly bonds. While Radha gives Jatila a curt reply, Rishi Sandipani puts forth a challenge to Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Gets the Sudarshan Chakra
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Balram set out to fulfil Guru Ma's request as an offering to Rishi Sandeepani. Later, Parashuram grants Krishna the Sudarshan Chakra

episodesList.title: Krishna Returns to Barsana?
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Balram decide to evacuate the villages around Mathura as a new danger approaches. Later, Krishna is ordered to return to Barsana.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna's Romantic Reunion
episodesList.summary: While Rukmini is obsessed with tales of Krishna's charm, Jarasand vows to avenge Kans' death. Elsewhere, Radha and Krishna relish their much-awaited reunion.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Announcement to Barsana
episodesList.summary: Yashodha is overwhelmed to see Krishna again while Jarasandh has a flashback of his duel with Kans. Later, Krishna makes an unexpected announcement to the villagers of Barsana.

episodesList.title: Krishna Hurts Radha's Feelings
episodesList.summary: Krishna makes a shocking revelation about Radha's decisions to Balram and later, breaks Radha's heart. Elsewhere, Rukmini fantasises about him.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Unexpected Request
episodesList.summary: Krishna meets Revathi alone at night to talk about Balram. While Barsana welcomes King Kakudmi, Krishna's request leaves Radha and the others stunned.

episodesList.title: Rukmini's Romantic Obsession
episodesList.summary: Rukmini is infatuated with her painting of Krishna and misleads Jarasandh. Later, Krishna teases Radha by glorifying the beauty of his future wife.

episodesList.title: Radha Weds Krishna
episodesList.summary: The Gods create a spectacular arena for Radha and Krishna's marriage. As Ganesha and Brahma chant the mantras, Radha and Krishna finally tie the knot.

episodesList.title: Rukmini Makes a Judgement
episodesList.summary: Radha explains her decision to Krishna while Samrat is infuriated by Rukmini's judgement. Later, Rukmini decides to help Krishna fight the war.

episodesList.title: Radha's Toughest Decision
episodesList.summary: While Jarasandh approaches Barsana with his army, Radha asks Krishna to leave the village. After agreeing to do so, Krishna bids farewell to Yashodha.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna's Tearful Goodbye
episodesList.summary: Ayan meets with Jarasandh's men to tell them about Krishna. Elsewhere, Radha pours her heart out to Krishna while he breaks his flute in front of her.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Parting Gift
episodesList.summary: As part of his final gift to Radha, Krishna makes an emotional declaration. Later, Ayan instigates the people of Barsana to dethrone Radha.

episodesList.title: Rukmini Is in for a Surprise
episodesList.summary: Ayan's attempt to dethrone Radha fails miserably. While she learns the truth about Jarasandh from him, Rukmini gets a surprising piece of information.

episodesList.title: Balaram Is Threatened
episodesList.summary: Ayan vents his anger on Radha while Krishna and Balram meet Devraj. Later, Balaram faces a severe threat after meeting Revati.

episodesList.title: Rukmini Clings onto Hope
episodesList.summary: Radha reveals to Krishna, the way to kill Jarasandh. Later, the kings arrive at the Swayamvar while a helpless Rukmini anticipates Krishna's arrival.

episodesList.title: Rukmini Is Imprisoned!
episodesList.summary: An arrogant Jarasandh imprisons Bhishmak and Rukmini. While Krishna foresees an approaching change, Jarasandh fixes Rukmini's wedding to Shishupal.

episodesList.title: Krishna Prepares for War
episodesList.summary: Shishupal decides to accept Jarasandh's proposal to fight Krishna and marry Rukmini. While Krishna prepares for war, Shishupal meets Rukmini in person.

episodesList.title: Jarasandh Beckons Kalyavan
episodesList.summary: Krishna tells Balram about Kalyavan, an immortal demon, who possesses the boon of invincibility. Later, Jarasandh urges Kalyavan to attack Krishna.

episodesList.title: Kalyavan to Face Krishna
episodesList.summary: Glowing with power, Kalyavan challenges Krishna to face him alone on the battlefield. However, Krishna taunts Kalyavan with an unexpected decision.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Ingenious Plan
episodesList.summary: Kalyavan is lured into a trap by Krishna's smart plan while Radha refuses to give up on Krishna. Later, Jarasandh announces Shishupal and Rukmini's marriage.

episodesList.title: Radha Defends Her Throne
episodesList.summary: Jarasandh fixes Rukmini and Shishupal's marriage. While Ayan tries to dethrone Radha, Vasudev tells her a motivational story about Krishna.

episodesList.title: Rukmini's Letter to Radha
episodesList.summary: Balram demands that Krishna share his divine sight while Radha submerges herself in the Yamuna. Later, Rukmini writes a letter to Radha.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Quest for Dwarka
episodesList.summary: Krishna sets off on his quest for the submerged city of Dwarka with Balram. Later, Jarasandh learns of this and prepares his massive army for the attack.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Balram on a Mission
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Balram decide to save the lives of some soldiers. While Samudra Dev offers to help Krishna, Radha makes a shocking disclosure to Ayan.

episodesList.title: Jarasandh Takes an Oath
episodesList.summary: Jarasandh swears to hunt Krishna down after receiving news of the latter's survival. Later, Radha, Revati and Rukmini all share a beautiful dream.

episodesList.title: Krishna Raises the City of Dwarka
episodesList.summary: Krishna receives news from Jarasandh regarding Balram's marriage to Revati. Later, he raises the city of Dwarka from the ocean as the Gods look on.

episodesList.title: Lord Ganesh Performs a Puja
episodesList.summary: Lord Ganesh performs a Puja for the inauguration of Dwarka. Meanwhile, Jarasandh agrees to Shishupal's demand and plans to attack Krishna during Balram's wedding.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Startling Demand
episodesList.summary: Jarasandh plans to wreak havoc at Balram's wedding while Rukmini curses Shishupal. Later, Krishna's unexpected demand stuns the villagers.

episodesList.title: Balram Is Furious!
episodesList.summary: Balram furiously berates Krishna when the latter asks the people of Mathura to donate their wealth. Radha learns a shocking fact upon receiving Rukmini's letter.

episodesList.title: Rukmini Is Helpless
episodesList.summary: An infuriated Radha gives firm orders to Balram. Elsewhere, a helpless Rukmini agrees to Shishupal's conditions, before their marriage.

episodesList.title: Krishna to the Rescue!
episodesList.summary: Krishna decides to fulfil Radha's orders despite unable to emotionally agree with her. While Rukmini is in a fix, Krishna comes up with an ingenious idea.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Heroic Move
episodesList.summary: Krishna takes custody of Rukmini and puts forth an open challenge to Shishupal, Rukmi and Jarasandh. Unable to accept defeat, Rukmi attacks Krishna.

episodesList.title: The Wrath of Krishna
episodesList.summary: A furious Krishna decides to kill Rukmi only to be stopped by Rukmini. While Revati falls unconscious on her wedding day, Jarasandh charges into Mathura with his army.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Smart Step
episodesList.summary: Krishna accompanies the inhabitants of Mathura to the mystical city of Dwarka. While Kutila taunts Radha, Rukmini expresses her undying belief in Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Rule Dwarka?
episodesList.summary: In an unexpected turn of events, Krishna is voted to be the king of Dwarka. Later, he introduces an unusual new system to rule over the mystical city.

episodesList.title: Balram, Krishna's Emotional Moment
episodesList.summary: Krishna announces the news of Balram and Revati's marriage. Later, Balram gets emotional upon reading a letter presented by Krishna.

episodesList.title: Balram, Revati Get Married
episodesList.summary: Balram and Revati tie the knot admist a grand celebration. Elsewhere, Ayan meets King Jarasandh and Shishupal with a secret motive in mind.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Wed Rukmini?
episodesList.summary: A massive tidal wave hits Jarasandh while Ugrasena makes a shocking announcement. Later, Krishna puts forth a condition regarding his marriage to Rukmini.

episodesList.title: Rukmini, Radha Perform Together
episodesList.summary: Radha gives an unexpected reply when Krishna reveals about his wedding with Rukmini. During the Saraswati Puja, Rukmini joins Radha for a performance.

episodesList.title: Radha Guides Rukmini
episodesList.summary: While Radha teaches Rukmini to make Kheer, the latter ends up making a modified variant of the dish. Later, Radha asks Krishna to choose between the recipes.

episodesList.title: Rukmini's Shocking Statement
episodesList.summary: Balram decides to meet Rukmini while Kutila and Ayan learn about her royal blood. Later, an annoyed Rukmini makes a shocking statement on the banks of the Yamuna.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Heroic Act
episodesList.summary: Clouded by delusions about Krishna's love, Rukmani jumps into the Yamuna river. Later, Krishna saves her life while Ayan and Kutila scheme against Radha.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Rukmini's Garland Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Radha decks up Rukmini for the wedding. While Krishna and Rukmini perform the Jaymala ritual, Radha prays for their joyful future.

episodesList.title: Rukmini's Request to Krishna
episodesList.summary: Revati tries to console an apprehensive Rukmini before the ritualistic wedding games. Later, Rukmini makes an unexpected request to Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Calls Radha to Dwarka
episodesList.summary: Krishna sends forth a letter calling Radha to Dwarka while Balram learns the truth from Revati. As Radha gets ready to leave, Kutila shoots accusations at her.

episodesList.title: Radha Reaches Dwarka
episodesList.summary: Rukmini prepares for Radha's arrival while the latter is taken aback by Dwarka's magnificence. Later, Rukmini gets upset when Radha refuses to stay in the room.

episodesList.title: Rukmini's Unthinkable Challenge
episodesList.summary: Rukmini challenges Radha that Krishna will send her away from Dwarka. During their wedding night, Krishna puts forth an unexpected question to Rukmini.

episodesList.title: Radha's Profound Statement
episodesList.summary: When Radha doesn't attend the grand feast, Krishna takes a plate of food for her. Later, Radha makes a profound statement to a confused Rukmini.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Rukmini's Quality Time
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Rukmini enjoy the night of the full moon together. Later, Balram is helpless as Radha does the unthinkable.

episodesList.title: Krishna Fulfils Rukmini's Wish
episodesList.summary: Rukmini is delighted when Krishna fulfils her wish despite his injury. While Dwarka decides to celebrate Maha Shivaratri, Sudama and his wife are in a crisis.

episodesList.title: Radha's Profound Thoughts
episodesList.summary: While Balram is busy planning for the Maha Shivaratri puja, Radha's enlightened statements confuse Rukmini. Later, a disguised Lord Shiva helps Sudama.

episodesList.title: Sudama Arrives at Dwarka
episodesList.summary: Rukmini makes a request to Krishna about the upcoming puja while Sudama finally arrives at Dwarka. Later, he runs into some unforeseen trouble at the city gates.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Sudama's Reunion
episodesList.summary: Sudama faces trouble from the guards while Krishna is happy to see him. Later, Krishna assigns Sudama an important task.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Unexpected Act
episodesList.summary: As the Chappan Bhog is served, Krishna recalls memories of the past with Sudama. Later, Rukmini is taken aback by Krishna's unexpected act.

episodesList.title: Bholenath Accuses Sudama
episodesList.summary: Disguised as Bholenath, Mahadev accuses Sudama of thievery and asks Krishna to be the judge. Later, Krishna decides to put Rukmini's faith to test.

episodesList.title: Sudama Is Annoyed
episodesList.summary: An annoyed Sudama tells Bholenath to leave Dwarka while Radha asks for five grains of rice from Sudama. At night, Rukmini sneaks into the kitchen to satiate her hunger.

episodesList.title: Nandi, Ganpret Visit Dwarka
episodesList.summary: Sudama and Rukmini try to control the chaos while Nandi and Ganpret ruin their arrangements for Mahashivratri. Later, Nandi makes a special request to Radha.

episodesList.title: Radha's Ethereal Form
episodesList.summary: Radha and Krishna share a dance in the forest. Later, Devi Radha appears alongside Mahadev in an ethereal form with a humble request.

episodesList.title: Katha Mahadev-Parvati
episodesList.summary: On Mahashivratri, Mahadev recollects the past and narrates the story of how he met Parvati. Later, Krishna and Rukmini perform some rituals together.

episodesList.title: Radha Decides to Leave Dwarka
episodesList.summary: With a blink of his eye, Mahadev wakes the sleeping residents of Dwarka. While Krishna promises Sudama a special Dakshina, Radha decides to return to Barsana.

episodesList.title: Satrajit's Unthinkable Demand
episodesList.summary: An arrogant Satrajit puts forth an unimaginable demand to Krishna. While Sudama is in for a huge surprise, Satrajit warns Krishna of the dire consequences.

episodesList.title: Satyabhama Stuns Satrajit
episodesList.summary: To obtain the precious stone, the villagers launch a deadly attack on Satrajit. Later, Satrajit is stunned to learn about Satyabhama's desire to marry Krishna.

episodesList.title: Will Krishna Marry Satyabhama?
episodesList.summary: Satrajit agrees to give the magical stone to Krishna, if he agrees to marry Satyabhama. While Rukmini is infuriated by the proposal, Krishna's reply stuns the royal court.

episodesList.title: Satyabhama Arrives at Dwarka
episodesList.summary: Satyabhama arrives at Dwarka to meet Krishna. Later, Radha makes an unexpected decision when she finds herself in a tough spot.

episodesList.title: Satyabhama Meets Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna promises Rukmini that he will never meet Satyabhama. While Krishna praises Satyabhama's beauty in the royal court, Satrajit accuses him of murder.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Strange Experience
episodesList.summary: After being humiliated by Satyabhama, Rukmini sends a letter to her father. Elsewhere, Krishna witnesses a strange sight while following mysterious tracks in a forest.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Fulfil a Promise
episodesList.summary: Krishna recalls an event from his Ram avatar and explains how he must uphold a shocking promise he once made. Rukmi hatches a clever plan to infiltrate Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Krishna Is Challenged
episodesList.summary: Balram decides against telling Radha and Rukmini the truth about Krishna. Meanwhile, Krishna is challenged to an epic battle by Jambhavan himself.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Jambhavan's Epic Battle
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Jambhavan are locked in a legendary battle while Rukmi asks Satyabhama to marry him. As Balram makes a shocking find, Jambhavan loses his cool.

episodesList.title: Krishna Emerges Triumphant?
episodesList.summary: Balram warns Rukmi after finding out about his plan. While Jarasandh approaches Dwarka with his army, Jambhavan falls to his knees upon Krishna's revelation.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Doesn't Have the Answer?
episodesList.summary: Radha sets out to prepare for Dwarka's first Holi while Satyabama makes a shocking statement. Later, Mahadev is faced with a puzzling situation.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna Ki Holi
episodesList.summary: Krishna accepts the offerings made to him on the occasion of Holi. While the celebrations in Dwarka begin, Radha witnesses a unique vision of Krishna playing Holi.

episodesList.title: Radha's Emotional Turmoil
episodesList.summary: Balram along with the people of Dwarka punish and insult Rukmi. While Satyabhama is excited to marry Krishna, Radha is lost in thought about his decision.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Satyabhama Get Married
episodesList.summary: Narad sets off on a mission to fulfil Krishna's wish. While Krishna and Satyabhama tie the knot on a grand note, Narad meets Devraj Indra and Indrani.

episodesList.title: Narakasura Rains Carnage
episodesList.summary: Satyabhama gets jealous by Krishna and Rukmini's bond while Narakasura wreaks havoc. To test Krishna's love for her, Satyabhama puts forth a surprising demand.

episodesList.title: Devraj Indra Is Helpless
episodesList.summary: Krishna assigns Satyabhama's request to Narad while Devraj Indra is helpless after Moor attacks Devlok. Later, Barsana faces the wrath of Moor.

episodesList.title: Ayan's Request to Krishna
episodesList.summary: Ayan puts forth a request to Krishna while the latter enjoys some quality time with Rukmini and Satyabhama. Later, he eavesdrops on Krishna's conversation.

episodesList.title: Moor Asura's Tale
episodesList.summary: While Krishna recalls the past and narrates Moor's tale to Balram, Narad meets Devraj Indra. Later, Krishna decides to fulfil Satyabhama's demand.

episodesList.title: Krishna Kills Moor
episodesList.summary: Moor abducts 16,100 women of Swarga Lok, which ultimately becomes the cause for his doom. Later, Balram names Krishna 'Murari' for killing Moor.

episodesList.title: Dwarka Welcomes Murari Krishna
episodesList.summary: Dwarka bestows the title Murari upon Krishna after he returns with Kutila. While Narakasur traps many women for a despicable plan, Satyabhama courts controversy.

episodesList.title: Krishna to End Narakasura?
episodesList.summary: Satyabhama half-heartedly gives up her place in the puja to Rukmini. While Narakasura wreaks havoc, Krishna decides to end him with Garud Dev's help.

episodesList.title: Krishna Returns to Dwarka
episodesList.summary: Radha tries to pacify a shattered Satyabhama after Krishna returns to Dwarka with the women. Later, Krishna stuns everyone with his unexpected request.

episodesList.title: Krishna  Summons the Gods
episodesList.summary: Radha performs the Vijay Tilak ritual while Krishna summons Indra, Vayudev, Dharamraj and Ashwini Kumar. Later, Krishna reveals Dooryadhan's misdeeds.

episodesList.title: Suryadev Makes a Revelation
episodesList.summary: Suryadev reveals that the Pandavas have taken the guise of sages and are hiding in Kampilya. Later, Krishna foretells a deadly clash between the Kauravas and Pandavas.

episodesList.title: Radha Faces Allegations
episodesList.summary: Radha's shocking confession after he shoots sharp allegations at her leaves Ayan furious. On the other hand, Krishna and Balaram depart from Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Arjun's Holy Union
episodesList.summary: Kunti gets valuable advice from Krishna after she asks the Pandavas to share the alms. Krishna is impressed by Arjun's sagacity and tells him about Draupadi's wedding.

episodesList.title: Krishna Arrives at Panchala
episodesList.summary: Krishna shares Draupadi's story with Arjun before leaving for the kingdom of Panchala to meet King Drupada. Elsewhere, Ugrapath gets furious at Radha.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Infinite Wisdom
episodesList.summary: Attracted by the grand palace, Arjun makes a promise to avoid getting recognised. Meanwhile, Krishna stuns King Drupada with his infinite wisdom.

episodesList.title: Draupadi to Have a Swayamvar
episodesList.summary: Following Krishna's advice, King Drupada decides to arrange Draupadi's Swayamvar. Later, Draupadi thanks Krishna. Elsewhere, Ayan creates problems for Radha.

episodesList.title: Shakuni's Strategic Act
episodesList.summary: Shakuni tries to manipulate Duryodhan into participating in Draupadi's Swayamvar. Later, Arjun grows suspicious of Krishna's activities.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Ingenious Plan
episodesList.summary: Krishna brews a clever plan to instigate Arjun into participating in the Swayamvar while Ayan takes a heartless decision. Later, Dhritarashtra accepts Duryodhan's request.

episodesList.title: Krishna Empowers Draupadi
episodesList.summary: Yudhishtir refuses to allow the Pandavas to attend the Swayamvar. Meanwhile, Krishna convinces King Drupada to empower Draupadi with her weapon of choice.

episodesList.title: Duryodhan Arrives in Panchala
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan, Shakuni and Karna arrive in Panchala to attend Draupadi's Swayamvar. While Duryodhan challenges Balaram in a mace-fighting duel, Krishna introduces himself to Karna.

episodesList.title: Ayan's Heartless Act
episodesList.summary: Krishna meets Shakuni as Duryodhan and Balaram engage in a fierce battle. Karna introduces Krishna to Duryodhan while Ayan's heartless act leaves Radha baffled.

episodesList.title: Arjun Meets Draupadi
episodesList.summary: Arjun and Draupadi feel drawn to each other at the temple while Krishna brews a clever plan. Later, Jarasandh's unthinkable act leaves King Drupad enraged.

episodesList.title: Krishna Cautions Karna
episodesList.summary: Karna pledges to hand Draupadi over to Duryodhan after he wins the Swayamvar. Later, Krishna warns Karna regarding the consequences of this undying loyalty.

episodesList.title: Draupadi's Swayamvar Begins
episodesList.summary: King Drupada announces the commencement of Draupadi's Swayamvar. While Draupadi refuses to let Karna participate, Arjun attends the Swayamvar.

episodesList.title: Arjun's Miraculous Feat!
episodesList.summary: Arjun's miraculous feats leave everyone in the room dumbfounded. While he wins Draupadi's hand in marriage, Krishna makes a stern proclamation to the furious warriors.

episodesList.title: Kunti's Shocking Command!
episodesList.summary: Shakuni tries to calm Duryodhan and Dushashan. Later, the Pandavas are shocked with Kunti's decision upon their arrival at the hut!

episodesList.title: Kunti's Shocking Command!
episodesList.summary: Shakuni tries to calm Duryodhan and Dushashan. Later, the Pandavas are shocked with Kunti's decision upon their arrival at the hut!

episodesList.title: Dilemma Strikes Draupadi
episodesList.summary: Yudhisthir takes a shocking decision while Draupadi awaits Krishna's arrival. Later, Krishna's decision leaves Draupadi facing a grave dilemma.

episodesList.title: Reality Strikes Bhishm
episodesList.summary: Draupadi takes a shocking decision while Bhishma is delighted to learn that the Pandavas are alive. Later, Krishna gets emotional upon meeting Bhishma.

episodesList.title: Shakuni's Devious Ploy
episodesList.summary: Krishna advises Bhishma to ensure the safety of the Pandavas. While Duryodhan blackmails Karna, Shakuni orchestrates a devious ploy.

episodesList.title: Kunti's Stern Refusal
episodesList.summary: Vidur informs the Pandavas that Bhishm wants them to return to Hastinapur. However, Kunti fears for the Pandavas' safety and sternly rejects the proposal.

episodesList.title: Krishna Convinces Kunti
episodesList.summary: Krishna showcases a glimpse of his divinity and convinces Kunti to accept the proposal. However, Shakuni and Duryodhan plan to stop the Pandavas from returning to Hastinapur.

episodesList.title: Duryodhan Demands His Rights
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan's shocking demand leaves Dhritarashtra in a grave dilemma. Later, Radha is delighted to meet Krishna.

episodesList.title: Duryodhan's Unexpected Outburst
episodesList.summary: While Duryodhan's coronation ceremony commences, Dronacharya interrupts to confront Dhritarashtra. Later, Duryodhan gets furious with Krishna.

episodesList.title: Kunti's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan confronts Shakuni while Krishna yearns for Radha. Later, Kunti takes a shocking decision regarding Pandavas' opinion for the prospective King.

episodesList.title: Gandhari's Outrageous Act
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan puts up a pretentious act while Gandhari's annoying behaviour leaves Bhishm dejected. Later, Krishna gives Arjun some valuable advice.

episodesList.title: Arjun Seeks Out Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna tells Shakuni that he will not take sides to determine the future King of Hastinapur. The next day, Arjun tries to find Krishna to clear his dilemma.

episodesList.title: Karna Challenges Arjun
episodesList.summary: While Arjun faces a dilemma, Karna challenges him for fierce combat. Later, Dhritarashtra's unexpected announcement leaves Duryodhan delighted.

episodesList.title: Shakuni's Vicious Motive
episodesList.summary: Krishna supports Yudhisthir's opinion about the division of the dynasty. While Shakuni brews a vicious plan, Duryodhan's announcement leaves everyone rattled.

episodesList.title: Balaram Is in Trouble?
episodesList.summary: While Shakuni instructs Duryodhan to carry out his plan, the latter asks Balaram to stay back in Hastinapur. Later, Arjun and Draupadi find themselves in a dilemma.

episodesList.title: Krishna Is Adamant
episodesList.summary: Despite the Pandavas' plea to stay the night, Krishna takes shelter in the forest. Later, Draupadi's careless act enrages an unexpected guest.

episodesList.title: Arjun Faces an Indomitable Enemy!
episodesList.summary: Arjun and the Pandavas decide to build a palace for Draupadi. However, Arjun will have to defeat Takshak for that, who is protected by Lord Indra himself.

episodesList.title: Arjun Acquires the Gandiva Bow
episodesList.summary: Pleased with Arjun's will, Lord Agni blesses him with the Gandiva bow. Using his powers, Arjun resumes his attack to remove Takshak, but Indra stands in his way!

episodesList.title: Shakuni's Evil Ploy
episodesList.summary: Krishna leaves for Dwarka after bidding goodbye to the Pandavas. Meanwhile, Shakuni makes Krishna's look-alike, Paundraka Vasudev to take his place in Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Paundraka Instigates Radha
episodesList.summary: Paundraka Vasudev instigates Radha into convincing Subhadra to marry Duryodhan. Later, Paundraka's unthinkable words leave Radha suspicious.

episodesList.title: Arjun Arrives at Dwarka
episodesList.summary: While Radha senses impending danger, Balram puts Krishna behind bars. Later, Arjun visits Dwarka and meets Radha.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Arjun
episodesList.summary: Subhadra is confused about her feelings for Duryodhan as she gets impressed with Arjun's behaviour. Later, Arjun gets shocked at the imposter's demeanour.

episodesList.title: Subhadra's Test of Love
episodesList.summary: Subhadra decides to ask Duryodhan and Arjun the same question to put an end to her dilemma. Meanwhile, Krishna escapes prison by switching places with Paundrak.

episodesList.title: Krishna Pacifies Balaram
episodesList.summary: Krishna calms an enraged Balram and reveals Shakuni's devious intentions. Elsewhere, Shakuni prepares to execute yet another heinous ploy!

episodesList.title: The Wrath of Krishna
episodesList.summary: Paundraka pays the price with his life for underestimating Krishna's power. While Duryodhan gets tricked, Krishna reveals the person who will kill Jarasandh.

episodesList.title: Krishna Has a Plan?
episodesList.summary: In order to teach him an important lesson, Radha puts forth a challenge to Bheem. Later, a disguised Krishna and Bheem enter Jarasandh's lair.

episodesList.title: Jarasandh Is Unbeatable?
episodesList.summary: Bheem is baffled when his attempts to kill Jarasandh keep ending in failure. While Radha eagerly awaits for some news, Krishna gives Bheem a helpful tip.

episodesList.title: Ghatotkach Searches for Bheem
episodesList.summary: While Ghatotkach sets out in search of Bheem, Mahayama thirsts for human blood. Later, Bheem and Ghatotkach engage in a fierce battle.

episodesList.title: Bheem Discovers the Truth
episodesList.summary: After fighting intensely with Bheem, Ghatotkach battles Krishna. Bheem discovers the startling truth about Ghatotkach during a tussle.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Radha's Alone Time
episodesList.summary: While Krishna tells Radha how much he loves her, Yudhisthir vows to take charge as the king. Later, Arjun gets angry when Shishupal insults Krishna.

episodesList.title: Duryodhan Turns Vindictive
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan's question leaves Draupadi offended while he turns vindictive by her action. Meanwhile, Krishna offers some sound advice to Draupadi.

episodesList.title: Krishna Ends Shishupal's Life!
episodesList.summary: Shishupal's hubris becomes his enemy when Krishna ends his life. While Duryodhan opposes Krishna's judgement, Radha asks for Draupadi's help.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Valuable Advice
episodesList.summary: Krishna offers some advice to Yudhisthir while Radha grows concerned about Draupadi. Later, a game of dice begins between Shakuni, Duryodhan and the Pandavas.

episodesList.title: Yudhisthir Faces Defeat
episodesList.summary: With his cunning move, Shakuni defeats Yudhisthir while Duryodhan puts up an evil act. Later, Dronacharya tries to stop Yudhisthir from doing the unthinkable.

episodesList.title: Duryodhan's Outrageous Act
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan announces that the Pandavas are his slaves, leaving everyone filled with rage. Meanwhile, Draupadi's dignity is at stake.

episodesList.title: Draupadi's Vastraharan
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan commands Dushasan to disrobe Draupadi while everyone watches the heinous act silently. Later, Draupadi calls Krishna to save her dignity.

episodesList.title: Pandavas' Heartfelt Apology
episodesList.summary: At last, Dhritarashtra intervenes to stop the humiliation. However, the Pandavas set out for exile along with Draupadi and apologise to Krishna for their actions.

episodesList.title: Draupadi Impresses Durvasa
episodesList.summary: Impressed by Draupadi, Sage Durvasa grants her a boon. Later, she puts forth a heartfelt request before Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Meets the Pandavas
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan commands Dushasan to search for the Pandavas. While Krishna decides to meet the Pandavas, they arrive at the Matsya Kingdom.

episodesList.title: Keechak Lusts Sairandhri
episodesList.summary: While Keechak lusts Sairandhri, she threatens him for for his malicious behaviour. Later, he attempts to molest her and an infuriated Bheem takes him on.

episodesList.title: Bheem's Promise to Draupadi
episodesList.summary: Krishna apologises to the Pandavas while Duryodhan decides to attack the Matsya kingdom. On the other hand, Bheem makes a promise to Draupadi.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Proposal for Peace
episodesList.summary: Krishna offers a peace treaty to Dhritrashtra on behalf of the Pandavas. With an intent to kill Krishna, Duryodhan asks Dushasan to close the doors of Hastinapur.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Vishwaroop Darshan
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan commands his men to hold Krishna captive while Bhishm asks Dhritrashtra to take the right stand. Later, Duryodhan witnesses Krishna's Vishwaroop avatar.

episodesList.title: Duryodhan's Sly Act
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan refuses to surrender while the Pandavas engage in preparations for the battle. Later, Duryodhan fakes his apology to Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Prepares for War
episodesList.summary: Krishna agrees to grant Duryodhan's wish while Radha expresses her concern over the decision. Later, Arjun and Krishna gear up to battle Duryodhan and his army.

episodesList.title: Arjun Is Unsure about the War
episodesList.summary: The Pandavas gear up for battle while Arjun confesses about his inability to fight his family and his Guru. Later, Krishna enlightens Arjun.

episodesList.title: Krishna Guides Arjun
episodesList.summary: Krishna narrates Arjun the holy tale of Narayan unwillingly killing Kavyamata to establish Dharma. Later, Arjun picks up the Dhanush to begin the war.

episodesList.title: Arjun Faces a Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Krishna narrates a story about King Harishchandra's sacrifices when Arjun faces a grave dilemma. Later, an enlightened Arjun musters up the courage to fight.

episodesList.title: Arjun's Divine Experience
episodesList.summary: Arjun learns that Krishna is an incarnation of Lord Vishnu and gets enlightened with spiritual awareness. Later, Arjun witnesses Krishna's Vishwaroop Avatar.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Infinite Incarnations!
episodesList.summary: Arjun is stunned when Krishna reveals his incarnations and shows him the extent of his powers. After the war starts, Radha learns some distressing news.

episodesList.title: Duryodhan Accuses Bhishm
episodesList.summary: Ayan vents his anger on Krishna while Karna is adamant about participating in the battle. Later, Duryodhan shoots some shocking allegations at Bhishm.

episodesList.title: Arjun Kills Bhishma
episodesList.summary: Dhritarashtra is traumatised after receiving some disturbing news about the Kauravas. While Arjun kills Bhishma, Karna is all set to battle against the Pandavas.

episodesList.title: What Is Krishna Upto?
episodesList.summary: Ayan offers to grant Krishna's request while Karn is left speechless by Kunti's revelation. Later, Krishna asks Indra Dev to do the unthinkable.

episodesList.title: Karna Kills Ghatotkach
episodesList.summary: Karna sacrifices his Kavach and Kundal to fulfil his promise while Indra gifts him a divine weapon. Later, Karna kills Ghatotkach.

episodesList.title: Bheem Fulfils His Promise
episodesList.summary: Bheem valiantly fulfils his promise to Draupadi while Arjun kills an unarmed Karna. Later, Bheem, in a fit of rage, attacks Duryodhan.

episodesList.title: Krishna Gets Cursed!
episodesList.summary: Ayan is enlightened about Krishna and Radha while Dhritarashtra's act leaves the Pandavas in shock. Enraged at Krishna, Gandhari does the unthinkable.

episodesList.title: Gandhari Does the Unthinkable
episodesList.summary: Gandhari's shocking curse leaves Krishna in tears. While Jambavati shares her deep sorrows with Radha, Mahadev foretells an impending doom.

episodesList.title: Radha's Request to Rukmini
episodesList.summary: Balram is elated to meet Krishna after a long time while King Rukmi, along with Rukmavati, arrives at Dwarka. Later, Radha puts forth a request to Rukmini.

episodesList.title: Jambavati's Shocking Demand
episodesList.summary: Jambavati shares her unexpected desire before Krishna. While Mahadev grants Krishna a boon, Jambavati gives birth to Sam.

episodesList.title: Sam's Unthinkable Demand
episodesList.summary: Radha organises Sam's birthday while he puts forth a shocking demand from Krishna. Later, Balram berates Sam for his disgraceful behaviour.

episodesList.title: Sam Attacks Nagdev
episodesList.summary: Krishna's warnings fall on deaf ears while Sam launches a diabolical attack against Nagdev. Later, Krishna tries to stop Sam from doing the unthinkable.

episodesList.title: Balram's Stern Decision
episodesList.summary: Sam cooks up a story when Krishna confronts him. While Sam is against Radha and Krishna's union, Balram concludes to a surprising decision.

episodesList.title: Radha Visits Sam's Gurukul
episodesList.summary: Radha joins Sam in his gurukul to support him in his journey of knowledge. Meanwhile, Krishna is disheartened after being separated from Radha.

episodesList.title: Sam's Evil Move
episodesList.summary: With a vicious motive in mind, Sam performs a dark ritual while Sandipani commands his disciples to protect the Ashram. Later, Radha gives Sam a stern warning.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Achyuta Avatar
episodesList.summary: Sam wreaks havoc in Sandipani's ashram while Krishna sets out to rescue Radha. With a hidden plan in mind, Krishna takes his Achyuta avatar.

episodesList.title: Herculean Task for Sam
episodesList.summary: Anirudh confronts Sam while the latter brews a cunning plan against Krishna. Later, Krishna puts forth a daunting challenge to Sam.

episodesList.title: Sam Threatens Radha
episodesList.summary: With an evil motive in mind, Sam casts a diabolical spell on a snake. While Krishna confronts Sam, the latter threatens Radha.

episodesList.title: Sam Grows Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Sam expresses his despair about being devoid of Krishna's love since childhood. While Krishna's arrival leaves everyone elated, Sam grows suspicious.

episodesList.title: Krishna Stuns Sam
episodesList.summary: Krishna decides to leave from Sandipani's ashram while Sam makes a shocking demand. Later, Sam is left bewildered on witnessing Krishna's divine act.

episodesList.title: Sam's Unfaltering Faith
episodesList.summary: After witnessing Sam's ardent devotion, Mahadev appears before him. While Sam procures a divine weapon, Jambavati makes a heartfelt request to Parvati.

episodesList.title: Radha's Ardhnarishwar Avatar
episodesList.summary: Sam brews an evil plan against Achyuta. While Sam uses his weapon to launch a deadly attack on Achyuta, Radha takes her Ardhnarishwar avatar.

episodesList.title: Sam's Challenge to Krishna
episodesList.summary: Achyuta tries to pacify an enraged Sam while the latter decides to end his life out of dejection. Later, Sam challenges Krishna for a fierce battle.

episodesList.title: Sam Gets Cursed
episodesList.summary: Elated by Krishna's death, Sam returns to the Ashram, only to be cursed by his Guruji to turn into a powerless man. Is it the end of Krishna's clan?

episodesList.title: A Tough Moment for Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna reveals his true form to Saambh and Maharishi Sandeepani. While Radha tries to reason with Saambh, his statements leave Krishna deeply hurt.

episodesList.title: Saambh Is Persistent
episodesList.summary: Saambh stands his ground after Anirudh tries to clear his misbelief about Radha and Krishna. Later, Jambavati expresses her wish for Saambh's marriage.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Evil Ploy
episodesList.summary: Saambh learns a shocking truth about Banasur after he overhears Radha and Krishna's conversation. He then instigates Anirudh to do the unthinkable.

episodesList.title: Banasur to Attack Dwarka
episodesList.summary: Banasur refuses Usha's request while Saambh learns some divine facts about Krishna. Meanwhile, Banasur decides to attack Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Krishna Battles Banasur
episodesList.summary: After Saambh departs, Banasur arrives in Dwarka to wage war against Krishna. Later, a fierce battle ensues when Banasur rejects the peace offering.

episodesList.title: Saambh, Lakshmana Join Hands
episodesList.summary: Banasur faces Mahadev's unbridled rage while Saambh proposes to Lakshmana for marriage. Filled with hatred for Krishna, Saambh and Lakshmana join hands.

episodesList.title: Saambh, Lakshmana Tie the Knot
episodesList.summary: Balram grows restless after learning about Anirudh's whereabouts. While Saambh and Lakshmana tie the knot, she brews an evil plan.

episodesList.title: Saambh Is on a Mission
episodesList.summary: Saambh obtains Krishna's divine weapons while Banasur holds Pradyumna captive. Later, Saambh sets out to rescue Pradyumna and Anirudh.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Shocking Deal
episodesList.summary: Saambh puts forth a shocking deal before Banasur. While Saambh and Banasur gang up against Krishna, Usha learns about Anirudh's innocence.

episodesList.title: Balram, Banasur's Fierce Face-off
episodesList.summary: Usha plans to help Saambh, Anirudh, Pradyumna escape from the prison. While Saambh's plan goes for a toss, Balram and Banasur engage in a fierce face-off.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Joins the Fight
episodesList.summary: While Saambh uses Chitralekha to bring Radha to Banasur, Krishna declares war. Later, Banasur calls Mahadev to assist him in defeating Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Attacks Banasur
episodesList.summary: Radha reminds Mahadev of his promise to Krishna. While Krishna launches a fierce attack on Banasur, Saambh faces his inevitable fate.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Sly Act
episodesList.summary: Lakshmana tries to instigate Jambavati against Radha. While Balram makes a shocking announcement, Saambh shoots a sharp accusation at Anirudh.

episodesList.title: Krishna Curses Saambh
episodesList.summary: A grave dilemma strikes Radha while Banasur spills the truth about Saambh's misdeeds. Later, Saambh faces Krishna's unthinkable curse.

episodesList.title: Radha's Shocking Promise
episodesList.summary: Banasur's proposal about Anirudh and Usha's marriage leaves Balram elated. Later, Radha makes a shocking promise to Jambavati.

episodesList.title: Dhanvantari Arrives to Meet Krishna
episodesList.summary: Radha meets Dhanvantari on her way to find medicine for Saambh. She brings him to the palace, only to find Krishna missing.

episodesList.title: Lakshmana Instigates Jambavati
episodesList.summary: Lakshmana tries to influence Jambavati against the rest of the family. Later, Krishna discloses an important secret to Balaram.

episodesList.title: Krishna Visits Mahadev
episodesList.summary: Krishna goes to Mahadev in a bid to wake him up from his deep slumber. At Dwarka, Lakshmana hatches an evil ploy against Radha.

episodesList.title: Radha Makes a Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: While Krishna informs Radha about Mahadev's slumber, Dhanvantari's revelation leaves her shocked. Later, Radha consumes the poisoned food.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Cunning Ploy
episodesList.summary: Lakshmana brews a diabolical plan while Saambh sends Rukmi a shocking letter. With a vicious plot in mind, Saambh assigns Rukmi a daunting task.

episodesList.title: Balram, Rukmi's Fierce Face-off
episodesList.summary: Rukmi challenges Balram for a game of dice while Saambh uses an evil trickery to recover himself. Later, Balram and Rukmi engage in a fierce battle.

episodesList.title: Can Krishna Save Dwarka?
episodesList.summary: While Radha takes the drastic step of leaving Dwarka, Saambh plans to drown the island kingdom. Will Radha come back in time for Krishna to save Dwarka?

episodesList.title: Saambh's Plan Goes Awry
episodesList.summary: Disappointment strikes Saambh after his plan goes awry. While Jambavati makes a shocking revelation about Samantak Mani, Saambh humiliates Krishna.

episodesList.title: Balram's Shocking Announcement
episodesList.summary: Saambh hatches an evil plan to destroy Dwarka. While Krishna asks Balram to protect Samantak Mani, the latter makes a shocking announcement.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Cunning Ploy
episodesList.summary: Saambh attempts to steal the Samantak Mani while the people of Dwarka face grave trouble. Later, Krishna's shocking revelation leaves everyone rattled.

episodesList.title: Radha Faces Humiliation
episodesList.summary: Balram confronts Krishna to spill the truth while the residents of Dwarka humiliate Radha. Meanwhile, Balram is hell-bent on finding the Samantak Mani.

episodesList.title: Radha in a Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Jambavati stops Balram from reaching the Samantak Mani. While Chandra Dev heeds to Saambh's prayers, Radha is in a quandary.

episodesList.title: Parvati Visits Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna discloses to Radha that he is bound by the promise made to Chandra Dev. Heeding Radha's ardent prayers, Parvati visits her with a solution.

episodesList.title: Shree Ganesh's Brilliant Idea
episodesList.summary: Shree Ganesh brews an ingenious idea to find the Samantak Mani while Chandra Dev humiliates him. Later, Saambh faces Chandra Dev's unbridled fury.

episodesList.title: Balram in Quest of Samantak Mani
episodesList.summary: Balram, Anirudh, Nishath and Ulmuk encounter some ghosts in the forest.

episodesList.title: Saambh Faces Shree Ganesh's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Saambh and Shree Ganesh engage in a fierce battle while Surya Dev regains his power.

episodesList.title: Lakshmana Confronts Saambh
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Radha spend some blissful time while Lakshmana confronts Saambh.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Unusual Declaration
episodesList.summary: Radha is elated when a herd of cows from Barsana visits her.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Clever Plan
episodesList.summary: Jambavati gets petrified upon spotting Saambh in the disguise of a tiger.

episodesList.title: Balram's Heroic Act
episodesList.summary: Upon learning about Radha's sacrificial decision, Sudama and his family decide to end their lives.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Devious Plan
episodesList.summary: Saambh hatches a devious plan to thwart Radha and Krishna's union.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Story of Love
episodesList.summary: Krishna decides to take Radha to Golok and answer her queries on love through a story.

episodesList.title: Jambavati, Saambh's Devious Ploy
episodesList.summary: After Saambh overhears Krishna's story, he hatches a heinous plan along with Jambavati.

episodesList.title: An Enormous Task for Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna goes into Samadhi and assigns Radha a task to protect him during his meditation.

episodesList.title: Parvati To Krishna's Aid!
episodesList.summary: Witnessing Shukracharya's vengeful intentions, Parvati comes to Krishna's aid.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Outrageous Act
episodesList.summary: Mahadev appears before Saambh to fulfil his demands.

episodesList.title: Radha Loses Her Memory
episodesList.summary: Radha forgets all about Krishna, Dwarka and also her own identity. While Jambavati rejoices, Krishna and others try to jog Radha's memory.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Shocking Announcement
episodesList.summary: Krishna attempts to stop Radha from leaving Dwarka. While Radha meets a disguised Mahadev, Krishna makes a shocking announcement.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Adiyogi Avatar
episodesList.summary: Mahadev takes his Adiyogi avatar to help Radha regain her memory. While Saambh humiliates a disguised Mahadev, Krishna executes his quirky plan.

episodesList.title: Saambh Faces His Fate
episodesList.summary: Mahadev reveals his plan to jog Radha's memory. While Radha witnesses a past occurrence, Saambh faces his unfortunate fate.

episodesList.title: Radha Gets Closer to Her Fate
episodesList.summary: Radha takes yet another step towards getting closer to Krishna. On the other hand, Balaram bullies a tied-up Saambh.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Gift for Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna keeps butter and fruits for Radha. Later, when Radha thinks about Gopal while relishing the gifts, Saambh tries to find Krishna.

episodesList.title: Gopal Stuns Radha
episodesList.summary: While Saambh's ploy falls short, Radha unknowingly witnesses the re-enaction of her and Krishna's love story. Later, Gopal visits Radha with a stunning information.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Spell Backfires
episodesList.summary: Saambh speaks rudely to Kishori and tries to attack Manmohan when the latter reverses Saambh's spell. Meanwhile, under the spell, Saambh ends up cross-dressing.

episodesList.title: Radha Feels Anxious
episodesList.summary: Radha confronts Gopal about purposely ignoring her but the latter denies doing it. Later, an anxious Radha confides in Adi Yogi about her feelings.

episodesList.title: Radha Confesses Her Feelings
episodesList.summary: Saambh helps Gopal make kheer so the latter can impress Radha, who confesses her love to Gopal after eating it. How will Gopal react?

episodesList.title: Saambh's Devious Ploy
episodesList.summary: Gopal takes Radha shopping and she is left elated. Meanwhile, Saambh takes help from Shukracharya to separate Krishna and Radha!

episodesList.title: Radha's Staunch Vow
episodesList.summary: Radha informs Adi Yogi about her love for Gopal and rejects Krishna's affection. Later, she takes a stern vow in front of Gopal.

episodesList.title: Radha Has Mixed Feelings
episodesList.summary: Radha hears Gopal and Krishna play the flute simultaneously and gets confused. When Gopal confesses his love to Radha, it leaves her with mixed feelings.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna Reunited!
episodesList.summary: While Radha and Krishna are reunited, Saambh is inflicted with a terrible curse. Later, an old enemy swears to take revenge against Krishna.

episodesList.title: Shukracharya's Master Plan
episodesList.summary: Shukracharya makes a master plan and with Saambh's help, simultaneously attacks Dwarka and Indralok. Meanwhile, Krishna makes a romantic promise to Radha.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Vile Conspiracy
episodesList.summary: Indra requests Krishna for help against Bali's attacks. Meanwhile, Saambh conspires with Shukracharya and Takshak to force Krishna to Paatal Lok.

episodesList.title: Indra Summons Devmata Aditi
episodesList.summary: Saambh comes to know some hidden secrets after he witnesses the occurrences in Paatal Lok. Later, Indra summons Devmata Aditi to save Dev Lok.

episodesList.title: Krishna Fulfills Aditi's Promise
episodesList.summary: Krishna fulfills Devmata Aditi's promise and gets reborn as her son. While he gains victory in the Dwarka war, Devmata Aditi convinces him to battle Bali.

episodesList.title: Shukracharya Traps Balaram
episodesList.summary: Balaram enters Paatal Lok to fulfil the promises made by Krishna. However, Shukracharya traps him and attempts to force Krishna into entering Paatal Lok.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Helps Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna faces an unexpected hurdle as Shukracharya closes the entry to Paatal Lok. Later, he receives the help of Mahadev and Devi Gauri.

episodesList.title: Krishna Enters Paatal Lok
episodesList.summary: Krishna enters the Paatal Lok and manages to overcome Danavraj Bal's illusions. Later, he arrives at Hatkeshwar Mahadev's territory and faces Vasuki.

episodesList.title: Krishna Befriends Vasuki
episodesList.summary: Krishna's act helps him befriend Vasuki and garner no resistance from Hatkeshwar Mahadev. While Bali and Shukracharya perform a Yagya, Krishna faces Takshak.

episodesList.title: Parvati Helps Krishna
episodesList.summary: While Krishna meditates to overcome the crisis, Sheshnaag and Vasuki battle Takshak. Later, Parvati gives a hint to Krishna to uncover an ally.

episodesList.title: Garud Defeats the Devas
episodesList.summary: To rescue Mata Vinanta, Garud accepts Mata Kadru's challenge of retrieving the Amrit Kalash. While he defeats the Devas, Indra seeks Narayan's help.

episodesList.title: Garud Wins Lord Vishu's Heart!
episodesList.summary: Garud wins Lord Vishnu's trust after forgiving Indra. Later, he visits Paatal Lok to bring the divine Amrit Kalash and fight the serpents.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Makes a Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: Mahadev decides to sacrifice Vasuki to ruin Bali's yagna, thus saddening Krishna. Later, Krishna sets forth a condition in front of a despondent Bali.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Staunch Decision
episodesList.summary: Shukracharya calls upon Brihaspati and ascertains Krishna's folly of ruining Bali's Yagna. Later, upon being accused, Krishna inflicts a punishment upon himself.

episodesList.title: Krishna Reveals His Distress
episodesList.summary: Krishna tells Balaram about the curse being the reason for his decision. Meanwhile, Jambavati gives Saambh some advice.

episodesList.title: Dejection Strikes Radha
episodesList.summary: Radha is dejected about being departed from Krishna. While she refuses to perform Saraswati Puja, Devi Parvati gives her some valuable advice.

episodesList.title: Radhas Difficult Boon
episodesList.summary: Lakshmana and Jambavati worry about Saambh's meditation. A shock awaits Krishna as he discovers about Radha's terrible boon from Maa Saraswati.

episodesList.title: Krishna Seeks a Boon
episodesList.summary: Saraswati blesses Saambh to fulfill Radha's boon while Krishna breaks down. Later, Krishna seeks a wish from the Goddess for Radha.

episodesList.title: Saambh Vows to End Krishna!
episodesList.summary: Seeing the celebratory environment of Holi in Dwarka, Saambh fumes with rage and vows to wreak havoc. On the other hand, Radha expresses her wish to Krishna.

episodesList.title: Saambh Manipulates Yamuna
episodesList.summary: Saambh employs manipulative tactics and instigates Yamuna against Krishna. While he convinces her to seek Shani's help, Krishna decides to visit Vrindavan.

episodesList.title: Krishna Fears the Worst
episodesList.summary: While Yamuna wrecks havoc in Vrindavan, Krishna fears the awakening of Shani. Later, Saambh convinces Yamuna to seek Shani's help to tackle Krishna.

episodesList.title: Shani's Unbridled Wrath
episodesList.summary: Krishna reveals the untold past between Shani and him to Radha. While Shani's fury wrecks havoc in Vrindavan, Krishna plans to prevent Yamuna's meeting.

episodesList.title: Saambh Intsigates Shani
episodesList.summary: Saambh faces Shani's uncontrollable anger. Meanwhile, Shani goes to meet Krishna after Saambh attempts to instigate Shani against Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Yamuna's Wedding Tale
episodesList.summary: Krishna calms down a devastated Yamuna. Later, Krishna tells Radha about his marriage with Yamuna.

episodesList.title: Yamuna Realises Her Folly
episodesList.summary: Yamuna admits her folly of summoning Shani Dev and inciting his anger. As Radha gets tensed, Krishna reiterates the tale of Shani Dev.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Helps Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna narrates the incident that led to Shani's designation as the God of Karma. Later, Mahadev buys time for Krishna by delaying Shani's retaliation.

episodesList.title: Saambh Seeks to Meet Shani
episodesList.summary: Yamuna attempts to convince Shani to forgive Krishna. While Mahadev brews a plan, Saambh seeks Yamuna's permission to meet Shani.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Save Mahadev
episodesList.summary: Mahadev disguises himself as a sage to hide from Shani. Elsewhere, Krishna executes a clever plan to save Mahadev from Shani's Vakradrushti.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Is Captured
episodesList.summary: Under Kashiraj's orders, Mahadev is captured and produced before him. Later, Krishna confronts Shani as the latter lands Mahadev into deep trouble.

episodesList.title: Shani Is Remorseful
episodesList.summary: Shani expresses his grief to Krishna while Mahadev makes a revelation. Meanwhile, Shani grows remorseful after learning a grave truth.

episodesList.title: Shani Targets Krishna
episodesList.summary: Shani realises his mistake and stops the execution of Mahadev. However, he remains adamant about unleashing his Vakradrishti on Krishna.

episodesList.title: Shani's Heartfelt Apology
episodesList.summary: Shani makes a heartfelt apology to Krishna and the latter asks Shani to participate in Gauri-Shankar's Puja. Later, Saambh faces Shani's unbridled wrath.

episodesList.title: Krishna Spills a Foreboding Truth
episodesList.summary: Krishna tells Balaram that soon the world will fall into chaos, rendering the latter speechless. Meanwhile, Radha and others prepare to celebrate Holi in Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Radha Remain Reluctant
episodesList.summary: Saambh refuses to play Holi after falling into the pool of blue ink. Later, a heartbroken Radha and a dejected Krishna refuse to play Holi.

episodesList.title: Radha's Unusual Plan
episodesList.summary: When Krishna rejects Radha's idea to play Holi with her, the latter conjures up a plan. She lures Krishna, and he falls in a mud pool.

episodesList.title: Radha to Surprise Krishna
episodesList.summary: While Krishna plays a prank on Radha, the latter plans to surprise him on the eve of Holi. However, Krishna and Mahadev grow worried about her plan.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna's Lathmar Holi
episodesList.summary: On the occasion of Lathmar Holi, Radha gets enthusiastic to celebrate it with Krishna. However, Krishna refuses to play, unaware of Saambh watching them.

episodesList.title: Radha to Please Krishna
episodesList.summary: Radha performs a special ritual to please Krishna, but Samba finds out about her plan and decides to ruin it for her.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Devious Ploy
episodesList.summary: Radha attempts to bridge the gap between her and Krishna. While she decides to play Holi with Krishna, Saambh puts his devious plan into motion.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Smart Move
episodesList.summary: When Saambh sneakily burns Radhas dhatu, Krishna suggests to play water Holi. A distraught Radha looks at the fire, unaware of Krishna's move.

episodesList.title: Krishnas Important Advice
episodesList.summary: When Radha smears ash on Krishna, the colour at the festival turn into ash. Later, Radha receives an important advice from Krishna and celebrates Holi with him.

episodesList.title: Radha's Request to Krishna
episodesList.summary: Radha and Krishna play the most magnificent Holi that Dwarka has ever seen. Later, Radha makes a request to Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Is Remorseful
episodesList.summary: Krishna grows remorseful about a past decision while Mahadev tries to pacify him. Meanwhile, Krishna foretells about an impending danger.

episodesList.title: Shankhachur, Indra's Fierce Clash
episodesList.summary: Shankhachur and Indra engage in a fierce fight. While Indra seeks Mahadev's help to kill Shankhachur, Radha searches for Krishna.

episodesList.title: Radha Grows Enraged
episodesList.summary: Radha loses her cool after Krishna reveals Sridhama's curse from their past life. Elsewhere, Suryadev tries to brew a plan to defeat Shankhachur.

episodesList.title: Suryadev Seeks Radha's Help
episodesList.summary: Suryadev and other Gods seek Radha's help to save them from Shankhachur's wrath. Later, all the Gods and Shankhachur engage in a deadly battle.

episodesList.title: Shankhachur in Trouble!
episodesList.summary: Shankhachur's wife feels guilty after she learns about his misdeeds. While he loses his powers, Radha and Krishna engage in friendly banter.

episodesList.title: Shankhachur's Arrogant Answer
episodesList.summary: An arrogant Shankhachur ilItreats Tulsi when she questions him about his love. While Radha asks Krishna to spill the truth, he enlightens her.

episodesList.title: Shankhachur to Attack Kailash
episodesList.summary: Radha enlightens Tulsi about the sanctity of her love towards Shankhachur. Later, Shankhachur plans to attack Kailash.

episodesList.title: Tulsi's Outrageous Decision
episodesList.summary: Shankhachur, along with his troops, arrives at Kailash to attack. While Krishna makes Radha envious, Tulsi takes an outrageous decision.

episodesList.title: Shankhachur Demands War
episodesList.summary: On behalf of Mahadev, Devi Parvati takes the form of Maa Kali to battle Shankhachur. However, Krishna stops the fierce combat and convinces Shankhachur otherwise.

episodesList.title: The End of Shankhachur
episodesList.summary: Devi Tulsi expresses her affection to Shankhachur before their wedding ceremony. Later, Mahadev attacks an arrogant Shankhachur for misusing Devi Tulsi's affection.

episodesList.title: Devi Tulsi Curses Krishna
episodesList.summary: After the death of her lover Shankhachur, Devi Tulsi fumes in anger and places a deadly curse on Krishna. Later, Radha pleads for mercy.

episodesList.title: The End of Krishna?
episodesList.summary: Krishna returns to Dwaraka and tells everyone about the curse. After he spends his last moments with Radha, Krishna turns into a stone.

episodesList.title: Radha's Request to Saambh
episodesList.summary: When Saambh pretentiously goes to help Radha, she makes a request to him. Later, Saambh provokes Devi Tulsi against Krishna.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Devi Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Devi Tulsi arrives and tells Radha that her sacrificial act is meaningless. However, she is shocked to learn about the ultimate sacrifice Radha is ready to make.

episodesList.title: Shukracharyas Ploy Fails
episodesList.summary: Radha toils hard to give shape to Krishna's idol. Later, Shukracharya's ploy fails as Saambh's attempt to eradicate Krishna's idol turns ineffective.

episodesList.title: Radha Searches for the Idol
episodesList.summary: As Krishna's idol suddenly disappears, Radha looks for it everywhere. Later, Mahadev prophesies Krishna's arrival in a new avatar.

episodesList.title: Krishna's New Avatar
episodesList.summary: Radha and Balaram are perplexed as the idol mysteriously appears in front of them. Later, Krishna emerges in his new avatar and meets Radha.

episodesList.title: Krishna Helps Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna decides to help Radha in finding the idol. Later, Radha advises Devi Tulsi to forgive Krishna and end his curse.

episodesList.title: Radha Is Questioned
episodesList.summary: Lakshmana vows to kill Radha when she suspects her strange behaviour. Later, Radha is questioned by Lakshmana as she attempts to trick her.

episodesList.title: Banke Recites a Poem
episodesList.summary: Krishna meets Radha as Banke Bihari and recites a beautiful poem to her. Meanwhile, Devi Tulsi demands answers from Mahadev.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Saves Devi Tulsi
episodesList.summary: While Saambh plans to target Radha, Mahadev saves Devi Tulsi's life during her tapasya. Later, Radha decides to prove that Banke is not an imaginary person.

episodesList.title: Banke, Radha Take a Challenge
episodesList.summary: Banke and Radha take a painting challenge before the villagers. As the competition takes place, Devi Parvati is eager to find out who will win.

episodesList.title: Radha Faces an Obstacle
episodesList.summary: Banke informs Radha that she can call out to Krishna whenever she wants to. Later, Radha is in trouble as she encounters Dantavakra.

episodesList.title: Krishna Marries Tulsi
episodesList.summary: Balaram finds it difficult to fight Dantavakra and rescue Radha from his clutches. Elsewhere, Krishna is relieved from the curse as Tulsi marries Krishna.

episodesList.title: Banke Befriends Dantavakra
episodesList.summary: Banke comes to rescue Radha and Balaram from Dantavakra's clutches. However, they are perplexed as Banke befriends him and urges them to surrender.

episodesList.title: Dantavakra Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Dantavakra confronts Banke for tricking him. While he is shocked to learn about his past, the curse on Krishna gets lifted.

episodesList.title: Krishna Kills Dantavakra
episodesList.summary: Krishna saves Radha and Balaram by defeating Dantavakra. While he reveals the truth about Banke, Radha makes a shocking announcement.

episodesList.title: Radha Upsets Hanuman
episodesList.summary: Hanuman gets upset when Radha announces that she is the greatest disciple. While Krishna urges Radha to take back her proclamation, Hanuman leaves for Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Krishna Welcomes Hanuman
episodesList.summary: Krishna prepares a feast for Hanuman to welcome him to Dwarka. Meanwhile, Hanuman gets into a conflict with Garud Dev when he insults Shri Ram.

episodesList.title: Ram Blesses Hanuman
episodesList.summary: Hanuman accepts Garud's challenge after receiving the blessings of Shri Ram. While Suryadev fears the return of Hanuman, Krishna narrates a glorious tale.

episodesList.title: Hanuman Arrives at Dwarka
episodesList.summary: Garud and Suryadev feel inspired after their encounter with Hanuman. Later, he reaches Dwarka and grows curious about Krishna.

episodesList.title: Hanuman Relishes the Feast
episodesList.summary: Hanuman savours the spread of delicious laddoos prepared by Radha. While Balaram and Radha search for him, Saambh devises an evil plan.

episodesList.title: Hanuman Meets Radha
episodesList.summary: Hanuman introduces himself to Radha and requests her to retract from her proclamation. Later, Balaram and his men fail to capture Hanuman.

episodesList.title: Hanuman's Devotion Towards Dwarka
episodesList.summary: Hanuman sets his goal to fill Dwarka with love and devotion. Further, he executes his first plan towards Saambh.

episodesList.title: Hanuman, Radha's Big Challenge
episodesList.summary: Hanuman and Radha challenge each other on who is the greatest god, Shri Ram or Krishna. As the competition opens up to the citizens of Dwarka, Hanuman has touble finding a neutral judge.

episodesList.title: Radha Learns about Hanuman
episodesList.summary: Radha finds out about Hanuman's tremendous powers from Krishna. While she seeks Parvati's help, Balaram makes a revelation to Krishna.

episodesList.title: Another Win for Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna's plan gets successful as he convinces Radha to retain the challenge. However, Hanuman grows worried as Radha is eager to face him.

episodesList.title: Hanuman's Active Participation
episodesList.summary: Hanuman tries to apprehend Mahadev's hint about Radha's weapon. Later, Hanuman partakes in the competition and proves his power of devotion.

episodesList.title: Radha Wins the Challenge
episodesList.summary: Radha proves her devotion towards Krishna and wins the challenge which leaves Hanuman surprised. Later, Sambh prepares for his next move against Krishna.

episodesList.title: Saambh Instigates Shani
episodesList.summary: Hanuman apologises to Krishna and promises to teach Saambh a lesson. On the other hand, Saambh makes a clever move and summons Shani.

episodesList.title: Hanuman Teaches a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Hanuman engages in a face-off with Shani and wins the fight. Later, he tends to Shani, who understands his mistakes.

episodesList.title: Tricky Situation for Hanuman
episodesList.summary: Radha prepares sweets to make Hanuman feel at home in Dwarka. While he is confident about his victory, Krishna's statement puts him in a dilemma.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Ram Avatar!
episodesList.summary: After reaching Kishkinda, Hanuman receives an important mission from Shri Ram. Later, Krishna transforms into his Ram avatar in front of Hanuman.

episodesList.title: Hanuman's Divinity for Ram
episodesList.summary: Hanuman expresses his sentiments for Lord Ram before the villagers. On witnessing their dedication and divinity, Lord Ram showers them with his blessings.

episodesList.title: Krishna Embraces Balaram
episodesList.summary: An infuriated Balaram becomes calm after Krishna hugs him. Meanwhile, Hanuman feels Radha is as concerned about him as Sita was.

episodesList.title: Hanuman Reveals the Truth
episodesList.summary: Hanuman tries his best to get Radha to recognise him but fails. After Krishna gives him an idea, Hanuman tells her the truth.

episodesList.title: Krishna Advises Hanuman
episodesList.summary: Seeing Hanuman upset, Balaram reveals his truth to him. While he is elated, Krishna advises him on how to make Radha aware of the eternal reality.

episodesList.title: Hanuman Glad to Help
episodesList.summary: Radha grows curious about the special arrangements at the newly built temple. While Hanuman expresses his eagerness to help, Krishna appreciates his service.

episodesList.title: Hanuman's Idol Is Established
episodesList.summary: At Krishna's behest, Mahadev arrives in Dwarka. In the presence of Radha and Balram, Krishna establishes Hanuman's idol, declaring him a true devotee.

episodesList.title: Alakshmi Creates Chaos
episodesList.summary: The residents of Dwarka are taken aback when Alakshmi wreaks havoc using dark magic. Krishna narrates the tale of Alakshmi's past.

episodesList.title: Alakshmi Unleashes Her Wrath
episodesList.summary: A furious Alakshmi commands Jvarasura to torture the residents of Dwarka. While they assume it to be Radha, Krishna meets Alakshmi.

episodesList.title: Devi Sheetala to Help Radha
episodesList.summary: Alakshmi challenges Radha and manifests her sinister plan. After Radha pleads Parvati for help, Devi Sheetala comes to her aid.

episodesList.title: Alakshmi Enters Dwarka
episodesList.summary: A furious battle between Jvarasura and Devi Sheetala commences. After accepting Alakshmi's condition, Krishna puts forth a challenge and allows her to enter Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Krishna on the Meaning of Love
episodesList.summary: While Radha welcomes Alakshmi in Dwarka, Krisha teaches her the meaning of love. Later, Alakshmi manifests her sinister trap.

episodesList.title: Radha Confesses Her Love
episodesList.summary: Saambh joins hands with Alakshmi in her devil plan. On the other hand, Radha confesses her selfless love for Krishna.

episodesList.title: Jambavati Pays a Price
episodesList.summary: Jambavati asks Kuber for a large sum of his gold, unaware that she has to pay a heavy price for it. On seeing her repent her actions, Krishna tells her Maha Lakshmi's Katha.

episodesList.title: Krishna Recites Lakshmi Katha
episodesList.summary: Krishna recites Lakshmi Katha, setting an example of Treta Yug. But, Alakshmi's evil intentions affect everyone and ignites greed in them.

episodesList.title: Radha Helps Jambavati
episodesList.summary: Radha plays a game to make Jambavati understand the meaning of Dhan Lakshmi. Later, they make a devotional call to Lakshmi.

episodesList.title: Alaksmi's Diabolical Plan
episodesList.summary: Krishna promises Radha, that he will not restrict her from helping Alakshmi. To put Radha in trouble, Alakshmi prepares tasteless food and invites the Monks for a meal.

episodesList.title: Alaksmi Frames Radha
episodesList.summary: As the women in the kitchen fall sick due to Alaksmi's spell, Radha gets into trouble. Later, she blames Radha for spoiling the refreshments meant for the monks.

episodesList.title: Krishna Recites Lakshmi Katha
episodesList.summary: Alaksmi comes up with an evil plan when Radha is asked to prepare food for the Rishis. To calm down the enraged Rishis, Krishna recites Dhanya Lakshmi Katha.

episodesList.title: Radha Receives Blessings
episodesList.summary: The Rishis ask for forgiveness from Dhan Lakshmi at Radha's request. They bless Radha as she wins their hearts by serving delicious food.

episodesList.title: Alakshmi's Wicked Resolution
episodesList.summary: Krishna predicts something unusual about the day of Purnima. Later, Alakshmi resolves to evoke sadness in Dwarka before Purnima.

episodesList.title: Krishna Forgets to Play the Flute
episodesList.summary: Alakshmi causes hindrance when Krishna begins narrating a tale on Vidhyalakshmi. The villagers are stunned as Krishna fails to remember how to play the flute.

episodesList.title: Radha Loses Her Memory
episodesList.summary: Alakshmi is thrilled when Radha loses her complete memory. While Krishna helps Radha recollect, she confronts Alakshmi about her wicked intentions.

episodesList.title: Radha, Alakshmi at War!
episodesList.summary: Radha poses a challenge to Alakshmi, asking her to win Krishna over. Accepting the same, Alakshmi accumulates her supreme powers troubling Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Krishna Recites Parvati Katha
episodesList.summary: To get rid of the negativity, Krishna decides to recite Devi Parvati Sati Swarup Katha. Later, Krishna takes a significant decision on Radha's insistence.

episodesList.title: Krishna Presents a Proposal
episodesList.summary: Krishna defines the meaning of love as Radha makes a sacrifice. Later, she admits her failure when Krishna proposes to divide him into two equal pieces.

episodesList.title: Alakshmi Realises True Love
episodesList.summary: Alakshmi apologises to Radha after realising the true meaning of love. As she unites Radha and Krishna, he appreciates every woman who loves unconditionally.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Plea to Krishna
episodesList.summary: To save Dwarka from Alakshmi's evil traces, Mahadev requests Krishna to perform Ashwamedha Yagya. When Krishna refuses him, he comes up with another plan.

episodesList.title: Narada Plans Ashwamedha Yagya
episodesList.summary: As Mahadev convinces Narada, he meets Rukmini and Radha to execute his idea. Later, Krishna appears as Narada discusses his plan for Ashwamedha Yagya with Radha.

episodesList.title: Krishna Refuses the Yagya
episodesList.summary: Krishna confronts Narada about the Ashwamedha Yagya. While Narada tries to evade him, Krishna declines to participate in the Yagya.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Wives Are Welcomed
episodesList.summary: Narad Muni greets each wife of Krishna for the Ashwamedha Yagya. Elsewhere, Balaram gets worried as he is unable to bring an Ashwa for the Yagya.

episodesList.title: Krishna Tricks Radha
episodesList.summary: While Radha persuades Krishna's wives for the Ashwamedha Yagya, Narad Muni applauds her. Later, Radha's genius plan fails as Krishna tricks her.

episodesList.title: Krishna Pranks Narad Muni
episodesList.summary: Krishna plays a prank on Narad Muni as he plans to trap him for the yagya. Later, Saambh gets determined to seperate Krishna and Radha.

episodesList.title: Parvati Advises Narad Muni
episodesList.summary: Narad Muni lands in a fix as Krishna wants him to select the wife for the Yagya. As he decides to leave, Devi Parvati comes up with a solution.

episodesList.title: Radha to Make a Choice
episodesList.summary: Radha gets into a dilemma when Narada urges her to choose Krishna's wife for the Yagya. While Krishna stops her, she accepts Narada's plea.

episodesList.title: Krishna Performs Mahadev Pooja
episodesList.summary: Krishna teaches Chayan to Radha as she gets upset about his fasting. As he performs the Mahadev Pooja, she insists on fasting too.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Evil Act
episodesList.summary: Radha decides to drink milk to break Krishna's fast. However, Saambh comes up with a wicked plan to hurt Krishna.

episodesList.title: Saambh Accuses Radha
episodesList.summary: Saambh blames Radha for conspiring against Krishna's wives and decides to prove it. Later, Narada conveys Krishna's idea to help Radha in the selection process.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Shrewd Manipulation
episodesList.summary: Saambh tries to influence the situation to stop Radha from selecting a wife for the Yagya. He suggests donating gold while Radha is about to declare her choice.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Tula Daan
episodesList.summary: To choose a wife for the Yagya, Saambh organises Tula Daan for Krishna. Later, Saambh and others get elated to experience a miracle.

episodesList.title: Radha Excpresses Her Love
episodesList.summary: When Saambh plots revenge against Krishna, the Ashwa escapes from the trap. Later, Balaram is astounded by the definition of love from Radha.

episodesList.title: Radha to Save Krishna
episodesList.summary: Radha initially refuses to remove the thorn from Krishna's body to respect Rukmini's wishes. But she decides to save him when he faces deep agony.

episodesList.title: Krishna Calls Off the Yagna
episodesList.summary: Radha tells Krishna that Rukmini should not participate in the Ashwamedha Yagna with him. To cater to her wish, Krishna calls off the Yagna.

episodesList.title: Devi Parvati's Request to Krishna
episodesList.summary: Devi Parvati expresses her desire to witness Bal Ganesha, but Lord Shiva denies it. Later, Krishna fulfils her demand.

episodesList.title: Ganesha's Mischievous Acts
episodesList.summary: Mahadev complains to Krishna about Ganesha as he snatches away his Trishula. Later, Ganesha gets curious about the strongest weapon in the world.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Grows Angry
episodesList.summary: Krishna enjoys the meal together with the Gods and Ganesha. An angry Mahadev scolds Ganesha as he eats all the Modaks after Krishna provokes him.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Comes up with a Plan
episodesList.summary: Ganesha is upset as Mahadev scolds him for eating Modak. Later, Mahadev comes up with a plan to make Krishna meet Ganesha.

episodesList.title: Ganesha Arrives at Dwarka
episodesList.summary: Realising Mahadev's plan, Krishna decides to leave Dwarka and take Vishnu's avatar. Upon Ganesha's arrival, the people of Dwarka are ecstatic.

episodesList.title: Ganesha Makes an Attempt
episodesList.summary: Radha is upset as she fails to feed the Modaks to Ganesha. Elsewhere, Ganesha makes several attempts to take the Sudarshan Chakra.

episodesList.title: Ganesha Drinks the Kshira Sagar
episodesList.summary: To awaken Krishna for the Sudarshan Chakra, Ganesha drinks the milk from Kshira Sagar. As he fails to find Ganesha, Balaram lands in deep trouble.

episodesList.title: Balaram's Request to Ganesha
episodesList.summary: Balaram finds Ganesha and urges him to replenish the Kshira Saga. Later, Ganesha agrees after Parvati requests him.

episodesList.title: The Birth of Ganesha
episodesList.summary: Vinayak was a gritty little boy who lost his life at Mahadev's hands because he followed Parvati's advice. To placate her anger, Mahadev created Ganesha.

episodesList.title: Ganesha's Request to Radha
episodesList.summary: Ganesha finds Radha, and she feeds him a Modak. He then makes an innocent request, and she goes to execute his plan.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Teach Ganesha
episodesList.summary: Krishna decides to take Ganesha with him to Dwarka for instilling knowledge within him. Meanwhile, Radha prepares an ostentatious feast for his welcome.

episodesList.title: Ganesha Avoids Krishna
episodesList.summary: Ganesha's team of mice find out the Modaks prepared by Radha. Later, to evade Krishna's questions about the Sudarshan Chakra, Ganesha avoids him.

episodesList.title: Ganesha's Mischievous Act
episodesList.summary: After hearing about Krishna's escapades with stealing butter, Ganesha tries it himself. He then uses his mice team and steals all the butter from Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Ganesha Frames Krishna
episodesList.summary: When Krishna asks about the butter thief, a guilty Ganesha frames Krishna. Later, he tells Ganesha a story to make him realise his mistake.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Lesson to Ganesha
episodesList.summary: While Ganesha and Krishna win the food task, Krishna gives him a valuable advice on winning. With Krishna's help, Ganesha successfully plays the flute.

episodesList.title: Krishna Defeats Saambh
episodesList.summary: Saambh wants to prove to Ganesha that his jhula is the strongest. However, Krishna wins the competition as Saambh falls from his jhula.

episodesList.title: Ganesha Accuses Saambh
episodesList.summary: Radha and Krishna gift Ganesha a peacock feather by letting him win the competition. Saambh counter questions Ganesha after he blames him for stealing his Modaks.

episodesList.title: Veda Vyasa Chooses Ganesha
episodesList.summary: Krishna welcomes Veda Vyasa at his place. Ganesha agrees to perform the task for popularity while Veda Vyasa chooses him after getting impressed.

episodesList.title: Ganesha's Great Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: Ganesha starts to write Mahabharata as Veda Vyasa dictates. Ganesha sacrifices his tooth to carry on his writing while the pen breaks due to Saambh's plot.

episodesList.title: Ganesha Confesses the Truth
episodesList.summary: Ganesha blames Saambh for the loss of his tooth, but he forgives him with an open heart. Later, he admits his act of hiding Sudarshana Chakra to Radha.

episodesList.title: Krishna Briefs Ganesha
