episodesList.summary: Ganesha listens carefully while Krishna elaborates the stories of his various avatars. When Mohasur arrives at Dwarka, Krishna gets a premonition.

episodesList.title: Parvati Gives an Ultimatum
episodesList.summary: Radha stands up to Mohasur and refuses to let him take Ganesha away. When all fails, Radha faces Parvati, who gives her an ultimatum to return Ganesha.

episodesList.title: Krishna Gets Defeated
episodesList.summary: Ganesha hides to avoid Mohasur when Krishna denies fighting the former. Further, Krishna fights with Mohasur to avoid destruction but is defeated.

episodesList.title: Ganesha Grows Victorious
episodesList.summary: Ganesha chooses the path of truth by returning Krishna his Sudarshana Chakra. Mohasur liberates Radha and Parvati from his spell after Ganesha wins over him.

episodesList.title: Radha Grows Upset
episodesList.summary: A sad Radha decides not to participate in the Janmashtami celebration. Later, Ganesha questions her when he finds her in tears.

episodesList.title: Krishna Janmashtami Special!
episodesList.summary: On the occasion of Janmashtami, the Gods meet Krishna to honour the festival. Krishna and Radha enter the galaxy as twinkling stars shower over them.

episodesList.title: Radha Gets Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Radha waits for Krishna when Shukracharya tells Saambh of the end of her curse. Later, Shukracharya kidnaps Radha before her life takes an auspicious turn.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Arduous Effort
episodesList.summary: Devi Parvati fumes with anger and decides to finish Shukracharya's powers for trapping Radha. After following Krishna's flute, can Radha reach him?

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna Return to Dwarka
episodesList.summary: Hundred years ahead, Radha and Krishna spend time together on their swing. However, they decide to return to Dwarka and meet their associates.

episodesList.title: Radha's Strong Wish
episodesList.summary: Radha desires to settle with Krishna at Goloka, but he refuses to do so. However, against Krishna's wish, she leaves Dwarka to reunite with him at Goloka.

episodesList.title: Radha Goes Back to Dwarka
episodesList.summary: As Radha leaves for Goloka, Krishna is unable to stop her. However, Balram's questions compel her to return back to Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Ultimatum to Radha
episodesList.summary: Radha leaves Dwarka and hides from Krishna in a cave. However, Krishna arrives at the cave and asks her to come out or else he will never meet her again.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna Makes a Promise
episodesList.summary: On Radha's insistence, Krishna promises to end their relationship of love. Elsewhere, the dwellers of Dwarka get excited to welcome them.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Promise to Balaram
episodesList.summary: Balaram expresses his concern to Krishna about Radha. However, Krishna dimisses his query by stating that his love with Radha is eternal.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Evil Resolution
episodesList.summary: Krishna welcomes the Yaduvanshis and makes Saambh their representative. Later, an evil Saambh resolves to destroy Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Request to Radha
episodesList.summary: Radha attempts to end Krishna's suffering by stopping time which puts the world in danger. Later, Krishna tries to reason with Radha in order to save the world.

episodesList.title: Krishna Makes a Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: Krishna gives up all his powers and tells Radha that he will be killed if she destroys the world. Saambh learns about the former's weakness and plans an attack.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Plea to Balaram
episodesList.summary: With the help of Devaki, Krishna manages to comfort a sad Radha. Later, he asks Balaram to accompany Saambh and Anirudh to unite the Yaduvanshis.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Dream Comes True
episodesList.summary: Radha makes Krishna's dream a reality by inviting Gopikas to cook for him. Later, Saambh and Balaram's plan to set Anirudh up works in their favour.

episodesList.title: Radha Turns Jealous
episodesList.summary: Krishna praises the dessert prepared by the Gopikas when a jealous Radha finds it tasteless. The Gopikas groom Krishna while Balaram, Anirudh, and Saambh are absent.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Big Plans for Radha
episodesList.summary: Balram refuses to fight with Bhaldev on Saamb's advice, to rescue Anirudh. Elsewhere, Krishna prepares for a grand event to celebrate Radha's birthday.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Astute Plan
episodesList.summary: Despite Krishna's request, Saambh is ready to declare a war against the Yaduvanshis. Later, Krishna has a clever plan to get Anirudh back.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Genius Strategy
episodesList.summary: Krishna invites Somdev and Baldev as chief guests for the ceremony, and both give up the war out of respect. Later, Baldev returns Anirudh to Krishna.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna's Celebration
episodesList.summary: While Radha grows worried about Krishna, he celebrates her birthday. Further, Krishna fulfils Devki's miracle wish.

episodesList.title: Devki Becomes Nostalgic
episodesList.summary: Devki gets emotional after witnessing Krishna's greatness and tells him the story about his birth. Later, Krishna shares a romantic moment with Radha.

episodesList.title: Radha, Rukmini Take a Vow
episodesList.summary: When Sukracharya and Saambh conspire to eliminate Krishna, Radha and Balaram sense a danger. Later, Rukmini and Radha promise to protect him.

episodesList.title: Radha Is Horrified
episodesList.summary: As Radha hopes to receive an interpretation, Krishna leaves Rukmini's question unanswered. Later, Radha grows shell-shocked to witness an improbable object.

episodesList.title: Radha Makes a Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: Radha goes searching for Jara in fear of Krishna's life. On learning about Jara's poverty, Radha sacrifices her ring as a sign of love.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Words to Jara
episodesList.summary: As Krishna promises Jara to teach archery, the latter returns him Radha's ring. Jara remains firm in his faith in Krishna, while his wife chastises him.

episodesList.title: Rukmini to Stop Krishna?
episodesList.summary: A frantic Radha resolves to stop Krishna from keeping his promise to Jara. She ultimately asks Rukmini to stop him.

episodesList.title: Radha's Plea to Krishna
episodesList.summary: Radha pleads with Krishna to stop Rukmini from leaving Dwarka, while he asks her to make a promise. Later, Krishna burns his hands trying to save Radha.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Cunning Plan
episodesList.summary: Saambh finds Jara and brings him to Dwarka, knowing that Radha had a premonition of him ending Krishna's life. Meanwhile, Radha tries to warn Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Shocks Radha
episodesList.summary: Radha grows elated as Jara takes back his words from Krishna. While Krishna's shocking response hurt Radha, she takes an unusual step to save his life.

episodesList.title: Krishna Trains Jara
episodesList.summary: Saambh focuses on making Jara stay back in Dwarka while Krishna trains him. Later, Radha and Krishna start the Navaratri puja by praying to Maa Durga.

episodesList.title: Saambh Stops Jara
episodesList.summary: Saambh prevents Jara from leaving Dwarka to fulfill his evil intentions. Later, Jara insists to perform the Shakti Puja with Radha and Krishna.

episodesList.title: Jara Accomplishes the Task
episodesList.summary: Jara manages to fulfil his task by collecting the flowers with Radha and Krishna's help. Later, Saambh asks Jara to be Krishna's minister.

episodesList.title: Maa Durga Blesses Radha
episodesList.summary: As Jara fails to please Maa Durga, Krishna tries to sacrifice an eye to please the goddess. Maa Durga is pleased by Krishna and blesses Radha.

episodesList.title: Saambh is Furious!
episodesList.summary: Saambh is furious that Jara didn't ask for the wish that Saambh had instructed him to ask for. Further, Gurudev takes Saambh to Rishi Durvasa to end Krishna.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Devious Plan
episodesList.summary: As Saambh learns Rishi Durvasa's short-tempered nature, he makes a plan to make the latter furious. Meanwhile, Krishna wishes to create a symbol depicting love.

episodesList.title: Saambh Outwits Durvasa, Krishna
episodesList.summary: Radha and Krishna complete the monument depicting their love. On the other hand, Saambh attains victory in his sinister plan of tricking Rishi Durvasa.

episodesList.title: Troubling News For Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna gets worried when he learns that Rishi Durvasa is coming to Dwarka and starts the preparations. Later, Durvasa presents a shocking condition to Krishna.

episodesList.title: Durvasa's Shocking Revelation
episodesList.summary: Krishna accepts Durvasa's humiliation with a smile on his face. Later, Durvasa apologises to Radha and Krishna and reveals that he humiliated him to protect him.

episodesList.title: Worrying News for Durvasa
episodesList.summary: Durvasa gets concerned when the other Rishis don't arrive at Dwarka before the ceremony. Later, he learns that someone misled them to stop the ceremony.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Conspiracy Continue
episodesList.summary: Saambh conspires against Radha as he serves rotten fruits to Durvasa and other Rishis. Later, Krishna comes up with a plan to catch the culprit.

episodesList.title: Saambh Insults Durvasa
episodesList.summary: Saambh faces Durvasa and calls the Rishis fraudsters. Meanwhile, Krishna has a plan to handle the situation.

episodesList.title: Saambh Receives a Curse
episodesList.summary: Saambh claims that Durvasa and the other sages are all fake as they blessed him with the impossible. Later, Durvasa curses him to give birth from his own body.

episodesList.title: Radha's Request To Balaram
episodesList.summary: Jambavati is shocked to learn about the curse Saambh received from Durvasa. Radha requests Balaram to find Saambh and help him when the latter leaves Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Shukracharya Manipulates Saambh
episodesList.summary: Shukracharya joins hands with King Shalva in order to destroy Krishna and Balaram. He manipulates Saambh into luring Krishna to danger.

episodesList.title: Shalva's Devious Plan
episodesList.summary: Shalva expresses his desire to rule Dwaraka by dethroning Krishna, leading to a scuffle between the two forces. Meanwhile, Radha is concerned about Krishna's absence.

episodesList.title: Balaram Gets Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Krishna's clone enters Dwarka and reveals to Balaram that he knows all about Shukracharya and Shalva's plan. However, Balaram gets suspicious about his behaviour.

episodesList.title: Radha Gets Worried
episodesList.summary: As Krishna behaves weirdly, Balaram pleads with Radha to keep an eye on him. Eventually, Radha gets bothered when Krishna plays with the feather.

episodesList.title: Krishna's New Disguise
episodesList.summary: A disguised Krishna meets King Shalva to gauge how big of a threat he is and the motivation behind him. Later, Balaram questions Kaptasur's battle strategy.

episodesList.title: Giridhari Traps Kaptasur
episodesList.summary: As Giridhari supplies milk for the Govardhan Pooja, Radha invites him. Kaptasur gets into a trap while Giridhari wants to listen to Govardhan Katha from him.

episodesList.title: Kaptasur Manipulates King Shalva
episodesList.summary: While King Shalva confronts Kaptasur for not fulfilling his duty, the latter manipulates him to get the Pushpavimaan. Later, Radha presents a gift to Krishna.

episodesList.title: Radha Tests Kaptasur
episodesList.summary: Radha gets suspicious about Kaptasur when he gloats about his victory and decides to test him. However, Kaptasur comes up with an excuse when he fails the test.

episodesList.title: Radha Learns the Truth!
episodesList.summary: Krishna tells Radha that the person who she thought was him was Kaptasur in disguise. Later, Shalva's army reaches Dwarka for the Pushpaka Vimana.

episodesList.title: Kaptasur's Rude Conduct
episodesList.summary: Kaptasur hurts Balaram's feelings by misbehaving with him for the loss of the Vimana. However, he agrees with Radha after she admits to give away the Vimana.

episodesList.title: Kaptasur Gets Stabbed!
episodesList.summary: Kaptasur sees Radha with Krishna and realises that she knows the truth. Later, he goes to Shalva's kingdom to meet him, but gets stabbed.

episodesList.title: Krishna Pranks Radha!
episodesList.summary: Rishi Durvasa brings Kaptasur back to life as Shalva gives him a warning for betraying him. Later, Krishna pretends to be Kaptasur to play a prank on Radha.

episodesList.title: Krishna Challenges Kaptasur
episodesList.summary: Kaptasur confronts Krishna and threatens to kill him. After a war of words, Krishna vows to finish himself if Radha chooses Kaptasur over him.

episodesList.title: Radha Discovers Kaptasur's Plan
episodesList.summary: After Kaptasur impersonates Krishna, Radha is asked to identify him with her eyes closed. Eventually,Radhadiscovers Kaptasur's nefarious intention.

episodesList.title: Gopis Invite Krishna
episodesList.summary: The Gopis invite Krishna and Radha to their villages to perform the Raas. Later, Vidurath receives Mahadev's blessing after offering penance to him.

episodesList.title: Krishna Challenges Balaram
episodesList.summary: Balaram accepts Krishna's wrestling challenge. As Krishna partially reveals his motive after losing, Shukracharya makes a deadly deal with Vidhurath.

episodesList.title: Vidhurath Challenges Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna welcomes Vidhurath to Dwarka, but the latter invites him to a duel to avenge his brother, Dantavakra's death. Krishna accepts his challenge.

episodesList.title: Shri Krishna Outwits Vidhurath
episodesList.summary: Shri Krishna outwits Vidhurath by pretending to be tired during their duel while the sun sets. The next morning, Krishna starts the duel.

episodesList.title: Krishna Eludes Vidhurath
episodesList.summary: Since the whole world has been made a fighting ring, Krishna eludes Vidhurath and reaches Vrindavan with Radha. Later, Shukracharya assists Vidhurath.

episodesList.title: Vidhurath Kidnaps the Gopikas
episodesList.summary: The Gopikas joyously welcome Krishna and Radha to their village. However, Vidhurath kidnaps all of the Gopikas to persuade Krishna to come to their rescue.

episodesList.title: Krishna Surprises Vidhurath
episodesList.summary: Krishna arrives where Vidhurath has captured the gopikas and surprises him with his illusion. Awestruck, Vidhurath falls in mud in front of Krishna.

episodesList.title: Vidhurath Gets Executed!
episodesList.summary: Vidhurath accepts his loss and requests Krishna to put a stop to their battle. Later, Krishna kills Vidhurath for attempting to harm Radha.

episodesList.title: Shukracharya's Evil Plan
episodesList.summary: Shukracharya furiously determines to wipe out Krishna by taking away the love that has his life. Elsewhere, Krishna anticipates a forthcoming danger.

episodesList.title: Shukracharya Challenges Nishath
episodesList.summary: Saambh moans after suffering from a severe stomachache caused by leprosy. Later, Shukracharya infiltrates Nishath's mind to turn him against Krishna.

episodesList.title: Nishath Gets Provoked
episodesList.summary: As he resolves to save Nishath, Balaram asks Krishna to look after Saambh. On the other hand, Shukracharya and Shalva instigate Nishath against Krishna.

episodesList.title: Nishath Puts Forth His Demands
episodesList.summary: As Shukracharya provokes Nishath, the latter questions Krishna's credibility in Dwarka. Later, Nishath demands Krishna to step down from the throne.

episodesList.title: Radha to Help Saambh
episodesList.summary: A mysterious individual gives Jambavati and Radha a potion to save Saambh. Later, Radha fakes an injury to get access to his chamber.

episodesList.title: Colossal Powers Affect Saambh
episodesList.summary: Balaram is upset when Krishna refuses his request to be the king for a day. Later, Saambh suffers as supernatural powers erupt from his body.

episodesList.title: Balaram's Drastic Decision
episodesList.summary: Balaram feels degraded as Krishna forbids him to be the Dwarkadhish. Out of anger, he decides to master the knowledge by leaving Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Disturbing Anticipation
episodesList.summary: Balaram decides to acquire knowledge from the sage, unaware of the evil plans. Elsewhere, Krishna's realisation about the forthcoming danger makes him upset.

episodesList.title: Balaram Gives Assurance
episodesList.summary: Balaram assures Krishna that his Gurudev will fix the plight raised in Dwarka. While Krishna is upset, Balaram is confident about saving Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Balaram Foils Romaharshan's Ploy
episodesList.summary: While Balaram catches Nishad red-handed, Romaharshan carries on the act of doing the Yajna. Later, Balaram foils Romaharshan's ploy.

episodesList.title: Balram Warns Romharshan
episodesList.summary: Balram furiously lashes out at Nishath as he tries creating a rift between him and Krishna. Meanwhile, as he tries to teach Romharshan a lesson, Krishna asks Balram to not interrupt the ritual.

episodesList.title: Romharshan Feels Relieved
episodesList.summary: As Balram continues to intimidate Romharshan for conspiring against Krishna, the latter convinces Dwaraka to impress Mahadev. Later, Mahadev grants Romharshan a wish.

episodesList.title: Balaram's Outrageous Act
episodesList.summary: A furious Balaram attempts to kill Romharshan to stop Mahadeva from offering his boon of indemnity. Later, Krishna convinces them.

episodesList.title: Krishna Is Helpless
episodesList.summary: An impotent Balaram breaks down to see Krishna's helplessness towards Romharshan's evil deeds. Elsewhere, Shukracharya celebrates the forthcoming destruction.

episodesList.title: Balaram Challenges Romharshan
episodesList.summary: Balaram refuses to let Romharshan leave Dwarka without facing any consequences and challenges him for a fight. Hearing this, Radha worries for him.

episodesList.title: Saambh's Oath to End Musal
episodesList.summary: Krishna feels worried about the dangerous and lethal Musal who is in Dwarka. Elsewhere, Saambh pledges to do penance of Mahadev and end Musal.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Blessing to Saambh
episodesList.summary: Krishna explains to Radha the consequences of Saambh's oath to defeat Musal. Later, Mahadev bestows destructive energy on Saambh to fight Musal.

episodesList.title: Krishna Foils Shukracharya's Plan
episodesList.summary: Krishna faces a dilemma, but he successfully foils Shukracharya's plan. Furthermore, Saambh has a change of heart as the family reunites.

episodesList.title: Radha Reassures Saambh
episodesList.summary: Radha reassures Saambh when Krishna cancels the celebratory festival. Moreover, she promises Saambh that she will convince Krishna to approve the celebration.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Anand Tandav
episodesList.summary: Mahadev and Krishna perform Anand Tandav and Anand Leela respectively. Meanwhile, Shukracharya's spies steal the unholy pestle's fragments.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna Revisit Nidhivan
episodesList.summary: While Krishna and Radha revisit Nidhivan, he lights up the trees to etch their bond. Meanwhile, Shukracharya orders his troops to smuggle the alien pestle.

episodesList.title: Krishna Feels Worried
episodesList.summary: Krishna asks a tensed Samudradev to be calm, but in a state of denial, the latter approaches Mahadev. Meanwhile, Radha feels aloof, but Krishna reassures her.

episodesList.title: Subhadra Arrives at Dwarka
episodesList.summary: While the army is getting readied to defend Shalva's attack on Dwarka, Subhadra foresees death. Later, she reaches Dwarka to deliver the vital news to Krishna.

episodesList.title: Saambh Makes a Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: Subhadra reveals that she has foreseen Abhimanyu's death at Shalva's hands and asks Krishna to save him. Later, Saambh leaves Krishna shocked with his sacrifice.

episodesList.title: Saambh Leaves for the War
episodesList.summary: An undaunted Saambh leaves for war without taking Krishna's blessings. During the fight, Shukracharya asks Shalva to direct all his weapons only towards Saambh.

episodesList.title: Pradyumna Becomes a Martyr
episodesList.summary: Pradyumna dies from the impact of Shalva's special weapon. Later Balaram, Nisath and Saambh take an oath of avenging his death.

episodesList.title: Rukmini Is Devastated
episodesList.summary: A grief-stricken Rukmini laments the death of Pradyumna after viewing his deceased face. Later, she wailfully questions Krishna about his power.

episodesList.title: Krishna Decides to Fight!
episodesList.summary: After an intense and heartfelt conversation, Krishna gets ready for a war against Shalva and his army. However, Radha stays unhappy with Krishna.

episodesList.title: Radha's Sacrifice for Krishna!
episodesList.summary: While Krishna defends Saambh, Nishad, and Balaram from Shalva's attack, Radha leaves Dwarka after promising Rukmini. Later, she decides to take her own life.

episodesList.title: Devaki in Trouble!
episodesList.summary: While Radha keeps her resolve by not entering the warzone, Krishna puts down his weapons. However, Shalva uses Devaki as a trump card to bring Krishna into the fight.

episodesList.title: Krishna Feels Powerless
episodesList.summary: Krishna appears defenceless as Shalva holds Devaki captive. Meanwhile, as Balaram pleads with Radha to join them on the battlefield, Shalva captures Vasudev.

episodesList.title: End of Vasudev, Devaki?
episodesList.summary: Devaki and Vasudev get perished on the battlefield by Shalva. Consequently, Shalva faces Radha's wrath as she acquires her power to kill him.

episodesList.title: Balaram's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: Devastated by the death of Vasudev and Devaki, Balaram decides to break ties with Krishna. Elsewhere, Radha and Rukmini experience a startling event.

episodesList.title: Radha Leaves Dwaraka
episodesList.summary: Radha is grateful as Krishna saves Vasudev and Devaki from Shalva's wrath. Meanwhile, to fulfil the promise made to Rukmini, Radha decides to leave Dwaraka.

episodesList.title: Radha Resurrects Pradyumna
episodesList.summary: Radha returns to Dwaraka with the power of Goddess Parvati to resuscitate Pradyumna. Later on, Radha declares that Shalva must die at Krishna's hands.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Final Move
episodesList.summary: Shalva receives a final warning after Shukracharya rescues him from captivity. Krishna eventually employs the Sudarshana Chakra on Shalva.

episodesList.title: Balaram to Leave Dwarka
episodesList.summary: Krishna uses his persuasion skills to convince Balaram to go to Hastinapur and find an end to the drought. Later, Krishna receives a letter from Yashoda.

episodesList.title: Balram Travels to Vrindavan
episodesList.summary: Krishna implores Balram to see their mother after receiving an invitation message. Elsewhere, Saambh and Nishath are confronted by a massive lizard-like asura.

episodesList.title: Radha Grows Restless
episodesList.summary: Radha conveys her desire to visit Vrindavan, but Krishna pays no heed. While he sleeps peacefully, Radha grows restless.

episodesList.title: Radha Tricks Krishna
episodesList.summary: Balram receives a message from Saambh about a gigantic lizard-like creature. Meanwhile, Radha attempts to trick Krishna in order to travel to Vrindavan.

episodesList.title: Radha Upsets the Gopis
episodesList.summary: Radha irks the Gopis by doubting their affection for Krishna as they criticise him. Meanwhile, Balram reaches out to protect his sons from a giant monster.

episodesList.title: Radha Meets Yashoda
episodesList.summary: Yashoda feels delighted when Radha pays her a surprise visit. Radha later reminisces about her time with Krishna on entering his bedroom.

episodesList.title: Krishna Comes to Gokul
episodesList.summary: Krishna tries his best to stop Radha from meeting the Gopis but fails. Later, he arrives at Nand's place, brings down a hanging pot of butter and starts relishing it.

episodesList.title: Krishna Meets Yashoda
episodesList.summary: While Krishna steals the butter pot and hides, an evil creature searches for him. Later, Krishna returns to Gokul and meets Yashoda.

episodesList.title: Yashoda Convinces Krishna
episodesList.summary: Yashoda persuades Krishna to stay with her for a few more days. Meanwhile, the evil creature successfully escapes from Balram's trap.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Pranks with the Gopis
episodesList.summary: Krishna decides to end the conflict between Radha and the Gopis and plays with them. Meanwhile, Yashoda cooks for him the whole night.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Advice to Balaram
episodesList.summary: Krishna tricks the Gopis and Yashoda yet again to gain their affection. While Saambh gets annoyed at a sleeping Balaram, Krishna advises the latter.

episodesList.title: Krishna's New Tactic
episodesList.summary: Balaram comes to know bout the past birth of the Asur who is in the form of a lizard. Meanwhile, the residents of Vrindavan come to meet an injured Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Feels Remorse
episodesList.summary: Krishna repents for his pretention of being injured. Meanwhile, the Asur travels to Vrindavan creating rampage all over.

episodesList.title: Krishna Gets Caught by Radha
episodesList.summary: While Krishna tries to escape secretly to face the Asur, Radha catches him red-handed. Meanwhile, Balaram and the boys fail to capture the Asur.

episodesList.title: Krishna Meets Nrigasur
episodesList.summary: Krishna somehow manages to escape from his house. Later, he meets Nrigasur and gives him salvation from his lizard form.

episodesList.title: Balram Is Restricted
episodesList.summary: Krishna prevents Balram from visiting Vrindavan by promising him something better. Meanwhile, Radha doubts Krishna's behaviour and asks Yashoda to check his room.

episodesList.title: The Gopis at Krishna's Service
episodesList.summary: The Gopis take Krishna to a beautiful place to make him happy and shower their love on him. Elsewhere, Banar Rakshas attacks Gokul.

episodesList.title: Krishna in a Tough Situation
episodesList.summary: Nand comes up with a smart plan to convince Krishna to hatch some Durlav Pushp. Later, Krishna lands in a fix when Radha and Yashoda request him for the Pushp.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Secrets Revealed!
episodesList.summary: Krishna's lies get revealed in front of Yashoda and Radha. Later, he comes up with another mischievous plan to pacify them and win their affection.

episodesList.title: Radha Feels Guilty
episodesList.summary: Radha reads Krishna's emotional letter publicly and feels guilty. Meanwhile, another devil approaches Dwarka via the sea route.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Mischievous Ways
episodesList.summary: Krishna tricks Radha but she refuses to fall for it. Dau receives Krishna's letter of apology, but doesn't believe his words while danger looms over Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Krishna Is Challenged
episodesList.summary: An enormous demon approaches Dwarka, challenging Krishna. Later, Krishna hears of the demon and informs Balram about his onslaught.

episodesList.title: Balaram Defeats Dwividh
episodesList.summary: Dwividh continues to create a rampage in Dwarka, looking for Krishna. Later, he tries to abduct the Gopis when Balaram and the boys defeat him.

episodesList.title: Dwividh Resolves to Retaliate
episodesList.summary: Dwividh decides to kidnap the Gopiyas to entice Krishna to Dwarka. Balaram eventually learns about Dwividh's initiative to reattack Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Dwividh Abducts the Gopis
episodesList.summary: Dwividh attacks once again with his army and kidnaps the Gopis. Later, Krishna gets the message and decides to combat him.

episodesList.title: Radha Fights Dwividh
episodesList.summary: Radha battles Dwividh courageously, but he abducts her. Meanwhile, Krishna gets surrounded by Dwividh's soldiers.

episodesList.title: Krishna Makes Dwividh Collapse
episodesList.summary: A tired Dwividh falls as he races to catch Krishna. Meanwhile, the Gopis refuse to leave with Balaram till Krishna comes to rescue them.

episodesList.title: Balaram Executes Dwividh
episodesList.summary: Dwividh hurls huge rocks at Krishna and the Gopis after threatening him to fight. Later, Balaram kills Dwividh after Krishna's instructions.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Decision Shocks Radha
episodesList.summary: Radha is startled by Krishna's revelation after meeting him on the outskirts of Vrindavan. Eventually, Krishna notifies Yashoda that he must return to Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Krishna Directs Saambh
episodesList.summary: As Krishna arrives at Dwarka, a few sages approach him regarding Hans and Dimbak's problem. With Krishna's warning, Saambh goes to tackle the situation.

episodesList.title: Dwellers of Dwarika in trouble
episodesList.summary: Hans plans to hold marriage for the bachelors of Dwarka and orders to abduct them. Elsewhere, Durbasha calls Balaram and Krishna to tackle the problem of the Brahmins.

episodesList.title: Radha Puts Her Foot Down
episodesList.summary: Radha stands as a barrier between the unconsented marriages that Hans is trying to do. Later, Maharishi Durbasha expresses his helplessness to Krishna.

episodesList.title: Radha Is in a Bind
episodesList.summary: Hans declares that if Radha agrees to marry him, he will spare all the abducted women. Subsequently, Krishna recommends a personal meeting with Hans.

episodesList.title: Radha to Marry Hans
episodesList.summary: Hans sends a gift for Radha and a letter to Krishna to tell him that he wants to marry Radha. Later, Radha agrees to the marriage to save the people of Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Hans Arrives in Dwarka
episodesList.summary: While Radha feels guilty about hiding her decision from Krishna, Hans arrives with the prisoners. Later, Radha declares her decision for the people of Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Hans Faces Disappointment
episodesList.summary: Hans desires to fulfill Radha's wish of weighing her in gold but gets failed in fulfilling it. However, Radha gives Hans another chance.

episodesList.title: Hans to Attack Kuber
episodesList.summary: Hans decides to strike Kuber for his wealth after failing to weigh Radha in gold. Meanwhile, Radha requests Krishna to stay out of her dispute with Hans.

episodesList.title: Hans Gets Furious
episodesList.summary: Hans gets perplexed when he cannot weigh gold equal to Radha and thinks it is part of Krishna's deception. Later, he wishes to meet Mahadev.

episodesList.title: Krishna Erupts in Rage
episodesList.summary: Hans provokes mayhem after Krishna refuses to give him his ornament. Later, as he kidnaps Radha to marry her forcefully, Krishna gets outraged.

episodesList.title: Krishna Defeats Hans
episodesList.summary: Hans reveals the weapons he received from Mahadev as blessings, yet Krishna beats him in the battle. Later, Mahadev takes Hans' defeat as an insult to himself.

episodesList.title: Krishna Battles Mahadev!
episodesList.summary: Krishna persuades Mahadev to restore the boon he offered to Dimbak. However, as Mahadev rejects Krishna's suggestion, the two engage in a fierce battle.

episodesList.title: Krishna Narrates a Story
episodesList.summary: The downfall of the world starts as Krishna and Shiva clash in battle. Krishna later recounts a story about Mahadev's boon to prove his culpability.

episodesList.title: Vrikaasur's Wicked Desire
episodesList.summary: Krishna narrates the story of Vrikaasur seeking Mahadev's blessings. He also mentions a boon that Mahadev bestowed on the demonic Vrikaasur.

episodesList.title: Vrikaasur Assaults Devlok
episodesList.summary: The Gods flee to Vaikunth for safety when Vrikaasur attacks Devlok. Later, Shukracharya asks Vrikaasur to take over Vaikunth, but he decides to attack Kailas.

episodesList.title: Narayan's Plea to Lakshmi
episodesList.summary: Bhasmasur resolves to invade Narayan's Vaikunth Lok after conquering Kailas Lok. Meanwhile, Narayan requests that Lakshmi bathe in the holy Mansarovar Lake.

episodesList.title: Bhasmasur Gets Distracted
episodesList.summary: Narayan finds a solution when Bhasmasur gets fascinated by Lakshmi and Parvati. Upon learning this, an enraged Shukracharya decides to confront Bhasmasur.

episodesList.title: Mohini Dupes Bhasmasur
episodesList.summary: Mohini pretends to love Bhasmasur to prevent him from attacking Vaikunth. Later, she confronts the Gods on behalf of Bhasmasur.

episodesList.title: Mohini's Message to Bhasmasur
episodesList.summary: Lakshmi gets ready to go to war against Bhasmasur, but Mohini tells her how to avoid it. Later, Mohini delivers a shocking message to Bhasmasur.

episodesList.title: Mohini to Marry Bhasmasur
episodesList.summary: Bhasmasur is delighted as Mohini decides to marry him in front of Guru Shukracharya. However, Guru Shukracharya feels suspicious of Mohini's decision.

episodesList.title: Mohini Faces a Challenge
episodesList.summary: While Bhasmasur asks to meet with Mohini's family before their wedding, Lakshmi feels confused about Narayan's plan. Later, Mahadev arrives to meet Bhasmasur.

episodesList.title: Mohini's Real Identity Revealed
episodesList.summary: Mohini wants her family members to prepare a dance performance for her wedding. Later, Shukracharya informs Bhasmasur about Mohini and her family's real identity.

episodesList.title: Mohini Ends Bhasmasur
episodesList.summary: Mohini manipulates Bhasmasur into joining her in dance and makes him touch his head which causes him to turn into ashes. Later, Mahadev apologises to Narayan.

episodesList.title: Maharishi Bhrigu's Egoistic Action
episodesList.summary: After the sages ask which of the Trimurtis is the best, Maharishi Bhrigu decides to test them. Meanwhile, Krishna and Radha organise Holi festivities in Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Lakshmi Punishes Bhrigu
episodesList.summary: Bhrigu wakes up Narayan from his meditation by stepping on his chest. While Narayan impresses him with his humility, Lakshmi gives Bhrigu a punishment.

episodesList.title: Bhrigu Upsets Bhargavi
episodesList.summary: Narayan grants Bhrigu's wish as Lakshmi is born as his daughter and he names her Bhargavi. However, Bhrigu upsets her by not letting her leave the house.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Makes a Promise
episodesList.summary: Bhrigu swears that he will not let Narayan meet Bhargavi, an avatar of Lakshmi. Later, Shrinivas states that he is on the quest for his soulmate.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Offers to Dance
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas decides to dance after sneaking into a women's dancing competition. The princess, however, rejects his proposal because he is not a woman.

episodesList.title: Enchanting Dance by Shrinivas
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas begins dancing in front of Natraj without any audience. Meanwhile, as Bhairavi learns about Shrinivas, she feels drawn to him without meeting him.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Is Praised
episodesList.summary: Natraj proclaims Shrinivas to be the greatest dancer in the universe. On the other hand, Shrinivas feels dissatisfied as Bhargavi is not present.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Meets Bhargavi
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas decides to leave Venkatgiri after failing to meet Laxmi. However, as he waits near the ocean, Bhargavi runs into him, fulfilling his wish.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas and Govindraj Gets Help
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas suffers injuries on his leg and Govindraj gets irked at his behaviour of avoiding Padmavati's aid. Later, Shrinivas gives up and listens to Padmavati's advices.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas, Rajkumar's Face-off
episodesList.summary: As Shrinivas prepares to leave the place, Rajkumar smokes in anger and blames him for taking advantage of his sister. Later, Shrinivas grows anxious to meet his Laxmi.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Visits Bhargavi
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas arrives at Bhargavi's house and wishes to take her with him, with her father's permission. Elsewhere, Padmavati desires to marry Shrinivas.

episodesList.title: Bhrigu Decides Bhargavi's Fate
episodesList.summary: Bhrigu finds similarities between Padmavati and Bhargavi's horoscopes. Later, he makes a shocking decision about Bhargavi's marriage.

episodesList.title: Vasu Doubts Krishna
episodesList.summary: Rishi Brigu tells Vasu that Padmavati has to wait for three months to marry. Later, Vasu gets suspicious and assumes Krishna's involvement in Rishi Brigu's verdict.

episodesList.title: Srinivas Impresses Rishi Bhrigu
episodesList.summary: Padmavati tells Srinivas that if he agrees to teach her dancing, she will say yes to her marriage. Later, Srinivas prepares Payasam for Rishi Bhrigu.

episodesList.title: Rishi Bhrigu's Desire
episodesList.summary: To Bhargavi's chagrin, Rishi Bhrigu requests that Shrinivas educate her. He then expresses his desire to get Bhargavi married to Shrinivas.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas to Impress Bhargavi
episodesList.summary: To shower love and impress Bhargavi, Shrinivas starts his dance performance. Elsewhere Padmavati waits for Shrinivas for the dance class.

episodesList.title: Padmavati's Immense Curiosity
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas agrees to teach Padmavati to see her eagerness. He makes a plan so that she can understand that he does not love her.

episodesList.title: Kumar Vasudev's Wicked Plan
episodesList.summary: Infuriated, Kumar Vasudev makes a wicked plan against Shrinivas and tries to imprison him. Elsewhere, Shrinivas gets ready to visit Bhrigu's house to impress Bhargavi.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Visits Bhargavi's House
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas arrives at Bhargavi's house and impresses her family with his culinary skills. Later, Bhargavi induces Shrinivas to admit to sending her flowers.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi to Annoy Shrinivas
episodesList.summary: Bhargavi feels irritated at Shrinivas's behaviour and decides to teach him a lesson. Later, when he excels in his task, Bhargavi exhausts out of frustration.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Learns Vasudev's Intent
episodesList.summary: While Shrinivas returns to the palace, he grasps Vasudev's intention against him. Later, to spoil his plan, he takes Padmavati around.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Astounds Vasu
episodesList.summary: Vasu is excited to learn about Shrinivas' misfortune and tries to convey it to Padmavati. Later, Shrinivas shocks him with his appearance.

episodesList.title: Vasu Collides into Bhargavi
episodesList.summary: Vasu runs into Bhargavi at the market where she looks for the man who sent her the flowers. Meanwhile, Vasu says that he sent those flowers and decides to visit her home.

episodesList.title: Vasu Humiliates Shrinivas
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas feels heartbroken after Vasu humiliates him in front of Bhargavi and Rishi Vrigu. Later, Govindraj grows concerned about Shrinivas when he bursts into tears.

episodesList.title: Vasudev Reveals Shrinivas' Secret
episodesList.summary: Padmavati is shocked when Vasudev discloses that Shrinivas works at Rishi Vrigu's house as a cook. Later, Bhargavi goes to meet Shrinivas.

episodesList.title: Vasu Plans to Impress Bhargavi
episodesList.summary: Vasu decides to impress Bhargavi with a precious gift and gain control over Rishi Vrigu. Meanwhile, Shrinivas accepts Bhargavi's apology.

episodesList.title: Padmavati Gets Restless
episodesList.summary: Padmavati requests her friends to keep their eyes on Bhargavi and Shrinivas. Meanwhile, Bhargavi gets impatient to meet Shrinivas as she wants to impress him.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas, Bhargavi Become Friends
episodesList.summary: While Bhargavi is impressed by Shrinivas' story, he convinces her to become his friend. Elsewhere, Padmavati receives false information from her friends.

episodesList.title: Srinivas Stops Govindaraj
episodesList.summary: Govindaraj plans to inform Padmavati about Srinivas and Bhargavi's relationship in order to ask her help. However, Srinivas stops Govindaraj from doing so.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi Thinks of Shrinivas
episodesList.summary: Bhargavi gets lost in memories of Shrinivas and decides to give him a gift. Elsewhere, Kumar Vasu meets Rishi Vrigu to get in his good books.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi, Shrinivas Get Closer
episodesList.summary: Vasu plans on asking Rishi Vrigu for Bhargavi's hand in marriage. Later, Shrinivas and Bhargavi realise that they both bought gifts for each other.

episodesList.title: Padmavati Comes Across Bhargavi
episodesList.summary: Bhargavi goes the palace to return Vasu's gift and comes across Padmavati on the way. Elsewhere, Vasu tries to talk about his marriage but gets interrupted.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi Feels Heartbroken
episodesList.summary: Bhargavi returns Vasu's present which offends him, but he remains adamant to marry her. Elsewhere, Padmavati gets close with Shrinivas and waits for Bhargavi.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Supports Bhargavi
episodesList.summary: Padmavati talks down to Bhargavi which pushes Shrinivas to take a stand. Later, Padmavati and Bhargavi feel flustered by the challenge that lies ahead.

episodesList.title: Vasudev to Expose Padmavati
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas gets worried and helps Bhargavi as she gets her leg injured. Meanwhile, Vasudev plans to expose Padmavati's love for Shrinivas to the king.

episodesList.title: A Hazard for Shrinivas
episodesList.summary: Padmavati purposely puts a condition for her swayamvar to marry Shrinivas. Meanwhile, Shrinivas gets restless to learn about Padmavati's condition.

episodesList.title: Rishi Vrigu's Bad Dream
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas and Bhargavi feel excited about their union, but Rishi Vrigu's dream causes mayhem. Later, Shrinivas gets to know about Rishi Vrigu's Yagya with Bhargavi.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas, Bhargavi in a Fix
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas sees Rishi Vrigu performing a yagya and realises that Mahadev must comply with his disciple's wish. Later, Rishi Vrigu decides to get Bhargavi married.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Is Determined
episodesList.summary: Rishi Vrigu wants to keep away Bhargavi from Narayan, but Shrinivas decides to try his best to marry her. Elsewhere, Bhargavi gets a boon from Mahadev.

episodesList.title: Rishi Vrigu Makes a Confession
episodesList.summary: To impress Rishi Vrigu, Vasu presents him with wealth. Later, Rishi Vrigu considers Shrinivas as a suitable competitor for Vasu in Bhargavi's Swayamwar.

episodesList.title: Rishi Vrigu Gets Impressed
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas suggests Rishi Vrigu to wait till Padmavati's swayamvar, to find the best groom for Bhargavi. Later, Rishi Vrigu gets impressed by Vasu's behaviour.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Shrinivas
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas is shocked when Vasu tells him that Rishi Vrigu chooses him as Bhargavi's life partener. Later, Bhargavi decides to tell Shrinivas about her feelings.

episodesList.title: Srinivas, Bhargavi's Reunion!
episodesList.summary: Srinivas pacifies Bhargavi by leaving his leftover dessert for her to eat and get united. Later, they feel the love between them and get lost in the moment.

episodesList.title: Padmavati Is Delighted
episodesList.summary: Padmavati receives a letter bearing Shrinivas' name and feels happy. Meanwhile, Shrinivas makes a plan to prevent Kumar Vasu's evil motive.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi Becomes Anxious
episodesList.summary: Bhargavi gets restless to tell Shrinivas about her marriage with Vasu. Elsewhere, Vasu's men keep an eye on Shrinivas.

episodesList.title: Rishi Vrigu Probes Bhargavi
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas wants to meet Rishi Vrigu to persuade him about his marriage with Bhargavi. Elsewhere, Rishi Virgu enquires Bhargavi about an incident.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Saves Bhargavi, Padmavati
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas saves Bhargavi by telling Rishi Vrigu about two men leaving his house at night. He further reveals that they were following Padmavati.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas' Plan Works
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas is glad that his plan to stop Bhargavi and Vasu's marriage works. Later, as Vasu's secret informers get caught, the Maharaja decides to punish him.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi's Penalty for Shrinivas
episodesList.summary: Padmavati confronts Bhargavi and tells her that she has a special connection with Shrinivas. Bhargavi gets suspicious and punishes Shrinivas.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas' Romantic Gesture
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas takes Govindraj to the lake to help him collect all the lotuses to present them to Bhargavi. Meanwhile, Padmavati asks Vasudev to do the same.

episodesList.title: Vasu, Shrinivas in a Conflict
episodesList.summary: To make Bhargavi happy, Shrinivas collects all the lotuses from a pond and presents them to her. However, Vasu feels Shrinivas is taking away his credit.

episodesList.title: Rishi Vrigu Questions Shrinivas
episodesList.summary: Rishi Vrigu gets furious with Shrinivas and questions his intentions with Bhargavi. Later, Vasu visits Rishi Vrigu's house to meet Bhargavi.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Convinces Rishi Vrigu
episodesList.summary: Rishi Vrigu feels convinced by Shrinivas' answer about giving lotuses to Bhargavi. When Vidya wishes to invite Padmavati to her wedding, Bhargavi grows tense.

episodesList.title: Padmavati's Solemn Promise
episodesList.summary: After learning about her Swayamvar, Padmavati vows to marry Shrinivas. Later, Bhargavi presents Padmavati with Vidya's wedding invitation.

episodesList.title: Vidya, Kartik's New Beginning
episodesList.summary: Padmavati reunites with Bhargavi after realizing that Shrinivas and Bhargavi are not getting married. After Kartik arrives, he maintains a distance from Vidya.

episodesList.title: Vasu, Padmavati's Sudden Arrival
episodesList.summary: Vasu and Padmavati decide to attend the Yagya at Rishi Vrigu's house. However, Bhargavi feels upset when she is unable to sit with Shrinivas during the ritual.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas in a Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas is in a fix when Bhargavi is annoyed, and he tries to mend the situation. Meanwhile, Padmavati tells her friends that the Swayamvar is a fake one.

episodesList.title: Govindraj Decides to Meet Rajan
episodesList.summary: While Shrinivas gets disheartened, Govindraj gets tensed for him and decides to meet Rajan. Padmavati confronts Shrinivas and questions about his wedding.

episodesList.title: Padmavati Finds Shrinivas, Bhargavi
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas gets worried when Govindraj brings gifts from Padmavati's place. Later, when the former comforts Bhargavi, Padmavati gets envious.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi Questions Shrinivas
episodesList.summary: Bhargavi learns about Padmavati's gifts for Shrinivas and questions the latter. Rishi Vrigu receives a message from Ranjan and gets furious at Shrinivas.

episodesList.title: Rishi Virgu Fumes in Rage
episodesList.summary: Rishi Vrigu gets furious after he finds Shrinivas' claims of his prediction being wrong. Later, Shrinivas turns nervous when Padmavati tries to convey her love to him.

episodesList.title: Rishi Vrigu Makes a Decision
episodesList.summary: Rishi Vrigu gets surprised when Shrinivas points out his miscalculation about Padmavati's swayamvar. Rishi Vrigu decides to examine Shrinivas.

episodesList.title: Padmavati to Admit Her Feelings?
episodesList.summary: Srinivas and Bhargavi get romantic when the latter comes to collect flowers at the lake. Later, Srinivas stops her from confessing her feelings for him.

episodesList.title: Surprising News for Bhargavi
episodesList.summary: While Bhargavi feels anxious, Shrinivas informs Rishi Vrigu that their marriage will take place the next day. Elsewhere, Padmavati's Swayamvar takes place.

episodesList.title: Padmavati's Swayamvar Begins
episodesList.summary: On the day of Padmavati's Swayamvar, Ranjan introduces her to the suitors. Vasu names Shrinivas as the judge for the dance competition of the Swayamvar.

episodesList.title: Rishi Vrigu Devises a Plan
episodesList.summary: Rishi Vrigu devises a plan to examine Shrinivas and makes a decision about Bhargavi's wedding. Later, Bhargavi resolves to take a stand for herself.

episodesList.title: Befitting Reply by Shrinivas
episodesList.summary: While Vasu insults Shrinivas, the latter gives him an apt reply. Vasu makes a plan and requests Shrinivas to stay in the palace till Padmavati's wedding.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas' Escape Plan
episodesList.summary: To break free from the palace, Shrinivas decides to distract the guards. He summons Govindraj and laces the food given to the guards with Bhaang.

episodesList.title: Bhargivi, Shrinivas Meet Secretly
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas keeps a daring task before Govindraj in his absence. Later, he meets Bhargivi secretly and conveys to her the difficult situation he faced.

episodesList.title: Govindraj Is Saved
episodesList.summary: To save Govindraj from a difficult situation, Shrinivas misleads Padmavati and Vasu. Elsewhere, Rishi Virgu is all set to conduct Vasu and Bhargavi's wedding.

episodesList.title: Padmavati's Swayamvar Starts
episodesList.summary: The princes visit Maharaj Akash's palace to participate in Padmavati's Swayamvar. Elsewhere, Bhargavi wishes Shrinivas to prove his excellence before Rishi Vrigu.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Is in a Distress
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas gets upset when things go unexpectedly in the wrong direction, and he fails to control it. Later, he questions Mahadev.

episodesList.title: Rishi Vrigu's Suggestion
episodesList.summary: Rishi Vrigu advises Rajan to set up an archery competition to find a perfect match for Padmavati. Shrinivas makes a plan and seeks Govindraj's help.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Bhargavi gets shocked to learn about Rishi Vrigu's plan for Padmavati's Swayamvar. Later, Rishi Vrigu gets scared and decides to hide Bhargavi from Narayan.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Narrates the Story
episodesList.summary: Mahadev shares the story of the most powerful bows in the world, Sharanga and Pinaka. Rishi Vrigu offers prayers to Mahadev in front of the fire to know about Narayan.

episodesList.title: Rishi Vrigu's Quest for Narayan
episodesList.summary: Rishi Vrigu, with his divine vision, discovers the presence of Narayan in Venkatgiri. He then decides to protect Bhargavi as long as Narayan is in the palace.

episodesList.title: Padmavati's Weird Demand
episodesList.summary: When Rishi Vrigu fails to select a suitable groom for Padmavati, she asks Akash to allow Shrinivas to participate in the Swayamvar. Will Shrinivas agree?

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Wins the Swayamvar
episodesList.summary: The detractors of Shrinivas get dumbstruck when he excels in archery and takes Padmavati with him. Rishi Vrigu learns about Narayan's form and fears about Bhargavi.

episodesList.title: Krishna Reveals His Feelings
episodesList.summary: Krishna confesses the truth about his love and shares the reasons behind his actions. Meanwhile, Rishi Vrigu gets adamant about conducting Bargavi's wedding.

episodesList.title: Padmavati's Shocking Experience
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas reveals himself as the supreme being to Padmavati and finally displays his Swaroop. Later, Rishi Vrigu confronts Rajan with a shocking proposal.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi Is in Pain
episodesList.summary: Padmavati returns to the palace and apologises to King Akash for her past deeds. Disappointed Bhargavi wants to know about Shrinivas' love as the wedding comes nearer.

episodesList.title: Padmavati's Self Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas comes before Bhargavi and assures her about his love. When Padmavati loses all hope, she gets determined to finish her life.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Marries Padmavati
episodesList.summary: To perform his duty, a disheartened Shrinivas gets married to Padmavati. Bhargavi confesses her love for Shrinivas in her letter and decides to leave Venkatgiri.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Confronts Rishi Vrigu
episodesList.summary: While Bhargavi leaves Venkatgiri, Shrinivas confronts Rishi Vrigu to question the latter's intention. Later, Rishi Vrigu apologises to Shrinivas for his selfish desires.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi Is Questioned
episodesList.summary: Bhargavi swears to the Goddess that she will only consider Shrinivas as her husband. Later, some villagers visit the temple and ask Bhargavi about her husband.

episodesList.title: Rishi Vrigu Is Penalised
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas is determined to punish the person behind Bhargavi's distress. Rishi Vrigu is aware of Narayan's penalty and gets tensed when King Akash calls him.

episodesList.title: Rishi Vrigu Receives an Ultimatum
episodesList.summary: Akash holds Rishi Vrigu responsible for the outcomes and wants everything fixed before sunset. When Shrinivas sticks to his decision, Rishi Vrigu faces hardships.

episodesList.title: Rishi Vrigu Grows Anxious
episodesList.summary: Kumar Vasu faces Rishi Vrigu's wrath when he wants to find Bhargavi to punish her. On the other hand, Rishi Vrigu gets shocked to see Vidya's ruined wedding hall.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas' Shocking Condition
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas makes a condition for Padmavati when the latter is determined to do anything to please Shrinivas. Bhargavi gets restless to see the corruption in Uma's village.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi Learns about Uma
episodesList.summary: Govindraj informs Rishi Vrigu that Padmavati and Vasu are searching for Bhargavi. When Bhargavi gets hurt by Uma's behaviour, the latter comes to tell the truth.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi Takes an Oath
episodesList.summary: Bhargavi vows to Narayan that she will reunite Gauri and Shankar. Later, Padmavati makes a request to Shrinivas about their marital relationship.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi Convinces Aai
episodesList.summary: Bhargavi reaches Aai's home and convinces the latter to agree to Gauri and Shankar's wedding. Later, Bhargavi gets lost in Shrinivas' thoughts.

episodesList.title: Aai Ridicules Shankar
episodesList.summary: Padmavati is delighted as Shrinivas takes her on a trip. Meanwhile, after seeing Shankar's strange attire, Aai disapproves of Gauri marrying him.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Helps Shankar
episodesList.summary: As Shankar walks around the forest feeling defeated, Mahadev appears in a guise of a hermit and guides him. Shankar gets heavily compensated for helping Vasu.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi's Valiant Efforts
episodesList.summary: Bhargavi resolves to end Gauri's forced marriage to Alok and seeks help from Narayan. In the meantime, Vasu deceives Shankar in order to reach Bhargavi.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Kumar Vasu
episodesList.summary: Kumar Vasu gets shocked to learn about Bhargavi's feelings for Shrinivas. Later, he informs Bhargavi about Shrinivas and Padmavati's marriage to take his revenge.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi Feels Shattered
episodesList.summary: Bhargavi feels miserable when Vasu tells her that Shrinivas is not worthy of her love. She loses her senses but wakes up to Shrinivas making her a promise.

episodesList.title: Kumar Vasu's Vicious Plan
episodesList.summary: Padmavati tells Shrinivas that he should stay with her until there is some news of Bhargavi. Kumar Vasu makes a vile plan to prevent Shrinivas from meeting Bhargavi.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas to Locate Bhargavi?
episodesList.summary: Govindraj learns of Bhargavi's exact location and informs Shrinivas. However, Padmavati becomes concerned and demands proof of Bhargavi's whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Rishi Bhrigu Reveals the Truth
episodesList.summary: Akash gets shocked when Rishi Bhrigu discloses the truth about Shrinivas' real identity. Rishi Bhrigu seeks Mahadev's help to prevent Shrinivas from meeting Bhargavi.

episodesList.title: Mahadev, Kanyakumari's Tale
episodesList.summary: To stop Shrinivas from marrying Bhargavi, Shukracharya reminds Mahadev of his past with Kanyakumari. Later, Mahadev tells the tale of Kanyakumari.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Restricts Shrinivas
episodesList.summary: Mahadev decides to locate Shrinivas and prevent him from meeting Bhargavi while Vasu devises a plan to kidnap Uma.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi Becomes Agitated
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas refuses to accept Mahadev's staggering condition. As a result, Bhargavi becomes distressed since Shrinivas failed to reach her before sunset.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Gets Desperate
episodesList.summary: Vasu instructs Aai to look after Bhargavi and keep her away from Shrinivas. Later, a desperate Shrinivas arrives at Aai's house to persuade Bhargavi.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi Ignores Shrinivas
episodesList.summary: Upon Aai's request, Bhargavi refuses to meet Shrinivas. Later, Lord Mahadev assures Gauri that Shrinivas will find a way to meet Bhargavi.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Seeks Govindraj's Help
episodesList.summary: Bhargavi declines Kumar Vasu's invitation to attend the Gokul Ashtami celebrations. Thereupon, Shrinivas convinces Govindraj to help him meet Bhargavi.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas' Epic Plan
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas devises a plan with Govindraj, and they disguise themselves as a married couple to meet Bhargavi. Later, Shrinivas finds a way to visit Karveerpur.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Visits Karveerpur
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas and Govindraj wear disguises and arrive at Karveerpur with butter for the Janmashtami celebration. When Kumar Vasu seeks their help, Shrinivas gives a condition.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Celebrates Dahi Handi
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas resolves to engage in the Dahi Handi celebration as Vasu fails to break the pot. After noticing Bhargavi leave the festivity, he slips while climbing.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi Worries for Shrinivas
episodesList.summary: After Bhargavi shows trust in him, Shrinivas, disguised as Venkatesh, breaks the earthen pot. After the pyramid collapses, Bhargavi rushes to his aid.

episodesList.title: Srinivas Helps Bhargavi
episodesList.summary: Srinivas tells Govindaraj that Bhargavi needs to love herself first before she can truly love him. Later, Srinivas finds Bhargavi in pain at the lake and helps her.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas' Mischievous Act
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas steals Bhargavi's clothes while she is bathing in the river. When Govindraj gets worried, he climbs a tree and returns the clothes.

episodesList.title: Kumar Vasu Gets Agitated
episodesList.summary: Kumar Vasu gets furious to see Bhargavi's concern when she questions him about Shrinivas' whereabouts. Later, Aai plans to help Kumar Vasu keep Bhargavi distracted.

episodesList.title: Padmavati Announces a Competition
episodesList.summary: Padmavati meets Bhargavi and asks her to participate in the dance competition. When Bhargavi gets challenged, Shrinivas urges her to take part.

episodesList.title: Kumar Vasu Devises a Plan
episodesList.summary: Kumar Vasu makes a devious plan against Bhargavi to take revenge for his humiliation. Shrinivas decides to help Bhargavi to gain self-confidence when she feels dejected.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Comforts Bhargavi
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas tries to boost Bhargavi's confidence when she decides to withdraw her name from the competition. Will Bhargavi regain her confidence?

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Bhargavi
episodesList.summary: Mahadev disguises himself to confront Kumar Vasu and reveals the name of the guy who stole Bhargavi's clothes. Soon, Bhargavi receives shocking news about Venkatesh.

episodesList.title: Venkatesh Accepts His Fault
episodesList.summary: Venkatesh accepts his mistake when Bhargavi confronts him about his notorious actions. However, he claims that he had no evil intentions toward her.

episodesList.title: Venkatesh's Promise to Bhargavi
episodesList.summary: Kumar Vasu orders Padmavati to lose in the dancing competition. Elsewhere, Venkatesh accepts Bhargavi's request and promises to bring Shrinivas to the contest.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Discovers Vasu's Evil Plan
episodesList.summary: Venkatesh promises Padmavati that he will bring Shrinivas to the dance contest. Furthermore, Shrinivas learns of Vasu's evil plot against Padmavati.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas to Judge the Competition
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas surprises Bhargavi and Padmavati with his sudden arrival. Bhargavi and Padmavati choose to make Shrinivas the judge of the competition.

episodesList.title: Bhargavi Rejects Vasu
episodesList.summary: Vasu forces Bhargavi to marry him after she wins the competition, but she refuses his proposal. Later, he decides to teach Venkatesh a lesson for manipulating Bhargavi.

episodesList.title: Vasu Gets Manipulated
episodesList.summary: Kumar Vasu gets influenced by Bharya, who asks him to put Venkatesh and Shrinivas on the death row. Vasu then visits Shukracharya following Bharya's request.

episodesList.title: Kohlasur Has Risen
episodesList.summary: Shukracharya awakens Kohlasur to take revenge on Vishnu after several years. Elsewhere, Raja Akash meets Padmavati, and Bhargavi meets her parents.

episodesList.title: Kohlasur Declares War
episodesList.summary: Kohlasur warns Kumar Vasu from ordering him when the latter tells him to kill everyone. After Shrinivas and Venkatesh appear in front of him, he declares war on them.

episodesList.title: Mahalaxmi's Devi Ambabai Form
episodesList.summary: Bhargavi comes before Kohlasur and wants to teach him a lesson for his heinous conduct. She acquires Mahalaxmi's powers and annihilates him in Ambabai's form.

episodesList.title: Shrinivas Displays His Swaroop
episodesList.summary: Shrinivas reveals the truth in front of everyone and displays his Swaroop. Rishi Vrigu apologises to Shrinivas for his previous deeds and requests him to marry Bhargavi.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Pledge to Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna makes a promise to Radha and announces to celebrate Navaratri to empower the women in the world. Later, he invites all the Devtas to Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Exceptional Plan
episodesList.summary: To make Navaratri special, Krishna plans something exceptional for women. Later, Radha feels dejected when Balaram and Saambh make a blunder in Krishna's plan.

episodesList.title: Radha Feels Dejected
episodesList.summary: Radha gets disheartened to think about the questions Krishna will face in the future for not marrying her. Elsewhere, Shukracharya devises a devious plan against Krishna.

episodesList.title: Shukracharya Awakens Apasmar
episodesList.summary: Krishna makes Mahadev take his Nataraj avatar so that all the wives who see him can feel Mahabhava. Later, Shukracharya wakes up Apasmar, who can erase memories.

episodesList.title: Shukracharya's Evil Instruction
episodesList.summary: Krishna tells Parvati's story of how Apasmar treated her. Shukracharya instructs Apasmar to snatch women's memories and make them unwise.

episodesList.title: Radha's Decision Upsets Krishna
episodesList.summary: Apasmar casts his spell on the women and eliminates the positive vibes from them. Krishna gets bothered by Radha's decision to not attend Mahadev's Anand Nritya.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Strategy Against Apasmar
episodesList.summary: While Apasmar visits Kailash to obstruct Mahadev's Anand Nritya, Krishna tricks Apasmar to thwart his plan. Radha gets furious to see Krishna's behaviour toward Subhadra.

episodesList.title: Radha Gets Furious
episodesList.summary: Angry, Radha questions Krishna's intention for ignoring a drowning Subhadra. Elsewhere, Shukracharya learns the exact location of Mahadev.

episodesList.title: Krishna Takes a Decision
episodesList.summary: An anxious Balaram informs Krishna about Apasmar's visit to Kailash. Afterwards, Krishna decides to gratify Radha by narrating the story of Trijata.

episodesList.title: Parvati Warns Apasmar
episodesList.summary: While Apasmar attempts to stop Mahadev's Ananda Nritya, Parvati furiously warns Apasmar. Later, Mahadev fumes in anger when Apasmar attacks him to prevent his dance.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Convince Apasmar
episodesList.summary: Apasmar feels victorious as Parvati, Radha and other females turn into the victims of his majestic power. Krishna confronts Apasmar in an effort to make him understand.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Rudra Tandav!
episodesList.summary: Furious, Mahadev starts Rudra Tandav and throws an open challenge to Apasmar when he boasts of his devil powers. Apasmar grasps super strength from the devils to overcome Mahadev.

episodesList.title: Krishna Knits a Plan
episodesList.summary: Saambh informs Krishna and Balaram about the women who left the palace due to Apasmar's power. Krishna designs a plan to locate them and gives his flute to Balaram.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Fumes in Anger
episodesList.summary: Shukracharya seeks Rahu and Ketu's help to prevent Balaram and Saambh to find out Radha. Elsewhere, Krishna grows anxious when Mahadev furiously decides to kill Apasmar.

episodesList.title: Parvati Takes a Decision
episodesList.summary: Parvati decides to create another world only for the women to stay away from men. Krishna narrates Rahu and Ketu's involvement in Radha-Krishna's eternal love story.

episodesList.title: Krishna Narrates Samudra Manthan
episodesList.summary: Krishna describes to Balaram why he and Radha never got united. He recounts the incident of Samudra Manthan and Swarbhanu's intent to get the Amrit.

episodesList.title: Samudra Manthan Takes Place
episodesList.summary: Krishna explains how the Asurs and Devtas took part in the Samudra Manthan. The Asurs grabbed Vasuki's head, and the Devtas held the tail. Swarbhanu urges Shukracharya to stop it.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Great Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: Mahadev drinks the poisonous Halahal during the Samudra Manthan to save the Asurs and the Devtas. Later, Mohini entices the Asurs and the Devtas with her charm.

episodesList.title: Krishna Briefs the Reason
episodesList.summary: Krishna tells everyone that the Kaal Sarpa Dosha is why he and Radha remain separated. Mahadev's Tandav Nritya brings the realisation of love in Radha and Parvati.

episodesList.title: Krishna Searches for Radha
episodesList.summary: Parvati urges theÂ women to sense the love of their husbands after she feels guilty forÂ misinterpreting Mahadev.Â Krishna gets determined to find Radha and other females.

episodesList.title: Rahu, Ketu's Evil Move
episodesList.summary: To keep Radha away from Krishna, Rahu and Ketu use their powers to send Radha far away, so that the couple can never meet. Can Krishna overcome this setback?

episodesList.title: Krishna Faces Rahu and Ketu
episodesList.summary: Despite Saambh's refusal, Krishna sends him away. Moreover, he asks Balaram to leave since this is a battle that he must fight by himself.

episodesList.title: Radha Sees the Future
episodesList.summary: Radha forsees the Ardh-Nareshwar Avatar and realises that it is she and Krishna. The Devtas feel elated about this Mahabhaav, which infuriates Rahu and Ketu.

episodesList.title: Parvati Receives Radha's Invite
episodesList.summary: Devi Parvati becomes ecstatic after receiving Radha's invite to celebrate Vijayadashami in Dwarka. Later, Radha and Krishna welcome Mahadev and Parvati to Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Shankhachur Visits Dwarka
episodesList.summary: Shankhachur comes to Dwarka for the Havaan as he wishes to meet Radha and garner her praises. However, when Radha ignores him and meets Krishna, Shankhachur gets irked.

episodesList.title: Balaram Grows Agitated
episodesList.summary: Balaram gets infuriated after learning about Shankhachur's behaviour towards Revati. Elsewhere, Damini advises Shankhachur to meet Shukracharya to ploy against Krishna.

episodesList.title: Shankhachur Abducts the Gopis
episodesList.summary: Parvati prepares to welcome Radha and Krishna in the Golok. Meanwhile, an infuriated Shankhachur kidnaps the Gopis after they belittle him.

episodesList.title: Parvati Grows Anxious
episodesList.summary: Mahadev comforts Parvati when she gets worried thinking about Krishna's intention. Elsewhere, Krishna gets furious when Shankhachur forces the Gopis to marry him.

episodesList.title: Radha to Save the Gopis!
episodesList.summary: Krishna teaches a lesson to Shankhachur as he tries to attack the Gopis. Radha decides to convince Shankhachur of her love to free the Gopis from his trap

episodesList.title: Shukracharya Advises Shankhachur
episodesList.summary: Shukracharya instructs Shankhachur to give a specific condition to Radha when he meets with her. Later, Balaram gets furious at Krishna for not looking for Shankhachur.

episodesList.title: Krishna Gets Blamed
episodesList.summary: When Shankhachur takes Radha with him to fulfil his ill intentions, Krishna gets accused of letting her go. Later, Krishna reveals his plan to Balaram.

episodesList.title: The End of Shankhachur
episodesList.summary: Krishna reaches Shankhachur's place and puts an end to the latter's life for his misdeeds. Later, Radha and Krishna get engaged in the Rasleela along with the Gopis.

episodesList.title: Shukracharya's Devious Motive!
episodesList.summary: To bring an end to mankind, Shukracharya invites the power of Asuras. Fearing the inevitable destruction, Krishna decides to act against Shukracharya.

episodesList.title: Krodhasur Spreads Rage
episodesList.summary: Shukacharya invocates Shadaripu to destroy humanity, and then the latter calls out Krodhasur. Later, Krodhasur visits Dwarka to spread rage and bring about Krishna's end.

episodesList.title: Lobhasur's Evil Motive
episodesList.summary: Due to Krodhasur's act, Balaram faces the people of Dwarka's rage. Shadripu invokes Lobhasur, who manipulates Saambh against Balaram.

episodesList.title: Mohasur Misleads Rukmini
episodesList.summary: Mohasur misleads Rukmini into believing that Radha is Krishna's priority. Elsewhere, Sukracharya decides to spread negativity and darkness in Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Krishna Confronts Shadripu
episodesList.summary: Krishna decides to confront Shadripu when darkness descends on Dwarka. Later, Krishna gives a shocking sanction to Shadripu.

episodesList.title: Krishna Explains to Radha
episodesList.summary: Radha gets puzzled when everyone lashes out at her for asking about Krishna's whereabouts. Later, Krishna informs Radha about Krodhasur's control over everyone.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Tale of Ram Rajya
episodesList.summary: Krishna talks about Ram Rajya and the significance of Deepavali. Krishna then defeats all the Asurs by chanting Lord Ram's name and peace returns to Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Radha Takes a Decision
episodesList.summary: Krishna asks Rishi Garga to write Garga Sanhita based on Radha and Krishna's Prem-Bhakti Ras. Radha decides to make Rishi Garga witness her and Krishna's love story.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna to Relive the Past
episodesList.summary: Krishna lives in Vrindavan and Radha in Varsana to experience the love of their past. Radha can feel Krishna's presence and gets excited to meet him.

episodesList.title: Krishna Devises a Plan
episodesList.summary: Krishna gets restless to meet Radha and he makes a plan to visit Barsana along with Balaram. Later, Radha gets furious and gives a firm condition to her Sakhis.

episodesList.title: Krishna Disguised Himself
episodesList.summary: Krishna disguises himself as Gopadevi and visits Barsana along with Balaram to meet with Radha before the half-moon. Radha gets mesmerised when Krishna plays the Veena for her

episodesList.title: Kansa to Meet with Bakasur?
episodesList.summary: With the energy of Radha and Krishna's love, a dormant demon, Bakasur awakes and decides to meet Kansa. Kansa takes an oath after learning about Krishna's survival.

episodesList.title: Krishna Makes Radha Furious
episodesList.summary: Radha fumes in rage as Krishna makes fun of her attire and appearance. Later, Bakasur keenly searches for Krishna to seek revenge for Putana's death.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Gopadevi Form
episodesList.summary: Radha sends Krishna a letter, asking him to visit her. However, she identifies him when he arrives to meet her in the guise of Gopadevi.

episodesList.title: Radha and Krishna Meet
episodesList.summary: According to Radha's promise, she and Krishna meet on a half-moon night. On the other hand, Bakasur finally sees Balaram and gets proof that Krishna is alive.

episodesList.title: Balaram to Save Barsana
episodesList.summary: Bakasur creates a terrible storm in Barsana. While Balaram confronts Bakasur, Vrishabhanu gets worried about the demon and decides to move Vrindavan.

episodesList.title: Radha Visits Vrindavan
episodesList.summary: Radha gets overjoyed when Krishna welcomes her in Vrindavan. Elsewhere, after being defeated by Balaram, a furious Bakasur seeks permission from Kans to kill Krishna.

episodesList.title: A Surprise for Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna surprises Radha as he reveals a romantic gift for her. Later, Kans threatens Bakasur, making him find a ray of hope in tracing Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Fights Bakasur
episodesList.summary: Krishna dodges the ball that Radha throws with all her might, knocking Bakasur out. Later, Krishna and Bakasur engage in a fierce battle.

episodesList.title: Radha Stops Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna gets furious when Bakasur returns to Vrindavan, and he prepares to destroy him. However, Radha stops Krishna because she doesn't want to lose him again.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Condition for Radha
episodesList.summary: Krishna promises to not attach himself to Bakasur under the condition that Radha won't attack him. Later, Krishna goes to Bakasur who swallows him alive in front of Radha.

episodesList.title: Bhadrakali to Defeat Bakasur
episodesList.summary: Parvati comes before Bakasur in the form of Bhadrakali and decides to kill him after his heinous acts. Later, Radha grows anxious and frees Krishna from her oath.

episodesList.title: Krishna Defeats Bakasur
episodesList.summary: Radha frees Krishna from his oath, and the latter defeats Bakasur, releasing Prince Utkal from his curse. Later, Krishna uses the Ashta Sakhas to envy Radha.

episodesList.title: Kans Fumes in Anger
episodesList.summary: Radha gets jealous of her sakhis when Krishna promises to take them on a tour. Meanwhile, Kansa gets infuriated as Akrur informs him about Bakasur's death.

episodesList.title: Kansa Takes an Oath
episodesList.summary: Krishna plans a surprise for Radha and arranges a special festival in Vrindavan. Kansa gets furious and swears not to meet Jarasandha until he kills Krishna.

episodesList.title: Asti Makes a Firm Decision
episodesList.summary: Asti decides to stop Kansa from committing another sin and asks Akrur's help to meet Krishna. Later, Krishna gets shocked to learn about Ashta Sakhi's decision.

episodesList.title: Radha's Special Announcement
episodesList.summary: Prapti advises Kansa to get in touch with demons who are more powerful than Bakasur. Radha decides to make arrangements for the Maha Raas festival in Vrindavan.

episodesList.title: Radha's Shocking Condition
episodesList.summary: Mahadev and Parvati eagerly wait to attend the Maha Raas Utsav in Vrindavan. When Radha learns about Krishna's tricks, she puts forth a condition to him.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna's Raas Leela
episodesList.summary: Krishna meets Mahadev and devises a plan to keep up his promise to Radha. Later, the residents of Vrindavan enjoy the special Raas-Leela celebrations.

episodesList.title: Lakshmi-Narayan's Swaroop
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Radha reveal their real Swaroop to the Ashta Sakhis. Later, Radha is shocked to see the changes in Ashta Sakhis' behavior towards her.

episodesList.title: Kansa to Meet Aristasura
episodesList.summary: Yashoda and Kirtida are shocked to witness the Ashta Sakhis' behaviour towards them. Upon Akrur's advice, Kansa decides to meet Aristasura and kill Krishna.

episodesList.title: Radha to Impress Yashoda
episodesList.summary: Radha is concerned that the Gopis have discovered her and Krishna's true identity. Later, she convinces the Gopis to look after Yashoda in order to impress her.

episodesList.title: Kans Sends a Bison
episodesList.summary: The residents of Vrindavan are glad when Kans sends them a black Bison for protection. In the meantime, Krishna, Balaram and Radha's suspicions grow.

episodesList.title: The Birth of Demon Aristhasur
episodesList.summary: Mahadev tells Devi Parvati how Sage Vartantu was cursed and turned into the demon Aristhasur. Parvati is worried about the consequences of Aristhasur in Vrindavan.

episodesList.title: Asthi in Grave Trouble
episodesList.summary: Despite Radha's refusal, Balaram feels enraged at Aristhasur and decides to warn him. Elsewhere, Kans coerces Asthi into performing a Yagya against Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna Takes Accountability
episodesList.summary: Nand Baba commands Balaram leave Vrindavan and go on an exile. However, Krishna takes the blame and bids goodbye to everyone as Radha joins him.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna Go on an Exile
episodesList.summary: Radha and Krishna depart from Vrindavan as they go on an exile together. Later, Krishna builds a hut amidst the woods and spends time with Radha.

episodesList.title: Arishtasura Unveils His Identity
episodesList.summary: The residents of Vrindavan panic as the black bison turns out to be Arishtasura. Deceiving him, Balaram leads Arishtasura to Krishna's habitat.

episodesList.title: Arishtasura Seeks Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: After Krishna frees him from his curse, Arishtasura begs for forgiveness as he realises his mistake. Later, Krishna asks Balaram to return to Vrindavan.

episodesList.title: Nanda Apologises to Krishna
episodesList.summary: Balaram tells Nanda and the people of Vrindavan that Krishna won't return until they realise their mistake. Later, Nanda apologises to Krishna for punishing him.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Lesson to Vrindavanbasis
episodesList.summary: Krishna gives a valuable lesson to Vrindavanbasis as they realise their mistakes. Meanwhile, the Devtas hail Vrindavan for its beauty, leaving Brahma furious.

episodesList.title: Brahma Dev Confronts Krishna
episodesList.summary: An enraged Brahma Dev vows to confront Krishna and ask him to tell Radha to take her words back. Elsewhere, Yashoda feels happy to learn that Radha likes Krishna.

episodesList.title: Brahma Dev in Disguise
episodesList.summary: Taking a guise of a sage, Brahma Dev visits Vrindavan to prove his statement. Later, he hatches a plan and tries to manipulate the Sakhis against Krishna.

episodesList.title: Radha Gets Disheartened
episodesList.summary: Radha is in shock learning of Krishna's move to change Yashoda's decision about his marriage with Radha. Elsewhere, Brahma Dev abolishes the Sakhis of Vrindavan.

episodesList.title: Yashoda's Shocking Condition
episodesList.summary: Yashoda furiously gives a shocking condition to Krishna when all the sakhis get abolished from Vrindavan. Balaram is shocked to learn about Brahma Dev's vile plan.

episodesList.title: Radha in a Bind
