episodesList.summary: While Yashoda is concerned about her demand, Radha is unsure how to fulfil Yashoda's wish. Meanwhile, Brahma Dev plots to derail Radha's plan.

episodesList.title: Kans Summons Agasura
episodesList.summary: Brahma Dev apologises to Radha for his arrogance after realising the mistake. On the other hand, Kans summons an enormous serpent named Agasura to kill Krishna.

episodesList.title: Agasur Poisons the Kheer
episodesList.summary: Krishna welcomes the Vrindavanbasis and convinces Kritika to eat the Kheer. Agasur gets determined to kill Krishna so arrives at Vrindavan and poisons the Kheer.

episodesList.title: Kirtida Makes an Announcement
episodesList.summary: Kirtida is disappointed as Krishna ignores her in front of everyone. Krishna convinces Kirtida with his tricks and she announces her consent to Radha's marriage with him.

episodesList.title: Agasura's Villainous Decision
episodesList.summary: Agasura confronts Kans and promises to kill Krishna on the day of his wedding. Later, Radha feels dejected when Krishna asks her to rethink about their marriage.

episodesList.title: Krishna Is in a Tough Spot
episodesList.summary: Agasura hatches a plan and creates a huge mountain in front of the Vishnu temple. Krishna grows anxious as Balaram requests him to inform his parents about his decision.

episodesList.title: Krishna, Radha's Wedding Prep
episodesList.summary: Krishna gets into his childhood, to fulfil Radha's wish. Radha summons the Devtas and asks them to conduct her and Krishna's wedding at the auspicious moment.

episodesList.title: Krishna Weds Radha
episodesList.summary: Radha and Krishna take part in the wedding rituals in the presence of the Devi and Devtas. After their marriage, Krishna puts a tough question before Radha.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna's Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: Radha and Krishna decide to eliminate the memory of their wedding from the minds of their dear ones. While the people of Vrindavan visit the Vishnu mandir, Agasur plans to kill Krishna.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Joyful Moment
episodesList.summary: Krishna spends a cheerful moment with Radha, Balaram, and the Ashta Sakhis. Later, Balaram is shocked to discover Lalita and Vishakha entering a terrible cave.

episodesList.title: Krishna to the Rescue
episodesList.summary: Krishna requests Agasura to release the people of Vrindavan from his captivity. Agasura agrees but asks Krishna to become his meal in exchange.

episodesList.title: Radha Feels Disheartened
episodesList.summary: Radha gets disheartened when Vrishbhanu and Kirtida decide to return to Barsana. Kans makes a decision to meet with Narada to ask for a suitable way to kill Krishna.

episodesList.title: Indra Dev's Bizarre Demand
episodesList.summary: To trouble the Vrindavanbasis, Indra Dev keeps weird desires before them for his Pooja. Radha feels disheartened about leaving Vrindavan and Krishna.

episodesList.title: Mahadev's Advice for Narad
episodesList.summary: Mahadev asks Narad to fulfil Indradev's wish and to deliver his message to Kans. Elsewhere, the Vrindavanbasi begin the ritual according to Indradev's demand.

episodesList.title: Devraj Indra Gets Furious
episodesList.summary: Devraj Indra gets furious as the Vrindravanbasi refuse to fulfil his unwanted demands. He furiously teams up with Kans to punish the Vrindavanbasi and take his revenge.

episodesList.title: Vrindavan Faces Indra Dev's Wrath
episodesList.summary: The Vrindavanbasi get into trouble when the entire Vrindavan floods due to heavy rainfall. Indra Dev decides to take revenge for the dishonour he faces in Vrindavan.

episodesList.title: Krishna to Rescue Vrindavanbasi
episodesList.summary: Krishna decides to shift Vrindavanbasi to Govardhan Parvat to save them from Indra Dev. However, they get scared and question Krishna's decision.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Govardhan Leela
episodesList.summary: Krishna lifts the Govardhan hill to protect the Vrindavan from the terrible rain and thunderstorms. Elsewhere, Kans gets furious and summons Indra Dev.

episodesList.title: Vrindavan Faces an Outrage
episodesList.summary: The Vrindavan people face a sudden calamity due to Indra Dev's terrifying rage. Later, Akrur gets astonished to see Krishna's Govardhan Leela and apologises to him.

episodesList.title: Indra Dev's Apology
episodesList.summary: Indra Dev realises his mistake to fight against Krishna and apologises to the latter. Kans gets infuriated when Akrur advises him to change his decision to kill Krishna.

episodesList.title: Radha Bids Farewell!
episodesList.summary: When Krishna asks Radha to leave, she is concerned that she has failed despite her best efforts. Later, Radha bids everyone a tearful goodbye.

episodesList.title: Krishna Brings Radha Back
episodesList.summary: Radha is surprised to see Krishna and he wishes to bring her back to Dwarka. Later, Krishna informs Radha about the Garg-Samhita.

episodesList.title: Radha, Krishna in a Pickle
episodesList.summary: Radha gets intrigued by the prospect of visiting Golok and requests that Krishna prepare for it. Meanwhile, Saambh and the others request Krishna for a celebration.

episodesList.title: Krishna in a Tough Spot
episodesList.summary: Radha gets shattered after learning about Krishna's fate regarding his death. Later, Krishna gets into a dilemma when Radha asks for a promise.

episodesList.title: Akrur Brings Gifts for Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna hinders Akrur's attempts to hunt a deer to gift the former. Later, while Akrur visits Krishna with the special gift, Radha fears Krishna's death.

episodesList.title: Krishna Advises the Dwarkabasis
episodesList.summary: Krishna advises the Dwarkabasis to remain united under all circumstances and enjoy the moment. Saambh gets attracted to Jara's arrow and is determined to have it.

episodesList.title: Mahadev Reveals a Story
episodesList.summary: While Parvati grows anxious, Mahadev reveals the story behind the fate of Krishna's death. Later, Jara accuses Saambh of stealing his arrow and a conflict ensues.

episodesList.title: Radha-Krishna Share a Moment
episodesList.summary: Radha and Krishna spend their last moments together before Radha's heartbreaking goodbye. Elsewhere, Jara and Saambh hatch a plan for each other to take revenge.

episodesList.title: Saambh Gets Punished
episodesList.summary: Krishna gets disheartened and refuses to play the flute as Radha departs for Golok. Krishna announces the punishment for Saambh for stealing Jara's arrow.

episodesList.title: Radha Returns to Golok
episodesList.summary: Radha completes her life on earth abiding by the curse of Shreedama and returns to Golok. Elsewhere, Jara feels dejected as Krishna does not accept his gift.

episodesList.title: Saambh Makes a Profound Vow
episodesList.summary: Saambh expresses regret for his behaviour and vows restraint toward Lakshmana. However, Jara's attempt to approach Krishna enrages Saambh again.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Last Meeting
episodesList.summary: Rukmini breaks down in tears and asks Krishna to guide her amidst this tough situation. Later, Krishna meets his family for the last time and puts forth a request.

episodesList.title: Krishna Bids Goodbye
episodesList.summary: Before leaving Dwarka, Krishna has Rukmini revisit their beautiful times. Later, he tells Balaram of his departure, and they begin to weep uncontrollably.

episodesList.title: Krishna Breathes His Last
episodesList.summary: Jara shoots an arrow towards Krishna's foot that injures him mortally, and he passes away. With Krishna's death, Kali Yug begins with a cataclysm on earth.

soundtrack.title: Tracklisting
soundtrack.composer: The original music of the series is composed by Surya Raj Kamal with the background score by Jitesh Panchal and Sushant Pawar. Lyrics are penned by Shekhar Astitwa, Neetu Pandey Kranti, Vikas Chauhan, Dr. Kannan, and others. The shlokas, mantras, and excerpts from various Hindu mythology scriptures and texts like Bhagavata Purana and Brahma Vaivarta Purana have been transformed into various themes. Popular devotional songs like Shri Krishna Govind Hare Murari, Govind Bolo Hari Gopal Bolo, and Bolo Jai Kanhaiya Lal Ki have also been recreated. Some shlokas, bhajans, songs, and background music from Swastik's another magnum opus series Mahabharat are also used in the series. Surya Raj Kamal has composed more than 20 original compositions for Raasleela of Radha-Krishn. Star Bharat in December 2018 uploaded a video consisting of 14 songs from the series till that date.

tagline: RadhaKrishn is an Indian Hindi-language television drama series that premiered on 1 October 2018 on Star Bharat and is also digitally available on Disney+ Hotstar.

title: Roop – Mard Ka Naya Swaroop
summary: Roop – Mard Ka Naya Swaroop (transl. Roop – New Form of Man) is an Indian television series that aired on Colors TV from 28 May 2018 to 17 May 2019. The series challenges stereotypes and aims to redefine the new age man, who doesn't consider being sensitive a sign of femininity. It stars  Shashank Vyas and Donal Bisht.
plot: Roopendra "Roop" Singh Vaghela is an eight-year-old boy who deals with patriarchal norms of society. He likes cooking, washing and sewing the clothes which are considered female jobs by the orthodox society. Shamsher doesn't want Roop to stay with the women of the house so he decides to send Roop away to a military boarding school.

articleSections.title: 15 years later
articleSections.text:
Roop returns home and decides to oppose Shamsher's misogynistic views. Roop meets Ishika Patel and falls in love with her. Ranveer, on the other hand, gets attracted to Ishika's beauty and wants to possess her. Roop ends up marrying Ishika while trying to save her from Ranveer. Ishika doesn't trust Roop at first, but later falls for him. Ranveer seeks revenge and kidnaps Ishika. Shamsher kills Ranveer while protecting Roop and Ishika.
Then Ranveer's brother comes to take revenge. Fai baa and Ranveer's brother Shambhu take revenge from shamsher. Shambhu is taken to jail and Shamsher is taken out from jail. Shamsher starts drinking a lot of alcohol and tries to succeed but Roopendra saves him. Roop's behaviour helps him to quit drinking.

title: Roja
summary:
Roja  (transl. Rose) is an Indian Tamil-language drama television series produced by Saregama. Consisting of two seasons, that first aired on 9 April 2018 and concluded on 3 December 2022 respectively on Sun TV, it was written by Vasubharathy, Selvam Subbhaiya and Guru Sampath Kumar. The first season of this series starred Priyanka Nalkari, Sibbu Suryan, Shamili Sukumar and VJ Akshaya in lead roles. The first season premiered on 9 April 2018, and ended on 3 December 2022 with 1316 episodes.
The second season of this series premiered on 6 January 2025 aired on Saregama's YouTube Channel. It stars Priyanka Nalkari and Riyaz Khan in the lead role. The season focused on Roja and Arjun's daughter Malar, after a 24-years leap. The second season premiered on 6 January 2025, and ended on 21 March 2025 with 55 episodes The show was re-telecastied from January 19, 2026, at 09:00AM (Indian Standard Time).

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: Due to the COVID-19 outbreak in India, Roja and all other Indian television series and film productions were suspended from 19 March 2020. Three months later, shooting was permitted, and the team commenced filming in July. The show telecasted new episodes on 27 July 2020. With the increase in COVID-19 cases in Tamil Nadu, the production was once again suspended in mid-May 2021 for a few weeks.

articleSections.title: Ratings
articleSections.text:
Initially aired at 3:00 PM IST, positive audience reception led the station to reschedule the show to a prime time slot of 9:00 PM IST in early 2019. Within three months, the show was shifted once more to 7:00 PM IST. It was shifted again in 2021 to 9:00 PM IST.

title: Raktha Sambandham
summary: Raktha Sambandham (transl. Bond with blood) is an Indian Telugu-language television series on Zee Telugu and also in digital platform ZEE5, before TV telecast. It stars Meghana Lokesh and Siddharth Varma. The series premiered on 9 April 2018 with Gundamma Katha series. It has off-aired on 10 May 2021 with a mega episode.
plot:
The story is about the loving relationship of two siblings, Krishna Prasad and Krishna Priya, sharing a strong bond. Priya adores Krishna Prasad and is even willing to sacrifice her own happiness for her brother’s needs.
Prasad's wife, Durgamma and Priya become pregnant around the same time. Due to social conditions and comments, Durgamma says she will die if she doesn't give birth to a male child. Unfortunately, Durgamma gets a girl, Tulasi. Priya gives birth to a boy, Adhitya. Later they are exchanged by their parents to save Durgamma's life. Only Prasad, Priya and her husband, and also Prasad's mother know the truth of the children's birth.
Durgamma always boasts about her son and insults Priya and Tulasi. Tulasi always enjoys fighting with Durgamma which annoys Durgamma. Then Tulasi and Adhitya fall in love with each other but Durgamma agrees to get them married. the rest of the story is about how Durgamma tries to separate the loving couple and how Tulasi overcomes the hard conditions and wins Durgamma's acceptance for their wedding. Tulasi and Aditya marry though Durgamma refuses to accept her. Meanwhile, Lakshmi, Aditya's former fiancée along with her grandmother and Durgamma plots against Tulasi. After many incidents and twists, Aditya and Tulasi learns about their true parentage and Durgamma accepts Tulasi as her daughter.
The story ends as Tulasi gets pregnant and gives birth to twin girls, though Durga expected twin boys. But a changed Durga accepts them wholeheartedly and they live happily ever after.

title: Rishta Likhenge Hum Naya
summary:
Rishta Likhenge Hum Naya (transl. We'll write a new relation) is an Indian drama series that aired on Sony TV, starring Tejasswi Prakash and Rohit Suchanti. It premiered on 7 November 2017.
The series is a restructuring of Pehredaar Piya Ki, which received negative social media response for depicting its two central characters, Diya, an 18-year-old princess and Ratan, a 9-year-old prince, as married. The Broadcasting Content Complaints Council (BCCC) asked SET India to move the series to a later 10pm time slot and the network complied. After a drop in viewership resulting from the move, series producers opted to restructure the series for prime time, in part by removing the child marriage theme by advancing Ratan's age to adulthood and recasting the character.
plot: Since Diya's duties get over, she decides to marry Abhay Singh Rathore, her fiancé but he leaves her. Ratan learns his late father wanted him to be with Diya, so he marries her reluctantly. Ratan finds it hard to fulfill his responsibilities to Diya, also due to the nine-year age gap between them. More problems arise when Yash marries Mohana, Arpita's daughter. Ratan decides to divorce Diya, only after helping her win a case against Abhay and Arpita. Diya then realizes her love for Ratan. Another problem arises when a man claims that he is the real Ratan Maan Singh and tries to influence the entire family against Ratan. His truth is revealed, as he tries to assassinate the entire family. Ratan then realizes his love for Diya, and they work together with their family to eliminate the terrorist. The show ends revealing that Diya is pregnant with Ratan's child and Mohana is pregnant with Yash's child.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Tejasswi Prakash as Diya Singh: Sajjan and Jyoti's daughter; Isha's sister; Ratan's wife (2017–2018) *Rohit Suchanti as Ratan Singh: Maan and Padma's son; Diya's husband (2017–2018)

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: The cast has already been finalised. While some characters from Pehredaar Piya Ki series are being carried over into this new series, new cast members have joined them, too. Rohit Suchanti has replaced child actor Affan Khan as a recast of Ratan Singh followed by Siddharth Shivpuri, Gauri Singh and Khalid Siddiqui. Siddharth Shivpuri, then decided to quit the show, and is being replaced by Puneet Sharma. The serial is set in the western India state of Rajasthan in the city of Bikaner & Machkund of Dholpur.

episodesList.title: Diya Foils Assassination Attempt on Ratan Singh
episodesList.summary: The story begins with Kesar Mehal. Maan Singh and Padma died in an accident years ago. Their son, Ratan Singh, whose life is under threat, is protected by Diya. Even after a decade, Diya has not forgotten her vow given to Maan Singh. As Diya foils one more assassination attempt on Ratan Singh, will she finally unmask the faceless men?

episodesList.title: Ratans Arrival
episodesList.summary: Diya wants to inform Ratan about the threat to his life before he arrives in India. But, Diya gets shocked to find out that Ratan is arriving in India. She gets ready and leaves to meet Ratan fearing that the people who want to see him dead might be aware of his arrival.

episodesList.title: Assassins
episodesList.summary: Diya arrives at the airport to escort Ratan home safely. After the initial confusion to identity Ratan, Diya heads home with him. While they are on the way, hired assassins block their path in a bid to kill Ratan. How will Diya save Ratan this time around?

episodesList.title: Diya Saves Ratan
episodesList.summary: Diya saves Ratan from hired goons who have been sent to kill Ratan. Risking her life and defying the odds, Diya escorts Ratan out of the danger towards safety. Who has sent these assassins? Will Diya unravel the truth?

episodesList.title: Ratan Arrives Home
episodesList.summary: Ratan Singh arrives home and is greeted by his family members. Diya gets into an argument with Chote Thakur. When Ratan arrives in his room, the bodyguards conduct a search of his room, which does not go down well with the family members.

episodesList.title: The Sword
episodesList.summary: Chote Thakur wishes to take the sword that was given to Diya by Ratan Singh. But, Diya refuses to hand it over and tries to persuade Ratan to refuse Chote Thakur's request. But, then after a few words are exchanged, Diya picks up the sword walks towards Chote Thakur.

episodesList.title: Plan To Kill Ratan
episodesList.summary: When Chote Thakur asks for the sword from Ratan, Diya refuses to hand over the sword. She decides to fight Chote Thakur and teach him a lesson. When Diya wins the sword fight, Chote Thakur has no other option but to devise another plan. Will Diya be able to save Ratan?

episodesList.title: Diya Saves Ratan's Life
episodesList.summary: Diya stops Ratan from having the dessert specially prepared for him. The family members are perplexed and ask Diya about it. She informs that someone has poisoned the dessert. Will she find out that Chote Thakur was involved?

episodesList.title: Ratan Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: While Diya is busy with her work, Ratan Singh manages to find a way out of the palace without being caught by the guards. Unknown to him, two men are on his trail. Will Diya find Ratan before the men kidnap him?

episodesList.title: The Looming Threat
episodesList.summary: Ratan wanders into the dense forest and Diya follows him closely behind. The sharpshooters follow Ratan in an attempt to kill him. Will Diya be able to save Ratan before he is caught by the sharpshooters?

episodesList.title: Yash's Loyalty
episodesList.summary: Diya manages to rescue Ratan. Then, Ratan argues that Yash might have a hand in the recurring attacks on him. Diya assures Ratan that Yash is loyal to him. Yash assures that he will catch the attackers soon. Will Yash be able to catch the attackers?

episodesList.title: Golden Shoes
episodesList.summary: Choti Thakurayan tells Ratan that she bought golden shoes for everyone from a cultural exhibition. Ratan suggests Yash get a sketch made of the culprit from a sketch artist. Everyone is confused and try to solve the mystery. Priya alone in her room throws her crutch and informs her aide over the phone that she will kill the shooter herself before he opens his mouth.

episodesList.title: Diya Moves To Ratans Room
episodesList.summary: Diya and Ratan return home from the police station. Priya also returns home. Choti Thakurayan tells children a story of two cats fighting each other looking at Diya and Priya. Yash walks to Priya's room reminiscing ghunghat wearing tea lady attacking him. Her hands shiver holding the gun and she throws throwing chilly powder and escapes. Ratan suspects that it was her mother. Diya challenges to find the culprit in 15 days.

episodesList.title: Ratan And Diya's Closeness
episodesList.summary: Ratan starts taunting Diya reading her diary. Yash during morning work out fights with a man and then says he lost babasa, his father, Raghu Singh. Yash asks the reason for him living away from his wife. He says some secrets are better-kept secret. Isha informs Bua that Ratan wants to sell off all the properties.

episodesList.title: Diya's Treatment
episodesList.summary: Diya speaks to Ratan over the phone and says she will reach him soon. She pops in some painkillers and tries to leave when someone locks the door from outside. Priya wearing veil is seen in store room checking Kesar Mahal's secret book. Ratan takes his friends to the torture chamber and shows them all dangerous equipments. He demonstrates each equipment and gets his neck stuck in one.

episodesList.title: Torture Chair
episodesList.summary: Ratan unconsciously sits on a punishment chair and opens the bucket rope knot filled with hot wax. Diya notices Ratan and saves him. Ratan calls every family member to warn them that the culprit will get the punishment. Will Diya be able to catch the culprit?

episodesList.title: Store Room's Secrets
episodesList.summary: Diya walks towards Choti Thakurayan's room speaking to Yash that they have to check each employee of the palace even if he is employed for 2 days and find out who corrected death chair in torture room. Yash asks Diya why did not she trust him and inform him about Choti Thakurayan beforehand.

episodesList.title: Ratan and Diya On A Date
episodesList.summary: Ratan is happy after Choti Thakurayan is arrested and plays a prank on Diya. He also asks her out on a date and she agrees. Yash tries to console Choti Thakurayan in the lock-up and brings food for her. Priya informs Raghu about the situation as to how Diya alleged Choti Thakurayan and she accepted the allegations and got arrested.

episodesList.title: A New Twist
episodesList.summary: Ratan's aunt manages to prove her innocence. Ratan finds it hard to believe that Diya was wrong in her judgement. He vents out his anger on Diya as she is left in disbelief about the sudden turn in events.

episodesList.title: Ratan's Apology
episodesList.summary: Yash scolds Ratan after he behaved badly with Diya while she saved his life. It takes some convincing and later Ratan apologizes to Diya. The maid informs Isha that Ratan has freed Diya from all her duties and asked her to leave. Isha is happy with the information and informs Bua the same thing. Ratan's friends tell Ratan that Diya cares for him too much and she might have strong feelings for him.

episodesList.title: Diya's Next Move
episodesList.summary: Ratan is eager to find out about Diya's next plan and so are the people who want to see Ratan dead. Diya cleverly dodges the question, Ratan puts before her about her next move. And in this process, the two end up coming together. What is Diya's next move?

episodesList.title: The Secret
episodesList.summary: Ratan wants to resolve the differences with Diya. Meanwhile, Diya wants to read the will of Ratan's father to find out any clues about Ratan's attackers. Finding some clue, Diya decides to inform Ratan. What Is the secret?

episodesList.title: Another Assassination Attempt
episodesList.summary: A man follows Ratan closely behind. Another assassination attempt on Ratan takes place as he is trapped inside his car. Diya arrives and saves Ratan's life yet again. Now, Ratan wants to make the family members believe that he is in love with Diya.

episodesList.title: The Drama
episodesList.summary: Diya and Ratan pretend before the family members that they are in love. The drama they have staged in front of the family proves to be a success as Chote Thakur believes it to be true and refuses to acknowledge their relationship.

episodesList.title: The Blindfold
episodesList.summary: The family members find it hard to believe that Ratan and Diya are in love. As part of a ritual, Ratan has to carry Diya up the steps leading to the temple. Upon reaching the temple, yet another attack takes place on Diya. Who has tried to kill Diya?

episodesList.title: Those Three Words
episodesList.summary: Vyom forces himself onto Sharanya. When the family members knock on the door, Sharanya manages to free herself. Vyom has no memory of the event and Sharanya does not inform her family members about it. While she is asleep, Shiv comes close to Sharanya. Will she find out that Vyom is innocent?

episodesList.title: Dadi Sa's Anger
episodesList.summary: Ratan informs Diya that they should inform the family members that their romance is merely an act. But, Diya insists that they should announce their engagement before the family members. Before the family members, Dadi Sa hits Diya on her head and she starts bleeding.

episodesList.title: Diya's Ultimate Decision
episodesList.summary: Priya asks Diya to decide if she wants to be a body guard or wife and leaves the decision to her. Ratan comforts Diya and applies a balm to her head after she gets hurt. Choti Thakurayan decides to kill Diya in her sleep and decides to get the work done once and for all.

episodesList.title: Attempt To Kill
episodesList.summary: Choti Thakuranisa thinks if it is Diya's conspiracy, seeing the pillows kept there. She hears them coming and places bedsheet over the pillows. Ratan asks her why she came as he asked her to sleep. Diya says she was thinking why he was worried and that's why she had to come. Ratan says he thought about Isha's words that she was unfaithful to them. Will Diya find out Choti Thakuranisa present in the room?

episodesList.title: Golden Gun
episodesList.summary: Diya comes to the room and sees the clothes etc. Ratan asks her to stay back for him. Diya says this can be done later and asks why is he acting, and says there is nobody here. Ratan thinks he is doing this to protect her. Diya says she will wrap up hotel work and come. Ratan says that he will also come with her. The guards come and give the gold pistol to her. Bua asks what's it? Diya tells her that as she told her that iron is inauspicious in her hand, she got gold pistol made. They get surprised. Bhuvan asks Diya to shoot him and says he will become rich. Diya says bullets are made of silver.

episodesList.title: Abhay Returns
episodesList.summary: Ratan moves from his way and thinks why hasn't Diya told him this important thing. He wonders why she will do this with him. Yash knocks at Priya's door. Priya opens the door. Yash says that he has to check her room, as Diya was attacked by someone. Will Yash find the truth about Priya?

episodesList.title: Engagement Ring
episodesList.summary: Abhay proposes Diya for marriage. Diya says that it is all old talks now, and 12 years is a long time. She is getting engaged to Ratan Sa. Abhay tells her that she always belonged to him and shows her favourite flowers. Diya asks him to take the ring while leaving and keeps their engagement ring. Abhay asks why does she do this? He tells her that he waited for her for 12 years and says that he will return with answers this time. He takes the ring and says that Choti thakurayan has invited him for dinner. Diya is upset.

episodesList.title: Attacker Escaped
episodesList.summary: Jeweller Kedia brings the designs of the engagement ring. Choti Thakurayan says Ratan and Diya are tired. Diya says she is very excited to select the ring. Abhay says he shall leave now. Sakshi asks him to stay back and says we need your suggestion also in selecting the ring. Abhay agrees. Yash sees the CCTV footage and wonders where is the attacker hiding. Priya is going to her room. Yash comes there and asks her where is she going? Priya says she is going to her room. Yash asks her to sit for some time. Diya asks him about the attacker. Yash says it seems he has eloped. Abhay asks him to catch the attacker.

episodesList.title: Hatred for Diya
episodesList.summary: Diya tells Ayush that she is very upset with the person calling Abhay and says she will ask him that who called him. She informs regarding the misunderstanding that is created between Ratan and her. Jhunki comes there and hears them. Diya smiles and asks Ayush if he is sure that Abhay is not in his room. Ayush says yes and gives her the keys. Jhunki goes and informs Priya. Ratan searches for the flowers of the bouquet. He gets a dry flower in the diary and thinks this means she still loves Abhay. Ratan searches her stuff. Yash asks why is he seeing her personal things. Ratan says that he is going to share a life with her. Yash tells Ratan that Diya and he love each other, and tells that it was Diya's past life, which she has forgotten. Ratan asks him to tell everyone if he loses and says it is a deal. Isha comes to Abhay's room.

episodesList.title: A Sword By Choti Thakuranisa
episodesList.summary: Abhay comes to the room and sees Diya and Ratan on each other. Ratan says that there is nothing as such. Diya says she is going to be engaged to Ratan soon. Abhay takes out the sword given by Choti Thakuranisa and looks at Diya. He says she is still the same as before and knows well that she is his life. He keeps the sword on Ratan's neck, but Diya holds the sword. Will Diya tell the truth to Abhay?

episodesList.title: Diya Rejects Abhay
episodesList.summary: Abhay checks the time and takes out the sword. Ratan stops him and says that he himself will tell him. Diya comes and asks Ratan not to interfere between Abhay and her. Diya asks him to go home and die if he wants to die, but not to ruin her engagement. Diya tells him angrily that he is her past and she has nothing to do with him now.

episodesList.title: Property Papers
episodesList.summary: Ratan makes Diya wear the necklace. A servant informs Bhuvan Singh that Data Hukum has called a lawyer to the house with the papers, to put all the properties into Diya's name. Bhuvan Singh confronts Data Hukum.

episodesList.title: Engagement Day
episodesList.summary: Bhuvan asks Choti Thakuranisa to do something, or else Diya will not give them a room in the hotel. Choti Thakuranisa asks him to let her sleep and asks him to sleep as well. Diya says that tomorrow all drama will end, then you can search for a girlfriend, who will love you very much. Ratan thinks he can help Diya with the preparation. Priya and her husband plan to blast Diya and give her liquid explosive. Priya keeps it in her stick.

episodesList.title: Horse Ride
episodesList.summary: Choti Thakuranisa and Nitya dance with the dancers as Ratan and Diya sit for engagement. Sakshi also dances on the morning song. Diya also dances and thinks that who will attack me today. Isha also dances. Priya goes to a corner and is about to inject the coconut. Sakshi comes and calls her. Priya dances a bit and goes again. Yash comes in front of her. She says she wants water. Yash goes to bring it. Priya injects the coconut. Diya comes and asks what is she doing? Priya gets tensed.

episodesList.title: Clothes On Fire
episodesList.summary: Ratan is on the horse, when Choti Thakuranisa signs a servant and he lights crackers in front of the horse. The horse gets crazy and makes Ratan fall down. Ratan's chest catches fire due to the perfume which Choti Thakuranisa gave to Ratan. Ratan shouts for help. Choti Thakuranisa removes her shawl, runs to him and covers him with her shawl.

episodesList.title: Ratan Declares Diya As A Traitor
episodesList.summary: Ratan asks Diya how can she lie easily and asks how can she manage all the words easily, enemy, savior, etc. He says that he heard what she said and trusted her blindly. He says he doesn't like Kakusa, but his doubt is not wrong. He tells that whenever he was attacked, she saved him. He says that if she is so intelligent then why was the attacker not caught.

episodesList.title: Diya Prisoned
episodesList.summary: Diya decides to return all the papers to Ratan and leave forever. Bhuvan, Sakshi, and Mohak come to arrest Diya. Bhuvan informs that he has not done this, its Ratan's orders which he is following. Diya is shattered and doesn't resist or say anything. Bhuvan announces to everyone that whoever betrays Ratan, this is what will happen to them. Officers bring Diya down in handcuffs/chain. Ratan and Diya look at each other and turn their face away. Yash comes and tells Bhuvan to stop the act and tells Ratan that she is their friend and it is illegal to imprison someone.

episodesList.title: Diya's Confinement
episodesList.summary: Diya is confined in a cell when Yash meets her and inquires about her health. Then, Ratan meets Diya and asks her to kill him. Ratan believes that Diya is the hired assassin, whose task is to kill Ratan. Though the whole situation comes to an end, Diya decides to find out the person who has created a rift between the two

episodesList.title: Diya's Plan
episodesList.summary: The tables have turned and Diya takes charge of the palace. In a bid to prove her innocence and to find the culprit who planted the seed of suspicion about her in Ratan's mind, Diya asks the family members to gather in the hall. Diya puts her plan into action and starts interrogating the family members. Will Diya be able to find the culprit?

episodesList.title: The Announcement
episodesList.summary: Diya is about to make an announcement. Papa Hukum is still dancing. Will he able to stop soon?

episodesList.title: Diya Takes Over
episodesList.summary: Diya takes over the property. Ratan objects and is about to go to the court to reverse his decision, when Diya holds him hostage.

episodesList.title: Diya Fights For Her Life
episodesList.summary: Diya is in the hospital. She is about to have a surgery. Ratan is worried about her. He had to sign a consent form for Diya's surgery.

episodesList.title: Yash Apologises To Diya
episodesList.summary: Yash gets his mother arrested. She pleads him to forgive her, but he doesn't. He then asks for Diya's forgiveness. Will she forgive him?

episodesList.title: Yash Is Ashamed
episodesList.summary: Yash is ashamed of his parents. Diya tells him that he should not be worried about what people will think. Diya soon learns that Ratan is in trouble.

episodesList.title: Ratan Forgives Kaki Masa
episodesList.summary: Kaki Masa asks for Ratan's forgiveness. Ratan says that he has always considered her his mother.

episodesList.title: Ratan To Marry Diya
episodesList.summary: Ratan finds a letter from his father. When he reads the letter, he finds out that his father had instructed Ratan to help Diya get married. But if he can't find anyone for her, the letter instructs Ratan to marry her. But he doesn't seem ready for such a commitment.

episodesList.title: Diya Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Diya apologizes to her father. She tells him that she wants to serve him. Her father asks her to leave, but she refuses.

episodesList.title: Diya's Wedding Preparations
episodesList.summary: Ratan reveals that he was the one who orchestrated the wedding between Abhay and Diya. He is very excited about the wedding. But he soon seems to get stressed, as he sees the way Arpita treats Diya.

episodesList.title: Ratan's Surprise
episodesList.summary: Diya wants to tie the knot with Abhay in the truest sense and fulfill the promise. Meanwhile, Ratan is trying to woo Tanvi, the wedding planner. He plans a surprise adventure trip.

episodesList.title: Diya And Abhay Get Engaged
episodesList.summary: Ratan, who was supposed to be the ring bearer for Diya and Abhay's engagement, wore the ring so that he doesn't misplace it. But later, the ring gets stuck on Ratan's finger and he is not able to take it off.

episodesList.title: Diya And Abhay Get Engaged
episodesList.summary: The engagement ceremony is about to start and Ratan who was supposed to bring the ring, is nowhere to be seen. Abhay promises him to take care of Diya. Sajjan Singh stalls the time by telling everyone that Ratan took the ring for polishing.

episodesList.title: Fast Day
episodesList.summary: Sajjan Singh tells Ratan that he and his wife will keep the fast. Ratan says he will only keep the fast. Choti Thakuranisa asks Ratan not to be stubborn. Diya says that her parents will do this rasam. Ratan says that he will do this rasam. Yash says it is not that easy. Ratan says that he can be hungry for a day.

episodesList.title: Ratan Remembers What He Did
episodesList.summary: Ratan wakes up. When he does, he remembers his outburst. He goes and apologizes to Diya's father.

episodesList.title: Ratan's Party Invite
episodesList.summary: At the mehendi ceremony, Ratan Singh decides to gift a dress to Diya and asks her to attend a party. Seeing that the dress is too short, Diya decides not to wear the dress and instead wears a churidar to the party.

episodesList.title: Ratan Is Disappointed
episodesList.summary: Diya arrives at the party. Ratan is disappointed that she isn't wearing the skirt he gave her. Tanvi arrives and asks Ratan why Diya isn't wearing the skirt. Ratan isn't pleased.

episodesList.title: Ratan Fights With Diya
episodesList.summary: Ratan loses his cool. He argues with Diya. He tells her that she is always uncomfortable. He tells her that she was asked to do nothing more than kiss her future husband. Ratan tells her that it wasn't a big deal and why she is trying to make it a big deal about it.

episodesList.title: Abhay Plots His Revenge
episodesList.summary: Ratan walks in on Abhay plotting his revenge. Meanwhile, preparations are being made for the wedding. Diya wants Ratan to attend the wedding. She is surprised when Ratan arrives.

episodesList.title: Waiting For The Groom
episodesList.summary: Diya and her family are waiting for the groom's party to arrive. Everyone is getting impatient. Yash comes back and tells Diya's father that Abhay's house is locked.

episodesList.title: Abhay Reveals The Truth
episodesList.summary: Abhay tells Diya that he never intended to marry her. Ratan asks him why he is doing this. Arpita replies by telling Ratan about Abhay's insult all those years ago. She implies that Ratan is responsible for everything.

episodesList.title: Ratan Promises
episodesList.summary: Sajjan Singh tells Ratan that they have suffered enough till now and asks him if he'll be able to give Diya the happiness that she deserves. Ratan promises in front of everyone that he'll fulfill all the responsibilities of marriage.

episodesList.title: Ratan Gets Frustrated
episodesList.summary: Ratan gets frustrated with so many marriage customs. He feels as if its a punishment for him. Isha asks Diya to step on the plate with the red color and step into the house. But Ratan is frustrated with everything starts rushing, so Diya, who is tied to him, has to run behind him ruining the custom.

episodesList.title: The Newly Weds
episodesList.summary: Post marriage, Ratan and Diya find it awkward to face each other. Ratan decides to sleep in another room but is asked by the family members to be with Diya, in accordance with the customary practice. Ratan faces trouble while he is in the room, and the blame is directed on Diya.

episodesList.title: Diya's Efforts
episodesList.summary: Choti Thakurayan asks Diya to make sure Ratan has no problem. Diya sees a flower string falling on Ratan and tries to set it while standing on the bed. The bed breaks and they fall down inside.

episodesList.title: The Portrait
episodesList.summary: Diya finds it hard to walk in a saree and thinks how do girls carry it. Ratan gives her a gown to wear for the family portrait. Diya tries the designer gown and it gets torn by mistake, so she tries to cover it up.

episodesList.title: The Plan
episodesList.summary: Choti Thakurayan with the help of others, plans to send Ratan and Diya on a honeymoon so that they can have a fresh start. Diya blames herself for Ratan being depressed all the time. Diya tries to help Ratan but they both fall in the bathroom and the water tap breaks.

episodesList.title: Diya's Struggles With Cooking
episodesList.summary: Diya is determined to prepare Ratan's favorite sweet dish by herself and serve it to the guests when they come. Ratan doesn't believe that Diya can cook anything and plans with the servant to change her dish with his when the guests come. Diya burns the cake.

episodesList.title: Singapore Trip
episodesList.summary: Yash invites Ratan on a trip to Singapore. Believing that Diya is going to her mother's house, Ratan agrees to come with him. But, Diya too is going on a trip to Singapore. Will Diya and Ratan end up seeing each other at the airport?

episodesList.title: The Airport
episodesList.summary: Choti Thakurayan's plan to send Diya and Ratan on a honeymoon to Singapore is going well. Ratan believes that Diya is going to her mother's house and he is going to Singapore with Yash. Diya and Ratan pack their bags and go to airport separately. They are about to see each other.

episodesList.title: Make It Work
episodesList.summary: Diya and Ratan fight with each other and say that the marriage was a mistake and they have spoiled their lives by doing so. Diya's father and Yash try to make Diya and Ratan understand to take this marriage as a challenge and try to make things work together. Diya and Ratan decide to try and make their marriage work anyhow.

episodesList.title: Diya Gets Drunk
episodesList.summary: Ratan and Diya after agreeing to one another, drive to a restaurant to get some food where the waiter mixes some vodka in their soft drinks. Choti Thakurayan tells Nitya that they need to search a good girl for Yash. Yash meets someone. Diya gets drunk and asks Ratan to dance with her.

episodesList.title: Abhay Gets Upset
episodesList.summary: Abhay gets upset after he hears the news of Diya's marriage to Ratan from Bhuvan when they meet at the dentist's, as he wanted to ruin her life. Ratan is frustrated with Diya's behavior after getting drunk. Yash gets Muana bailed out of the lockup. Choti Thakurayan tries to find a suitable match for Yash.

episodesList.title: Ratan and Diya's Romantic Dinner
episodesList.summary: Ratan and Diya are ecstatic to be together for the dinner. Diya presents Ratan with a gift. She decides to surprise Ratan by wearing a dress which suits the occasion. Together they share a romantic dance in the evening.

episodesList.title: Diya's Rescue Attempt
episodesList.summary: Seeing that Ratan is not keeping well, Diya decides to get him a few medicines. In her absence, Ratan is called to participate in a challenge by his friends. Diya while searching for Ratan, stumbles upon the scene, and fearing that he is drowning, dives in the water.

episodesList.title: Diya's Heartbreak
episodesList.summary: Diya learns that Ratan has informed his friends about him being single. Diya feels dejected as Ratan has not acknowledged their relationship with his friends. Seeing their quarrel is Abhay, whose sole intention is to create animosity between the two.

episodesList.title: Diya Knows The Truth
episodesList.summary: Diya fights off the goons after they surround her alone at night while Abhay takes her pictures sneaking around. The police comes on the spot and takes Diya to the police station. Later Diya comes to know the truth about Abhay following them and conspiring against them. Ratan realises that he is not happy with his marriage to Diya and decides to break the marriage off.

episodesList.title: Ratan's Confrontation
episodesList.summary: Ratan decides to tell Choti Thakurayan that he wants to end the marriage. Diya wants to help him in confronting her, but he refuses. Ratan and Diya come to know that Yash has found a girl that he wants to get married to and they get excited. Choti Thakurayan asks Ratan and Diya to go handle the arrangements and buy gifts for Mohana.

episodesList.title: Diyas Truth
episodesList.summary: Ratan and Diya are successful in avoiding the chore of making Diya a Thakurayan that Choti Thakurayan wanted to carry out. But later when Choti Thakurayan falls in the bathroom and Diya goes to save her, her truth comes out. As Diya wipes the water off of her hands, Choti Thakurayan notices the color coming off.

episodesList.title: The Holi Challenge
episodesList.summary: Ratan doesn't like playing Holi and is repulsive to getting his face dirty with all the colours, so he makes sure that no one throws any colour on him, but Diya challenges him that she will make him bathe with colours from head to toe. Diya makes a plan and is successful in throwing colours on Ratan. Nitya, to bring out the truth out of Ratan and Diya, makes them drink Bhaang. Choti Thakurayan gets to know this and plans to stop it.

episodesList.title: Choti Thakurayan's Confrontation
episodesList.summary: Choti Thakurayan comes to know the truth about Diya and Ratan and confronts Diya that if they break their marriage, Ratan has to leave the position of Daata Hukum and will be treated the same way as he treated Abhay in front of everyone and also tells her to make the marriage work anyhow. Yash and Mohana get engaged and everyone shares their happiness but a new threat arises which spoils everything.

episodesList.title: Framed
episodesList.summary: Yash and Mohana get engaged and everyone shares their happiness until Arpita comes there and claims that Diya attacked Abhay with a bottle in Goa because of which he was admitted to the hospital and was in a coma for four days. She calls the police and gets Diya arrested. Ratan stands there feeling helpless and not able to do anything.

episodesList.title: Chaos
episodesList.summary: Diya has been accused by Arpita of attacking Abhay and she gets Diya arrested but Ratan saves her by getting her bailed at the right time. Ratan promises Diya that he will save her and protect her no matter what. Yash is disappointed in Mohana after knowing her relations with Arpita and tells her to leave. Ratan decides to visit Goa and find a loophole in the case.

episodesList.title: Ratan Is Adamant
episodesList.summary: Ratan is adamant that he will save Diya and prove her innocent anyhow and promises Diya's father that he'll never let anything happen to her. Choti Thakurayan sends Arpita a proposal to resolve the case outside the court and come to the terms of settlement and Apita accepts it. How will Ratan react when he comes to know about this?

episodesList.title: Diya Slaps Abhay
episodesList.summary: Diya slaps Abhay after he asks her to apologise to him. Ratan tells her to slap Abhay and then apologise. Yash meets Mohana after her scooter slips on the road. Yash informs Ratan that no one is ready to take Diya's case so Ratan decides to fight the case himself.

episodesList.title: Ratan's Fight For Justice
episodesList.summary: Diya is sure that Ratan will emerge victorious. Ratan is working hard to win the case at any cost. Diya wants to make sure Ratan's health is not affected, while he prepares to build the case. Ratan finally comes up with a solution that will prove Diya as innocent in the court.

episodesList.title: A Proof
episodesList.summary: Diya visits Mohana's house and sees Arpita hugging her. Arpita calls Choti Thakurayan on her phone and mocks her for Ratan fighting Diya's case on his own. Diya talks to Mohana to make her understand everything that's been going on. Ratan finally finds a loophole in the case.

episodesList.title: The Day Of Hearing
episodesList.summary: The day of Diya's court hearing arrives and Ratan is all prepared to prove Diya not guilty and get her out of the case. Both the parties set their story straight and give the proper evidence to back the story but later on Abhay and Arpita do something that Ratan has no answer to.

episodesList.title: Ratan's Plan
episodesList.summary: Arpita advises Ratan not to fabricate the evidence. Ratan meets Kaki Maa Sa and asks her if she exchanged the broken glass, which was a crucial evidence. Kaki Maa Sa informs that she did fabricate the evidence. How will Ratan prove Diya's innocence?

episodesList.title: Suspicion
episodesList.summary: As per the plan, Mohana and Yash create suspicion in the mind of Abhay. He overhears that Ratan, Yash, and Mohana are meeting Arpita in a restaurant. Abhay is unaware that Diya has dressed up as Arpita. When Abhay arrives at the restaurant, he sees Diya and mistakes her to be Arpita.

episodesList.title: Ratan's Final Play
episodesList.summary: Ratan is on his way to the court for Diya's hearing, but is stopped and surrounded by Abhay and his goons. He knew this would happen, so he installs a camera on the dashboard of his car, so that he can record whatever they do. Ratan is beaten up badly by Abhay and his goons. Will Ratan be able to reach the court on time?

episodesList.title: Moment Of Happiness
episodesList.summary: Diya and Ratan return home after winning the case in the court and proving that Diya is innocent. Choti Thakurayan is upset with Diya because of what Ratan went through for her. Yash proposes Mohana on the road in front of the media and asks her forgiveness. Diya realizes that she is in love with Ratan and also kisses him when he is asleep.

episodesList.title: Diya Is In Love
episodesList.summary: Diya calls up Yash and asks him for his help. Yash suddenly leaves and Mohana feels dejected, that Yash values Diya above her. Diya does not want Ratan to end their relationship, as she is falling in love with him. Will Diya expresses her feelings to Ratan before it's too late?

episodesList.title: Express The Love
episodesList.summary: Diya decides to let Ratan know the truth and to express her love for him, but could not gather the courage to do so. Meanwhile, Mohana is feeling dejected thinking Yash's first priority will always be Diya and Ratan. Diya decorates the room in a romantic manner and decides to express her love when Ratan comes back.

episodesList.title: Diya's Plan Fails
episodesList.summary: Diya's plan fails after Kaku Sa comes into the room instead of Ratan and spoils everything by mistake. Ratan comes to the room and is furious to see the mess Diya has made. Ratan tells Diya that they will tell everyone the truth once Choti Thakurayan's health improves. Diya tells everything to Yash and asks him for help.

episodesList.title: Diya Tries To Cook
episodesList.summary: Diya helps Ratan solving a business problem. Choti Thakurayan asks Diya when is she planning to end their relationship and return home to her parents. Diya cooks food for Ratan but Mohana being jealous, tries to spoil the food. Diya sends a note in the food basket for Ratan, expressing her love.

episodesList.title: The Missing Lunch Box
episodesList.summary: Diya is eager to find out if Ratan has liked the food she prepared for him. But, due to a mix-up, Ratan does not get to taste the food sent by Diya, which leaves Diya disappointed. Meanwhile, Mohana informs Yash that their marriage date has been finalized. When she asks Yash to leave his job and join the family business, Yash is puzzled. Will Yash leave his job for Mohana?

episodesList.title: Another Try
episodesList.summary: Thakurayan notices that Ratan listens and obeys everything that Diya tells him and decides to get Ratan out of the unwanted relationship.

episodesList.title: Plan To Refuse
episodesList.summary: CT alerts Ratan about Diya's feelings towards him. Ratan is shocked on learning this and decides to refuse Diya's proposal. Ratan institutes a plan with the help of Bhuvan to distance Diya from him.

episodesList.title: The Druggie
episodesList.summary: Ratan decides to make Diya believe he is not the nice guy she believes him to be. He tries to act drunk in front of her, but seeing her asleep makes his heart melt. With that plan being spoilt, he moves on to a new plan to assassinate his character.

episodesList.title: Another Plan
episodesList.summary: Diya confesses her love to Ratan and Ratan is shocked to hear it. Ratan decides to kill Diya's love for him by behaving badly. Diya finds out about Yash quitting his defense job and getting into the family business. Diya catches Ratan with drugs.

episodesList.title: The Blood Test
episodesList.summary: After the whole facade that Ratan created when he tried to act like a drug addict to make Diya hate him, Diya actually starts doubting him and takes him for a blood test. On the other hand, Yash and Mohana's relation continues to get tensed after Mohana makes Yash quit his police job.

episodesList.title: The Blood Sample
episodesList.summary: Thakur Sa plans with Ratan to make Diya hate him and leave him. Diya gets a nurse to take Ratan's blood samples, to check if he takes drugs. Thakur Sa changes the blood sample, which leads to the reports being positive for drugs. How will Diya react to the news?

episodesList.title: Another Plan
episodesList.summary: Kaku Sa tells Ratan that Choti Thakurayan will beat him up after getting to know about his plans to help Ratan, but Ratan makes him emotional, and persuades him to help him again. Ratan decides to sell his ancestral jewellery to the jeweller and when Diya gets to know about this, it shocks her.

episodesList.title: Ratan's Lie
episodesList.summary: Diya learns that Ratan has borrowed money by lending his ancestral ring. She discovers that Ratan is receiving a package from someone. When she confronts Ratan, he reveals that he is addicted to drugs. Seeing that Diya is not letting him go, Ratan ends up revealing that he pretended to be a drug addict, so that Diya starts hating him.

episodesList.title: One-Sided Love
episodesList.summary: Diya finally realizes that Ratan is not in love with her and will never be so she decides to free him from the bounds of her love and let him go. Diya tells Ratan that they should both file for a divorce and after the deed is done, they should tell their families. The thought of Diya leaving shatters Ratan

episodesList.title: Ratan and Diya's Divorce
episodesList.summary: It's an atmosphere of celebration at the palace but in Diya's life a turmoil is brewing. Ratan and Diya approach the lawyer for divorce. Ratan informs Diya that it's time that they inform about the divorce to their family members.

episodesList.title: Bankruptcy
episodesList.summary: Ratan's video of selling his ancestral ring to a jeweler goes viral which creates a turmoil in Ratan's family after Mohana shows everyone the video. Choti Thakurayan blames Diya and her one-sided love for Ratan for everything. The news of bankruptcy spreads like wildfire in the woods.

episodesList.title: Yash Marries Mohana
episodesList.summary: Mohana pleads with Yash to stay back. Yash makes a decision and decides to marry Mohana the same day. After the marriage, instead of staying with Mohana, Yash decides to go with Ratan and Diya. What will be Mohana's reaction?

episodesList.title: Diya's Belief
episodesList.summary: The sponsors want to back out as they do not believe Ratan can carry the responsibility on his shoulders. Diya assures them that Ratan has the capability and asks them to adhere to the contract. How will Ratan keep up Diya's word?

episodesList.title: Diya's Will Power
episodesList.summary: Diya believes that she can prove the news of Ratan's bankruptcy false and convinces the sponsors to give them 24 hours to do the same. Mohana Baisa continues to get jealous of Yash's closeness to Ratan and Diya, and decides to find out their plan to get out of the bankruptcy situation. Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Foolproof Plan?
episodesList.summary: Diya's foolproof plan of stealing all the jewelry from Ratan's house to dodge the news of bankruptcy is in the process, as Ratan and Yash with her succeed in executing the plan. But Mohana Baisa is adamant to fail their plan. Yash keeps the suitcase full of jewellery with him for the night but later Mohana Baisa does something that puts the whole plan into crisis. Watch the episode to know what happens.

episodesList.title: Chaos Everywhere
episodesList.summary: Police start investigating the theft of gold and money from Ratan's house, Diya and Ratan believe that their plan was foolproof but things go sideways after the police fail to find the stolen goods and all they find is an empty bag. When the news reaches Choti Thakurayan, she becomes furious and puts the entire blame on Diya. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Diya Unmasks Mohana
episodesList.summary: Yash finds out that someone mixed a sedative in the water, which made him drowsy. Yash, Ratan, and Diya believe that a family member is involved. Later, when Diya, Ratan, and Yash arrive at the lab, a woman, who is trying to steal the lab reports, tries to make an escape. Who is this woman?

episodesList.title: Meethi Halwayi
episodesList.summary: Mohana Baisa tells Diya the truth about her mixing a sedative in Yashs drink and the reason behind it. Diya tears the lab reports and decides to protect Yash and Mohanas marriage. Mohana breaks down and feels guilty about what she did. Meethi Halwayi comes to Raj Mahal to take her money.

episodesList.title: The Statue
episodesList.summary: Ratan decides to build a statue of his father and decides to present it in the garden. Mohana decides to help Yash to make Ratan understand his love for Diya and to improve their relations but their efforts somehow hurt Diya. Someone comes with the statue disguised as Ratan and performs the rituals.

episodesList.title: Shocking Claim
episodesList.summary: A man claims that he is the true heir to Maan Singh's legacy and he is Ratan Maan Singh. Diya and the rest of the family members are shocked to hear this claim. Diya asks the man to produce proof for his shocking claim. Will the truth leave Diya shocked?

episodesList.title: The True Heir
episodesList.summary: Diya allows the man, who claims to be Ratan Maan Singh, to stay in the palace. She keeps a watch on the man with the help of Yash. Then, Ratan makes a video call to his teacher in London but the teacher too claims that he is not Ratan Singh. How will Diya find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Real Or Fake?
episodesList.summary: To see if he is the real Ratan Maan Singh or just a pretender, Diya and the entire family decide to take a test of the person who claims to be the true heir. Yash and Choti Thakurayan's faith is tested after he passes both the tests. Diya promises Ratan that she'll not let anything happen to him and will get to the truth however impossible it may seem. Will Diya be able to find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Finding Deepu
episodesList.summary: Diya and Yash try to find Deepu, whom Meethi claims to be an exact replica of Ratan, and when Yash and Diya reach Deepu's village they are shocked to see Deepu's photos. What is in the photos that made Diya and Yash shocked? How will others react to the news of Deepu

episodesList.title: Twisting The Truth
episodesList.summary: The whole Singh family is in doubt of who the real Data Hukum is. The imposter is gaining trust and attention and the real Ratan is on edge that his family is denying his identity. Diya is the only one who has faith in Ratan, and she is trying her level best to bring the truth to light. Arpita has escaped from jail and has a gun.

episodesList.title: The Impostor Steals The Show
episodesList.summary: Diya's plan fails miserably as Arpita shoots both the real and imposter Data Hukum. A DNA test emerges to prove that the newly imposter is the real Ratan. The Singh family is shocked to their bones. The real Ratan is kicked out of the family home. Although Diya still has faith in Ratan.

episodesList.title: The Motive
episodesList.summary: Finally, the motive of imposter Data Hukum is revealed when he gets his men to enter the "Vivaah" event with explosives and guns and is helped by none other than Mithi Halwayi. The real Data Hukum Ratan also enters the event by disguising as a musician. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Code No. 1418
episodesList.summary: Ratan smells something fishy about Meethi and believes that she is somehow involved in the imposter's conspiracy, so he tells Diya to keep an eye on her. The imposter gives Meethi a code no. 1418 which is important for them to complete their mission. What is code no. 1418?

episodesList.title: Deciphering the Code
episodesList.summary: There is a huge occasion at the Singh family and the doppelganger Data Hukum is palling to take out the foreign guests at the invitation. Diya and Ratan brainstorm to decipher the code but at the nick of time, they fail to do it. More ammunition is brought in and people are in danger.

episodesList.title: The Attack
episodesList.summary: Ratan regains consciousness and meets Diya. With Ratan's help, Diya manages to avert a disaster by getting her hands on the bomb. The imposter's plan fails and his team carries out an attack on the guests. How will Diya and Ratan avert this disaster now?

episodesList.title: Diya To The Rescue
episodesList.summary: The imposter Data Hukum brings his gunmen into the hotel and violently shoots on everyone. Diya and Yash with their guns rescue the family. The whole Singh family is at shock to find out that they have been fooled by an imposter. Watch the full episode to know more!

episodesList.title: The Hostages
episodesList.summary: The imposter Data Hukum and his gunmen are all over the place. Diya, Ratan, and Yash lead the family and friends to a safe room inside the palace. They are locked inside without food and water as the terrorists are in search of them. Watch what happens in the episode.

episodesList.title: Trapped
episodesList.summary: It's been quite a few hours since the imposter and Meethi with their terrorists, trap everyone in the panic room and everyone is starting to get hungry. So Diya, Ratan, and Yash plan to get some food for everyone from the pantry but the impostor soon gets the whiff of them cooking food and tracks them. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Putting Up A Fight
episodesList.summary: Ratan and Diya's entire family is still hidden inside the panic room and the terrorist is getting furious every minute, so they release a pesticidal gas in the entire house to force them out. Diya also has her own plan to defeat the terrorists but everyone believes that the plan is too dangerous to be carried out. What is Diya's plan? Will she be able to get everyone to safety?

episodesList.title: The Fight Continues
episodesList.summary: The imposter has got Diya and is trying to get the truth out of her. He starts torturing Diya, hitting her, and tries to slit her throat. Ratan takes care of the hostages and his own family. When things get out of control, Ratan jumps in to save Diya, but things turn south as they both get captured by the imposter Data Hukum.

episodesList.title: At The Gunpoint
episodesList.summary: The imposter Data Hukum has Diya and Ratan under his belt. He asks for Erik, the foreigner guest. Somehow Diya and Ratan manage to set a gas bomb and set free the hostages, but things turn worse when the Rajput family is taken back and at the imposter's gunpoint.

episodesList.title: The Sky Is Clear
episodesList.summary: Although the imposter made his escape but the police get the chance to arrest his men. Diya, Ratan, and the rest of the family is finally safe, they rejoice and share the love for each other. Everyone commends Diya for her courage. Diya finds the dagger that the imposter Data Hukum used to commit his crimes.

episodesList.title: The Locket

title: Ragini MMS: Returns
summary:
Ragini MMS: Returns is an Indian found footage erotic horror web series produced under ALTBalaji. The series is the third installment of Ragini MMS Franchise.
The first season starred Karishma Sharma, Riya Sen, Siddharth Gupta, and Nishant Singh Malkani. It premiered on ALTBalaji and ZEE5 on 19 October 2017.
The second season stars Sunny Leone, Divya Agarwal, Varun Sood, Navdeep, and Navneet Kaur in the leading roles. This season was released on 18 December 2019.
The series is directed by Suyash Vadhavkar and Shahriyar Afsan Ovro and produced by Ekta Kapoor and Shobha Kapoor.
plot:
Season 1
The story revolves around the life of Simran (Riya Sen), and Ragini (Karishma Sharma). The uncanny haunting that they witness at an old deserted college is at the heart of this story. Running behind the scandalous MMS CD, which has thrilling mysteries and dark secrets to unwind, is what awaits the two in search to fight the freakish energy that surrounds them.
Season 2
Meena (Sunny Leone), a paranormal investigator, arrives in India from Canada. She visits the Victoria Villa that is said to have been haunted by the ghost of Captain Burns. Meena, along with her boyfriend, Rajeev (Navdeep), are killed by the ghost. Eleven years later, Ragini (Divya Agarwal) and her friends decide to celebrate their friend's Bachelorette party at Victoria Villa.

title: Rishton Ka Chakravyuh
summary: Rishton Ka Chakravyuh (transl. Labyrinth of Relationships) is an Indian television drama series aired on STAR Plus. The show stars Mahima Makwana, Narayani Shastri, Rahul Ssudhir,Sangita Ghosh, Ankit Siwach and Ajay Chaudhary. Set against a royal backdrop, the show revolves around a mother, authoritative royal businesswoman Satrupa, and her 17-year-old free-spirited, confident daughter Anami. The show depicts the life of a royal, industrialist family that resides in Laal Mahal, the house of conspiracies. The show is loosely based on the story of Laal Mahal and depicts grey shades of relationships. The series ended on 23 February 2018.
plot:
Seventeen-year-old Anami, abandoned at birth and adopted by a pandit family in Banaras, returns as the sole yet reluctant heir to a royal family in Laal Mahal in the Bihar badlands.
The tale begins with Satrupa bringing back Anami, whom she gave away at birth, to Laal Mahal after her son and Anami's twin brother Vatsalya's death. Reluctantly, Anami agrees to go back to Laal Mahal.
Adhiraj Pandey, the CBI officer who is handling the case of anything related to Lal Mahal, gradually develops a close bond with Anami, and the two become best friends. Slowly, Anami learns about the past of Laal Mahal and gets to know her dead brother through his diary. She decides to stay in Laal Mahal and find the true culprit behind her brother's death. Because Adhiraj is her best friend and actually loves her without knowing it, he helps her in any decision she makes without any reluctance. She also brings Sudha, her biological father's mistress and also the mother of Narottom, (Anami's half-brother) to Laal Mahal to make Narottom's life happy. She is unaware of Sudha's true motives who wants all the money, power and property of Lal Mahal.

articleSections.title: Anami and Satrupa
articleSections.text: Satrupa warns Anami for Sudha, but because of Anami's stubborn behavior and misconception about Satrupa, she never trusts her. At first, Anami trusts Sudha blindfolded but gradually Adhiraj suspects Sudha and tells Anami to watch out for her. Anami tries running away from Lal Mahal to live with her foster parents when her brother Laddo, who is the son of her foster parents, was kidnapped by Sudha's brother and her maternal uncle Purushottam. Adhiraj plans to go with her citing her safety, in order to spend more time with Anami. Neither Adhiraj or Anami wants to leave each other but Anami cannot stay in Lal Mahal. When Anami and Adhiraj, along with Laddo reach Anami's foster parents, they spend a night in one of her dad's friend's houses. Sudha gets the house on fire through people whom she had hired to work for her. Anami thinks it was Satrupa's plan and decides to return to seek revenge.

articleSections.title: Adhiraj and Anami
articleSections.text:
Meanwhile, Adhiraj expresses his feelings for Anami. Anami seeks some time for her to discover her feelings for him. She gets to know Sudha's true motives when Adhiraj gets proof against her, which causes her to be imprisoned. Narottam provides the proof through a self-confessed audio recording. Anami knows that Satrupa is not guilty. In the end, Sudha is exposed and Anami asks Satrupa for forgiveness. Both share a huge hug and the whole family is happy. Baldev and Satrupa reunite. When Narottam was about to leave Laal Mahal, Anami asks the reason and he tells that because his mother and maternal uncle were involved in Vatsalya's accident, he has no right to stay with the family. Anami promises to keep the secret and asks him not to leave. Terms are settled between Baldev-Satrupa and Narottam. Anami tells Adhiraj about the accident and he makes Sudha confess her crimes. Adiraj and Anami bring Madhu and Murari Pathak to Laal Mahal. Satrupa requests them to stay with them at Laal Mahal.
Seeing the closeness between Anami and Adhiraj Dhiru, Pandey (Adhiraj's father) gets Adhiraj transferred. Learning this, Baldev, along with Gayatri (his mother) meets Pandey and asks for forgiveness for all their deeds and offers friendship. Baldev accepts Narottam and he agrees to stay. Gayatri invites the Pandey family for dinner and everyone shares a happy time until they come to a huge shock. Vatsalya comes into Lal Mahal calling Satrupa (Maa). Everyone is shocked including Anami. The series ends on a cliffhanger with Anami and Vatsalya's face.

articleSections.title: Development and premiere
articleSections.text: On 3 August 2016 an article published stating Mahima Makwana and Narayani Shastri being part of the show. On 17 July 2017 the first promo of the show was released on Mahima's Instagram. After that, a series of promos featuring Anami was released with #AnamiEkTsunami on Star Plus web pages. The show produced by Bhupinder Singh and Sanjot Kaur under the banner of Rolling Pictures is a Political, Family Drama loosely based on the story of Mahabharat and depicts grey shades of relationships. The show premiered at 6:00 p.m.(IST) on Monday 7 August 2017 and airs from Monday to Friday. Later on, the show shifted to 8:00 pm.(IST) prime time.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Actresses, Mahima Makwana and Narayani Shastri were chosen to play the role of Anami and Satrupa respectively. Talking about her character Narayani said, "Satarupa is a sophisticated royal woman. She is a strong woman with a mind of her own and I am enjoying playing the same". Mahima, who has to wear a wig of Dreadlocks in the show said, "Which female actress on TV has adorned jattas? It a herculean task to move around and do action scenes with this heavy wig. I always like trying out different things, so it's fun and people are also giving me a positive feedback". Actress, Sangita Ghosh of ' Kehta Hai Dil Jee Le Zara fame, was cast to play Sudha. Newcomer Ankit Siwach landed in role opposite Mahima Makwana. Actor Akash Gill was chosen to play effeminate Character. Initially, Seema Pahwa was cast as Anami's mother. The role ultimately went to Lubna Salim. Actor Benjamin Gilani was earlier cast as Vikramaditya Singh but was replaced by Ram Gopal Bajaj before the release. The other Prominent casts include Ajay Chaudhary, Lubna Salim, Anju Mahendru, Devrshi Shah, Praneet Bhat among others.

title: Rudram
summary: Rudram is a Marathi thriller television series was directed by Bhimrao Mude, written by Girish Joshi and produced by Nikhil Sheth, Vinod Lavekar, Sandesh Kulkarni under the production house Potadi Entertainment. The series starred Mukta Barve, Vandana Gupte, Satish Rajwade, Mohan Agashe among others and debuted on Zee Yuva on 7 August 2017. The final episode was broadcast on 16 November 2017.
plot: Ragini (Mukta Barve) is an ordinary young woman living an ordinary life. Her life is turned up side down when her husband, only child and her father are killed in a car accident, but luckily she survives. Dealing with the following guilt and mental trauma, with the help of her physciatrist (Mohan Agashe) and accompanied by her mother (Vandana Gupte) she discovers that the accident was a premediated murder. This sets her on a journey of investigation and revenge, while struggling with personal and emotional challenges.
