title: Raja Rani
summary:
Raja Rani (transl. King Queen) is an Indian Tamil drama television series that debuted on Star Vijay on 29 May 2017. The show is produced by Global Villagers and directed by Praveen Bennett, and has two seasons.
The first season starring Sanjeev Karthick and Alya Manasa aired from 29 May 2017 to 13 July 2019. The second season premiered on 12 October 2020 and ended with 725 episodes from 21 March 2023. Alya Manasa, Riya Vishwanathan, Sidhu Sid, Asha V. Gowda and Praveena are playing the lead roles in the television serial.
The first season is a remake of the Bengali serial Ke Apon Ke Por of Star Jalsha. The second season is a remake of the Hindi serial Diya Aur Baati Hum of StarPlus.
plot:
The story focuses on Semba Sembaruthi, a maid working for the Rajasekar family. Both Rajasekar and his wife Lakshmi treat Semba as their own daughter, but their daughters-in-law Archana and Vadivu and Rajasekar's elder daughter worry that Semba will inherit part of the family property, reducing their own shares, so they mistreat Semba. Karthik is Rajasekar's youngest son and returns to Chennai after a period spent working as a scientist in Singapore. Karthik combats the difficulties Semba faces.
Karthik's girlfriend Divya comes from Singapore to visit his family. Vadivu's brother Sanjay attempts to seduce Semba but is stopped by Karthik, who decides that Semba should marry and uploads her profile to a marriage website. A groom comes to visit, but Sanjay intercepts him and tells him lies about Semba, so he leaves without meeting her. Archana brings in a groom who is a distant relative and an alcoholic. The groom's family proposes marriage within two days, and Rajasekar's family accepts the proposal. Preparations for the wedding are in full swing when it is discovered that the groom is still married to his first wife, whom he abandoned.
Meanwhile, Karthik and Divya are planning to get engaged on Semba's wedding day. Divya goes to the airport to fetch her parents, who are arriving from Singapore. Semba's marriage is stopped and Rajasekar is blamed by everyone for her pitiable position. Rajasekar is devastated and persuades Karthik to marry Semba to mitigate the disaster of the failed wedding. Divya arrives at the last moment, just in time to see the wedding become official. Divya asks Karthik whether he married Semba only out of pity, but he remains silent and leaves angrily.
After Divya leaves, Karthik expresses his anger by throwing things. His mother realises that her son has been sacrificed, and she becomes furious and turns against her husband, and eventually Semba. Semba does not expect Karthik to treat her like a real wife, so she continues to work as a maid. One day Lakshmi's friend comes to meet Semba, not knowing her history, and she criticises the family for marrying a maid to their son. Humiliated, Lakshmi is persuaded by Archana and Vadivu to call Divya back. Meanwhile, Rajasekar plans a reception for the newlyweds, but is only supported by his brother Chandrasekar, youngest daughter Vinodhini, and her fiancé Harish.
Divya comes to the reception and causes drama when Karthik accepts Semba as his wife. Then the couple prepares to spend their first night together, but Lakshmi suddenly begins to have chest pains. Karthik panics and stays with his mother. Since she is not allowed to see Lakshmi, Semba sleeps alone in the room that she was to share with Karthik. This event is a turning point, as Lakshmi and Karthik begin to appreciate her. Archana, Vadivu and Sanjay all try to undermine Semba and make her leave the house, but Karthik begins to fall in love with her.
A beauty competition leads Archana to overwork Semba by giving her beauty treatments. Karthik becomes angry, and makes Semba participate in the competition, which she eventually wins.
Karthik entrusts Semba with documents about his confidential project involving space and the military. Archana, Vadivu and Sanjay steal the documents and blame Semba. Karthik is angry and humiliates Semba, who finds the documents and reveals that Sanjay was the thief, but is so humiliated that she leaves the house. Karthik later finds her and brings her home.
Karthik and Semba's relationship becomes stronger, and he confesses his love to her and she accepts. Meanwhile, Divya offers Karthik a job without revealing her identity. He and Semba go to a party to celebrate his new job, and find Divya there. She was previously married to Vicky, a rich 65-year-old businessman, and is wealthy.
While Karthik is working at her company, Divya moves into his house as a guest and tries to get help from the family to separate Semba and Karthik. Archana, Vadivu and Sanjay agree to leave Karthik alone in the house, in return for . Divya drugs Karthik; while he is unconscious she tries to have sex with him, but Semba uncovers her plot.
Despite Vinodhini's engagement to Harish, Vadivu's father Devraj wants his son Sanjay to marry her instead, to gain control of Rajasekar's family. When Harish's family asks about the dowry, Devraj increases the dowry to stop the marriage. Rajasekar is not very well off, and tries to take in savings from his bank, but his cheque bounces. The bank manager says that Rajasekar's elder son Amudhan has forged his signature and emptied his account. Devraj, knowing this, has set a trap by making Rajasekar's house security for a loan of lakhs (500 billion), carrying interest of 0.2% per week. At Harish and Vinodhini's marriage, the money lender stops the proceedings by demanding his weekly interest, as Devraj planned. Finally, Rajasekar sells his house to cover the debt. Harish's family members are humiliated by this incident. Archana and Vadivu fight Harish's family and his mother is injured. Kathiresan, Harish's father, then cancels the marriage. The marriage hall manager demands to be paid for the costs of the wedding, and all the family members except Archana and Vadivu give up their gold and jewels including Semba's thaali, the marital holy mangala sutra necklace. The family is left almost destitute, and their family maid Shanthi finds them a modest house. Semba plays a Kabbadi game and Swarna is determined to win against her, and lets Archana and Vadivu join her team. Semba's team wins, angering Swarna. Karthik gets a job but is later rejected due to meddling by Divya. He decides to get a job as a taxi driver and meets Veni, the company owner. Veni likes his pleasant character and starts to fall in love with him not knowing that he is already married. She tells Semba to get them married, but Semba says that she's already married to him. Veni is initially hurt and upset but later forgives them. Harish puts all his effort into impressing Vinodhini, who is angry at him since the marriage incident. Vadivu runs for election against Swarna but loses. Archana sees Amudhan having an affair with another lady and tells Semba, who goes to the lady's house. After she returns, Semba tells Archana to be kind to Amudhan, and Archana starts to like her. Karthik, Semba, Vinodhini and Harish try to scare Vatti, who has just moved into Rajasekar's old house. Vatti catches them red-handed, but later is frightened and tells them if they give him half the sale amount in two days, they will regain their house. Harish promises his parents that after he gives Vinodhini money he will never see her again, and tries to give her money. She realises how much he loves her and rejects the money. Veni helps Karthik's family and gives them some money, and through much effort they are able to get enough money to regain their house. Lakshmi's sister visits the house and holds a competition for best daughter-in-law. Semba wins and Archana gets angry and turns against her again. Vinodhini asks if she can marry Harish and they agree to meet the family, but Harish's family insults them, provoking conflict. She attempts suicide but Semba stops her. She then decides to run away and marry Harish, but the next day she receives a voicemail from Semba saying that Rajasekar had a heart attack, so she returns and agrees to marry the man of her family's choosing. When the family goes to the temple, Harish's parents apologise and ask to have Vinodhini and Harish marry. They agree and the couple marry with the families' blessings. Semba's family goes to the village where she grew up. The villagers believe that Rajasekar killed Semba's father. She eventually discovers the truth and becomes upset with him, but later forgives him. Vinodhini becomes pregnant and the family is happy with the news. Karthik gets a transfer to Singapore and is leaving in a few days. Vadivu scolds her children for going near Semba, but she later realises her mistakes when Semba teaches her a lesson and she apologises to her. On her last day, Archana realises Semba's kind heart and stops her from going to Singapore, and apologises for all her mistakes.

title: Romil and Jugal
summary:
Romil and Jugal is an Indian Hindi web series, produced by Ekta Kapoor for ALTBalaji. It stars Rajeev Siddhartha and Manraj Singh in lead roles. The series follows two young gay men, and the way the society treat them.
The series was made available for streaming on the ALT Balaji App and its associated websites.
plot: The series concerns two modern men who fall in love with each other. Jugal, a Tamil-Brahman boy, is a little bit shy but falls in love with Romil, a Punjabi hunk and playboy. After spending time and navigating life together, they successfully become accepted by their narrow minded society. Their orthodox family also becomes more aware. They understand that their relationship is completely genuine and that they can't live without each other. They end up being accepted as a couple by both the general society and their families, but...

episodesList.title: Love at first sight
episodesList.summary: Ramya narrates the story of Romil and Jugal to Ahalya.In a small town of Colwynganj, Rosie is excited to get intimate with Jugal. Jugal refuses Rosey as he is a gay and a frustrated Rosey pushes him in the pool of water.

episodesList.title: A Kiss And A Punch
episodesList.summary: Ramya explains Jugal has tried to come out many times but her family ignored him . Ramya is in love with Romil. Jugal goes a trip with Romil worrying Mehul as he could break his heart. The book club ladies bunk the book club and join Sunitha's party. In the trip, Jugal kisses Romil for which Romil thrashes Jugal.

episodesList.title: Dream Or Reality?
episodesList.summary: Jugal returns from the trip to home. Jugal's dad warns him to stay away from Romil. Romil kisses Jugal as he realised his feelings for men. Sunitha befriends Subramaniyam whereas Bhagyalakshmi befriends Rajinder. Jugal takes Romil to a private place.

episodesList.title: Virgins No More!
episodesList.summary: Romil and Jugal have sex. Mr and Mrs Kohli and Subramaniyam have a dinner. Mehul worries as she secretly likes Jugal. Ramya flirts with Romil but Romil rejects her saying he is in love with someone else. Sunitha reads the messages of Romil and Jugal and assumes that her son is in love with Rosie.

episodesList.title: Truth and Lies
episodesList.summary: Romil and Rosey perform well their stage roles as Romeo and Juliet impressing their parents to give a shot to their relation. Ramya learns the truth about Romil and Jugal. Jugal decides to reveal the truth to their parents and insists Jugal to do the same. Ramya begs Romil to tell the truth later but Jugal drops the truth. Enraged about this, Jugal's parents disown him. Romil accepts the marriage proposal of Romil and Rosy disappointing Jugal.

episodesList.title: In Love And War
episodesList.summary: Jugal stays with Mehul. Mr.Kohli invites Mr and Mrs Subramaniyam to the engagement of Romil and Rosey. Frustrated Subramaniyam reveals the truth that Romil is a gay.In the fear of acceptance, Romil rejects Jugal and accepts to marry Rosey. Romil breaks up with Jugal and avoids him. Their families celebrate the relationship. Frustrated Ramya stands for Jugal and calls Romil a coward to accept the truth and if he marries Rosey, he would be spoiling her life. Feeling sorry for Jugal, Romil tries to console Jugal but Jugal calls him a coward. Estranged Romil decides to have sex with Rosey and visits her house. He couldn't do it and reveals her the truth. Angered, her father thrashes him outside. Romil reveals the truth to his family. Romil and Jugal mend their relationship and kiss in public. Their families involve in a quarrel publicly and create a public nuisance. Romil and Jugal bail their parents but still they refuse them.

After spending time and navigating life together, they successfully become accepted by their narrow minded society. Their orthodox family also becomes more aware. They understand that their relationship is completely genuine and that they can't live without each other. They end up being accepted as a couple by both the general society and their families, but...

title: Rising Star
summary:
Rising Star is an Indian Hindi-language version of the international franchise series Rising Star, a reality television singing competition. The show premiered on 4 February 2017 on Colors TV. Its third and final season ended on 8 June 2019.
This is the first reality television show in India which involves live audience voting. Votes can be sent through Colors TV app (season 1) and Voot app.(season 2–3)
Playback singer and music director Shankar Mahadevan, actor-singer Diljit Dosanjh and playback singer Monali Thakur formed the trio of experts. Monali was later replaced by Neeti Mohan in the third season of the show. This show marked Dosanjh's television debut.

articleSections.title: Hosts
articleSections.text: The first season of the show was hosted by singer-actor Meiyang Chang and dancer-choreographer Raghav Juyal. Television actor Ravi Dubey took over as host for the second season and was replaced by actor-singer Aditya Narayan in the third season.

articleSections.title: Format
articleSections.text:
In contrast to other singing competition TV shows which feature a cast of celebrity judges, Rising Star features a cast of celebrity experts and considers the viewers at home the judges. During each performance, the audience at home is able to decide in real time whether or not a contestant is sent through to the next round by using a mobile voting app.
While the viewers are considered the "judges", the expert panelists also may influence the vote, but with continuously decreasing percentage votes over the total public vote and not exceeding 5% of the total voting power.

articleSections.title: Auditions
articleSections.text:
The auditions are the first round where the acts are individually called to perform. As a reportage of the announced performer is shown, viewers are invited to register for voting for that specific act. Following a countdown of three seconds, the candidate has to start performing behind a screen called "the wall".
With the start of the performance, the voting kicks in. Registered voters have the option of voting just "yes" or "no". Non-votes are also considered "no" votes. If an expert votes "yes", another 5% is added to the tally of the contestant. The contestants also see random photos of voters in their favour. The faces of panelists voting "yes" are also shown in larger frames.
Once the contestant reaches 80% of "yes" votes, the wall is raised and the contestant goes to the next round of the competition.

articleSections.title: Duels
articleSections.text: Contestants who make it through the auditions are paired by the judges to face off in a duel. The first contestant sings with the wall up and sets the benchmark for the second contestant. The second contestant sings with the wall down. If the second contestant betters the first contestant's vote total, the wall rises and the second contestant was through to the next round while the first contestant is eliminated; if the second contestant fails to raise the wall, the second contestant is eliminated and the first contestant goes through.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: On 16 October 2016, Variety reported that Viacom18 had signed a licensing deal with Keshet International for the format rights to Rising Star. The show began airing on Colors TV from 4 February 2017.

episodesList.title: Rising Star: Season Premiere
episodesList.summary: With phenomenal singing talent pooling in from all across the nation, the stage is set for a battle of epic proportions.Thisis the only reality show where the audience can vote LIVE for their favourites and instantly get them to shoot up the ladder of success. So have you picked your Rising Star yet? Watch the season premiere now.

episodesList.title: Gayatri and Shruti's magical spell
episodesList.summary: The sisters, Gayatri and Shruti are sure to go a long way with their mesmerising voices. Winning hearts all the way, watch what their mentors have to say! Also do not miss the magical vocals of Shankar Mahadevan and Diljith Dosanjh. The excitement has just begun. Stay tuned!

episodesList.title: Double Dhamaal in Rising Star
episodesList.summary: Abhipsa and Ayesha's version of Shankar Mahadevan's Breathless and Das Vegas' Mayya Mayya sets the standard really high for the show. Maithili Thakur mesmerises the audience and the mentors with her song Bhor Bhaye. Kumar Sujoy's unique version of the song Main Solah Baras ki adds more glitter to the evening. Chakor and Suraj of Udaan Sapnon Ki fame come in to encourage the contestants. Don't miss out this epic episode and tune in to find who else made to the mentor's list.

episodesList.title: Rising Star Kids Special
episodesList.summary: Tiny tots from all over the country bring their golden voices on to the Rising Star stage in this Kids Special episode. Anmol Sharma and Loveleen Kaur strike a chord with their Punjabi swag. Nikita Boro gives it her best shot with the song Sawaar Loon and even shares the stage with Monali Thakur. While Nitin Nayak impresses Shankar Mahadevan and bags a free scholarship, Peehu Srivastava gives the hosts a run for their money. Watch to see which of these small wonders manage to make the cut.

episodesList.title: Another Rockstar from Dosanjh!
episodesList.summary: Bannet Dosanjh's dream comes true as he gets to rock out in front of his idol Diljit. But will he be able to impress the voting audience? A bunch of talented singers like Shreyasi Bhattacharya and Piyush Panwar woo the hearts of the mentors with their impeccable performances. Also featuring a few unique brilliant ensembles, Rising Star gets even more interesting as each contestant hopes for the voting bar to fill up. Tune in to see who makes the cut and who goes home.

episodesList.title: The stars in the making
episodesList.summary: From north to south and from east to west, Rising Stars have marked its presence everywhere. From the borders of India- Tibet border to the main stage of Rising Star, soldier Vikram Jeet Singh starts the show with a bang. Raagdeep- a beatbox group follows in with a similar heavyweight performance. Ritesh,Dipsikha and the Humsufi band step up the ante by their rocking performances. Tune in to check out a must watch episode with mesmerising performances.

episodesList.title: When the benchmark is raised!
episodesList.summary: The auditions just got a lot more tougher as the contestants are now required to garner a minimum of 90% votes to qualify. Small wonder Deblina Nath from Kolkata manages to do complete justice to it, but the rest aren't so lucky. Contestants like Jidnesh Vaze and Kausik Kar bring out their A-game and manage to impress the mentors. But will it be enough to bag the required amount of votes and nail the auditions? Tune in to find out!

episodesList.title: Make way for Govinda!
episodesList.summary: The evergreen Govinda is here to rock the show! The search for India's brightest singing talents ends today as its the last day of auditions. Rakshita starts the show with a bang with her rendition of Dil Mera Muft Ka and gets a whopping 94% votes. Dharmendra, Shayani and Vikram Labadiya and group follow in with similar rocking performances.

episodesList.title: Duels Ki Takkar with Anushka!
episodesList.summary: Watch Anushka Sharma set the stage on fire and promote her upcoming film, Phillauri. It is Duels ki Takkar this weekend where a contestant has to beat the percentage of votes that the previous contestant has set in order to go to the next round. While Piyush Panwar's performance of 'Tadap Tadap Ke' gets him 52% votes, Ameya Date gets a staggering 92% vote for his amazing rendition of Tum Hi Ho. Stay tuned as the duels continue between the other talented contestants!

episodesList.title: Kolaveri Di with a Punjabi twist!
episodesList.summary: The war of vocals gets more intense as Duels Ki Takkar continues with more Rising Stars going head to head for their spot in the top 16! Do not miss Diljit's unique Punjabi twist to the viral hit song Kolaveri Di. Contestants realise the harsh reality that even getting 90% votes is not enough when their rival's game is strong. Tune in to find out who will advance and whose Rising Stars dreams will be squashed!

episodesList.title: Duels Ki Takkar reaches closure!
episodesList.summary: It's the final week of Duels Ki Takkar and the competition for the Top 16 spot intensifies. Rubina Dilaik of Shakti fame connects with a voter playing the role of the fourth judge. Deblina Nath sets the bar high with 90% votes for her performance, only to be topped by Ankita Kundu who bags 92% votes. Will Maithili Thakur beat Sayani Pandit or will it be the other way round? There is a surprise in store for them by none other than Shankar Mahadevan. What is it? Watch to find out!

episodesList.title: Holi Special with Varun Dhawan and Alia Bhatt!
episodesList.summary: Holi gets all the more colourful as Varun Dhawan and Alia Bhatt come to promote their new movie, Badrinath Ki Dulhania. As the Duels Ki Takkar comes to an end, Ankita Sachdev gives a mind-blowing performance and bags 93% votes thereby winning over her competitor Sheuli Samaddar. Do not miss Alia Bhatt's rendition of Humsafar that takes everyone by storm. Tune in now to witness the remaining contestants battle it out to be in the Top 16!

episodesList.title: Top 16 ready for the face-off!
episodesList.summary: Powerful voices, notable singers and one rocking band! The Top 16 finalists are ready and raring to go. Once again, Ameya Date casts a spell with his magical rendition of the song 'Kill Dil' that wins him 89% votes. Maithili scores 92% votes for her version of the song 'Albela Sajan' and tops the chart. Watch Rakshita get emotional as she hits the Red zone. Will Nitin's performance lead to Rakshita's elimination? Watch to find out!

episodesList.title: Battle among the Top 16 gets more intense.
episodesList.summary: It is definitely the survival of the fittest, as the battle among the top 16 contestants continues. While Afsana's performance of Ghani Bawri helps her garner 92% votes, Vikram's powerful vocals manage to beat her mark as he garners a staggering 93% vote for his rendition of Saiyyan. The competition intensifies when Diljot Qawwali group's rendition of Baawre/Aaya Tere Dar Pe and Jidnesh Vaze's performance of Jhingat enter into a tie with an equal 88% votes. Who will make it through?

episodesList.title: Battle of the Duets!
episodesList.summary: The contest is heating up. This time the competition gets real tough as there is a risk of a duet couple getting eliminated together. Although Afsana and Bannet's performance of Ainvayi Ainvayi receive an impressive 89% vote, Ameya and Maithili's performance of Badal Ghumad receives 94% vote and a standing ovation. Now with the bar set extremely high, how will the upcoming duet performances be? Watch to find out!

episodesList.title: Vikram Jeet and Ankita raise the bar!
episodesList.summary: As the Duets Challenge rages on, Vikram Jeet and Ankita's performance of O Haseena Zulfowali sets the bar incredibly high. They receive a staggering 96% vote. Now the next duets have an uphill climb. Will they be able to match up to that score? Ankita Kundu and Diljot Qawwali Group's performance of Kajra Re and Jhoom Barabar Jhoom receives 93% vote. Nitin and Chelsi are up next. Will they make it? Tune in to find out!

episodesList.title: Rising Star 1st April 2017
episodesList.summary: Get ready to witness a competition like never before! The contestants have to sing to the beats of the one and only DJ Chetas! Yes, you heard it right! Diljot Qawwali Group's performance of Afgan Jalebi/ Dhadhang Dhang gets 87% votes. While Afsana's performance of Banno fails to touch the desired mark by just 2%, Ameya's rendition of Kabhi Jo Badal Barse manages to gather 87% votes. With another elimination around the corner, whose journey will be cut short tonight?

episodesList.title: A Musical Tribute to loved ones
episodesList.summary: Our loved ones mean the world to us. It is time to pay them a tribute. The singers are all charged up with their emotional performances tonight. While Ameya's dedication to his mother with the song Maa garners him a well deserved 93% votes, Vikram Jeet's triumphant rendition of Chak De India dedicated to his comrades receives 91% votes. Do not miss Afsana sing Lambi Judai for her father. Will she be able to garner enough votes?

episodesList.title: 'Rap' it just like Sonakshi Sinha!
episodesList.summary: The Dabangg girl and rap enthusiast, Sonakshi Sinha makes her presence felt on the Rising Star Stage as she promotes her upcoming film, Noor. Today's cross-cultural theme sees Bannet superseding everyone with the highest votes of 92% for his performance on Niti Khair Manga. While Ameya and Vikram Jeet's performances are hailed, Diljot Qawwali Group and Afsana Khan face the threat of elimination. Do not miss Sonakshi's cool rap duet with Bannet. A must watch!

episodesList.title: Retro-night with Begum Jaan Vidya Balan!
episodesList.summary: Vidya Balan is here for 3 reasons; entertainment, entertainment and entertainment! Present here to promote her upcoming movie Begum Jaan, Vidya simply steals the show. It is time to get nostalgic as the Top 7 contestants sing a few classic songs in their own style. Bannet's performance of Yaad Aa Raha Hai Tera Pyaar gets a well deserved 88% vote, but he faces a tie with Maithili for her performance of Shaan Se. Who out of them will make it to the semi-finals and what will be the fate of the rest

episodesList.title: Vikram Jeet continues his dream run
episodesList.summary: The Grand Finale is near and the pressure to perform is at an all-time high. Bannet's brilliant performance gets him a staggering 84% votes. But it's Vikram Jeet who steals the show with his rendition of Layi Vi Na Gayi that gets him 89% votes and makes him the first contender for the Ticket to Finale duel. Ankita and Maithili's jugalbandi is a bliss to watch. Ameya lands on the red seat after his unexpected shaky performance. Will this be Ameya's last performance on stage?

episodesList.title: Ticket to Finale up for grab!
episodesList.summary: After an flawless rendition and surpassing the likes of Bannet and Ankita, Maithili is all set to lock horns against Vikram Jeet in the Ticket to Finale round. Who will win the highly coveted spot in the final? Despite being ill, Nikita gives a courageous performance on Zoobi Doobi but heads to the red seat due to low votes. As elimination draws closer, will her bad luck turn worse? And do not miss, Bharti Singh's humour is exactly what you need to lighten this tense atmosphere.Tune in!

episodesList.title: Contestants sing with the stars!
episodesList.summary: Established voices from the industry share the stage with the contestants as the finale draws closer. Bannet and Master Saleem's powerful combo is praised as out of the world and is enough to seal Bannet's spot in the finale. Ankita's pairing with the hit machine Neha Bhasin, and Vikram Jeet's performance with the versatile Akriti Kakar creates waves! But it all comes down to the final face-off between the two. Who will be the lucky one? And don't miss Maithili's rendition with Jubin Nautiyal!

episodesList.title: Who will be the nation's first Rising Star?
episodesList.summary: It's the grand finale and the public gets one last chance to choose the nation's first Rising Star. Actor Anil Kapoor is here as a guest judge and to promote the DVD release of the second season of 24. It's a cutthroat competition between the three talented finalists. Ankita makes a comeback with her performance of Kahin Aag Lage and receives 69% votes. With Maithili and Bannet's performances up next, who will be this season's champion? Tune in to find out!

episodesList.title: Season Premiere
episodesList.summary: 3 amazing mentors, countless talented singers and over 1.3 billion judges! Indias only LIVE singing reality show is back with a brand new season. Watch the grand premiere now.

episodesList.title: Doctor Sudeep raises the bar
episodesList.summary: Sudeep Ranjan, a doctor by profession raises the bar on the second day of the season with the song Khamoshiyan. While his performance fetches a staggering 93% votes, the duo of Soham and Chaitanya push the bar higher with the song Dagabaaz Re and bag 94% votes.

episodesList.title: A thanksgiving special
episodesList.summary: Amidst our busy lives, we often forget to thank the people who make our lives a bit easier. Watch this special episode of Rising Stars Season 2 that celebrates the contribution and incessant service of Postmen, Nurses, Dabbawalas and Mothers, coupled with back to back extravagant musical performances.

episodesList.title: Harmony Chorus Group tops the chart!
episodesList.summary: Sindhu Wadekar, the eldest contestant, takes the stage by storm with her rendition of Hansta Hua Noorani Chehra receiving 89% votes. But the Harmony Chorus group tops that with a stunning medley of Kal Ho Naa Ho, Choti Si Asha and Taare Zameen Par receiving 93% votes.

episodesList.title: Vishal's fan moment with Kumar Sanu
episodesList.summary: The young Zaid Ali kicks off the weekend with his performance of the song Mere Rashke Kamar receiving a well deserved 91% votes. But the contest turns even more special for Vishal Srivastava who finally gets to meet his idol, the legendary singer Kumar Sanu. But will starstruck Vishal be able to impress the nation with his performance of the song Ab Tere Bin?

episodesList.title: The Brajwasi brothers dominate
episodesList.summary: The Brajwasi brothers dominate the final day of the auditions. Chetan, Ajay, Hoshiyar and Hemant Brajwasi set new benchmarks with stunning back to back performances. While Chetan garners 93% votes, his brothers gain 94% votes each. Will the remaining three contestants strike a chord with the judges and the nation?

episodesList.title: Manish and Iulia join the singers
episodesList.summary: Manish Paul and Iulia Vantur join the contestants as the stage of music gets ready for the Duels ki Takkar. Who will be eliminated and who will make it to India's favourite 16.

episodesList.title: Sukhwinder Singh takes the stage
episodesList.summary: Sukhwinder Singh joins the panel of judges to boost the morale of the contestants and entertain one and all with his singing. Watch him perform some of his iconic songs on the second day of Duels Ki Takkar.

episodesList.title: Gurdas Maan joins the judges
episodesList.summary: Gurdas Maan joins the judges as the contestants try to impress the King of Bhangra. With only a few positions left in the India's Favourite 16, who will be able to win the judges and the country's heart.

episodesList.title: Sonakshi and Raftaar spice up the stage!
episodesList.summary: The set of Rising Star is made more lively and colourful by the presence of Sonakshi Sinha and Raftaar who promote her new film, Welcome to New York and Roadies Xtreme respectively. With the presence of such talented celebrities in the midst, will the contestants be able to steal the show again? Watch all the performances.

episodesList.title: Duets dazzle the stage
episodesList.summary: Contenders turn into partners as India's favourite 16 gear up for the duets round. With Richa Sharma honouring the show as guest judge, the show begins with Mamta Raut and Afreen Group's medley performance of Billo Rani and Humka Pini Hain. They garner 89% votes.

episodesList.title: Alka Yagnik's tribute to Sridevi
episodesList.summary: As the country mourns the death of Sridevi, Rising Star pays a special tribute to the legendary actor. Joined by guest Alka Yagnik, the contestants render beautiful performances of classic songs starring Sridevi. Also, the judges take the stage to pay homage to the deceased star.

episodesList.title: Kavita's musical homage to Sridevi
episodesList.summary: The tributes continue with the one and only Kavita Krishnamurthy paying homage to the late Sridevi with her melodic prowess. As the contest heads towards another elimination, Vishnumaya's spectacular peformance of Hawa Hawai raises a new benchmark garnering 93% votes.

episodesList.title: A grand show for Hero No.1
episodesList.summary: As the battle for the Top 10 begins, the singers gear up to deliver their best with special performances of songs from Govinda's films and who better to judge them than Bollywood's Hero No.1 himself. Shasank Sekhar kicks off the show with the hit song Main Toh Raste Se Ja Raha Tha that bags him an impressive 85% votes, can that mark be beaten by any of the other performers?

episodesList.title: Celebrating love with the Baaghis
episodesList.summary: With Love as the theme of the new challenge, the singers are ready for a romantic night with the nation. Rohanpreet Singh starts the proceedings with the song Channa Mereya bagging a staggering 92% votes. To make the event even more special, guest judges Tiger Shroff and Disha Patani are here to promote their upcoming film Baaghi 2.

episodesList.title: Rani rocks Rising star
episodesList.summary: With the singers all set to pay homage to their respective Gurus, Rani Mukerji, star of the upcoming film Hichki is here to make the event even more special. Wild card Chetan Brijwasi starts the contest with an energetic rendition of the song Baawre receiving 83% votes.

episodesList.title: Childhood special with Shaan and Manish
episodesList.summary: With childhood memories being the theme of the day, Shaan and Manish Paul are here to join the fun. With the singers all set to make the entire nation nostalgic, young Zaid Ali raises the bar early on with his sweet rendition of Piya Haji Ali garnering an astounding 93% votes..

episodesList.title: Celebrating the evergreen Diva
episodesList.summary: The timeless Diva Rekha is here to sizzle the stage and support the singers, who are all set to pay a musical homage to the evergreen superstar. Vishnumaya Ramesh kicks off the Rekha Special event with the song Dil Cheez Kya Hai that wins her a standing ovation and a staggering 91% votes.

episodesList.title: Former Rising Stars return
episodesList.summary: In a collaborative effort unlike any, past season's contestants Bannet Dosanjh, Maithili Thakur, Ameya Date, Afsana Khan and Diljot Qawwali Group join this season's singers for some stellar performances. Akhtar brothers and Diljot Qawwali Group start off with an amazing rendition of Aaya Tere Dar Par Deewana that garners 90% votes..

episodesList.title: The unparalleled Udit Narayan
episodesList.summary: The battle of the Top 8 just got more grand because the legendary Udit Narayan is here to judge the performances. Rohanpreet Singh kick starts the episode with an ode to the guest judge. His performance of Pehla Nasha receives a well deserved 90% votes.

episodesList.title: A musical Dangal
episodesList.summary: The battle for the Top 6 have begun. Despite Chetan Brijwasi's dismal performance of the song Malhari that garners 58% votes, the singers are in a lively mood. Watch as they engage their singing prowess in a unique musical Dangal. This is not to be missed!.

episodesList.title: Hemant rocks Ticket to finale week
episodesList.summary: The contest for the Ticket to finale has begun and this prompts Hemant Brijwasi to deliver his best performance yet! His mind blowing medley of Bheegi Bheegi and Sunn Le Zara earns him 88% votes, making him the first certified challenger for the Ticket to Finale.

episodesList.title: October comes early on Rising Star
episodesList.summary: Varun Dhawan and Banita Sandhu, stars of the upcoming film October are here to have some fun and, of course, to share their expert judgment on the ongoing contest. With Chetan Brijwasi's stunning medley performance that garners 75% votes, the contest is off with a bang. But who will receive the precious Ticket to Finale?

episodesList.title: A touch of Alia to Rising Star
episodesList.summary: Alia Bhatt, Bollywood sweetheart and star of the upcoming film Raazi is here to make the Grand Finale weekend even grander. Zaid Ali kicks off the exciting contest with his stunning rendition of Teri Deewani that garners 88% votes. to witness the most decisive performances of the season.

episodesList.title: Rising Star Season 2: Grand Finale
episodesList.summary: The search for India's second Rising Star finally reaches its conclusion as the Top 4 finalists engage in another musical contest to win the nation's heart one last time. Kicking off the Grand Finale, Vishnumaya Ramesh hits the right note with her rendition of Hey Rama garnering an astounding 85% votes. Who will take the final victory lap?

episodesList.title: Rising Star 03: Season Premiere
episodesList.summary: Rising Star is back and the stars are aligned with a musical palette, more diverse than ever! From veteran playback singer Usha Timothy's rendition of Aaj Phir Jeene Ki Tamanna Hai garnering 94% votes, to rapper Dee MC's self-composed tune, No More Limits receiving 83% votes. The contest begins with a bang!

episodesList.title: Yeh Shaam, Sukhwinder ke naam!
episodesList.summary: What could be a better tribute to a veteran singer than his song being performed by aspiring rising stars and receiving a standing ovation? Nothing! Guest judge Sukhwinder Singh receives that very honour when Mansi Sisodia's stunning rendition of his song Dil Haara garners a staggering 95% votes.

episodesList.title: SRK joins the Rising star party
episodesList.summary: With Rising Star, the idea of 'Unity in diversity' is truly alive with people of diverse cultural backgrounds coming together for the musical journey of a lifetime. In fact the show has found a new super fan in none other than Shah Rukh Khan. Catch up on King Khan's wise advice for all the aspiring Rising stars.

episodesList.title: Chetan Brijwasi back for more!
episodesList.summary: Remember the Birjwasi brothers? Get ready to relive the trademark Brijwasi vocal prowess because the youngest of them Chetan Brijwasi is back to try his luck once more. Only this time he is back with a voice that will give his contenders a run for their money. Witness his rendition of Jee Karda that garners an impressive 86% votes.

episodesList.title: Duels Ki Takkar: Suparna Vs Usha
episodesList.summary: Join Rising Star as it pays a musical tribute to womanhood through the season's first day of Duels Ki Takkar! Suparna Panda kicks off the proceedings on this wonderful occasion with her rendition of the song Chupke Se garnering 90% votes. Now it's veteran singer Usha Timothy's turn. Will she be able to top Suparna's score and secure a place among India's Favourite 16?

episodesList.title: Sunday Dhamaka: Music with Mumbai Indians!
episodesList.summary: Ever wondered what the combination of cricket and music would be like? Wonder no more because Jasprit Bumrah, Yuvraj Singh and Krunal Pandya, stars of Mumbai Indians, are taking over the weekend and the Rising Star stage to prove that they are more than just cricketers. Witness this one-of-a-kind Jugalbandi of sports and melody.

episodesList.title: Saturday night fever with Mika Singh
episodesList.summary: The epic Duels Ki Takkar continues with a brand new weekend, and it adds a new spice to the musical journey. Mika Singh is here to bestow his star presence as the guest judge and of course belt out some of his biggest hits to the delight of his frenzied fans. Join in on the fun.

episodesList.title: Sunday Ke rang, Kalank team Ke sang!
episodesList.summary: Tonight's Duels Ki Takkar is more than just a contest, its a tribute! The musical tribute is to none other than the amazing cast of the upcoming film Kalank. With Sonakshi Sinha, Alia Bhatt, Varun Dhawan and Aditya Roy Kapur boarding the Rising Star train, the ride is sure to be Dhamakedaar. Catch all the performances and some adorable fangirl moments.

episodesList.title: Course redefined in Duels Ki Takkar!
episodesList.summary: This is the final night of Duels Ki Takkar, and Chow Oupseng Namchoom's performance of Baar Baar Dekho sets a jaw-dropping benchmark with 93% votes. But things go from nerve-racking to absolutely amazing following Chetan Brijwasi's performance when the judges come to a decision that will change the very course of the Rising star journey.

episodesList.title: A tribute to Kumar Sanu!
episodesList.summary: Its time to celebrate as India's favourite 17 have been chosen by the adoring public. What better way to kick off the grand premiere than with a very special guest? Watch as the top 17 showcase their unique vocal prowess and pay tribute to the legendary icon of Bollywood music, Kumar Sanu.

episodesList.title: Rekha's selfless act of kindness
episodesList.summary: Suparna Panda's melody leaves Rekha in awe, and her singing prowess melts her heart. Rekha returns the favour by solving her intricate family issue and reconciles her relationship with her estranged father. Her act of kindness is unique and something which will never ensue on the Rising Star stage, ever again. Watch Rekha's inspirational selfless act.

episodesList.title: In attendance: Students of the year
episodesList.summary: If you thought this summer is hot, brace yourself because Rising Star is set to soar the temperature with another Dhamakedaar weekend! All thanks to the trinity of hotties - Tiger Shroff, Tara Sutaria and Ananya Pandey, stars of the long-awaited movie Student of the Year 2. These gorgeous guests are here to encourage the singers and of course to indulge in non-stop Masti.

episodesList.title: The childhood express to nostalgia station
episodesList.summary: The proverb 'The Child is the father of the Man' rings amazingly true for the young Rising Star contestants. From facing hardships at an early age to facing societal opposition against their dreams and ambitions, the young singers have emerged as the epitome of inspiration. Watch this childhood special episode and enjoy a heartfelt union of music and nostalgia.

episodesList.title: Chow, the Chhota Raj Kapoor!
episodesList.summary: The Rising Stars pay tribute to the Bollywood icons and their iconic songs. The adorable Chow Oupseng Namchoom, starts off this melodic tribute train by garnering 88% votes with the song Mera Joota Hai Japani, that too in Raj Kapoor's iconic outfit.

episodesList.title: Starstruck Sunday with Ajay, Tabu and Rakul!
episodesList.summary: The weekend's epicness quotient is high, all thanks to Ajay Devgan, Tabu and Rakul Preet Singh, stars of the upcoming film, De De Pyaar De. With Ajay delivering his famous dialogues from Singham and Tabu showing off her beat boxing skills, these stellar guests inevitably leave everyone star struck.

episodesList.title: Bow down to Pyarelal, the musical majesty!
episodesList.summary: Thirty stellar musicians and one legendary Bollywood music composer on one stage! Yes, that is exactly what Rising Star has made possible. The great Pyarelal Ramprasad Sharma is here with his incredible music ensemble to set the stage ablaze, and the top 14 contestants pay tribute to the legendary icon.

episodesList.title: A musical homage to parenthood!
episodesList.summary: The aspiring Rising Stars have come a long way from their humble beginnings to being professional singers and rocking the nation. It is all thanks to their parents, and they pay emotional tributes to their loving progenitors. Join in on the tearjerker of a musical evening.

episodesList.title: Battle of the wild cards!
episodesList.summary: Everyone deserves a second chance, and that is exactly what Rising Star is offering Rehmat Ali and Konkan Kanya following their unfortunate elimination. With one more chance at the musical glory, which of these wild cards will secure a place among India's Top 8?

episodesList.title: Padma Shri legends steal the show!
episodesList.summary: What could be a greater honour for the Rising Stars than to witness two Padma Shri award-winning artists set the stage ablaze! That is exactly what they were treated to when the Dhak Dhak girl Madhuri Dixit took over the stage with her dance moves to the stellar vocal performance of the one and only Shankar Mahadevan.

episodesList.title: Abhishek: Rehmat is a limited singer!
episodesList.summary: Rising Star may have seemed like a friendly competition but not anymore! Abhishek Saraf turns the competition into a full-on rivalry by claiming that Rehmat Ali's repertoire is limited! Now, the only way Rehmat can strike back is to beat Abhishek's score of 91% votes. Will his singing also do the talking? To find out watch this Qawwali special episode.

episodesList.title: Blockbuster Sunday with Salman-Katrina!
episodesList.summary: The mere presence of superstars Salman Khan and Katrina Kaif calls for a celebration! But when these stars of the upcoming movie Bharat join in on the celebration, one thing is guaranteed- Unlimited fun! Slow motion dancing, comedy, Salman Khan special trivia and of course musical tributes to the Sultan of Bollywood, it's entertainment overload on the Rising Star stage. Treat yourself.

episodesList.title: Battle to dethrone Sanjay!
episodesList.summary: Sanjay Satish sets the bar high for the ticket to the finale with his stellar performance, winning 89% votes and the admiration of the audience. With many more talented performers in the queue, who all will knock on the door to the finale? Watch all the performances and more.

episodesList.title: Sunday special: Shankar-Tushar jugalbandi
episodesList.summary: So begins the semifinals as the top four fight it out for a place at the grand finale. But if you thought this tense musical battle needs some refreshing extra dose of entertainment, then you are in luck because the judges of Dance Deewane are here to do just that. Witness the weekend's highlight - A jugalbandi of Shankar Mahadevan's voice and Tushar Kalia's mesmerising dance moves.

episodesList.title: Big 3's battle for the grand glory!
episodesList.summary: After 13 weeks of fierce musical battles, the Grand finale is underway. Diwakar Sharma, Aftab Singh and Sanjay Satish lock horns one last time for the ultimate glory! With these Top 3 finalists continuing their high scoring streak until the very end, who will lift the coveted Rising Star trophy?

title: Rakhi Bandhan
summary: Rakhi Bandhan (Bengali: রাখি বন্ধন) is a Bengali television soap opera that premiered on 28 November 2016 and aired on Star Jalsha. Sayanta Modak, Sraboni Bhunia, and Subhrojit Saha play the lead roles. The show was dubbed in Tamil as Minmini Pookal, airing on Vijay Super. The show revolved round the unique bonding between the young actors Krittika and Soham, who played Rakhi and Bandhan respectively. Krittika was applauded for her comic timing, dialogue delivery and expressions. The show took a leap of 12 years in September 2018 and the young actors were replaced by Subhrajit and Srabani as Bandhan and Rakhi respectively. The show was produced by Blues Productions. The show went off air on 3 February after airing 787 episodes and was replaced by Mahapeeth Tarapeeth.
plot: Rakhi Bandhan is the story of a brother and a sister who lost their parents at tender age. They are neglected by their aunt who makes them do all the household chores. Bandhan takes an oath to bring Rakhi up as a good person and send her to school and fulfil all her dreams. The story revolves around Bandhan and Rakhi's relationship.

articleSections.title: 12 years' leap
articleSections.text: Of late, the show has taken a leap as we find Rakhi and Bandhan all grown up, an estrangement threatens to rip them apart. Bandhan still continues to try to bring his sister back under his care from where she'd left, driven by circumstances. Bandhan is determined to mend a straining relationship with his sister and the interpersonal relationship between two siblings still forms the core of the show.

title: Raadha
summary: Raadha is a popular Bengali television Soap opera that premiered on 31 October 2016, and aired on Zee Bangla. It was produced by Surinder Films and starred Aemila Sadhukhan and Ravi Shaw in the lead roles, with Monalisa Paul as the main antagonist. The show used to telecast Monday to Friday at 10:30 p.m. It originally aired at 6:00 p.m. until it got a new timeslot at 10:30 p.m. because of Joyee replacing its old timeslot. The show went off air on 8 December 2017. It was replaced by Rangiye Diye Jao.

title: Rishton Ka Saudagar – Baazigar
summary: Rishton Ka Saudagar – Baazigar (transl. Gambler: The Merchant of Relationships) is an Indian Hindi drama television series of Life OK which premiered on 20 June 2016 and ended on 23 September 2016 owing to lower viewership. Produced by Dhaval Gada and Gurudev Bhalla, it starred Vatsal Sheth,  Ishita Dutta. and Aalisha Panwar,
plot: The story revolves around Aarav and Arundati, who are shown to be very much in love at the start of the show. Aarav seizes every opportunity to surprise Arundhati and make her happy. Soon their wedding preparations begin but on the wedding day, it is revealed that Aarav hates Arundati and was marrying her just to take revenge as Arundhati slapped him in the past. Aarav leaves the mandap leaving everyone shocked. Arundati who's still in a trauma turns out to be pregnant with Aarav's child but later suffers a miscarriage. She decides to take revenge and gain back her lost respect and forcefully enters Aarav's house as his wife and starts living with him. Aarav plots against Arundati in order to kick her out of his house but fails every time. Aarav meanwhile murders his own father. Soon it is revealed that Aarav also killed his mother by poisoning her because she was unhappy with his father and they constantly fought and Aarav wanted to ease her sufferings. Arundati soon realizes that Aarav has some hidden bitter past which greatly affects his present actions and that past is linked to the happenings of his 9th birthday party. She arranges a birthday party similar to that of Aarav's 9th birthday and during the party a wooden door falls on Aarav and he suffers from a trauma which leads to his mind turning to that of a 9 year old. Arundati cares for him while all the other family members doubt her intentions. She finds out that on his 9th birthday Aarav saw his father with his Masi (now his step mom), also he was raped by the house servant. Aarav's dadi and Arundati contact a doctor over Aarav's condition and the doctor asks them to bring the same servant in front of Aarav in order to reverse his trauma. On the other hand it is revealed that Aarav's step mom is plotting to kill both Aarav and Arundati in order to gain hold of the entire property. Aarav regain his memory and decides to trap his step's mom and have her arrested with the help of Arundati. Finally, Aarav and Arundati have a happy reunion.

title: Rettai Vaal Kuruvi
summary: Rettai Vaal Kuruvi is a 2015 Indian Tamil-language soap opera starring Ashwin Kumar Lakshmikanthan and Pavani Reddy as a divorced couple who rekindle their romance. It aired on Vijay TV from 1 June 2015 to 16 October 2015 on Monday to Friday at 9:00PM IST for 99 episodes. It was directed by Jerold, with cinematography by Vishwanathan and music by Saravanan.
plot: The romance drama is about a divorced couple, who begin working at the same office. Nila's father, plans to kill Bala as a revenge on his sister's husband. He brings two local goons from Madurai to kill Bala and is stabbed but survives by the timely help of Nila. Nila and Bala become closer to each other. But as soon as Bala finds out Nila's father tried to kill him he becomes furious on Nila too. Then he goes to his friend, Armugam's marriage in a village to refresh his mind without telling any of his relatives. On the other hand, Nila lies to everyone that she is interested in moving to America as she can't bear Bala's hatred towards her but, moves to the same village to which Bala goes, without knowing his presence in there. It turns out to be Nila, the friend of Arumugam's to be wife, Devayani. Bala and Nila try to be away from each other but as Nila's friends were flirting with Bala, jealousy grows within Nila which brings them closer. Deyvani's mum and Arumugam's sister in law plan to bring them together in various ways, but none work. Pazhani, Deyvani's brother who went to prison for a murder regularly met her secretly, which Bala noticed and doubted on the bride. Without knowing Pazhani to be Devayani's brother, Bala brings the meeting to public, where Pazhani is hit by the village people. Though Bala and Nila get to know about each other's love, they're not expressing it. To ask forgiveness Bala and his friends visit the Deyvanai's place, but Pazhani beats them up. And due to sympathy the family forgives them but a nota for the marriage. Nila really feels sorry and both of them confess their love again. On the same day Nila gets hit by a car and is admitted in a hospital. Due to Nila's critical condition, her family moves her to Germany for treatment, without Bala's knowledge. Bala's passport is blocked by Nila's father ruining all ways to reach her. After few years Nila's sister in law calls Bala and tells him Nila doesn't remember her past. Without anyone revealing about Bala as her HUSBAND, she writes Bala's name on her own whenever she gets a paper. So they realise her love and reunite Bala and Nila with a new start. However Bala tells Nila, that he was her close friend. So she tells him to take her to places they have visited before in his bike. And they start over again.

Without anyone revealing about Bala as her HUSBAND, she writes Bala's name on her own whenever she gets a paper. So they realise her love and reunite Bala and Nila with a new start. However Bala tells Nila, that he was her close friend. So she tells him to take her to places they have visited before in his bike. And they start over again.

title: Reporters
summary:
Reporters is an Indian newsroom drama television series very loosely based on The Newsroom that premiered on 13 April 2015 on Sony Entertainment Television. The show stars Rajeev Khandelwal as Kabir and Kritika Kamra as Ananya.
Producer Shristi Arya stated that after meeting a reporter she was inspired to make a show based on journalists' life. The character of Kabir (Rajeev Khandelwal) is based on Rajdeep Sardesai and Arnab Goswami.
plot:
Reporters is a story in a newsroom backdrop of journalists Ananya Kashyap (Kritika Kamra) and Kabir Sharma ( Rajeev Khandelwal). Ananya is a junior reporter at KKN, the news channel she works for run by Malvika (Megha Chatterjee), the daughter of KL Prasad, the owner of KKN and his friend and partner Khalid (Bikramjeet Kanwarpal). Kabir, after working for Delhi Kranti Newspaper, joins KKN as the Editor-in-Chief. Kabir's special news bulletins at 9 pm brings the show to number one in the ratings. Ananya also puts up her share in KKN's success due to her bright thinking and potential to be a good journalist.
Ananya carries an article that had been written many years ago by Kabir in which Kabir defends her father, Sudhir Kashyap, against accusations made about pharmaceutical company corruption. Because of Kabir, Ananya decided to become a journalist. Ananya and her family are still in the hope that someday they'll meet her father, who had suddenly disappeared after he was released on bail. After the success of KKN's achievement of number one in ratings, Ananya gets a call from a farmer-turned-gunman, Baghi Madhavnath, for an interview, which she wants to do, despite the dangers. Kabir also accompanies her, as this interview can be very useful for their channel (and he secretly also wants to protect her even though they both hate each other). They are abducted by Madhavnath and his gang. After a few episodes, the duo escape thanks to Kabir's quick thinking and skills and escape from the kidnappers, who chase them into the jungle. During the jungle episodes, Ananya and Kabir share a good time with each other. Later, she tells Kabir about her father's story, making Kabir realize that she is the daughter of Sudhir Kashyap. But Kabir deliberately enacts that he doesn't remember her father. The run and chase drama finally ends.
The police finally capture Baghi Madhavnath and his accomplices, and Ananya and Kabir make it to KKN Studio, where they do a joint interview on one of Madhavnath's henchmen who helped them escape from the jungle, after realising how wrong he was about them. Kabir and Ananya finally become friends, with both falling in love with each other without even realising. Ananya also ask for Kabir's help to find the real culprits behind conspiracy against her father. Later Kabir returns Ananya her father's wallet stating that her father committed suicide. Knowing about her father's demise, Ananya's best friend Ronnie (Puru Chibber) who secretly loves Ananya consoles her and her family in their grief. Seeing this Kabir turns jealous and drinks alcohol who had quit drinking long back.
In the same intoxicated condition, he reads the news bulletin and returns to Ananya's home and seeing Ronnie again with her family, he drives back home. While driving back, he gets into an accident. When Kabir is in hospital, Ananya spots Kabir having good time with Tarini, about whom world talks about being his mistress, but are actually very good friends. This leads to a misunderstanding between Kabir and Ananya and their fights and misunderstandings continue for a while. At the same time, Ronnie proposes Ananya and Ananya politely says no to him stating she just considered him as her best friend. This upsets Ronnie and he stops talking to Ananya. Taking advantage of these situations, Malvika plots to remove Ananya from KKN offering her a job in Mumbai with a higher raise and the post of senior reporter through her friend on Mumbai's news channel. Wanting to stay away from Kabir and their fights and also stop upsetting Ronnie, Ananya decides to grab the job and resigns from KKN. Knowing this, Ronnie resolves his issues with Ananya and they become friends again but this doesn't stop Ananya from leaving KKN. Knowing how much Kabir and Ananya actually love each other, their colleague, Trisha, insists Ananya to visit KKN office before she boards her flight to receive a farewell and plans to reunite Kabir and Ananya by lying to her about farewell party, as there wasn't anyone supposed to be in office as everyone had gone for a summit which Kabir didn't attend. Kabir and Ananya being alone in office. Kabir proposes to Ananya and opens his heart in front of her, after which they share a kiss.
Ananya and Kabir finally realize their love for each other and are brought together, and romantic instances start to take place. But then Malvika is not happy about this. She steals the video chip about arms and ammunition smuggling and makes Kabir believe that it was lost due to Ananya's carelessness. Kabir shouts at Ananya in front of everybody in the office. Kabir goes to drop Ananya and after a brief altercation, she fumes out of the car. During the office hours the cold war continues between the two. To apologize to her, on the insistence of Tarini, Kabir goes to her house and ends up telling Ananya's mother about their relationship, who is now upset. But when Kabir explains to her about them, she agrees happily. Kabir asks Ananya out on a dinner date and they spend a wonderful and a romantic night together. Meanwhile, at KKN he's offered to be a 2% shareholder but with a 3-year lock-in period.
Kabir accepts it after Ananya urges him to and Khalid is relieved. The new Business-Head shows up after the merger deal is closed and everyone is stunned to see that it's Shreya (Ankita Bhargava), Ex-Mrs. Kabir Sharma. Kabir sees through all the trickery and accuses Khalid and KL of conspiring against him to force him to stay. Shreya claims to have joined for purely professional reasons. Although in the beginning, Shreya is sweet and polite, especially with Ananya, Kabir doesn't believe her. Disturbed by her presence, Kabir decides to tell Ananya truth about his married life with Shreya. Kabir reveals that he had initially written about a scam at Shreya's office to which Shreya tries to resolve this matter cleverly and challenging her friends that she would make Kabir bow down to her, who is all about his self-respect and principles. Shreya belonged to a rich family and Kabir at that time didn't even own a home and stayed on rent. They both keep meeting again and again regarding work and fall in love and get hitched. Soon after, Shreya starts showing her true colors from time to time, insulting Kabir in front of her friends about his poor financial status. One day, he gets to know about her challenge while at a party with Shreya and her friends. Devastated, he lands on Tarini's doorstep, who is his intern and a good friend. But in a flow of emotions, they both end up spending the whole night together, crossing all limits of marriage, which puts Kabir under guilt for cheating on Shreya, and he confesses to her. Seeking this opportunity which she was waiting for, Shreya divorces Kabir for being unfaithful to her and defames him and Tarini. Kabir feels responsible for destroying Tarini's life and career and starts supporting her (by making her his stringer) and her younger brother Anurag for their living. Ananya very maturely understands Kabir's side and accepts his love and promises to be with him forever. Meanwhile, Shreya also narrates their marriage story to Ananya's mother but altering few details and keeping Kabir at fault and poisoning her mind that Kabir was always hesitant to commit to her. To which Ananya's mother questions Kabir and asks him to get engaged with Ananya if he truly loves her, which he accepts. It is revealed that Shreya is lonely, so she comes back to India to again continue her lost relationship with Kabir. But by this time, Kabir had moved on with Ananya. Shreya teams up with Maanav luring him for the position of Co-Editor-in-chief.
Just a day before their engagement, a bomb scare incident occurs in which a bomb jacket is tied to Ananya and is aired live on the news channel. Seeing Kabir standing strong by her side even in time of death, Ananya's mother realizes her mistake of not trusting Kabir. After the bomb is defused, the next day, Ananya and Kabir get engaged with the happy consent of her mother. Hreya also lands up in their engagement from realizing that Ananya is Sudhir Kashyap's daughter and knows the truth about her father. Soon, Malvika resigns (for personal development).
It is later revealed that RG was responsible for Ananya's father's death and, abir all the while, knew the truth about Ananya's father's death, to which she broke her engagement with Kabir. Kabir had hidden this truth, fearing for the life of his brother Rajveer's son, who had once been kidnapped by the RG, forcing Kabir to unfollow this case. RG and Shreya team up to kill Ananya and Kabir. In all this conspiracy, Ronnie gets killed instead and Maanav realizes that this game is way more dangerous and gets scared. It is later revealed, after an investigation by Kabir, his colleagues and his stringer, that Shreya suffers from split bipolar disorder and is still on medication, which is revealed to the world, and Shreya is fired from KKN. With the help of Maanav, Kabir gets a sting operation done on Shreya and RG and the truth is revealed to the world about the conspiracy against Sudhir Kashyap and served justice. Finally, Kabir and Ananya accept their love for each other and lead a happy life.
reception: Rajyasree Sen of Fir, tpost reviewed negatively saying, "Instead of pretending to be "hard-hitting", maybe it would, be wiser for TV producers to stick to what they're good at – to emoenal ftoly dramas that strike a deadly balance between sexism and over-acting." Daily News and Analysis rated it 3/5 and summarized it as, "Definitely a change from the routine fare on TV, but needs to focus more on news gathering rather than breaking news." Indian Express rated 2/5 saying, "Reporters is all rattling bones with no flesh to sink one's teeth into."

Kabir explains her being calm is the only escape tactic they have, to keep away from Baghi's crosshair. KKN broadcasts the kidnapping of both their reporters leaving Ananya's family devastated.

Police start their work and locate Baghi's hideout where Kabir and Ananya have been held hostage, however they manage to escape form the spot.

episodesList.title: Junior Reporter Ka Khulasa
episodesList.summary: Kabir Sharma and Ananya Kashyap are being taken deeper into the jungles, Ananya Kashyap realizes that her locket has gone missing. Although, Kabir explains to her that he has dropped the locket on purpose, Ananya runs back in order to get her locket. Madhav and other naxalites see this and Madhav is forced to shoot Ananya in order to stop her. Meanwhile, Ananya's mother is being convinced that she is alive as her locket has been found. At the same time, the media decides to launch a mass protest to ensure the safety of Kabir and Ananya. Will Ananya meet her end at the hands of Madhav? Keep watching to know more.

episodesList.title: Ananyas Chip
episodesList.summary: Kabir and Ananya try to untie themselves but their job is only half done as Madhav approaches them. Madhav informs them that the movie against him will be releasing in spite of all the warnings and decides to kill Kabir. Kabir, on the other hand, stands fearless and claims that Madhav is treading the wrong path and is trying to hide his crimes by prohibiting the movie from its release. Kabir by now, manages to untie himself completely and escapes Madhav's camp along with Ananya, with the help of Desu. But will Kabir and Ananya land in safe hands without any kind of hinderance from Madhav? Find out here.

episodesList.title: Ananya Wants an Apology
episodesList.summary: Madhav points his gun towards Kabir and Ananya who had earlier managed to escape from him. But before he takes his shot, inspector Khurana enters the picture and rescues the reporters. The naxalites are later, arrested and almost instantly, the news of Kabir Sharma and Ananya Kashyap being safe, reaches the employees of KKN news channel.The employees begin to celebrate and moments later, Kabir and Ananya join this celebrations. Later, Kabir decides to read the breaking news for the channel and asks Ananya to join him. What effect will Kabir and Ananya's news have on the viewers? FInd out here.

episodesList.title: Kabir Spills the Beans
episodesList.summary: Ananya's friends decide to have a party to celebrate her safe return and her mother too agrees to the party. Meanwhile, Malvika and Khalid invite Kabir to go out for dinner but Kabir decides to spend the night alone. Kabir later, turns down Ananya's invitation to the party too. Later, Ananya narrates all that had taken place during her encounter with the naxalites, to her friends, during the party. She later, hears about Kabir's divorce from her friends and gets upset. Keep watching to know more.

episodesList.title: Kabir Gets the Power
episodesList.summary: Ananya and Kabir spend some time messaging each other before going to sleep and next morning, the Ananya brings a box of sweet dish for Kabir. Kabir is more than pleased to see the tiffin box in her hand and agrees to have the dish. Later, Kabir has a meeting with his staff and just then, Ananya gets a call about a lead that has developed on the roads of Delhi. She takes Kabir's permission to shoot the incident for the news channel. She ends up surprised when she realizes that this lead is about Navdeep Mahajan who wants to commit suicide as he is love with a girl whom he has not even proposed yet. Will this situation make for a good news coverage? FInd out how Ananya deals with this case.

episodesList.title: Episode 42
episodesList.summary: Ananya reaches the office and meets all of her colleagues who seems extremely happy with her news reporting skills. Kabir too signals her with his thumb raised upwards and Ananya is pleased to see him happy. But this makes Malvika jealous. Later, Rony reaches Ananya's home and decides to take her out for dinner. Ananya agrees, but she later refuses when Kabir calls her and expresses his desire to meet her. Kabir later enters her house and starts to tell her the truth regarding her father's death. Will Ananya learn the entire reality of her father death? Find out here.

episodesList.title: Episode 43
episodesList.summary: Ananya's mother arrives home and finds her daughter upset. On enquiring about the matter, Ananya produces the wallet that belonged to her father and reveals that her father is no more. Ananya's mother initially refuses to believe her daughter, but later bursts into tears. Meanwhile, Kabir seems upset as he has broken all of Ananya's hopes by informing her about her father's death. Later, in the office too, Kabir seems preoccupied by thoughts of Ananya. Rony later learns of Ananya's plight and immediately goes to his boss, Malvika, with a request to take a half day leave. When Malvika refuses to give him the leave, he decides to resign from the office, but Malvika stops him and gives him the leave. Will Kabir Sharma too reach Ananya's house in order to console her? Find out here.

episodesList.title: Episode 44
episodesList.summary: Malvika and Khalid start to get worried about Kabir, who has not turned up to the office, although it is almost time for him to read the news. But fortunately, Kabir arrives on time, and reads the news. He interviews, Navdeep and Jyoti, the two young lovers who had made headlines a few days earlier. While interviewing them, he refers to Jyoti as Ananya and the entire staff is shocked to see Kabir going wrong. Later, Manav tries to create a scene and accuses Kabir of being drunk while reading the news. However, the entire staff do not support his accusations. Keep watching to know what happens next.

episodesList.title: Episode 45
episodesList.summary: Kabir is admitted to the hospital. The doctor sees his reports and declares him out of danger. Khalid comes over there and talks to the physician about Kabir’s health. Khalid mocks at Kabir’s condition and asks Kabir why he is becoming the old Kabir. Ananya enters into the office, where she get to know about the Kabir’s accident. She get worried and dials Kabir’s number. Richa comes to meet Kabir in the hospital where she ask Kabir to admit that he loves Ananya. Ananya tries to meet Kabir when she is about to leave the office, her boss come and stop her. Ananya tries to make her understand Will Ananya be able to meet Kabir.Keep watching to know what happens next.

episodesList.summary: Watch The Episode!

episodesList.title: Episode 47
episodesList.summary: Ananya learns that Kabir has left for Singapore and tries to find out about the reason behind his sudden departure out of the country. However, she does not get a proper answer to her questions and she is left tensed. Meanwhile, Manav speaks to Malvika and offers her to join his team against Kabir but Malvika refuses his offer. Later, Manav heads a meeting where he distributes work to the staff. Malvika later, relieves Ananya of the interview that she was supposed to conduct of Syal. She later adds that it is Kabir's order to have her relieved. Ananya once again is confused and starts to think about her relations with Kabir. Manav, on the other hand, starts forming a team of his own, in order to, take the position that Kabir currently holds. Will Manav succeed in his cunning intentions? Find out here.

episodesList.title: Episode 48
episodesList.summary: Rony finally develops enough courage and proposes his love to Ananya but Ananya gives him no answer. Later, Ananya discusses about Rony with her mother and friend and all ask her to accept Rony's proposal as he is the right guy for her. Ananya however, refuses to accept his proposal as Rony is only her friend and she has no feelings for him. Later, Rony enters Manav's room for some work purpose and Manav starts to discuss about Ananya and Kabir with him. Will Ananya accept or reject Rony's proposal? Find out here.

episodesList.title: Episode 49
episodesList.summary: Manav appreciates Richa as she reads the news and later offers her to read a special business news too. Ananya, on the other hand, continues to remain troubled about Kabir and she goes to his office and speaks to his chair. She starts to accuse him of breaking people's heart and treating relationship as a means for entertainment. Ananya however, is shocked when Kabir appears before her. Later, Kabir spends the night thinking about Ananya, while Ananya spends the night laying in her room. Will Kabir and Ananya make any efforts to take their relationship forward? Find out here.

episodesList.title: Episode 50
episodesList.summary: Rony reads the letter written by Ananya for him, which explains that she wants him to be her best friend and shares no other feelings for him, unlike him. Later, Ananya enters Kabir's room, in order to speak to him, but then, Malvika too enters the office and begins to speak about the previous night that she had spent with Kabir. This obviously gets Ananya jealous and she walks out, upset. Later, Kabir has a meeting with the senior staff but during this meeting, he ignores every question put forward by Ananya and instead answers the questions laid out by the others. Will Ananya succeed in solving the various problems that her life has put forward for her? Find out here.

episodesList.title: Episode 51
episodesList.summary: Ananya stands shocked when Kabir stands before her and asks her out for dinner. But Ananya feels bad when she realizes that Kabir was speaking to Malvika and not her. Later, Ananya speaks to her mother about the complications that her life is pouring upon her. Next day, Khalid informs Kabir of author Nalini Verma's arrival to India and Kabir suggests Ananya's name to handle the book launch event. Ananya meanwhile, speaks to Richa and expresses her wish to leave KKN news due to the problems in her life. Richa, on the other hand, advices her to concentrate on her work and not let anything else take priority in her life. Will Ananya succeed in escaping the complications of life? Find out here.

episodesList.title: Episode 52
episodesList.summary: While, Ananya meets Nalini and brings her to KKN office, Kabir spends time with Anurag and pampers him until a new maid named Priyanka arrives. Later, Kabir meets Nalini and she informs Kabir about the pain that she notices in Ananya's eyes. After a while, Kabir has a meeting with his staff where he distributes the responsibilities among them. Just then, he gets a call from Anurag, who makes a demand for 'baigan ka bharta'. Having no idea about the dish, he asks his staff for the recipe. When Kabir asks Ananya for the recipe, she speaks rudely and refuses to indulge in any activity not concerning her job. Will Kabir have to meet Anurag's demands himself? Find out here.

episodesList.title: Episode 53
episodesList.summary: Anurag is pleased to see Ananya with a lunch box that contains his favorite dish, 'baigan ka bharta' in it. Anurag later, persuades Kabir to prepare coffee for Ananya while he  spends time with her. Later, Ananya leaves Kabir's house and Kabir goes on to narrate a romantic tale to Anurag that has Ananya in it. Next day at office, Ananya meets Nalini whom she is supposed to interview. A while later, Manav enters Rony's office and tries to convince him to sign on the papers that will help him replace Kabir. But Rony refuses to sign the papers. Watch the entire episode to witness the conversation between Nalini and Ananya.

episodesList.title: Episode 54
episodesList.summary: Nalini speaks to Ananya about love and advices her to invest as less as possible on emotions such as love. Later, Ananya learns that Rony has decided to leave the job, in order to stay away from her and this upsets Ananya. Malvika, on the other hand, makes a plan to get rid of Ananya who is a hinderance in her relationship with Kabir. As per Malvika's plan, Ananya gets an attractive job offer from a competing news channel. Later, Kabir is forced to replace Ananya and takes Nalini's interview. But this interview turns out to be a nightmare for the author. Find out how? Will Kabir let Ananya leave KKN office? Keep watching to get your answers.

episodesList.title: Episode 55

He later, brings Nalini's lover, Shekhar and Nalini is shocked to learn that Shekhar had lost his legs. Shekhar had decided to leave Nalini as he did not want to be a burden to her. Nalini realizes her mistake and repents as she apologizes to Shekhar. After the interview concludes, Ananya leaves the office and Malvika seems happy. Richa and Trisha later, are astonished at the news of her resignation and decide to do something about it. Will Trisha and Richa succeed in stopping Ananya from leaving the KKN office? Find out here.

episodesList.title: Episode 56
episodesList.summary: Ananya's mother is not very happy about her daughter transferring to Mumbai but Ananya insists on leaving Delhi for better job prospects. Later, Ananya's colleagues from the office, meet her and try to convince her to not leave KKN office but Ananya sticks to her decision. Next day, Ananya reaches her office before leaving for Mumbai, in order to meet her friends for the last time. But she is surprised, when she finds the entire office empty. Her surprise turns into shock when she finds Kabir waiting for her at the office. Will Kabir stop Ananya from leaving KKN office? Find out here.

episodesList.title: Episode 57

Manav informs Malvika that Kabir is busy in something more important than delivering a speech, and has said him to deliver the speech on his behalf. Meanwhile Kabir and Ananya are busy romancing and expressing their feeling for each other. Kabir insists her to maintain the relation between an Editor-in-Chief to that of a Junior reporter. Watch full episode to know more about Kabir and Ananya’s new relation.

episodesList.title: Episode 58

Kabir too is overcome by emotion and he suddenly declares dinner from his side to the entire office. Everyone in the office, including Malvika senses something fishy about Kabir's current behaviour. Keep watching to know what happens next.

episodesList.title: Episode 59
