title: Rangrasiya
summary: Rangrasiya (transl. The One Who Colours Me) is an Indian television drama series that aired on Colors TV from 2 January 2013 to 13 September 2014. It starred Ashish Sharma as Major Rudra Pratap Ranawat and Sanaya Irani as Parvati.
plot:
Parvati, affectionately known as Paro, has pure hatred towards Bharat Suraksha Dal, aka BSD officers, holding them responsible for the death of her parents. She was brought up by Thakurain Mala, and has consistent nightmares about her parents' deaths. The corrupt Raja Tejawat arranges Paro's wedding with Varun who plans to smuggle weapons across the border during the wedding procession. The procession is disrupted by BSD officers led by Deputy Commandant Rudra Pratap Ranawat and Varun is killed.
An oblivious Parvati blames Rudra for her husband's death. Rudra suspects that she is a material witness and hopes that she will testify. To prevent this, Tejawat hires goons to murder her. Rudra relocates her to his paternal home but when his malicious aunt Mohini insults Parvati's virtue, Rudra's father covers for them and announces she is Rudra's fiance. Eventually, Parvati emotionally sympathizes with Rudra after learning that his mother eloped with another man, unaware that his mother is the Thakurain. On the day of her wedding to Rudra, Parvati chooses to trust Tejawat and flees with him only to discover the truth behind her marriage to Varun. Upon realizing her mistake, she also becomes aware of her love for Rudra and returns to him.
Parvati tries her best to win over Rudra but in vain. He is accused of domestic violence and loses his job after which in a drunken state, he marries Paro. Rudra is reinstated and initially rejects Paro for betraying him but recognizes that he loves her. The couple go through: Rudra recovering from paralysis of his right arm, the interruptions of his ex-girlfriend, Laila and their mutual hesitation to confess their love for each other. They eventually unite and confess their feelings.
Thakurain Mala and Rudra meet again but Rudra has pure hatred towards her. Paro tries hard to unite mother and son and is eventually successful. Touched by his efforts to forgive his mother for her, Paro and Rudra finally consummate their marriage. The family is happy till Rudra receives an anonymous call saying that Paro will be killed. For safety, the family relocates. Varun's younger brother, Shanthanu Kumar enters their house as a bodyguard seeking revenge. Parvati finds out and Rudra comes in time to save her. Shanthanu gets arrested. Later, Parvati becomes pregnant and gives birth to a boy that the couple name Dhruv. Their happiness ends abruptly, when Shanthanu escapes from prison and murders Parvati, who dies in Rudra's arms. Shantanu is killed by Rudra.

articleSections.title: 7 Years Later
articleSections.text:
Rudra lives with his now seven-year-old son, Dhruv and his family. Having quit the BSD, his new assignment is being the bodyguard of Myrah Mehra. Myrah, who is identical in appearance to Parvati, is an NRI and has arrived from the US to pick a venue for her wedding to Rohit Sehgal. Rudra tries to keep his distance from her, in the process becoming hostile. While she is in Rudra's house, Myrah unknowingly falls in love with Rudra and they become friendly. When he rescues her from kidnappers, he recalls how he failed to save Parvati. Under the influence of pain medication, Myrah kisses Rudra, who reciprocates, thinking she is Paro, but catches himself just in time.
While Myrah starts to accept her feelings for Rudra, he expresses his frustration over her resemblance to his late wife, Parvati. Heartbroken, she decides to leave Rudra's life, but her fiancé arrives, inspiring jealousy in Rudra. After Myrah helps Maithlee and Samrat adopt a baby, Rudra develops a liking for her. Rudra refuses to confess that he loves Myrah, but has a conversation with Paro in a dream where she tells him to move on and be happy. She assures him that she has sent Myrah for him and Dhruv. In a drunken state, Rudra confesses his love to Myrah. She is confused about her feelings for him and chooses to marry Rohit. Rudra writes a letter in which he apologizes for being unable to attend her wedding, because he cannot bear the loss. Myrah sends a video that explains her love for Rudra to Rohit, who asks Myrah to pursue it. The show ends with Rudra and Myrah confessing their love, and the whole family celebrating.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Ashish Sharma as Deputy Commandant Rudra Pratap Ranawat: Idealistic Border Security Force Officer; Dilsher and Mala's son; Danveer's nephew; Samrat, Sumer and Sunehri's cousin; Parvati's second husband; Myrah's love interest; Dhruv's father *Sanaya Irani in dual roles as **Parvati "Paro" Pratap Ranawat (née Chauhan): Mala's foster daughter; Varun's ex-wife; Rudra's wife; Dilsher and Mala's daughter-in-law; Dhruv's mother **Myrah Mehra: Parvati's look-alike; Rudra's love interest *Rishi Sonecha / Kapish Chawla as Dhruv Pratap Ranawat: Rudra and Parvati's son; Samrat, Sumer and Sunehri's nephew; Dilsher and Mala's grandson

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
The show was shot extensively across arid terrains of Jaisalmer and dunes of Jodhpur. It was inspired by Shakespeare's Othello and the TV show Guns and Roses.
On 31 May 2014, Rangrasiya had a crossover with TV Show, Beintehaa when Rudra and Paro had travelled to Mumbai for the treatment of Rudra's paralysed hand.

episodesList.title: Parvati and Rudra’s Childhood
episodesList.summary:
Paro comes across an injured camel in the desert, looking around she sees a person approaching, she calls out for help. As the person comes near her she gets shocked, to see that he is a BSD officer. Paro, suddenly, wakes up from her dream, trembling and scared. Seeing her scared, her aunt asks her that has she seen the same nightmare again. Watch the episode and know what happens next.

The is a story of a young village girl, Parvati, and a BSD officer, Rudra.Their both follow different ideologies in life. While one believes in love, the other hates anyone who believes in that emotion, and yet get attracted to each other.How their cross paths and fall in love is the story.The show will portray a strong, passionate and aggressive love story.

episodesList.title: Parvati is Chosen to be a Bride Soon
episodesList.summary: Parvati wakes up trembling and scared from a nightmare about the BSD Officer. Meanwhile, Thakur Saheb finds the person who is cheating them. Later, Nag Devta chooses Parvati's bowl of milk, which as per ritual means that she will become a bride soon.

episodesList.title: Rudra is Assigned to a Mission in Birpur
episodesList.summary: Thakur Saheb announces that Parvati was selected to be a bride within a week by the snake God. Meanwhile, General V.K. Singh informs Rudra about his next mission in Birpur and this reminds Rudra of his childhood in Birpur.

episodesList.title: Rudra Saves Parvati from Goons
episodesList.summary: The Brigadier orders Rudra to go to Birpur as a spy. Meanwhile, a jeweller sends Parvati with some money to Thakur Param Singh. Later, Rudra rescues Parvati from some goons who are manhandling her.

episodesList.title: Rudra Begins his Investigations in Birpur
episodesList.summary: Rudra gets shot while rescuing Parvati from the goons, but he manages to drop Parvati home safely. On hearing about the incident from Parvati, Thakurain Mala is suspicious of the new BSD officer in the village. Later, Rudra starts his investigations.

episodesList.title: Rudra is Suspicious About Immigrants
episodesList.summary: Thakur Param Singh suspects that jeweller Kesri is stealing his money. Meanwhile, Rudra gets information about some infiltrators crossing the border and is suspicious that they are spies. Later, Parvati is excited about wearing her wedding dress.

episodesList.title: Varun and Parvati Exchange Rings
episodesList.summary: Thakur Param Tejawat welcomes Parvati's wedding party. Meanwhile, Rudra arrives at the venue to keep an eye on the proceedings, but Tejawat sneaks into the store room to check on the guns. Later, Varun and Parvati exchange rings.

episodesList.title: Bindi Shocked to See Guns in Haveli
episodesList.summary: Amandeep and Rudra enter the Haveli in disguise. Later, Amandeep sees Kesari and chases him. Meanwhile, Bindi takes Parvati to meet Varun and while coming back notices the guns being assembled in Haveli and gets shocked.

episodesList.title: Thakur Tells Bindi abotut his Gun Supply
episodesList.summary: Bindi informs Thakur about the guns. He then reveals to her about his guns supply and pushes her in the water. Later, he informs Thakurain that Parvati's marriage has to be hurried. Meanwhile, Rudra prints a fake search warrant to catch Thakur.

episodesList.title: Parvati Gets Married to Varun
episodesList.summary: Varun and Tejawat plan to smuggle weapons during the wedding. Parvati gets married to Varun. Meanwhile, Tejawat provokes Parvati against Rudra by telling her that BSD officers took Bindi. Later, Tejawat stops the BSD from searching the Haveli.

episodesList.title: Rudra catches Varun Red-handed
episodesList.summary: Parvati leaves from Haveli after her farewell. But Rudra catches Varun and the marriage for smuggling weapons across the border and they have a shoot out. Later, Rudra is shocked on seeing Parvati there.

episodesList.title: Rudra Reinstates Honour of the Indian Flag
episodesList.summary: After attacking Rudra, Thakur Tejawat's goons dishonour the Indian flag. This infuriates Rudra and he gets up and beats all of them and kills their leader. Later, Rudra shoots Varun in the head and Parvati watches as he dies.

episodesList.title: Rudra Kills Varun
episodesList.summary: Rudra kills Varun in the shoot out and imprisons Parvati as a witness. Meanwhile, Tejawat is angry as Rudra interrupts his smuggling business. Later, Rudra mourns for soldiers who died as a martyr in the shoot out and Parvati is sad for her loss.

episodesList.title: Rudra Interrogrates Parvati
episodesList.summary: Suspicious of the gun smuggling, Rudra Pratap assumes Parvati is an accomplice in the crime. He interrogates her in jail while she mourns the death of her husband; hoping Parvati will reveal any information pertaining to the case.

episodesList.title: Paro’s Aunt Refuses to Recognize Her
episodesList.summary: Rudra Pratap takes Paro to her aunt. She refuses to recognise Paro on Tejawat's commands, which forces Rudra to take her with him.

episodesList.title: Paro Is In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Rudra Pratap questions Paro while she is in custody and Thakurain Mala becomes worried for Paro. Meanwhile, Thakur Tejawat in trying to prevent any possibility of her testifying against him and hires goons to murder Paro inside the BSF compound custody.

episodesList.title: Rudra Protects Parvati
episodesList.summary: Rudra and Parvati are admitted in a hospital where the doctor plans to kill Parvati. Rudra gets her shifted to his ward as he feels she is unsafe. Later, Parvati starts panicking in her sleep remembering her parents death and Rudra calms her down.

episodesList.title: Rudra Saves Parvati
episodesList.summary: Danveer tells Mohini about Rudra and says he wants to bring him home, but Mohini disagrees. Meanwhile, the doctor injects a chemical in Parvati's saline drip, but Rudra removes the drip tube to save her. He tries to catch the doctor, but he escapes.

episodesList.title: Rudra Takes Parvati to a Safer Place
episodesList.summary: Parvati knows that Rudra has saved her life. However when Rudra wants to take her to a safer place she tries to escape. Later, he makes a plan with Aman where they fake Parvati's death. Tejawat gets news of this and becomes very happy.

episodesList.title: The Dark Side of Thakur Tejawat
episodesList.summary: Rudra Pratap manipulates Paro's death to save her from Thakur Tejawat. Meanwhile, Thakur Tejawat gives the villagers false hopes about attacking Rudra Pratap. Later, Rudra takes Paro to her home to keep her safe from Tejawat and his goons.

episodesList.title: Rudra Divides His House
episodesList.summary: In order to protect Parvati, Rudra divides the house into two and nails the curtains to all the windows. He warns everyone to not step on his side, at this his aunt gets angry and threatens that her sons will set things right.

episodesList.title: Rudra Brings his Father Back
episodesList.summary: Rudra visits his father and ignores his protests to pack his bags and get him back to their house. Later, on hearing about Rudra's return, Sumer comes home and gets into a fight with Rudra over his room.

episodesList.title: Rudra Conspires to Arrest Parvati and Thakurain
episodesList.summary: Rudra tells Dilsher that he has held Parvati against her will as she denied to give a statement against the weapon-smuggling racket. Rudra allows Parvati to go back to Veerpur but follows her in order to catch the Thakurain and Parvati red handed.

episodesList.title: Parvati Returns to Rudra’s House
episodesList.summary: Parvati is shocked to learn that Rudra and his officer are following her. She hides and overhears their conversation. Rudra is disappointed, but also worried as Tejawat's henchmen may reach Parvati soon. Later, Parvati's presence in his house puzzles him.

episodesList.title: Parvati Decides to Face Rudra
episodesList.summary: Parvati informs Rudra that she is ready to fight with him to make him realise that he is wrong and she will wait until the day he apologises to her for spoiling her life. Later, Rudra ties her hands and locks her up like a criminal.

episodesList.title: Laila Warns Rudra
episodesList.summary: Mohini is upset about Samrat incurring a loss of two lakhs. Meanwhile, Parvati is hesitant to share the room with Rudra. Later, Laila feels insecure as Rudra asks for clothes from her for another woman.

episodesList.title: Sunehri Asks Rudra about Parvati
episodesList.summary: Laila warns Rudra not to go close to Parvati. Meanwhile, Sunehri unknowingly falls on Parvati and asks Rudra about her. On the other hand, Maithili is upset as she cannot become pregnant. Later, Rudra tears Parvati's sleeve accidentally.

episodesList.title: Parvati’s Identity is Discovered
episodesList.summary: Major Rudra Pratap reminds his younger brother Samrat, that the house is still in the name of his father. Meanwhile, the family discovers under cover Parvati when Dilsher Ranawat suffers from a bronchitis attack.

episodesList.title: Mohini Humiliates Parvati
episodesList.summary: Dilsher and Parvati discuss about Dilsher's lie to the family, when Danveer walks in and warns them about Mohini finding out the truth. Later, Mohini barges into Parvati's room and drags her out to humiliate her.

episodesList.title: Rudra Takes Parvati to BSD Camp
episodesList.summary: Rudra takes Parvati to a BSD camp fearing about her life in Mohini's haveli. On the other hand, Mohini starts taunting Dilsher after Rudra leaves the haveli. Mohini cuts the ropes which have been tied by Rudra to divide the house. Later, Sumer, Mohini's son searches for the original documents of the haveli with an intention to sell it.

episodesList.title: Rudra Returns Home with Parvati
episodesList.summary: Amongst numerous taunts Mohini orders Maithili to finish her chores. Meanwhile, Rudra comes home with Parvati and is introduced as Rudra's fiancee. Later Rudra warns Parvati not to reveal the truth to anyone and also not to go out.

episodesList.title: Mohini Provokes Rudra
episodesList.summary: Danveer informs Rudra's mother about Rudra returning home. Meanwhile, Mohini plans to find out about Parvati and Rudra's relationship. Later, she provokes Rudra by talking about his mother, this upsets Rudra and he becomes emotional.

episodesList.title: Rudra Helps Parvati in the Kitchen
episodesList.summary: Parvati tries find the truth about Rudra's mother from Sunehri. Meanwhile, Mohini asks Parvati to make breakfast and Rudra helps her by teaching her how to light gas and use the mixer. Later, Rudra confronts Mohini at the dining table.

episodesList.title: Sumer Misbehaves with Parvati
episodesList.summary: Amandeep informs Rudra that Parvati's life is in danger because of Tejawat, but Rudra assures him of Paravti's safety. Later, Sumer's ill treatment of Parvati irritates Rudra.

episodesList.title: Maithili Opens Up
episodesList.summary: Maithili decides to tell the family about the complications regarding her fertility, and Samrat tries to stop her. She opens up to the family and also informs them about her wish to consult an orphanage, however, Mohini is against her.

episodesList.title: Rudra Saves Parvati from Mohini
episodesList.summary: When Parvati questions Mohini for her ill treatment towards Maithili, Mohini tries to slap Parvati; but Rudra saves her against Mohini. He takes Parvati away and makes her realize not to interfere in the household's issues.

episodesList.title: Rudra Gets an Ultimatum
episodesList.summary: BSD officials give Rudra a four day deadline to prove and justify his actions that he carried out without any instructions from his superiors or face court-martial. Meanwhile, Mohini gets a priest to fix a date for Rudra and Parvati's marriage.

episodesList.title: Parvati Pleads with Dilsher
episodesList.summary: Parvati begs Dilsher to stop her and Rudra's marriage from taking place, and Dilsher soothes her and asks her to not worry about the matter. Later, Sunehri congratulates Parvati, and informs her of Mohini's request.

episodesList.title: Rudra asks Parvati to Sign the Statement
episodesList.summary: Rudra announces infront of everyone that he wants to get married in the next four days and that Mohini will bear the expenses. Later, He threatens Parvati to sign the statement against Tejawat and promises that he will stop the marriage if she does.

episodesList.title: Mohini Offers Parvati a Deal
episodesList.summary: A drunk Sumer fails to recognise Parvati's photo. Meanwhile, Dilsher tells Rudra that his decision to marry Parvati is wrong. Later, Mohini talks to Parvati and asks her to conspire with her against Rudra. Parvati gets confused about joining Mohini.

episodesList.title: Rudra’s Marriage Preparations Begin
episodesList.summary: Rudra's marriage preparations are going on. Meanwhile, Parvati tells Mohini that she doesn't want to marry Rudra. Later, Rudra asks Parvati if she ever thought of her marriage being a compromise and she answers in affirmative.

episodesList.title: Thakurain is Rudra’s Mother
episodesList.summary: Dilsher and Danveer try to stop Rudra from continuing with the marriage. But he refuses to listen and performs Ganpati Sthapna as the first ritual for marriage with Parvati. Later, its revealed that Thakurain Mala is Rudra's mother.

episodesList.title: Mohini’s Quest
episodesList.summary: Danveer and Thakurain Mala meet in secret, where Mala tells Danveer to introduce her to Rudra. Meanwhile, Mohini overhears Dilsher and Paro's conversation, and plans to discover the true identity of Paro. Later, Rudra gifts Paro some bangles.

episodesList.title: Rudra and Paro’s Sangeet Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Rudra gets angry when Parvati sings his mother's song and warns her to never sing it again. The next day, Danveer gives Rudra's mother's bracelet to Parvati. Later, Rudra warns Parvati to not reveal herself, but Mohini tries in vain to expose her.

episodesList.title: Rudra Blames Parvati for the Chaos
episodesList.summary: Mohini brings Parvati along to invite the women in the village for her Sangeet Ceremony to expose her identity. On their return, Rudra reveals to Parvati about her husband's truth. Later, Parvati makes excuses and refuses to attend the Sangeet.

episodesList.title: Mohini Recognizes Thakur’s Goons
episodesList.summary: Mohini notices Thakur's goon because of his odd behaviour, and recognizes him from the photo. Meanwhile, Laila is jealous of Parvati and warns Rudra that she will kill her. On hearing this, Rudra worries about Parvati.

episodesList.title: Tejawat Learns about Mala’s Past
episodesList.summary: Sumer and Mohini kidnap Thakur's goon and question him about Parvati. Meanwhile, Rudra worries about Parvati after Laila's threat to harm her. Later, Tejawat gets furious on learning about Rudra and Thakurain Mala's relationship.

episodesList.title: Mohini Meets Tejawat
episodesList.summary: Tejawat meets Mohini and he is shocked to see Parvati's photo in her hand. Meanwhile, Maithili gets upset thinking that she can never become a mother. Later, Sumer gets a call from a dealer after he informs Samrat about his plans to sell the haveli.

episodesList.title: Dilsher Worries about Rudra and Paro
episodesList.summary: Dilsher worries about Rudra's job which always lands him in danger. Meanwhile, Sumer makes a deal with Thakur Tejawat to hand over Parvati in exchage of a large sum of money.

episodesList.title: The Kidnapping Plot
episodesList.summary: Sumer strategically plans to have Parvati kidnapped in the middle of the night and handed over to Tejawat. He tries to do the needful, but fails and later, is shocked to find her in the house.

episodesList.title: Sumer and Bheema Conspire
episodesList.summary: Bheema calls Sumer and tells him that he has Maithili and he will return her if Sumer hands Parvati over to him. Later, Sumer informs Mohini about his conversation with Bheema, but Parvati overhears them and decides to go with Sumer.

episodesList.title: Mohini’s Twisted Motives
episodesList.summary: Parvati courageously rescues Maithili from the clutches of the thugs. Meanwhile, Mohini is sneaky as ever as she confesses to Sumer about her plans to exact revenge on Parvati. Also, the conflict between Parvati and Rudra rages on.

episodesList.title: Parvati Burns Her Hands
episodesList.summary: Everyone in the house is preparing for Rudra and Parvati's mehendi ritual, when Rudra notices Parvati in deep thought, and asks her about what she is thinking. Later, Parvati burns her hands to avoid putting mehendi or sign the papers.

episodesList.title: Mohini the Wicked
episodesList.summary: Major Rudra decides to trap Tejawat while the Mahashivratri Funfair is being celebrated. Meanwhile, he is unaware of her aunt Mohini's wicked plan to ruin his marriage with Parvati.

episodesList.title: Laila Mixes Poison in Haldi
episodesList.summary: The Haldi ritual begins and everyone puts haldi on Rudra and Parvati. Meanwhile, Laila mixes poison in Haldi and applies it on Parvati. But later when Rudra finds out about Laila's plan, he drags Parvati to wash off the haldi from her body.

episodesList.title: Parvati Refuses to Sign the Papers
episodesList.summary: When Rudra goes to meet Parvati, she pushes him away and tells him that she will not sign the papers. Later, Mohini steps on Parvati's saree and tears it, to delay Parvati from coming to the wedding venue.

episodesList.title: Mohini Conspires against Dilsher
episodesList.summary: Mohini plans to set Dilsher's room on fire. Sunheri calls for help when she sees the house on fire. Meanwhile, Tejawat gets Mala to drink the juice to get her unconscious so that he can execute his plan.

episodesList.title: Paro Hits Rudra
episodesList.summary: Parvati hits Rudra on the head with a rod and makes him unconscious after Rudra threatens to kill Tejawat. Earlier, she spurns Rudra by refusing to return to him and instead takes the support of Tejawat. Parvati also accuses Rudra of being a murderer.

episodesList.title: Tejawat Holds Paro at Gunpoint
episodesList.summary: Rudra holds Tejawat at his gunpoint, but Parvati hits him on the head. Meanwhile, Doctor informs Danveer that Dilsher is in critical condition. Later, Tejawat points a gun at Parvati and confesses about his crimes.

episodesList.title: Dilsher is Hospitalized
episodesList.summary: Amandeep informs Rudra about the fire in his house and his father's condition. Rudra immediately goes to the hospital and is shocked to see his dad's condition. Later, he gets agitated at his dad's state and decides to find the culprit.

episodesList.title: Parvati Faces Rudra’s Wrath
episodesList.summary: Rudra is furious at Parvati and blames her for Dilsher's condition. Elsewhere, Tejawat flees his place in fear of getting arrested. Later, Rudra is shocked to see his mother's photo alongside Tejawat.

episodesList.title: Rudra Finds out Truth about his Mother
episodesList.summary: Rudra is completely shattered on seeing his mother's picture at Tejawat's house, which confirms his father's words. He gets drunk and hurts his hand in distress. Later, Parvati helps him and covers his wound.

episodesList.title: Rudra Blames Parvati
episodesList.summary: Rudra is shocked to see Parvati with him and questions her on her presence, but Parvati replies that he only asked her to stay. Rudra then blames Parvati for his father's state. Later, Parvati sees Rudra in the temple and rushes towards him.

episodesList.title: Parvati Disguises Rudra
episodesList.summary: Rudra goes to the temple to pray for Dilsher, while Parvati urges Rudra to take her home, only to be refused. Meanwhile, Parvati takes Aman's help to disguise Rudra, and Danveer catches Parvati red handed but decides not to tell Rudra.

episodesList.title: Mohini Attempts to kill Dilsher
episodesList.summary: Parvati takes care of Dilsher's fever while Mohini hides behind the cupboard looking for an opportune moment to kill Dilsher. Later, Rudra catches Parvati under her veil with the tattoo on her hand and rushes to check on Dilsher.

episodesList.title: The Redemption of Parvati
episodesList.summary: Rudra orders Parvati to leave the house because of her questionable deeds. However, she refuses to go and seeks redemption. Later, Rudra asks Parvati to marry Sumer and fulfill her wish to make up for her actions.

episodesList.title: Parvati Seeks Rudra’s Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Parvati seeks Rudra's forgiveness and he agrees to forgive her only if she marries Sumer. Later, Parvati finds her childhood doll in Rudra's cupboard, which reveals Rudra to be the same boy at whom she threw it when she was a child.

episodesList.title: Parvati Reveals her Love
episodesList.summary: Parvati comes to know that Rudra is the man she knew about 15 years ago. She reveals that she was in love with him ever since they met for the first time, and tries to make Rudra believe that they are destined to be together.

episodesList.title: Mohini Brings Paro In
episodesList.summary: Rudra gets close to Paro, but on seing the Sindoor on Paro's forehead, he gets angry and walks away. He then drags Paro out of the house. Later, Rudra is shocked when Mohini tells him that Paro will stay inside the haveli.

episodesList.title: Rudra Asks Paro to Leave
episodesList.summary: Rudra and Sumer bicker over Parvati, and Sunehri apologizes to Parvati for doubting her intentions. Later, Parvati confronts Rudra to apologies but he insists on her leaving the house.

episodesList.title: Sumer’s Conspiracy against Rudra
episodesList.summary: Rudra gets annoyed by Parvati following him around and tells her to stand outside the house until he calls her in. Meanwhile, Rudra's father gains back his conscious. Later, Sumeer conspires against Rudra by taking a picture of Parvati drenched.

episodesList.title: Maithili Confesses
episodesList.summary: Dilsher advises Rudra to open his eyes, making him realise his feelings for Parvati. Later, Maitalee confesses to Rudra about the fire that occurred, knowing that he does not believe that Paravti attempted to burn Dilsher alive.

episodesList.title: Rudra Gets Suspended
episodesList.summary: Rudra is suspended from BSD for leaking the information to media about his secret mission in Birpur. Meanwhile, Parvati wears Rudra's mother's saree. Later, Rudra humiliates Parvati in front of his family and blames her for his suspension.

episodesList.title: Rudra Enforces Marriage on Paro
episodesList.summary: An intoxicated Rudra forces Paro for the marriage. He then creates a holy fire and promises to make her life hell. Later, he puts sindoor on her forehead and ties a thread around her neck to signify the mangalsutra.

episodesList.title: Rudra Tries Taking Revenge
episodesList.summary: Parvati questions Rudra for trying to ruin her life, when Rudra replies that he is doing this to avenge his job that is in danger because of her. He also tells her to get used to tears as he will be hurting her a lot more in the future.

episodesList.title: Mohini’s Plan to Ruin Rudra’s Image
episodesList.summary: Rudra finds out about Sumer's conspiracy and beats him up for endangering his job and dignity. After which, Mohini treats Sumer's wounds and they both plot against Rudra, to prove that he is an abusive husband. Later, Rudra tries to get his job back.

episodesList.title: Damayanti Suspects Rudra
episodesList.summary: Women from social welfare visit the haveli to enquire about Parvati. Damyanti is not convinced by Parvati's answer, hence she decides to stay at the haveli. Later, Rudra is instructed by the BSD officer to behave properly in front of Damyanti.

episodesList.title: Paro and Rudra Get Closer
episodesList.summary: The society welfare officers stay back as they still doubt Rudra and Parvati's intentions. Meanwhile, Mohini and the officers are shocked to see Parvati and Rudra getting closer, and later, Rudra asks Mohini not to interfere in his life.

episodesList.title: Mohini Hurts Parvati
episodesList.summary: Mohini calls Parvati into the kitchen, and asks her to help her with her errands. However, Mohini is in a vindictive mood and hatches a plan to have her burnt.

episodesList.title: Paro Proves Rudra’s Innocence
episodesList.summary: Damayanti and Phulwari witness Rudra shouting at Parvati. However, Parvati convinces Damayanti that her marriage is trouble free as Rudra is very caring and protective. Damayanti later says that said she will report Rudra as innocent.

episodesList.title: Rudra Takes Parvati to Jaipur
episodesList.summary: Rudra stresses over Parvati's injury, and later, cautions Mohini to avoid Parvati. Eventually, Rudra takes Parvati to Jaipur, and she is in awe of the big city as she absorbs the new experience.

episodesList.title: Rudra and Paro’s Dance
episodesList.summary: Parvati comes out of the room, scared of the darkness. Rudra also realizes his mistake and rushes upstairs to see Parvati standing in the corridor and consoles her. Later, V.K.Singh's wife throws a party, where Rudra and Parvati dance together.

episodesList.title: Devyani Blackmails Mohini
episodesList.summary: Geeta spikes Rudra and Parvati's drinks. Later, the inebriated pair express their true feelings to each other. Meanwhile, Maithili follows Devyani after seeing her taking money from Mohini.

episodesList.title: Rudra and Paro Confess their Love
episodesList.summary: Rudra and Paro confess their love for each other in a drunken state. Meanwhile, Mohini confronts Maithili when she gets home and Samrat is informed of his wife's absence. Later, Maithili tells him she had a gut feeling and followed the girl.

episodesList.title: Paro is Upset
episodesList.summary: Rudra makes fun of Paro which upsets her. He apologizes to her but she asks him to buy her bangles to mitigate the situation. Meanwhile, Mohini and Sumer make plans to eliminate Paro.

episodesList.title: Rudra Eats Laddoo
episodesList.summary: Paro and Rudra are becoming closer. Rudra gets a call from V.K Singh, who says that he is getting back his job only because of Paro. On hearing this, Rudra feels insulted and gets very angry. Mohini and Sumer conspire about Rudra's death.

episodesList.title: Rudra Gets Poisoned
episodesList.summary: Rudra faints when Parvati brings him food. He is admitted in the hospital and the family is shocked to discover that he has been poisoned. On the other hand, Maithili tries to find the source of the poison and suspects Mohini for the devious act.

episodesList.title: Mohini tries to Harm Rudra
episodesList.summary: Mohini tries to inject a needle in Rudra's body, but fails as Parvati walks in. Later, with Maithili's help, Parvati tries to find out who poisoned Rudra. She also goes to a temple to pray for Rudra after he is unconscious for more than 12 hours.

episodesList.title: Parvati Prays for Rudra’s Life
episodesList.summary: Rudra's condition begins to deteriorate. The Pandit advises Paro to appeal to God and relinquish something that is most valuable to her. However, Paro continues to pray and decides to leave Rudra the same day he recovers.

episodesList.title: Parvati Accuses Mohini
episodesList.summary: Rudra is discharged from the hospital. Parvati later accuses Mohini of poisoning Rudra, and asks Mohini to eat one of the laddoos she prepared to prove her innocence. At first, Mohini hesitates and gets angry but later she eats a laddoo.

episodesList.title: Mohini Holds Sumer Responsible
episodesList.summary: Rudra catches Sumer and Mohini going to the hospital, thereby finding out about Mohini getting poisoned. Mohini, to everyone's astonishment, deceitfully holds Sumer responsible for poisoning Parvati, Rudra and Danveer.

episodesList.title: Rudra’s Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Danveer casts Sumer away to an isolated place, and Mohini goes to meet Sumer and pledges to avenge his punishment. Meanwhile, Rudra is in two minds about his love for Parvati.

episodesList.title: Laila Escapes from Tejawat
episodesList.summary: While Rudra talks to Parvati about the trauma he and his father went through when his mother abandoned them, he gets a call from the police. They inform him that a woman has escaped from Tejawat's house. Later, the woman turns out to be Laila.

episodesList.title: Laila and Mohini Conspire
episodesList.summary: Laila puts on a show to be transformed and apologizes to Parvati. Meanwhile, Laila and Mohini conspire against Parvati and Rudra to satisfy their vengeance. Later, Mohini trains Laila to do pooja in order for her to stay in the house.

episodesList.title: Laila’s Plan Backfires
episodesList.summary: Laila plans to get close to Rudra by taking off a button of his shirt. When Rudra wears it, he tries to fix it and fails. Just when Laila is about to offer help, Parvati stitches the button and impresses Rudra, causing Laila's plan to backfire.

episodesList.title: Laila Plots Against Parvati
episodesList.summary: Laila pleads Rudra to forgive her and Parvati tries making Rudra happy. Seeing Rudra smile, Parvati dances happily which makes Laila jealous. Meanwhile, Maithili unknowingly throws water mixed with chili powder at Paro and she screams in agony.

episodesList.title: Parvati Gets Blinded
episodesList.summary: Laila mixes chilli powder along with the colours and hurts Parvati. Danveer argues with Mohini for secretly meeting Sumer. Maithili suspects Laila and alerts Parvati to stay away from her. Later, Rudra learns about the incident and yells at Maithili.

episodesList.title: Rudra Takes Food for Parvati
episodesList.summary: Rudra arrives at the dining table and Laila waits for him to sit and eat with her. Instead, Rudra serves himself and takes the plate to his room to eat along with Parvati. Meanwhile, Dilsher appreciates his concern for his wife.

episodesList.title: Parvati demands Rudra’s Explanation
episodesList.summary: Parvati wakes up to the lightning sound and goes in search of Rudra. Consequently, she overhears the conversation Rudra has with Laila, where Laila asks him to let go of her hand. Parvati then asks him the reason behind holding Laila's hands.

episodesList.title: Rudra Tells Parvati about his Past
episodesList.summary: Mohini and Laila conspire to separate Rudra and Parvati. Meanwhile, Rudra takes Parvati to his secret place and reveals to her, his past with Laila which shocks Parvati. Later, Laila gets happy seeing Parvati upset with Rudra.

episodesList.title: Parvati is Upset
episodesList.summary: Rudra thinks that Parvati is upset because of Laila. Parvati says she doesn't have problem with Laila, instead she is doubtful if she has any right on Rudra or their marriage is just for namesake. Later, she also shares her problem with Maithili.

episodesList.title: Parvati Gets Tensed
episodesList.summary: Sunheri, Maithili and Parvati decide to go for a puppet show. Meanwhile, Laila collides with someone at the market, only to realise that it is none other than Sumer. Later, during the puppet show Rudra realises Parvati is tensed and stops the show.

episodesList.title: Rudra Confronts the Supervisor
episodesList.summary: Rudra confronts the supervisor of the puppet show and demands an explanation for not showcasing the "Dhola Maro" story as agreed earlier. He confesses that Laila had paid him to incorporate 'Pari' in the story.

episodesList.title: Rudra Evicts Laila
episodesList.summary: Laila tells Mohini that Rudra can't throw her out of the house, as Parvati will not let that happen. Later, a doctor confirms that Laila's wounds will heal in couple of days, Rudra tells her to move out to a safe place where Tejawat cant reach her.

episodesList.title: Rudra Asks Laila to Leave
episodesList.summary: Rudra throws Laila's bag in the hall and asks Aman to let her out of the house. He then takes a leave from work and takes Parvati to the doctor for her eye check up. Later, Rudra walks to Parvati and asks her if she needs any help in folding clothes.

episodesList.title: Laila Slaps Sumer
episodesList.summary: Rudra and Parvati slip and fall while folding clothes and attraction ensues. Elsewhere, Laila asks Sumer to marry her and slaps him, and warns him not to touch her. Later, while she walks in the market, she is kidnapped.

episodesList.title: Laila is Shocked to see Tejawat
episodesList.summary: Dilsher discloses about giving money to Samrat. Mohini gets angry and yells at everyone for hiding this from her. In the market, Rudra and Paro enjoy an ice gola. Rudra gets a call from Aman, who informs about Laila. Laila gets shocked to see Tejawat.

episodesList.title: Rudra Shares his Secrets
episodesList.summary: Rudra consoles Parvati that he will never let anyone come between them. Rudra is overwhelmed and asks Parvati to sing. Meanwhile, Tejawat plans a plot with Laila assuring her to get Rudra back in her life. Tejawat introduces Laila to Thakuraen Mala.

episodesList.title: Tejawat Reveals Rudra’s Past
episodesList.summary: Tejawat tells Laila that Rudra Pratap is Thakurain's son. On the other hand, Rudra reveals the truth to Parvati that he is Thakurain Mala's son. Later, Tejawat plays a trick with Laila's mind to make a deal with Rudra in exchange of his mother.

episodesList.title: Parvati Decides to Go Away
episodesList.summary: Parvati reveals to Maithili about her promise to Lord Shiva and tells her that she wants to go away from Rudra's life. Later, Parvati does everything with passion as it is her last night with Rudra. In the end, Parvati confesses her love to Rudra before leaving.

episodesList.title: Parvati’s Promise to Leave Rudra
episodesList.summary: Parvati recalls the promise that she had made to Lord Shiva. She leaves the train compartment and hides from Rudra while he desperately searches for her. Meanwhile, Laila tries to release Maasa from Raja Shaheb.

episodesList.title: Rudra Tries to Stop Parvati
episodesList.summary: Rudra requests Parvati to stay with him. However, Parvati wishes to fulfill her promise made to Lord Shiva and go away from Rudra's life. Meanwhile, Laila successfully releases the abducted Maasa. Later, Thakursa desperately searches for Maasa.

episodesList.title: Rudra Unveils His Love
episodesList.summary: Parvati is shocked to see Rudra standing on the railway track. Although she tries to explain her decision, Rudra asks her to prove her love. In the end, Parvati scolds Rudra for his act and promises that she will never leave him.

episodesList.title: Rudra and Paro Shocked to see Mala
episodesList.summary: Rudra tells Maithili to send Parvati to the BSD office. Meanwhile, Mohini tells Sumer about Maithili's recent behavior and decides to teach her a lesson. Later, Rudra tries to express his feelings to Parvati, but Mala interrupts them.

episodesList.title: Tejawat’s Plans
episodesList.summary: While, Parvati hugs Rudra's mother, Rudra is shocked to see her . Meanwhile, Tejawat is shocked to know that Thakurain had gone to the BSD office and asks his men to move out. Parvati later asks a reluctant Rudra to connect with this mother.

episodesList.title: Rudra Takes out his Anger
episodesList.summary: Rudra takes out his anger on Mala, as she had left him alone 15 years back. Meanwhile, Parvati tries to console him, but he misunderstands her. Later, Rudra, who is drunk, tells Dilsher not to get tensed as Mala won't ever come back in their lives.

episodesList.title: Rudra is Furious
episodesList.summary: Rudra is shattered and furious to see Mala after fifteen years. Meanwhile, Mala expresses to Parvati her regret for having left Rudra and his father. However, Rudra shouts at Parvati for bringing Mala to their house and tells her to send Mala out of the house.

episodesList.title: Rudra Questions Mala’s Return
episodesList.summary: Rudra shouts at Parvati for bringing his mother, Mala back to the Haveli. However, Dilsher defends Parvati and tells Rudra that it was his wish to bring Mala back. Later, Mohini tells Mala not to interfere in any of her matters.

episodesList.title: Sumer’s Shocking Comeback
episodesList.summary: Rudra shouts at Parvati for bringing his mother, Mala back to the Haveli. However, Dilsher defends Parvati and tells Rudra that it was his wish to bring Mala back. Later, Mohini tells Mala not to interfere in any of her matters.

episodesList.title: Mohini Decides to Leave the Haveli
episodesList.summary: Mohini takes out her frustration and taunts Mala. She then shocks everyone by telling that she will leave the Haveli and go away. Meanwhile, Parvati asks Rudra to console Mala, as she is upset. Later, Rudra and Parvati share some romantic moments.

episodesList.title: Mala Leaves the House
episodesList.summary: Mala leaves a letter for Parvati and leaves Haveli, as she is hurt by Mohini's words. Next morning, Rudra gets angry as he reads Mala's letter. Meanwhile, Mohini decides to leave the house, but Parvati stops her. Later, Parvati asks Rudra's help to search.

episodesList.title: Parvati Requests Rudra
episodesList.summary: Parvati gets nervous after she finds out that Mala is missing from the house and asks Rudra to find her. Although he gets agitated in the beginning, Rudra takes Parvati along with him and goes in search of Mala.

episodesList.title: Mala Explains Her Situation
episodesList.summary: Mala tells the family members about the reason behind her absence. Later, Parvati tries to convince Rudra and tells him to get close to his mother. However, Rudra tells Parvati that he cannot change his mind.

episodesList.title: Rudra Shields Mala
episodesList.summary: Mala looks for Dilsher's assistance in enhancing her relationship with Rudra. Meanwhile, Mohini makes a scene before Ranawats and expresses her hatred towards Mala, Rudra indirectly shields Mala. Later, Rudra tries to express his emotions to Parvati.

episodesList.title: Rudra Admits His Adoration
episodesList.summary: Rudra admits his feelings to Parvati and takes their relationship to next level, he giver her Mangalsutra. Later, Rudra and Parvati spends some romantic time together but Rudra gets distracted with Mala's obstruction.

episodesList.title: Rudra Angry At Mala
episodesList.summary: Rudra wants to clear all the barriers between him and Paro, wants to go on honeymoon with Paro, but Paro hesitates. Rudra gets angry and scolds Mala for leaving them and going to Tejawat. Mala remains quiet. But, Dilsher slaps him.

episodesList.title: Rudra Does Not Accept His Mother
episodesList.summary: After her long exile with another man, Mala returns to Dilsher's house. That infuriates Rudra and he argues with his father. He speaks ill of her and leaves, and Mohini comes and taunts at Mala. Dilsher tries to defend her honor.

episodesList.title: Rudra Wants Answers
episodesList.summary: Rudra overhears his mother's side of story when she tells Paro. He goes and confronts his father asking for an explanation. Mala comes and takes the blame for their broken marriage. Rudra undergoes an emotional conflict and leaves.

episodesList.title: Parvati Yells at Mala
episodesList.summary: Paro convinces Rudra to accept Mala. To which Rudra replies that he doesn't want to reopen the closed chapters of the past, else, he will be shattered. Paro yells at Mala and tells her that as she is a guest in the house, she should be like a guest only.

episodesList.title: Parvati Gets Attacked
episodesList.summary: Parvati behaves indifferent to get Rudra close to his mother. Later, she goes to the market with Maithili, where a mystery man follows them and throws acid on Parvati. Whereas, Rudra suspects that its Tejawat who attacked Parvati as he wants revenge.

episodesList.title: Rudra Tries to find the Attacker
episodesList.summary: Rudra asks Maithili about the attacker but she has the same answer that was given by Paro. The BSD rounds up a few men for inquiry but to no avail. On the other hand, Mohini starts taunting Mala after the incident of acid attack. Later, that night Rudra takes proper care of Paro and she makes him do all the work.

episodesList.title: Samrat’s Marriage Plans
episodesList.summary: Mohini takes Samrat to Sisodiya's house to fix his marriage with Shatabadi. Later, Samrat finds the truth and walks out of the house. In the interim, Rudra helps Parvati with the decoration of the house and spends some intimate time with her.

episodesList.title: Stranger Invades the Haveli
episodesList.summary: When Parvati is alone in the dark corridor, a stranger comes and hugs her from behind and she assumes it is Rudra. But she gets startled when Rudra walks in from the other side. Rudra then chases the stranger, but he manages to escape.

episodesList.title: Parvati Fasts for Rudra’s Wellbeing
episodesList.summary: Thakurain Mala gives food for Rudra and Parvati, and informs Rudra about Parvati's fast, and asks them both to eat. Later, Parvati is followed by a goon in the market, but Rudra comes and helps her.

episodesList.title: Shatabdi Visits the House
episodesList.summary: Rudra catches the man who threw acid on Parvati. Meanwhile, Shatabdi visits the Ranawat house and sees Maithili, but Mohini keeps Maithili away from Shatabdi and manages to send her back. Later, Parvati plans a surprise for Rudra's birthday.

episodesList.title: Rudra Gets A Surprise
episodesList.summary: Rudra gets a surprise on his birthday from his family. Thakurain Mala later, feeds him cake and apologizes for the past, and Rudra forgives her and takes her blessings. Meanwhile, Shanthanu plans on taking revenge on Rudra and Parvati.

episodesList.title: Shantanu Attacks Rudra and Paro
episodesList.summary: Shantanu attacks Rudra and Parvati. Rudra tries to catch him, but he escapes and then calls Rudra and wishes him on his birthday, and tells him that he has caught the wrong person. Meanwhile, Mohini and Sumer plan for Samrat's second marriage.

episodesList.title: Shantanu Drops Sunehri Home
episodesList.summary: Shantanu goes to Rudra's house and finds it empty. Later, Ranawat family is worried about Sunehri not returning from college, and decide to go look for her. Meanwhile, Shantanu drops Sunehri home in his car to find out Rudra's address.

episodesList.title: Shantanu Enters the House
episodesList.summary: Shantanu enters Rudra's house in a BSD officer's disguise. Parvati later talks to Shantanu about how Rudra rescued her life. But, Rudra is suspicious of Shantanu, and inquiries him about his wrist injury.

episodesList.title: Rudra Doubts Shantanu
episodesList.summary: Rudra doubts Shantanu over his weird actions when Danveer talks about a secret being exposed. As Shantanu deliberately avoids the topic and escapes, Rudra decides to sneak into Shantanu's room to find his whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Rudra’s Fury
episodesList.summary: Rudra suspects Shantanu to be conman and becomes furious when someone replaces Parvati's gift. He then beats up Shantanu and the Ranawats try to calm him. Later, he receives a voicemail from an anonymous person claiming to have replaced the gift.

episodesList.title: Rudra Gets Suspended
episodesList.summary: Rudra is paranoid about Shantanu, but Parvati consoles him. Meanwhile, Mohini plans Samrat's marriage with Shatabdi. Later, Rudra gets suspended for misconduct and Parvati plans a romantic evening to cheer him up.

episodesList.title: Mohini Gets Samrat Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Shantanu pretends to save Parvati and shoots himself in the process. Meanwhile, Mohini and Sumer lure Samrat to a stranded place to kidnap him, but are shocked to see Maithili there. Later, the hired men successfully kidnap Samrat.

episodesList.title: Sumer is Married to Shatabdi
episodesList.summary: Parvati and Shantanu save Samrat from marrying Shatabdi. Meanwhile, Maithali learns about Mohini's intentions, but they both get shocked to see Sumer married to Shatabdi. Later, Sumer explains how he was trapped into marrying Shatabdi.

episodesList.title: Mohini Plans to get rid of Shatabdi
episodesList.summary: Danveer finds out about Mohini's plan for Samrat's second marriage, and yells at her and Sumer. Later, Mohini's idea to irritate Shatabdi and make her leave the house fails, as Shatabdi doesn't fall for her plans.

episodesList.title: Shantanu Proposes to Sunehri
episodesList.summary: Shantanu proposes to Sunheri and asks her to runaway with him, but she refuses to runaway and asks him to convince her family instead. Later, Parvati is scared on finding a bullet in her room, and Rudra consoles her saying he'll protect her.

episodesList.title: Parvati Doubts Shantanu’s Actions
episodesList.summary: Rudra and Parvati share a romantic moment. Meanwhile, Sumer adds itching powder in Shatavdi's bathing water right before her 'Muh Dikhayi'. Later, Parvati casts doubts on Shantanu as two villagers tell her about seeing Shantanu in Birpur earlier.

episodesList.title: Sunehri Elopes with Shantanu
episodesList.summary: Shantanu asks Parvati to speak to the family about his and Sunehri's marriage, but she refuses. Later, Rudra tells Parvati that the bullet she found was fired from a BSD gun. Meanwhile, Sunehri steals her mother's jewelry to elope with Shantanu.

episodesList.title: Parvati Finds out Shantanu’s truth
episodesList.summary: Shantanu convinces everyone that he loves Sunehri and wants to marry her. And everybody starts making arrangements for their marriage, but Parvati is still skeptical about Shantanu. Later, she discovers that Shantanu is not a BSD officer.

episodesList.title: Shantanu Shoots Parvati
episodesList.summary: Parvati finds out about Shantanu's motives, so Shantanu tries to kill Parvati. But Rudra comes in and rescues her, and gets him arrested. Later, an enraged Shantanu grabs the police's gun and shoots Parvati, but the bullet misses her.

episodesList.title: Ranawats are Blessed with Babies
episodesList.summary: The Ranawats welcome their two new-born babies. Rudra and Parvati welcome a baby boy whereas Sumer and Shatabdi have a baby girl. Meanwhile, Shantanu escapes from the prison with the primary motive to kill Parvati.

episodesList.title: Parvati Dies
episodesList.summary: Rudra kills Shantanu and tries to save Parvati, but she succumbs to her injuries. He promises her to always keep Dhruv happy. Then, seven years into the future, everyone is preparing for Dhruv's seventh birthday party.

episodesList.title: Rudra Becomes Nostalgic
episodesList.summary: The Ranawat family organizes a party on Dhruv's seventh birthday. During the party Rudra becomes nostalgic and thinks about Parvati. In the interim, Myrah comes to Udaipur where she encounters a thief and teaches him a good lesson.

episodesList.title: Rudra is Flabbergasted
episodesList.summary: Rudra and Dhruv miss Parvati a lot. Meanwhile, Rudra gets a new assignment to arrange Myrah's security. Dhruv gets shocked seeing Myrah who is Parvati's look-alike. Later, even Rudra is flabbergasted when he sees Myrah for the first time.

episodesList.title: Myrah Finds Rudra’s Wallet
episodesList.summary: Dhruv hears Maithili and Rudra's conversation about Myrah. Elsewhere, Myrah finds Rudra's wallet on the floor. Later, Dhruv sneaks out of home and goes to meet Myrah. Rudra saves Myrah from getting hurt, after she returns his wallet to him.

episodesList.title: Dhruv Believes Myrah is His Mother
episodesList.summary: Rudra gives Dhruv a reality check, telling his dead mom won't return and that Myrah is not his mom. Later, Myrah is forced to go back to the hotel. As Myrah happens to see the biscuit packet she gave Dhruv, she goes to the Ranawat house to meet him.

episodesList.title: Myrah Visits the Haveli
episodesList.summary: Myrah falls on Rudra's feet and seeks his permission to visit the Haveli. However, when Myrah asks the family's permission to reside in their house, Rudra refuses and asks her to leave immediately.

episodesList.title: Myrah Stays in the Haveli
episodesList.summary: Myrah visits Rudra's house and plans to stay. However, Rudra is unhappy to see Myrah and asks her to leave. Soon, Dhruv gets a call from a cabinet minister who happens to be Myrah's uncle. He orders Dhruv to keep Myrah in the house.

episodesList.title: Myrah Yells at Rudra
episodesList.summary: Myrah yells at Rudra for scolding Dhruv. On seeing this Maithili informs Myrah that Rudra was trying to save Dhruv from getting hurt and also tells her that Rudra's wife had passes away seven years ago. Later, Myrah apologises to Rudra.

episodesList.title: Rudra Blames Myrah
episodesList.summary: Myrah asks Dhruv to help her in folding clothes, so that she can pay him to buy a gift for Koel. But Dhruv falls down from a chair while trying to put a bag on the shelf and Rudra blames Myrah for Dhruv's injuries and shouts at her.

episodesList.title: Myrah Argues with Rudra
episodesList.summary: Myrah argues with Rudra and sleeps outside. Rudra then covers her with Parvati's shawl to which Druv comments that his mother has sent Myrah in their life. Later, Shatabdi cooks food for Myrah, to which Dhruv mixes red chilli powder.

episodesList.title: Myrah Reminds Rudra of his Past
episodesList.summary: Rudra laughs at Myrah. and in an attempt to stop him Myrah stumbles and falls on him. Later, Rudra sees Dhruv crying, and Maithili asks him to inform Myrah about her resemblance to Parvati, but Rudra refuses to do so.

episodesList.title: Myrah’s Prank Scares Everyone
episodesList.summary: Myrah tries to scare Rudra by playing one of Paro's songs. She jumps from behind and laughs at Rudra got getting scared. Myrah, after realizing her mistake, asks for everyone's forgiveness. However, Rudra shouts at her of playing the prank.

episodesList.title: Krishna Janmashtami
episodesList.summary: Koel and Dhruv plan costumes for Rudra and Myrah on the celebration of Janmashtami. Later, Myrah surprises everyone with her new dress and also sings a classical song for Krishna.

episodesList.title: Rudra and Myrah Become Friends
episodesList.summary: Myrah makes paratha for breakfast, which Rudra appreciates and a friendship blossoms between them. Meanwhile, when Maithili gets Rudra a marriage proposal, he denies saying that Parvati's memories are enough for him to live with.

episodesList.title: Myrah is Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Myrah is kidnapped and tied up in a warehouse by two strangers who were in the disguise of saree sellers. Rudra goes out in search of Myrah. Earlier, Myrah had suggested Rudra remarry for the sake of Dhruv but Rudra had rejected the idea.

episodesList.title: Rudra Rescues Myrah
episodesList.summary: Rudra goes in search of the kidnappers that have held Myrah captive. The kidnappers move her to a new hideout but Rudra finds their whereabouts and saves Myrah.

episodesList.title: Myrah Expresses her Endearment
episodesList.summary: Rudra meets Myrah and takes her home. Later, Rudra comforts Myrah as the doctor takes care of her. As the time passes, Rudra and Myrah begin to feel a strong connection.

episodesList.title: Myrah Begins Loving Rudra
episodesList.summary: Rudra sees Paro in Mayra and gets closer to her. Meanwhile, Maithili is shocked to see them together. Next morning, Maithali makes Rudra understand that Myrah is just Paro's look-alike and is not really Paro. By then, Myrah starts to love Rudra.

episodesList.title: Myrah Falls in Love
episodesList.summary: Myrah sees a picture of herself in Rudra's room and begins to assume that he loves her and wants to see her in a traditional dress. She dresses up and tries to confess her love to him but Rudra rejects her and says that he still loves his wife.

episodesList.title: Myrah Returns to the Haveli
episodesList.summary: Myrah takes a U-turn & returns to the Haveli along with Rudra after Rudra informs her about Dhruv's sudden sickness. Myrah promises to stay till Dhruv fully recovers.

episodesList.title: Rudra Yells at Myrah
episodesList.summary: Myrah prepares soup for Dhruv. Later, Rudra scolds Myrah when she plays Parvati's song to get Dhruv to sleep and also for touching Parvati's saree. Meanwhile, Shatabdi, Mohini and Sumer plan their next move to get Myrah and Rudra married.

episodesList.title: Myrah Decides to Move Out
episodesList.summary: Myrah refuses to talk to Rudra, after which, she decides to move out from Rudra's house and packs her clothes. Rudra later takes the siutcases of Myrah back to her room and again tries to speak to her, but she leaves from there. Meanwhile, Samrat is impressed.

episodesList.title: Rudra Stops Mohini
episodesList.summary: Samrat and Maithili sit together to have a romantic dinner, but Mohini interrupts them. On noticing this Myrah argues with Mohini and Mohini gets angry and goes to slap Myrah, but Rudra interferes and stops her.

episodesList.title: Myrah’s Affection towards Rudra
episodesList.summary: Myrah is surprised when Rudra extolls her good qualities and speaks to her with compassion. Later, Myrah and Rudra are shocked to see Rohit in the house. Rohit talks to Myrah and gets close to her.

episodesList.title: Dhruv Gets Upset
episodesList.summary: Myrah sees some of Parvati's clothes with Rudra and consoles herself thinking Rudra still loves Parvati. Later, Dhruv gets upset when he finds out that Myrah is getting married to Rohit.

episodesList.title: Myrah Convinces Samrat and Maithili
episodesList.summary: Dhruv starts crying when he gets to know about Myrah and Rohit's wedding. Meanwhile, she explains to Dhruv that she is not his mother. Later, Myrah tells Rudra the reason behind marrying Rohit and also convinces Samrat and Maithili to adopt a child.

episodesList.title: Rudra and Rohit Argue
episodesList.summary: The love triangle between Rudra, Myrah and Rohit heats up with Rudra and Rohit having a face off over Myrah's shopping trip. Later, Rudra calls a vendor home for Myrah's shopping needs.

episodesList.title: Samrat and Maithili Adopt a Child
episodesList.summary: Mohini tells Myrah that Maithili can't go for prayers since she is unable to bear a child. Meanwhile, Rohit offers Myrah a drink but she refuses it. Later, Myrah persuades Maithili and Samrat to adopt a child.

episodesList.title: Samrat and Maithili Leave the Haveli
episodesList.summary: The entire Ranawat family is shocked when Mohini shouts at Maithili for adopting a child. Whereas, Samrat leaves the house along with Maithili. Later, Rohit goes to Rudra's room and asks him if he has fallen in love with Myrah.

episodesList.title: Samrat and Maithili Return
episodesList.summary: Myrah stuns everyone by bringing the banished Maithli & Samrat back to the haveli. Myrah then further shocks Mohini by showing her the papers that state that Rudra is the new owner of the Haveli.

episodesList.title: Myrah Helps Rudra
episodesList.summary: Myrah helps Rudra get full ownership of the Haveli and brings Samrat along with his wife and child back. Rudra and Myrah begin to realise they have feelings for each other, but Rohit stuns Myrah by confessing that he loves her.

episodesList.title: Mohini Accepts Chhoti
episodesList.summary: Myrah offends Mohini at the breakfast table. Maithili then makes Myrah understand that Maa Ji is the foundation of their house and she should respect her. Eventually, Mohini accepts Choti as her granddaughter and asks for everyone's forgiveness.

episodesList.title: Myrah Gets Close to Rudra
episodesList.summary: Maithili suggests that Rudra accept his love for Myrah, but Rudra continues to try and ignore his feelings. Later, Parvati appears in Rudra's dream and advises him to start a new life with Myrah.

episodesList.title: Rudra’s Agony
episodesList.summary: Maithili urges Myrah to reconsider her decision to marry Rohit. While Rudra is in agony over his inability to express his love for Myrah, Rohit surprises Myrah with a ring. Later, Rudra gets drunk and lashes out at Myrah.

episodesList.title: Rudra Confesses his Love
episodesList.summary: Rudra confesses his love to Myrah. Myrah turns him down saying she cannot betray Rohit. Meanwhile, Maithili asks Myrah to take the right decision by following her heart. Later, Rohit tells Myrah his decision to marry her the next day.

episodesList.title: Rudra Confesses his Love
episodesList.summary: Rohit talks to Myrah about getting married the very next day. Rudra congratulates them though he is pained. Myrah later saves Rudra from the falling chandelier and this prompts Rudra to confess his love for her in a letter.

episodesList.title: Rudra and Myrah’s Get-together
episodesList.summary: Myrah tells Maithili about Rudra's letter. Meanwhile, Rohit watches a video message sent by Myrah and finds out that she loves Rudra. Later, Myrah tells Rudra about the marriage and gets close to him.

plotHtml:
Parvati, affectionately known as Paro, has pure hatred towards Bharat Suraksha Dal, aka BSD officers, holding them responsible for the death of her parents. She was brought up by Thakurain Mala, and has consistent nightmares about her parents' deaths. The corrupt Raja Tejawat arranges Paro's wedding with Varun who plans to smuggle weapons across the border during the wedding procession. The procession is disrupted by BSD officers led by Deputy Commandant Rudra Pratap Ranawat and Varun is killed.
An oblivious Parvati blames Rudra for her husband's death. Rudra suspects that she is a material witness and hopes that she will testify. To prevent this, Tejawat hires goons to murder her. Rudra relocates her to his paternal home but when his malicious aunt Mohini insults Parvati's virtue, Rudra's father covers for them and announces she is Rudra's fiance. Eventually, Parvati emotionally sympathizes with Rudra after learning that his mother eloped with another man, unaware that his mother is the Thakurain. On the day of her wedding to Rudra, Parvati chooses to trust Tejawat and flees with him only to discover the truth behind her marriage to Varun. Upon realizing her mistake, she also becomes aware of her love for Rudra and returns to him.
Parvati tries her best to win over Rudra but in vain. He is accused of domestic violence and loses his job after which in a drunken state, he marries Paro. Rudra is reinstated and initially rejects Paro for betraying him but recognizes that he loves her. The couple go through: Rudra recovering from paralysis of his right arm, the interruptions of his ex-girlfriend, Laila and their mutual hesitation to confess their love for each other. They eventually unite and confess their feelings.
Thakurain Mala and Rudra meet again but Rudra has pure hatred towards her. Paro tries hard to unite mother and son and is eventually successful. Touched by his efforts to forgive his mother for her, Paro and Rudra finally consummate their marriage. The family is happy till Rudra receives an anonymous call saying that Paro will be killed. For safety, the family relocates. Varun's younger brother, Shanthanu Kumar enters their house as a bodyguard seeking revenge. Parvati finds out and Rudra comes in time to save her. Shanthanu gets arrested. Later, Parvati becomes pregnant and gives birth to a boy that the couple name Dhruv. Their happiness ends abruptly, when Shanthanu escapes from prison and murders Parvati, who dies in Rudra's arms. Shantanu is killed by Rudra.

title: Ramleela – Ajay Devgn Ke Saath
summary:
Ramleela – Ajay Devgn Ke Saath (transl. Ramleela – With Ajay Devgn), commonly known as Ramleela, is a mythological on-stage musical drama, based on the Indian epic poem Ramayan. The show premiered on 21 October 2012 on Life OK and completed the story in five episodes on 18 November 2012. The show was narrated by Bollywood actor Ajay Devgn, who provided a prologue at the beginning of each episode or act. The show aired during the period from Dussehra (the day Rama killed Ravana) in October till Diwali in November (the day Rama returned to Ayodhya, after 14 years of exile).
The show was divided into 5- to 10-minute skits combined with songs and dances performed by the main cast and other actors. Bollywood actors and Indian television stars played the roles of the characters. The grand sets and choreographer Remo D'Souza were much appreciated.
plot:
Sage Vishwamitra's rituals are plagued by demons. Young princes Rama and Lakshmana (sons of King Dasharatha of Ayodhya) of Ayodhya battle and defeat the demons once and for all. The sage then travels with the brothers to the kingdom of Mithila. In Mithila, princess Sita prays to Goddess Gauri for a good husband and meets Rama in the garden. The two instantly fall in love with each other. Sita's father, King Janaka organizes a Swyamvar to find a suitor for his daughter. As per the condition, the one who is able to mount an arrow on the mythical bow of Lord Shiva shall marry Sita. At the ceremony, only Ram is successful and he marries Sita.
In Rama's state, Ayodhya, maidservant Manthara poisons Queen Kaikeyi's (King Dasharatha's third and last wife) mind in asking King Dashratha for her two pending boons —to make her son Bharat the next king of Ayodhya and to exile Rama from Ayodhya for the next 14 years. With a heavy heart, King Dashrath exiles his sons Rama. Rama's half-brother, Lakshman, and wife Sita also accompany him. Stricken with grief, obedient half-brother Bharata begins to rule Ayodhya under the name of rightful King Rama, who begins his exile in Panchvati.
After 12 years, Ram, Lakshman, and Sita are well acquainted with the forest. But they are yet to meet the most feared villain of all times - Ravana. One day Ravana's sister, Surpanakha accidentally meets Rama and gets attracted to him. However, when he refuses, she advances to kill Sita but Lakshmana cuts her nose. Hearing this, an enraged Raavan remembers his shameful defeat in the court of Mithila, years ago, during Sita's Swayamvar. He disguises as a sage, tricks Ram and Lakshmana into leaving their hut, and abducts Sita in their absence. Ram and Lakshman arrive in time to find a fatally hurt Jatayu near their hut, who tells them about Sita's abduction.
On the other hand, Hanuman is in search of two young boys, who are known to have entered the forest of Kishkinda with bows and arrows. While on the lookout, his cronies locate Ram and Lakshman. Hanuman disguises as a sage and approaches them to find out that they are Rama and Lakshmana. When he learns this, his happiness knows no bounds.
With Hanuman's alliance, Ram and Lakshman help Sugreeva free the kingdom of Kishkindha and his wife, from his traitor brother Bali, in return for which, Sugreeva provides his army, the "Vaanar Sena" to search for Sita. They learn from the deceased Jatayu's brother Sampati that Sita has been imprisoned in the Ashok Vatika of Raavan's Lanka. Here in Lanka, Raavan threatens Sita, that if she doesn't accept him within a month, he will devour her rightfully.
Hanuman flies over the ocean and lands in Lanka. He successfully reaches the Ashok Vatika, where he imparts Ram's message to a distraught Sita. As he leaves, he destroys the Ashok Vatika to teach Raavan a lesson. Raavan's demons and sons capture Hanuman. Raavan orders his clergies to kill the monkey, but Vibhishan brings to his notice that it is Raavan's own rule that a king can punish a messenger, but not kill him. Raavan agrees upon this and asks his clergies to set fire to Hanuman's tail. As the clergies do so, Hanuman fights everyone and sets Lanka afire with his burning tail.
Hanuman comes back and they gear up to go to Lanka and fight against Raavan for his evil deed. They throw huge boulders into the ocean water, with "Shree Ram" written over them, and thus they make their way towards Lanka. While in Lanka, Lord Vishnu's greatest devotee, Vibhishan is worried about what will happen if Ram himself comes to Lanka. When he tries to bring his fears to Raavan's notice, Raavan tries to tempt Vibhishan with his wealth but when he fails, he kicks Vibhishan out of Lanka. But Ram greets Vibhishana in his army with great respect and honor.
A fierce battle sets, where Raavan's son, Meghanad fights Angada, Vibhishan, and Jambavan and defeats them. As Ram sets out to fight him, Lakshman chooses to fight instead and gets fatally injured in the attempt. A distraught Ram calls for help. Vaid Sushenu of Lanka arrives and examines Lakshman, only to admit that he is severely injured, and only a herb called "Sanjeevani", located in the mountain ranges of Himalayas can save his life. Ram requests Hanuman to get the herb in time, which Hanuman readily agrees to and sets out immediately. But in the mountain ranges, Hanuman faces a challenge when the mountain asks him to answer certain questions before they tell him the location of the herb. As Hanuman notices that time is running out, he lifts the mountain and flies his way back with it and saves Lakshman's life.
Just before the war, Raavan asks his soldiers to wake up his brother, Kumbhakarana, who has been sleeping for 6 months. After he wakes up he fights Ram in the battlefield but is killed. Ravan also receives the news of Meghnad's death. Raavan's wife Mandodari breaks down as she hears this, and tries convincing her husband to return Sita but Raavan ignores her pleas. In the battlefield, Ravana fights Ram and his army, and after much of a showdown, Vibhishan tells Ram the secret of Raavan's survival. Ram sets a bow towards Raavan's belly and kills him.
After the battle, Ram and Sita finally meet and everyone returns to Ayodhya, where the royal family and especially, Bharat are awaiting their arrival. The city of Ayodhya rejoices their beloved king's arrival and celebrates Diwali on the occasion.
